source.name: Divinum Officium
source.calendar: General monastic calendar; Clear Creek local propers not applied

017e4de5bce7ef4244ea.english: ℣. O Lord, + open thou my lips.

65890ff17991c309f21e.latin: ℟. Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
65890ff17991c309f21e.english: ℟. And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

bae8479f280aba1e7721.english: ℣. O Lord, open thou my lips.

0e4ad00ed33dd1a9259e.latin: 3:2 Dómine, quid multiplicáti sunt qui tríbulant me? * multi insúrgunt advérsum me.
0e4ad00ed33dd1a9259e.english: 3:2 Why, O Lord, are they multiplied that afflict me? * many are they who rise up against me.

fa20daaff635a036d5c8.latin: 3:3 Multi dicunt ánimæ meæ: * Non est salus ipsi in Deo eius.
fa20daaff635a036d5c8.english: 3:3 Many say to my soul: * There is no salvation for him in his God.

d001677d7a4974559e07.latin: 3:4 Tu autem, Dómine, suscéptor meus es, * glória mea, et exáltans caput meum.
d001677d7a4974559e07.english: 3:4 But thou, O Lord art my protector, * my glory, and the lifter up of my head.

a49328b3f65ff304bbb2.latin: 3:5 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * et exaudívit me de monte sancto suo.
a49328b3f65ff304bbb2.english: 3:5 I have cried to the Lord with my voice: * and he hath heard me from his holy hill.

4bd7566d42ecf50ceb05.latin: 3:6 Ego dormívi, et soporátus sum: * et exsurréxi, quia Dóminus suscépit me.
4bd7566d42ecf50ceb05.english: 3:6 I have slept and taken my rest: * and I have risen up, because the Lord hath protected me.

49db7f580ca2ae3bbb9b.latin: 3:7 Non timébo míllia pópuli circumdántis me: * exsúrge, Dómine, salvum me fac, Deus meus.
49db7f580ca2ae3bbb9b.english: 3:7 I will not fear thousands of the people, surrounding me: * arise, O Lord; save me, O my God.

9d134fe03db3c6dc9c01.latin: 3:8 Quóniam tu percussísti omnes adversántes mihi sine causa: * dentes peccatórum contrivísti.
9d134fe03db3c6dc9c01.english: 3:8 For thou hast struck all them who are my adversaries without cause: * thou hast broken the teeth of sinners.

b93e8156961f6ac09037.latin: 3:9 Dómini est salus: * et super pópulum tuum benedíctio tua.
b93e8156961f6ac09037.english: 3:9 Salvation is of the Lord: * and thy blessing is upon thy people.

0b2169031ec92f562716.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
0b2169031ec92f562716.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

9c33890601b92232e9d6.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
9c33890601b92232e9d6.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

1d4c2c235082af9840e8.latin: Ant. Regem Angelórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
1d4c2c235082af9840e8.english: Ant. The Lord, He is the King of the Angels, * O come, let us worship Him.

62b181a7993e12bc26ad.latin: Veníte, exsultémus Dómino, iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
62b181a7993e12bc26ad.english: Come let us praise the Lord with joy: let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.

78e4fa817d6ec9b88c68.latin: Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.
78e4fa817d6ec9b88c68.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

d57d31fccca09f0b7cc6.english: Ant. O come, let us worship Him.

7f04d10591b05664cd5c.latin: Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius (genuflectitur) veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
7f04d10591b05664cd5c.english: For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. (genuflect) Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

9568f2397e0e5927e2bc.latin: Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
9568f2397e0e5927e2bc.english: Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.

e227ba7ea9fe40aedc05.latin: Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
e227ba7ea9fe40aedc05.english: Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

38578ea48f1b436e4c70.latin:
Custódes hóminum psállimus Angelos,
Natúræ frágili quos Pater áddidit
Cæléstis cómites, insidiántibus
Ne succúmberet hóstibus.
Nam, quod corrúerit próditor ángelus,
Concéssis mérito pulsus honóribus,
Ardens invídia péllere nítitur
Quos cælo Deus ádvocat.
Huc, custos, ígitur pérvigil ádvola,
Avértens pátria de tibi crédita
Tam morbos ánimi quam requiéscere
Quidquid non sinit íncolas.
Sanctæ sit Tríadi laus pia iúgiter,
Cuius perpétuo númine máchina
Triplex hæc régitur, cuius in ómnia
Regnat glória sǽcula.
Amen.
38578ea48f1b436e4c70.english:
Angel-guardians of men, spirits and powers we sing,
Whom our Father hath sent, aids to our weakly frame,
Heavenly friends and guides, help from on high to bring,
Lest we fail through the foeman's wile.
He, the spoiler of souls, angel-traitor of old,
Cast in merited wrath out of his honoured place,
Burns with envy and hate, seeking their souls to gain
Whom God's mercy invites to heaven.
Therefore come to our help, watchful ward of our lives:
Turn aside from the land God to thy care confides
Sickness and woe of soul, yea, and what else of ill
Peace of heart to its folk denies.
Now to the Holy Three praise evermore resound:
Under whose hand divine resteth the triple world
Governed in wondrous wise: glory be theirs and might
While the ages unending run.
Amen.

40c45d1c0937a7b4759b.latin: Ant. Inclína Dómine, * aurem tuam, et exáudi me. ‡
40c45d1c0937a7b4759b.english: Ant. Incline thy ear, O Lord, * and hear me. ‡

39d23d4ae14ff59ae384.latin: 85:1 Inclína, Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me: * ‡ quóniam inops, et pauper sum ego.
39d23d4ae14ff59ae384.english: 85:1 Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me: * ‡ for I am needy and poor.

936bf90bfa809509dcfc.latin: 85:2 Custódi ánimam meam, quóniam sanctus sum: * salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperántem in te.
936bf90bfa809509dcfc.english: 85:2 Preserve my soul, for I am holy: * save thy servant, O my God, that trusteth in thee.

ab4d72f86a48117a5879.latin: 85:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam ad te clamávi tota die: * lætífica ánimam servi tui, quóniam ad te, Dómine, ánimam meam levávi.
ab4d72f86a48117a5879.english: 85:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to thee all the day. * Give joy to the soul of thy servant, for to thee, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.

5d0129fa3769b6cf46ce.latin: 85:5 Quóniam tu, Dómine, suávis, et mitis: * et multæ misericórdiæ ómnibus invocántibus te.
5d0129fa3769b6cf46ce.english: 85:5 For thou, O Lord, art sweet and mild: * and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.

70b96cd7070b5d4f115d.latin: 85:6 Áuribus pércipe, Dómine, oratiónem meam: * et inténde voci deprecatiónis meæ.
70b96cd7070b5d4f115d.english: 85:6 Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer: * and attend to the voice of my petition.

04dfb559df27227cc175.latin: 85:7 In die tribulatiónis meæ clamávi ad te: * quia exaudísti me.
04dfb559df27227cc175.english: 85:7 I have called upon thee in the day of my trouble: * because thou hast heard me.

aed941d8268d19561a87.latin: 85:8 Non est símilis tui in diis, Dómine: * et non est secúndum ópera tua.
aed941d8268d19561a87.english: 85:8 There is none among the gods like unto thee, O Lord: * and there is none according to thy works.

676004506aba04207e5c.latin: 85:9 Omnes gentes quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine: * et glorificábunt nomen tuum.
676004506aba04207e5c.english: 85:9 All the nations thou hast made shall come and adore before thee, O Lord: * and they shall glorify thy name.

10cfc844dfa74dbd665e.latin: 85:10 Quóniam magnus es tu, et fáciens mirabília: * tu es Deus solus.
10cfc844dfa74dbd665e.english: 85:10 For thou art great and dost wonderful things: * thou art God alone.

cb80d96959209990bf21.latin: 85:11 Deduc me, Dómine, in via tua, et ingrédiar in veritáte tua: * lætétur cor meum ut tímeat nomen tuum.
cb80d96959209990bf21.english: 85:11 Conduct me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: * let my heart rejoice that it may fear thy name.

eb1130f9e846a62fbd9a.latin: 85:12 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Deus meus, in toto corde meo, * et glorificábo nomen tuum in ætérnum:
eb1130f9e846a62fbd9a.english: 85:12 I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, * and I will glorify thy name for ever:

29c2a0f6286c30d21e93.latin: 85:13 Quia misericórdia tua magna est super me: * et eruísti ánimam meam ex inférno inferióri.
29c2a0f6286c30d21e93.english: 85:13 For thy mercy is great towards me: * and thou hast delivered my soul out of the lower hell.

d6a4a814a3b507455bb5.latin: 85:14 Deus, iníqui insurrexérunt super me, et synagóga poténtium quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt te in conspéctu suo.
d6a4a814a3b507455bb5.english: 85:14 O God, the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul: * and they have not set thee before their eyes.

6f7999c5fce20a2e49a7.latin: 85:15 Et tu, Dómine, Deus miserátor et miséricors, * pátiens, et multæ misericórdiæ, et verax,
6f7999c5fce20a2e49a7.english: 85:15 And thou, O Lord, art a God of compassion, and merciful, * patient, and of much mercy, and true.

ecd24a7ace510ed74e20.latin: 85:16 Réspice in me, et miserére mei, * da impérium tuum púero tuo: et salvum fac fílium ancíllæ tuæ.
ecd24a7ace510ed74e20.english: 85:16 O look upon me, and have mercy on me: * give thy command to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.

5a4967e796d09e1f3f2b.latin: 85:17 Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut vídeant qui odérunt me, et confundántur: * quóniam tu, Dómine, adiuvísti me, et consolátus es me.
5a4967e796d09e1f3f2b.english: 85:17 Shew me a token for good: that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, * because thou, O Lord, hast helped me and hast comforted me.

8f9c5c2834da1836405c.latin: 86:1 Fundaménta eius in móntibus sanctis: * díligit Dóminus portas Sion super ómnia tabernácula Iacob.
8f9c5c2834da1836405c.english: 86:1 The foundations thereof are in the holy mountains: * The Lord loveth the gates of Sion above all the tabernacles of Jacob.

cd8bb67717f66fd6abf0.latin: 86:3 Gloriósa dicta sunt de te, * cívitas Dei.
cd8bb67717f66fd6abf0.english: 86:3 Glorious things are said of thee, * O city of God.

c761f9ef4813d7e6c5ce.latin: 86:4 Memor ero Rahab, et Babylónis * sciéntium me.
c761f9ef4813d7e6c5ce.english: 86:4 I will be mindful of Rahab and of Babylon * knowing me.

7315d55bff6885161978.latin: 86:4 Ecce, alienígenæ, et Tyrus, et pópulus Æthíopum, * hi fuérunt illic.
7315d55bff6885161978.english: 86:4 Behold the foreigners, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians, * these were there.

c22f0741d962d7dcaea4.latin: 86:5 Numquid Sion dicet: Homo, et homo natus est in ea: * et ipse fundávit eam Altíssimus?
c22f0741d962d7dcaea4.english: 86:5 Shall not Sion say: This man and that man is born in her? * and the Highest himself hath founded her.

849be92d2af9e5fdf45a.latin: 86:6 Dóminus narrábit in scriptúris populórum, et príncipum: * horum, qui fuérunt in ea.
849be92d2af9e5fdf45a.english: 86:6 The Lord shall tell in his writings of peoples and of princes, * of them that have been in her.

fd39deebc98d108796d5.latin: 86:7 Sicut lætántium ómnium * habitátio est in te.
fd39deebc98d108796d5.english: 86:7 The dwelling in thee * is as it were of all rejoicing.

9cb67c8304d2cfdc0c70.latin: Ant. Inclína Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me.
9cb67c8304d2cfdc0c70.english: Ant. Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me.

88a670977998b583b2f9.english: Ant. Blessed be * the Lord for evermore.

6c713d9219083b20219e.english: 88:2 The mercies of the Lord * I will sing for ever.

5fc8636766aeffcecb30.latin: 88:2 In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.
5fc8636766aeffcecb30.english: 88:2 I will shew forth thy truth with my mouth * to generation and generation.

c6f694b629389cca8121.latin: 88:3 Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.
c6f694b629389cca8121.english: 88:3 For thou hast said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens: * thy truth shall be prepared in them.

a9150178972c3e5ecb6d.latin: 88:4 Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, iurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.
a9150178972c3e5ecb6d.english: 88:4 I have made a covenant with my elect: I have sworn to David my servant: * Thy seed will I settle for ever.

2e7c7a921cf7d512891a.latin: 88:5 Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.
2e7c7a921cf7d512891a.english: 88:5 And I will build up thy throne * unto generation and generation.

49e5448380dd26c2a99b.latin: 88:6 Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.
49e5448380dd26c2a99b.english: 88:6 The heavens shall confess thy wonders, O Lord: * and thy truth in the church of the saints.

23ab6943a3919f7d4687.latin: 88:7 Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?
23ab6943a3919f7d4687.english: 88:7 For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord: * or who among the sons of God shall be like to God?

167fad3a750fa7a4647a.latin: 88:8 Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu eius sunt.
167fad3a750fa7a4647a.english: 88:8 God, who is glorified in the assembly of the saints: * great and terrible above all them that are about him.

1932d061f2708003ac15.latin: 88:9 Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.
1932d061f2708003ac15.english: 88:9 O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? * thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

6d8fabd71dec60e891c4.latin: 88:10 Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum eius tu mítigas.
6d8fabd71dec60e891c4.english: 88:10 Thou rulest the power of the sea: * and appeasest the motion of the waves thereof.

a09e6212df374934a350.latin: 88:11 Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.
a09e6212df374934a350.english: 88:11 Thou hast humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: * with the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

a670a4be8cf35dd89c22.latin: 88:12 Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem eius tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.
a670a4be8cf35dd89c22.english: 88:12 Thine are the heavens, and thine is the earth: the world and the fulness thereof thou hast founded: * the north and the sea thou hast created.

344f35267cd91028fcd1.latin: 88:13 Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
344f35267cd91028fcd1.english: 88:13 Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name: * thy arm is with might.

03169f110e95de5311e6.latin: 88:14 Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * iustítia et iudícium præparátio sedis tuæ.
03169f110e95de5311e6.english: 88:14 Let thy hand be strengthened, and thy right hand exalted: * justice and judgment are the preparation of thy throne.

bdc261d967569c266408.latin: 88:15 Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit iubilatiónem.
bdc261d967569c266408.english: 88:15 Mercy and truth shall go before thy face: * blessed is the people that knoweth jubilation.

ca0255bcb4256fead765.latin: 88:16 Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in iustítia tua exaltabúntur.
ca0255bcb4256fead765.english: 88:16 They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance: and in thy name they shall rejoice all the day, * and in thy justice they shall be exalted.

4b3cf8160bc2ca80705f.latin: 88:18 Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.
4b3cf8160bc2ca80705f.english: 88:18 For thou art the glory of their strength: * and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.

6cbe0ce3abf2cafef1c0.latin: 88:19 Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.
6cbe0ce3abf2cafef1c0.english: 88:19 For our protection is of the Lord, * and of our king the holy one of Israel.

fbb0be8fb1eccfb73d9a.latin: 88:20 Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adiutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.
fbb0be8fb1eccfb73d9a.english: 88:20 Then thou spokest in a vision to thy saints, and saidst: * I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.

15716e167a56214ab8ff.latin: 88:21 Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.
15716e167a56214ab8ff.english: 88:21 I have found David my servant: * with my holy oil I have anointed him.

194022eb6d2a214b9b40.latin: 88:22 Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.
194022eb6d2a214b9b40.english: 88:22 For my hand shall help him: * and my arm shall strengthen him.

c22c73cea5220f144e0a.latin: 88:23 Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.
c22c73cea5220f144e0a.english: 88:23 The enemy shall have no advantage over him: * nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.

3155381d318716deac9d.latin: 88:24 Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos eius: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.
3155381d318716deac9d.english: 88:24 And I will cut down his enemies before his face; * and them that hate him I will put to flight.

bdc223d378d1f85a779e.latin: 88:25 Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu eius.
bdc223d378d1f85a779e.english: 88:25 And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: * and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

ed7861e8299f7462c159.latin: 88:26 Et ponam in mari manum eius: * et in flumínibus déxteram eius.
ed7861e8299f7462c159.english: 88:26 And I will set his hand in the sea; * and his right hand in the rivers.

0fcdac6f92c39eaca990.latin: 88:27 Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.
0fcdac6f92c39eaca990.english: 88:27 He shall cry out to me: Thou art my father: * my God, and the support of my salvation.

a993c556c33079bb482e.latin: 88:28 Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.
a993c556c33079bb482e.english: 88:28 And I will make him my firstborn, * high above the kings of the earth.

d4a87a33b86c02f3dc38.latin: 88:29 In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.
d4a87a33b86c02f3dc38.english: 88:29 I will keep my mercy for him for ever: * and my covenant faithful to him.

11e8239741a7877aad8a.latin: 88:30 Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen eius: * et thronum eius sicut dies cæli.
11e8239741a7877aad8a.english: 88:30 And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: * and his throne as the days of heaven.

2f4fee6d556cd2d2a2db.latin: 88:31 Si autem derelíquerint fílii eius legem meam: * et in iudíciis meis non ambuláverint:
2f4fee6d556cd2d2a2db.english: 88:31 And if his children forsake my law, * and walk not in my judgments:

be61bd1955b9ba734867.latin: 88:32 Si iustítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:
be61bd1955b9ba734867.english: 88:32 If they profane my justices: * and keep not my commandments:

bb0a47642fddc44b542e.latin: 88:33 Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.
bb0a47642fddc44b542e.english: 88:33 I will visit their iniquities with a rod: * and their sins with stripes.

fe9aca92ec6de4bdb9bd.latin: 88:34 Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:
fe9aca92ec6de4bdb9bd.english: 88:34 But my mercy I will not take away from him: * nor will I suffer my truth to fail.

6bee5e036193ac0ff545.latin: 88:35 Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.
6bee5e036193ac0ff545.english: 88:35 Neither will I profane my covenant: * and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.

7c2315d621e54fcfad42.latin: 88:36 Semel iurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen eius in ætérnum manébit.
7c2315d621e54fcfad42.english: 88:36 Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David: * his seed shall endure for ever.

31cdda6f283a50bfd908.latin: 88:37 Et thronus eius sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.
31cdda6f283a50bfd908.english: 88:37 And his throne as the sun before me: * and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven.

6c55c0169513241f2818.latin: 88:39 Tu vero repulísti et despexísti: * distulísti Christum tuum.
6c55c0169513241f2818.english: 88:39 But thou hast rejected and despised: * thou hast been angry with thy anointed.

305525bcc9a3dedbe421.latin: 88:40 Evertísti testaméntum servi tui: * profanásti in terra Sanctuárium eius.
305525bcc9a3dedbe421.english: 88:40 Thou hast overthrown the covenant of thy servant: * thou hast profaned his sanctuary on the earth.

490becb908a2c45ffdbe.latin: 88:41 Destruxísti omnes sepes eius: * posuísti firmaméntum eius formídinem.
490becb908a2c45ffdbe.english: 88:41 Thou hast broken down all his hedges: * thou hast made his strength fear.

c72aa6e56c11a44312d3.latin: 88:42 Diripuérunt eum omnes transeúntes viam: * factus est oppróbrium vicínis suis.
c72aa6e56c11a44312d3.english: 88:42 All that pass by the way have robbed him: * he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

c33eaac1389d6c5ec14d.latin: 88:43 Exaltásti déxteram depriméntium eum: * lætificásti omnes inimícos eius.
c33eaac1389d6c5ec14d.english: 88:43 Thou hast set up the right hand of them that oppress him: * thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

b7cdfd06a042969f6010.latin: 88:44 Avertísti adiutórium gládii eius: * et non es auxiliátus ei in bello.
b7cdfd06a042969f6010.english: 88:44 Thou hast turned away the help of his sword; * and hast not assisted him in battle.

0eb2d396da665d78b807.latin: 88:45 Destruxísti eum ab emundatióne: * et sedem eius in terram collisísti.
0eb2d396da665d78b807.english: 88:45 Thou hast made his purification to cease: * and thou hast cast his throne down to the ground.

94d4104525410e54ec24.latin: 88:46 Minorásti dies témporis eius: * perfudísti eum confusióne.
94d4104525410e54ec24.english: 88:46 Thou hast shortened the days of his time: * thou hast covered him with confusion.

917e36145c434be9feaa.latin: 88:47 Úsquequo, Dómine, avértis in finem: * exardéscet sicut ignis ira tua?
917e36145c434be9feaa.english: 88:47 How long, O Lord, turnest thou away unto the end? * shall thy anger burn like fire?

98d576e5b1a153191eba.latin: 88:48 Memoráre quæ mea substántia: * numquid enim vane constituísti omnes fílios hóminum?
98d576e5b1a153191eba.english: 88:48 Remember what my substance is: * for hast thou made all the children of men in vain?

61791ea2c3d9eddf1410.latin: 88:49 Quis est homo, qui vivet, et non vidébit mortem: * éruet ánimam suam de manu ínferi?
61791ea2c3d9eddf1410.english: 88:49 Who is the man that shall live, and not see death: * that shall deliver his soul from the hand of hell?

bbf3cbd2b76efbfac3d5.latin: 88:50 Ubi sunt misericórdiæ tuæ antíquæ, Dómine, * sicut iurásti David in veritáte tua?
bbf3cbd2b76efbfac3d5.english: 88:50 Lord, where are thy ancient mercies, * according to what thou didst swear to David in thy truth?

05b85290d7ca45f0365f.latin: 88:51 Memor esto, Dómine, oppróbrii servórum tuórum * quod contínui in sinu meo multárum géntium.
05b85290d7ca45f0365f.english: 88:51 Be mindful, O Lord, of the reproach of thy servants * which I have held in my bosom of many nations:

df6058f0fc7a6300e337.latin: 88:52 Quod exprobravérunt inimíci tui, Dómine, * quod exprobravérunt commutatiónem Christi tui.
df6058f0fc7a6300e337.english: 88:52 Wherewith thy enemies have reproached, O Lord; * wherewith they have reproached the change of thy anointed.

d96e1e3b6d473a170766.latin: 88:53 Benedíctus Dóminus in ætérnum: * fiat, fiat.
d96e1e3b6d473a170766.english: 88:53 Blessed be the Lord for evermore. * So be it. So be it.

6d5ead7e962f249609fd.english: Ant. Blessed be the Lord for evermore.

86afe8141c5e14bfa38a.english: Ant. Lift up thyself, * thou that judgest the earth.

ab11e8939047a80c1af5.latin: 75:2 Notus in Iudǽa Deus: * in Israël magnum nomen eius.
ab11e8939047a80c1af5.english: 75:2 In Judea God is known: * his name is great in Israel.

6195eb1f0f0dac47420a.latin: 75:3 Et factus est in pace locus eius: * et habitátio eius in Sion.
6195eb1f0f0dac47420a.english: 75:3 And his place is in peace: * and his abode in Sion:

8ff0de2b82c492711491.latin: 75:4 Ibi confrégit poténtias árcuum, * scutum, gládium, et bellum.
8ff0de2b82c492711491.english: 75:4 There hath he broken the powers of bows, * the shield, the sword, and the battle.

af404d611a9654ee15ba.latin: 75:5 Illúminans tu mirabíliter a móntibus ætérnis: * turbáti sunt omnes insipiéntes corde.
af404d611a9654ee15ba.english: 75:5 Thou enlightenest wonderfully from the everlasting hills. * All the foolish of heart were troubled.

ffaba46f24338499915e.latin: 75:6 Dormiérunt somnum suum: * et nihil invenérunt omnes viri divitiárum in mánibus suis.
ffaba46f24338499915e.english: 75:6 They have slept their sleep; * and all the men of riches have found nothing in their hands.

4aae7e6109ffbd46680d.latin: 75:7 Ab increpatióne tua, Deus Iacob, * dormitavérunt qui ascendérunt equos.
4aae7e6109ffbd46680d.english: 75:7 At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, * they have all slumbered that mounted on horseback.

b2f0511100192e6627e7.latin: 75:8 Tu terríbilis es, et quis resístet tibi? * ex tunc ira tua.
b2f0511100192e6627e7.english: 75:8 Thou art terrible, and who shall resist thee? * from that time thy wrath.

8ce9b230ce44f7fd6295.latin: 75:9 De cælo audítum fecísti iudícium: * terra trémuit et quiévit,
8ce9b230ce44f7fd6295.english: 75:9 Thou hast caused judgment to be heard from heaven: * the earth trembled and was still,

a1faed7a209a3dfec763.latin: 75:10 Cum exsúrgeret in iudícium Deus, * ut salvos fáceret omnes mansuétos terræ.
a1faed7a209a3dfec763.english: 75:10 When God arose in judgment, * to save all the meek of the earth.

ee67e38e12be40902c6c.latin: 75:11 Quóniam cogitátio hóminis confitébitur tibi: * et relíquiæ cogitatiónis diem festum agent tibi.
ee67e38e12be40902c6c.english: 75:11 For the thought of man shall give praise to thee: * and the remainders of the thought shall keep holiday to thee.

4b53c78a250a5fafd598.latin: 75:12 Vovéte, et réddite Dómino, Deo vestro: * omnes, qui in circúitu eius affértis múnera.
4b53c78a250a5fafd598.english: 75:12 Vow ye, and pay to the Lord your God: * all you that are round about him bring presents.

0e16f9cf00bf5ba99c15.latin: 75:13 Terríbili et ei qui aufert spíritum príncipum, * terríbili apud reges terræ.
0e16f9cf00bf5ba99c15.english: 75:13 To him that is terrible, even to him who taketh away the spirit of princes: * to the terrible with the kings of the earth.

53892cd178efa7690da6.latin: 93:1 Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.
53892cd178efa7690da6.english: 93:1 The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongeth: * the God of revenge hath acted freely.

bf1cf12754b62264b850.latin: 93:2 Exaltáre, qui iúdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.
bf1cf12754b62264b850.english: 93:2 Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth: * render a reward to the proud.

128419f3f60404dceb28.latin: 93:3 Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:
128419f3f60404dceb28.english: 93:3 How long shall sinners, O Lord: * how long shall sinners glory?

677b4d26178394294b73.latin: 93:4 Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur iniustítiam?
677b4d26178394294b73.english: 93:4 Shall they utter, and speak iniquity: * shall all speak who work injustice?

94b807dcd8a2dbe83766.latin: 93:5 Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.
94b807dcd8a2dbe83766.english: 93:5 Thy people, O Lord, they have brought low: * and they have afflicted thy inheritance.

e86db28be5e0903009cf.latin: 93:6 Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.
e86db28be5e0903009cf.english: 93:6 They have slain the widow and the stranger: * and they have murdered the fatherless.

87c59223a371ef5a4095.latin: 93:7 Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Iacob.
87c59223a371ef5a4095.english: 93:7 And they have said: The Lord shall not see: * neither shall the God of Jacob understand.

4ab6c16b30b078e08613.latin: 93:8 Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.
4ab6c16b30b078e08613.english: 93:8 Understand, ye senseless among the people: * and, you fools, be wise at last.

eeca35c1ff6e83f3c72e.latin: 93:9 Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?
eeca35c1ff6e83f3c72e.english: 93:9 He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? * or he that formed the eye, doth he not consider?

d0fd312a3e874284c2cd.latin: 93:10 Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?
d0fd312a3e874284c2cd.english: 93:10 He that chastiseth nations, shall he not rebuke: * he that teacheth man knowledge?

d8f7d6e98eb19e78df12.latin: 93:11 Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.
d8f7d6e98eb19e78df12.english: 93:11 The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men, * that they are vain.

a81db1555b331827d9ba.latin: 93:12 Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,
a81db1555b331827d9ba.english: 93:12 Blessed is the man whom thou shalt instruct, O Lord: * and shalt teach him out of thy law.

540235b01b899a49fa71.latin: 93:13 Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.
540235b01b899a49fa71.english: 93:13 That thou mayst give him rest from the evil days: * till a pit be dug for the wicked.

b5b48f11df297abfae01.latin: 93:14 Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.
b5b48f11df297abfae01.english: 93:14 For the Lord will not cast off his people: * neither will he forsake his own inheritance.

f37aead8d1bbdffb0e98.latin: 93:15 Quoadúsque iustítia convertátur in iudícium: * et qui iuxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.
f37aead8d1bbdffb0e98.english: 93:15 Until justice be turned into judgment: * and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.

11ad3b201af3e0d2934a.latin: 93:16 Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?
11ad3b201af3e0d2934a.english: 93:16 Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? * or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity?

71488fe292eb9d5195dd.latin: 93:17 Nisi quia Dóminus adiúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.
71488fe292eb9d5195dd.english: 93:17 Unless the Lord had been my helper, * my soul had almost dwelt in hell.

19a558118541cad9a8ed.latin: 93:18 Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adiuvábat me.
19a558118541cad9a8ed.english: 93:18 If I said: My foot is moved: * thy mercy, O Lord, assisted me.

70b9ce8e95f1739567c3.latin: 93:19 Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.
70b9ce8e95f1739567c3.english: 93:19 According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, * thy comforts have given joy to my soul.

bac969b890eca9fd4823.latin: 93:20 Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?
bac969b890eca9fd4823.english: 93:20 Doth the seat of iniquity stick to thee, * who framest labour in commandment?

14fe9c0de61bf5b453f5.latin: 93:21 Captábunt in ánimam iusti: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.
14fe9c0de61bf5b453f5.english: 93:21 They will hunt after the soul of the just, * and will condemn innocent blood.

fb2a73365a38a60184ee.latin: 93:22 Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adiutórium spei meæ.
fb2a73365a38a60184ee.english: 93:22 But the Lord is my refuge: * and my God the help of my hope.

a37504a5e1bb3d3c5005.latin: 93:23 Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
a37504a5e1bb3d3c5005.english: 93:23 And he will render them their iniquity: and in their malice he will destroy them: * the Lord our God will destroy them.

13d713a3519f3b78efc9.english: Ant. Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth.

eb225746dd9b27fe267b.english: ℣. Let my prayer come before Thee, O Lord.

605c8d98e84f056d3d8d.latin: ℟. Inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam.
605c8d98e84f056d3d8d.english: ℟. Incline Thine ear unto my cry.
