f44847bd6768b4799003.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

f8c5e47767bd5f54ae90.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
f8c5e47767bd5f54ae90.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

1b18527818cb1fccadf4.latin: Absolutio. Ipsíus píetas et misericórdia nos ádiuvet, qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivit et regnat in sǽcula sæculórum.
1b18527818cb1fccadf4.english: Absolution. May His loving-kindness and mercy help us, Who liveth and reigneth with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, world without end.

bb405e8257e9d677c72b.latin:
℣. Iube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. A cunctis vítiis et peccátis absólvat nos virtus sanctæ Trinitátis.
℟. Amen.
Lectio unica
Sermo sancti Bernárdi Abbátis
In Psalmum Qui habitat
Angelis suis mandávit de te. Mira dignátio, et vere magna diléctio caritátis. Quis enim? quibus? de quo? quid mandávit? Studióse considerémus, fratres, diligénter commendémus memóriæ hoc tam grande mandátum. Quis enim mandávit? cuius sunt Angeli? cuius mandátis obtémperant? cuius obédiunt voluntáti? Nempe Angelis suis mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis. Nec cunctántur quin étiam in mánibus tollant te. Summa ergo Maiéstas mandávit Angelis, et Angelis suis mandávit. Illis útique sublímibus, tam beátis quam próximis sibi cohæréntibus et vere domésticis mandávit de te. Tu quis es? Quid est homo, quod memor es eius? aut fílius hóminis, quóniam réputas eum? Quasi vero non sit homo putrédo, et fílius hóminis vermis! Sed quid putas mandávit de te? Ut custódiant te.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟. Angelis suis Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis:
* In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
℣. Míllia míllium ministrábant ei, et décies míllies centéna míllia assistébant ei.
℟. In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. In mánibus portábunt te, ne umquam offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
bb405e8257e9d677c72b.english:
℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benediction. Of all faults and sins may the power of the holy Trinity absolve us.
℟. Amen.
Lectio unica
From the Sermons of St. Bernard, Abbot (of Clairvaux.)
On Ps. xc
He hath given His Angels charge over thee. A wonderful graciousness, and a wonderful outpouring of love. For who hath given charge? And what charge? Unto whom? And over whom? Let us carefully consider, my brethren, let us carefully hold in mind this great charge. For who hath given this charge? To Whom belong the Angels? Whose commandments do they obey, and Whose will do they do? He hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways, and that not carelessly, for they shall bear thee up in their hands. The Highest Majesty, therefore, hath given charge unto Angels, even His Angels. Unto these beings so excellently exalted, so blessed, so near to Himself, even as His own household, unto these hath He given charge over thee. Who art thou? What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? or the son of man, that Thou visitest him? (Ps. viii. 5.) Even as though man were not rottenness, and the son of man, a worm. (Job. xxv. 6.) But what charge hath He given them over thee? To keep thee in all thy ways.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟. God hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
* They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
℣. Thousands of thousands ministered unto Him, and ten thousand times hundreds of thousands stood before Him.
℟. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest haply thou dash thy foot against a stone.

7bf2f443d9c2927965ec.latin: 95:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
7bf2f443d9c2927965ec.english: 95:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.

4501f65d53aeab59b8e0.latin: 95:2 Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini eius: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre eius.
4501f65d53aeab59b8e0.english: 95:2 Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.

726f35bf20328835451d.latin: 95:3 Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam eius, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília eius.
726f35bf20328835451d.english: 95:3 Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.

33f927f8a71ecfb8454d.latin: 95:4 Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
33f927f8a71ecfb8454d.english: 95:4 For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.

72a173bbbfac3741bf89.latin: 95:5 Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
72a173bbbfac3741bf89.english: 95:5 For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.

d65e9598b7ec91fb79ed.latin: 95:6 Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu eius: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne eius.
d65e9598b7ec91fb79ed.english: 95:6 Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.

5c33c3711a5ae6f9f26c.latin: 95:7 Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini eius.
5c33c3711a5ae6f9f26c.english: 95:7 Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.

c6a1d10658f40924c2c2.latin: 95:8 Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria eius: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto eius.
c6a1d10658f40924c2c2.english: 95:8 Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.

d7f7bb8e32c3e4b3adbd.latin: 95:9 Commoveátur a fácie eius univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
d7f7bb8e32c3e4b3adbd.english: 95:9 Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.

cb1c805813ff2ba80def.latin: 95:10 Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * iudicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
cb1c805813ff2ba80def.english: 95:10 For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.

1b7901871aeebc04effc.latin: 95:11 Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
1b7901871aeebc04effc.english: 95:11 Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.

1f7fba75d2d751f64870.latin: 95:12 Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
1f7fba75d2d751f64870.english: 95:12 Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

f634581996dd1abdb15f.latin: 95:13 Iudicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
f634581996dd1abdb15f.english: 95:13 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.

ce5a51250eadebaa6703.latin: 96:1 Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
ce5a51250eadebaa6703.english: 96:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.

d3198b13dcbc18f84b35.latin: 96:2 Nubes, et calígo in circúitu eius: * iustítia, et iudícium corréctio sedis eius.
d3198b13dcbc18f84b35.english: 96:2 Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.

41e0f937b3b45a54b1dd.latin: 96:3 Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos eius.
41e0f937b3b45a54b1dd.english: 96:3 A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.

fe8527aad697762e72ed.latin: 96:4 Illuxérunt fúlgura eius orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
fe8527aad697762e72ed.english: 96:4 His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.

f49ad58824a83acfae58.latin: 96:5 Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
f49ad58824a83acfae58.english: 96:5 The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.

97d4a84f864453c6730a.latin: 96:6 Annuntiavérunt cæli iustítiam eius: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam eius.
97d4a84f864453c6730a.english: 96:6 The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.

1a153f329351cf1f3ab0.latin: 96:7 Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
1a153f329351cf1f3ab0.english: 96:7 Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.

e180673ab47f293d975a.latin: 96:7 Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
e180673ab47f293d975a.english: 96:7 Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.

5d827f27dabfb07c65d9.latin: 96:8 Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Iudæ, * propter iudícia tua, Dómine:
5d827f27dabfb07c65d9.english: 96:8 And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.

8ec1076dcb2ee54fae2f.latin: 96:9 Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
8ec1076dcb2ee54fae2f.english: 96:9 For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.

758dc92b7e3408f2ae1f.latin: 96:10 Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
758dc92b7e3408f2ae1f.english: 96:10 You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.

e47517e1dc1374e0d2ab.latin: 96:11 Lux orta est iusto, * et rectis corde lætítia.
e47517e1dc1374e0d2ab.english: 96:11 Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.

2a9aa3fcc58be5b2a31f.latin: 96:12 Lætámini, iusti, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis eius.
2a9aa3fcc58be5b2a31f.english: 96:12 Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.

445c665bea59e6b699d2.latin: 97:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * quia mirabília fecit.
445c665bea59e6b699d2.english: 97:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * because he hath done wonderful things.

473c1683932521d718e5.latin: 97:1 Salvávit sibi déxtera eius: * et brácchium sanctum eius.
473c1683932521d718e5.english: 97:1 His right hand hath wrought for him salvation, * and his arm is holy.

ee8b1e6b0578f0a81f70.latin: 97:2 Notum fecit Dóminus salutáre suum: * in conspéctu géntium revelávit iustítiam suam.
ee8b1e6b0578f0a81f70.english: 97:2 The Lord hath made known his salvation: * he hath revealed his justice in the sight of the Gentiles.

8172b344b883cbf50748.latin: 97:3 Recordátus est misericórdiæ suæ, * et veritátis suæ dómui Israël.
8172b344b883cbf50748.english: 97:3 He hath remembered his mercy * and his truth toward the house of Israel.

df823ebf1aa3b679b617.latin: 97:3 Vidérunt omnes términi terræ * salutáre Dei nostri.
df823ebf1aa3b679b617.english: 97:3 All the ends of the earth have seen * the salvation of our God.

f27b7b48073d0e0ab7a6.latin: 97:4 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * cantáte, et exsultáte, et psállite.
f27b7b48073d0e0ab7a6.english: 97:4 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth; * make melody, rejoice and sing.

ecc8d00cd181c3c0615c.latin: 97:5 Psállite Dómino in cíthara, in cíthara et voce psalmi: * in tubis ductílibus, et voce tubæ córneæ.
ecc8d00cd181c3c0615c.english: 97:5 Sing praise to the Lord on the harp, on the harp, and with the voice of a psalm: * with long trumpets, and sound of cornet.

7c14f78cee15091cd78c.latin: 97:6 Iubiláte in conspéctu regis Dómini: * moveátur mare, et plenitúdo eius: orbis terrárum, et qui hábitant in eo.
7c14f78cee15091cd78c.english: 97:6 Make a joyful noise before the Lord our king: * let the sea be moved and the fulness thereof: the world and they that dwell therein.

a1752cbb93c9c2637846.latin: 97:8 Flúmina plaudent manu, simul montes exsultábunt a conspéctu Dómini: * quóniam venit iudicáre terram.
a1752cbb93c9c2637846.english: 97:8 The rivers shall clap their hands, the mountains shall rejoice together at the presence of the Lord: * because he cometh to judge the earth.

a965f7f03491627b54d9.latin: 97:9 Iudicábit orbem terrárum in iustítia, * et pópulos in æquitáte.
a965f7f03491627b54d9.english: 97:9 He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with equity.

4956244020a3afbdc9b6.latin: 98:1 Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.
4956244020a3afbdc9b6.english: 98:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the people be angry: * he that sitteth on the cherubims: let the earth be moved.

8040826f5e17e916603e.latin: 98:2 Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
8040826f5e17e916603e.english: 98:2 The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all people.

ad920d704c2cc90d0b2d.latin: 98:3 Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis iudícium díligit.
ad920d704c2cc90d0b2d.english: 98:3 Let them give praise to thy great name: for it is terrible and holy: * and the king’s honour loveth judgment.

2851388b956ddb73d955.latin: 98:4 Tu parásti directiónes: * iudícium et iustítiam in Iacob tu fecísti.
2851388b956ddb73d955.english: 98:4 Thou hast prepared directions: * thou hast done judgment and justice in Jacob.

9c9c7e959fd997fafb1b.latin: 98:5 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum eius: * quóniam sanctum est.
9c9c7e959fd997fafb1b.english: 98:5 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.

2a3550e955a2aa6082eb.latin: 98:6 Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus eius: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen eius:
2a3550e955a2aa6082eb.english: 98:6 Moses and Aaron among his priests: * and Samuel among them that call upon his name.

96d67897b63f27f6b326.latin: 98:6 Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
96d67897b63f27f6b326.english: 98:6 They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.

66994150ed30d594b1fe.latin: 98:7 Custodiébant testimónia eius, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
66994150ed30d594b1fe.english: 98:7 They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.

b6da932835334cef52f8.latin: 98:8 Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
b6da932835334cef52f8.english: 98:8 Thou didst hear them, O Lord our God: * thou wast a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.

42634cbf07089cfd6dcd.latin: 98:9 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto eius: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.
42634cbf07089cfd6dcd.english: 98:9 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore at his holy mountain: * for the Lord our God is holy.

c18d27c1ee1b871aa0c8.latin: 91:2 Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
c18d27c1ee1b871aa0c8.english: 91:2 It is good to give praise to the Lord: * and to sing to thy name, O most High.

bce635f4a6ba9fdca339.latin: 91:3 Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.
bce635f4a6ba9fdca339.english: 91:3 To shew forth thy mercy in the morning, * and thy truth in the night:

4a482e55ab41b917cb67.latin: 91:4 In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.
4a482e55ab41b917cb67.english: 91:4 Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: * with a canticle upon the harp.

ae0d0e85dc923346272e.latin: 91:5 Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
ae0d0e85dc923346272e.english: 91:5 For thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in thy doings: * and in the works of thy hands I shall rejoice.

7096bbbc54bdb628c81a.latin: 91:6 Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
7096bbbc54bdb628c81a.english: 91:6 O Lord, how great are thy works! * thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

a0328d2496f9a176a299.latin: 91:7 Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.
a0328d2496f9a176a299.english: 91:7 The senseless man shall not know: * nor will the fool understand these things.

ef75680c36f41099aabc.latin: 91:8 Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:
ef75680c36f41099aabc.english: 91:8 When the wicked shall spring up as grass: * and all the workers of iniquity shall appear:

89685e1a4b7340866bc1.latin: 91:9 Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
89685e1a4b7340866bc1.english: 91:9 That they may perish for ever and ever: * but thou, O Lord, art most high for evermore.

03edd848f6bddc0f988f.latin: 91:10 Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.
03edd848f6bddc0f988f.english: 91:10 For behold thy enemies, O Lord, for behold thy enemies shall perish: * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

b5897cc2c9df88331284.latin: 91:11 Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
b5897cc2c9df88331284.english: 91:11 But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: * and my old age in plentiful mercy.

23cf8d4244bcb473daf3.latin: 91:12 Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
23cf8d4244bcb473daf3.english: 91:12 My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: * and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

c33ebe43fa9aa7c52cc8.latin: 91:13 Iustus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
c33ebe43fa9aa7c52cc8.english: 91:13 The just shall flourish like the palm tree: * he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

b89e86d4b462be034edb.latin: 91:14 Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
b89e86d4b462be034edb.english: 91:14 They that are planted in the house of the Lord * shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

0958ce86dd654e1322d8.latin: 91:15 Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
0958ce86dd654e1322d8.english: 91:15 They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: * and shall be well treated, that they may shew,

122e0cf7ea5d6f0720be.latin: 91:16 Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.
122e0cf7ea5d6f0720be.english: 91:16 That the Lord our God is righteous, * and there is no iniquity in him.

1080fa32e698d22257b1.latin: 100:1 Misericórdiam, et iudícium * cantábo tibi, Dómine:
1080fa32e698d22257b1.english: 100:1 Mercy and judgment * I will sing to thee, O Lord:

7845488f34c1f185fb2c.latin: 100:2 Psallam, et intéllegam in via immaculáta, * quando vénies ad me.
7845488f34c1f185fb2c.english: 100:2 I will sing, and I will understand in the unspotted way, * when thou shalt come to me.

35585758fc19369b1bd4.latin: 100:2 Perambulábam in innocéntia cordis mei, * in médio domus meæ.
35585758fc19369b1bd4.english: 100:2 I walked in the innocence of my heart, * in the midst of my house.

4759c5e7e7f6f80f07a1.latin: 100:3 Non proponébam ante óculos meos rem iniústam: * faciéntes prævaricatiónes odívi.
4759c5e7e7f6f80f07a1.english: 100:3 I did not set before my eyes any unjust thing: * I hated the workers of iniquities.

85dd7174ab33123e95ac.latin: 100:4 Non adhǽsit mihi cor pravum: * declinántem a me malígnum non cognoscébam.
85dd7174ab33123e95ac.english: 100:4 The perverse heart did not cleave to me: * and the malignant, that turned aside from me, I would not know.

1eecdba59f8c9a15b467.latin: 100:5 Detrahéntem secréto próximo suo, * hunc persequébar.
1eecdba59f8c9a15b467.english: 100:5 The man that in private detracted his neighbour, * him did I persecute.

ecffe4194d0656280a19.latin: 100:5 Supérbo óculo, et insatiábili corde, * cum hoc non edébam.
ecffe4194d0656280a19.english: 100:5 With him that had a proud eye, and an unsatiable heart, * I would not eat.

5d700d8e2b5f1177340b.latin: 100:6 Óculi mei ad fidéles terræ ut sédeant mecum: * ámbulans in via immaculáta, hic mihi ministrábat.
5d700d8e2b5f1177340b.english: 100:6 My eyes were upon the faithful of the earth, to sit with me: * the man that walked in the perfect way, he served me.

6721918e98fb05bcd69d.latin: 100:7 Non habitábit in médio domus meæ qui facit supérbiam: * qui lóquitur iníqua, non diréxit in conspéctu oculórum meórum.
6721918e98fb05bcd69d.english: 100:7 He that worketh pride shall not dwell in the midst of my house: * he that speaketh unjust things did not prosper before my eyes.

71a0e1e232016edd6d85.latin: 100:8 In matutíno interficiébam omnes peccatóres terræ: * ut dispérderem de civitáte Dómini omnes operántes iniquitátem.
71a0e1e232016edd6d85.english: 100:8 In the morning I put to death all the wicked of the land: * that I might cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the Lord.

1fab3c6cf091c5d938cc.latin:
Exod. 23:21
Nec contemnéndum putes, quia non dimíttet cum peccáveris, et est nomen meum in illo.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Ascéndit fumus arómatum in conspéctu Dómini.
℟. De manu Angeli.
1fab3c6cf091c5d938cc.english:
Exod. 23:21
Take notice of him, and hear his voice, and do not think him one to be contemned: for he will not forgive when thou hast sinned, and my name is in him.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. The smoke of the incense ascended up before the Lord.
℟. Out of the Angel's hand.

98acc87d3a7fc9762b3c.latin: Kýrie, eléison. Christe, eléison. Kýrie, eléison.
98acc87d3a7fc9762b3c.english: Lord have mercy upon us, Christ have mercy upon us, Lord have mercy upon us.

807e5be448caf6c831c9.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
807e5be448caf6c831c9.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

c8bd4bf87b200f24083d.latin: Deus, qui ineffábili providéntia sanctos Angelos tuos ad nostram custódiam míttere dignáris: largíre supplícibus tuis; et eórum semper protectióne deféndi, et ætérna societáte gaudére.
c8bd4bf87b200f24083d.english: O God, Who in thine unspeakable Providence hast been pleased to give thine holy Angels charge over us, to keep us, mercifully grant unto our prayers, that we be both ever fenced by their wardship here, and everlastingly blessed by their fellowship hereafter.

1507840a34d6e65af268.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
1507840a34d6e65af268.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

caba3357bcade46e4002.latin: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
caba3357bcade46e4002.english: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

611b59dd68e2dd017141.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
611b59dd68e2dd017141.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

e401d23062280faa8035.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

cae1b7a405ac46b78581.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

03f640ccb05222682727.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
03f640ccb05222682727.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

1109d425f6faace3043d.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
1109d425f6faace3043d.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

cdde518423f350405be7.latin: 66:2 Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
cdde518423f350405be7.english: 66:2 May God have mercy on us, and bless us: * may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.

773cbd3cc84e8c901353.latin: 66:3 Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
773cbd3cc84e8c901353.english: 66:3 That we may know thy way upon earth: * thy salvation in all nations.

b289ca2cccaf92f4a4dc.latin: 66:4 Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
b289ca2cccaf92f4a4dc.english: 66:4 Let people confess to thee, O God: * let all people give praise to thee.

d32ae8f0e308b8ffdc4a.latin: 66:5 Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam iúdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
d32ae8f0e308b8ffdc4a.english: 66:5 Let the nations be glad and rejoice: * for thou judgest the people with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.

d64268a6464aa03d6f17.latin: 66:6 Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * terra dedit fructum suum.
d64268a6464aa03d6f17.english: 66:6 Let the people, O God, confess to thee: * let all the people give praise to thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.

d2386da81ab95f260bc8.latin: 66:7 Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
d2386da81ab95f260bc8.english: 66:7 May God, our God bless us, may God bless us: * and all the ends of the earth fear him.

e3808136cc7768478df2.latin: Ant. Angelis suis * Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
e3808136cc7768478df2.english: Ant. God hath given His Angels charge over thee, * to keep thee in all thy ways.

08df9456d16aa1051b37.latin: 92:1 Dóminus regnávit, decórem indútus est: * indútus est Dóminus fortitúdinem, et præcínxit se.
08df9456d16aa1051b37.english: 92:1 The Lord hath reigned, he is clothed with beauty: * the Lord is clothed with strength, and hath girded himself.

7487291380a75869eea3.latin: 92:1 Étenim firmávit orbem terræ, * qui non commovébitur.
7487291380a75869eea3.english: 92:1 For he hath established the world * which shall not be moved.

161422ffee1022fe6e3d.latin: 92:2 Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
161422ffee1022fe6e3d.english: 92:2 Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.

15378d792d862b33a637.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina, Dómine: * elevavérunt flúmina vocem suam.
15378d792d862b33a637.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up, O Lord: * the floods have lifted up their voice.

c8370f7b7f9623078868.latin: 92:3 Elevavérunt flúmina fluctus suos, * a vócibus aquárum multárum.
c8370f7b7f9623078868.english: 92:3 The floods have lifted up their waves, * with the noise of many waters.

027e68a65ee2449162bd.latin: 92:4 Mirábiles elatiónes maris: * mirábilis in altis Dóminus.
027e68a65ee2449162bd.english: 92:4 Wonderful are the surges of the sea: * wonderful is the Lord on high.

151a67b69d0dd0304b53.latin: 92:5 Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
151a67b69d0dd0304b53.english: 92:5 Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.

50c29048b62a37cb97b2.latin: Ant. Angelis suis Deus mandávit de te, ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
50c29048b62a37cb97b2.english: Ant. God hath given His Angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.

b72bb015f214558a07ea.latin: Ant. Laudémus Dóminum, * quem laudant Angeli, quem Chérubim et Séraphim, sanctus, sanctus, sanctus proclámant.
b72bb015f214558a07ea.english: Ant. Let us praise the Lord, * Whom the Angels do praise, unto Whom Cherubim and Seraphim do cry, Holy, Holy, Holy.

f064fb6fb1256eff8ed9.latin: 99:2 Iubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * servíte Dómino in lætítia.
f064fb6fb1256eff8ed9.english: 99:2 Sing joyfully to God, all the earth: * serve ye the Lord with gladness.

fab8e790df9b969c0806.latin: 99:2 Introíte in conspéctu eius, * in exsultatióne.
fab8e790df9b969c0806.english: 99:2 Come in before his presence * with exceeding great joy.

29a2ab0c94876156fc44.latin: 99:3 Scitóte quóniam Dóminus ipse est Deus: * ipse fecit nos, et non ipsi nos.
29a2ab0c94876156fc44.english: 99:3 Know ye that the Lord he is God: * he made us, and not we ourselves.

c970d150821e6693f201.latin: 99:3 Pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius: * introíte portas eius in confessióne, átria eius in hymnis: confitémini illi.
c970d150821e6693f201.english: 99:3 We are his people and the sheep of his pasture. * Go ye into his gates with praise, into his courts with hymns: and give glory to him.

902d70f7446ea40352bd.latin: 99:4 Laudáte nomen eius: quóniam suávis est Dóminus, in ætérnum misericórdia eius, * et usque in generatiónem et generatiónem véritas eius.
902d70f7446ea40352bd.english: 99:4 Praise ye his name: for the Lord is sweet, his mercy endureth for ever, * and his truth to generation and generation.

02c1842905b63a8b848c.latin: Ant. Laudémus Dóminum, quem laudant Angeli, quem Chérubim et Séraphim, sanctus, sanctus, sanctus proclámant.
02c1842905b63a8b848c.english: Ant. Let us praise the Lord, Whom the Angels do praise, unto Whom Cherubim and Seraphim do cry, Holy, Holy, Holy.

126caa1007b7b243aafd.latin: Ant. Angeli eórum * semper vident fáciem Patris mei, qui est in cælis.
126caa1007b7b243aafd.english: Ant. In heaven their Angels do always behold the face of My Father, * Which is in heaven.

96dcbd1b70c937a1a1d2.latin: 62:2 Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
96dcbd1b70c937a1a1d2.english: 62:2 O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

8096d0b87183eb0896a1.latin: 62:2 Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
8096d0b87183eb0896a1.english: 62:2 For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

5d9e0457e23d54e2c76e.latin: 62:3 In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: * sic in sancto appárui tibi, ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
5d9e0457e23d54e2c76e.english: 62:3 In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: * so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, to see thy power and thy glory.

fca68076fa421c3fe152.latin: 62:4 Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
fca68076fa421c3fe152.english: 62:4 For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

6b9938b647c7e2e0b8f5.latin: 62:5 Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
6b9938b647c7e2e0b8f5.english: 62:5 Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

aa3edcc6fedf03b54868.latin: 62:6 Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
aa3edcc6fedf03b54868.english: 62:6 Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

ed6f46717e4e1703e3fa.latin: 62:7 Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, in matutínis meditábor in te: * quia fuísti adiútor meus.
ed6f46717e4e1703e3fa.english: 62:7 If I have remembered thee upon my bed, I will meditate on thee in the morning: * because thou hast been my helper.

23f591b55fab9cd5579b.latin: 62:8 Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
23f591b55fab9cd5579b.english: 62:8 And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: my soul hath stuck close to thee: * thy right hand hath received me.

77e962cd013a25983b84.latin: 62:10 Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
77e962cd013a25983b84.english: 62:10 But they have sought my soul in vain, they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

6d4a5207e2abe2b1e5c5.latin: 62:12 Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, laudabúntur omnes qui iurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
6d4a5207e2abe2b1e5c5.english: 62:12 But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

08e66c894520351f532d.latin: Ant. Angeli eórum semper vident fáciem Patris mei, qui est in cælis.
08e66c894520351f532d.english: Ant. In heaven their Angels do always behold the face of My Father, Which is in heaven.

74419b85573b6739de53.latin: Ant. Benedíctus Deus, * qui misit Angelum suum, et éruit servos suos qui credidérunt in eum.
74419b85573b6739de53.english: Ant. Blessed be God, * Who sent His Angel, and delivered His servants that trusted in Him.

5768a040a07a298afe5f.english: Canticle of the Three Young Men [4]

6aa5688fdf5b48c75ebf.latin: 3:57 Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
6aa5688fdf5b48c75ebf.english: 3:57 All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

0bf7ba5a9bcaee5ea7e1.latin: 3:58 Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
0bf7ba5a9bcaee5ea7e1.english: 3:58 O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

30923c55ff8ece6b74df.latin: 3:59 Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
30923c55ff8ece6b74df.english: 3:59 O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

38e8aede2256489ed9c3.latin: 3:60 Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
38e8aede2256489ed9c3.english: 3:60 O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

4a02983a9f320cb85a3c.latin: 3:61 Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
4a02983a9f320cb85a3c.english: 3:61 O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

7efb8c3a1b836149d674.latin: 3:62 Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
7efb8c3a1b836149d674.english: 3:62 O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

651b9c404563746a32cb.latin: 3:63 Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
651b9c404563746a32cb.english: 3:63 O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

70b71da14225887c2253.latin: 3:64 Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
70b71da14225887c2253.english: 3:64 O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

4f27a43838bb302bd599.latin: 3:65 Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
4f27a43838bb302bd599.english: 3:65 O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

a08d71733f50effc98ed.latin: 3:66 Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
a08d71733f50effc98ed.english: 3:66 O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

60a71ae4b96192430db8.latin: 3:67 Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
60a71ae4b96192430db8.english: 3:67 O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

026b934624ad46cec022.latin: 3:68 Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
026b934624ad46cec022.english: 3:68 O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

ed6cb5adebff3aff6a11.latin: 3:69 Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
ed6cb5adebff3aff6a11.english: 3:69 O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

ed96b37af634ed071a08.latin: 3:70 Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
ed96b37af634ed071a08.english: 3:70 O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

5433bd8ffb6269d9a75a.latin: 3:71 Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
5433bd8ffb6269d9a75a.english: 3:71 O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

10810467e909577f46ab.latin: 3:72 Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
10810467e909577f46ab.english: 3:72 O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

d81e09c02e7b914acb3a.latin: 3:73 Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ iustórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
d81e09c02e7b914acb3a.english: 3:73 O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

37927855724912c213a8.latin: 3:74 Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
37927855724912c213a8.english: 3:74 O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

8f1a7d91e46ce89fb0db.latin: 3:75 (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
8f1a7d91e46ce89fb0db.english: 3:75 (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

67b34bbc74c2ed7e5315.latin: 3:56 Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
67b34bbc74c2ed7e5315.english: 3:56 Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

f73e9ccd480bb063f78b.latin: Ant. Benedíctus Deus, qui misit Angelum suum, et éruit servos suos qui credidérunt in eum.
f73e9ccd480bb063f78b.english: Ant. Blessed be God, Who sent His Angel, and delivered His servants that trusted in Him.

b6198c04c55b094cf782.latin: Ant. Laudáte Deum, * omnes Angeli eius: laudáte eum, omnes Virtútes eius.
b6198c04c55b094cf782.english: Ant. Praise ye God, * all His Angels Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

7b8f7191605c1f0a8709.latin: 148:1 Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
7b8f7191605c1f0a8709.english: 148:1 Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

6ee8fb84785225ec651c.latin: 148:2 Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli eius: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes eius.
6ee8fb84785225ec651c.english: 148:2 Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

fbde752035253ff2f94f.latin: 148:3 Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
fbde752035253ff2f94f.english: 148:3 Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

9a43b91138edf52501f0.latin: 148:4 Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
9a43b91138edf52501f0.english: 148:4 Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

a5c4c77e10fccf15c0d6.latin: 148:5 Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
a5c4c77e10fccf15c0d6.english: 148:5 For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

80eb6eaa9919bc15fe5f.latin: 148:6 Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
80eb6eaa9919bc15fe5f.english: 148:6 He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

e5bbc19296bc8d673bd6.latin: 148:7 Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
e5bbc19296bc8d673bd6.english: 148:7 Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

aace428740d187d77cb4.latin: 148:8 Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum eius:
aace428740d187d77cb4.english: 148:8 Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

a3644eefe0b58effb12c.latin: 148:9 Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
a3644eefe0b58effb12c.english: 148:9 Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

276124504ebfa6c789f0.latin: 148:10 Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
276124504ebfa6c789f0.english: 148:10 Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

ae6e8b3ad69b3ad56971.latin: 148:11 Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes iúdices terræ.
ae6e8b3ad69b3ad56971.english: 148:11 Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:

8a925636cce02818130e.latin: 148:12 Iúvenes, et vírgines: senes cum iunióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
8a925636cce02818130e.english: 148:12 Young men and maidens: let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * For his name alone is exalted.

58dee2f146f78d76f131.latin: 148:14 Conféssio eius super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
58dee2f146f78d76f131.english: 148:14 The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.

39e28d3b492afd76bcc6.latin: 148:14 Hymnus ómnibus sanctis eius: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
39e28d3b492afd76bcc6.english: 148:14 A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

4b05769ac93a2867a547.latin: 149:1 Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * laus eius in ecclésia sanctórum.
4b05769ac93a2867a547.english: 149:1 Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * let his praise be in the church of the saints.

8a831e0da3ea9ba146cf.latin: 149:2 Lætétur Israël in eo, qui fecit eum: * et fílii Sion exsúltent in rege suo.
8a831e0da3ea9ba146cf.english: 149:2 Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: * and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.

49868e191aa6e83b1200.latin: 149:3 Laudent nomen eius in choro: * in týmpano, et psaltério psallant ei:
49868e191aa6e83b1200.english: 149:3 Let them praise his name in choir: * let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.

8548768f43150caa0f30.latin: 149:4 Quia beneplácitum est Dómino in pópulo suo: * et exaltábit mansuétos in salútem.
8548768f43150caa0f30.english: 149:4 For the Lord is well pleased with his people: * and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.

8f17b5070a0642b8e4c4.latin: 149:5 Exsultábunt sancti in glória: * lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
8f17b5070a0642b8e4c4.english: 149:5 The saints shall rejoice in glory: * they shall be joyful in their beds.

de597047d47d2224af51.latin: 149:6 Exaltatiónes Dei in gútture eórum: * et gládii ancípites in mánibus eórum.
de597047d47d2224af51.english: 149:6 The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: * and two-edged swords in their hands:

85e53ad7cb8f0560e9e5.latin: 149:7 Ad faciéndam vindíctam in natiónibus: * increpatiónes in pópulis.
85e53ad7cb8f0560e9e5.english: 149:7 To execute vengeance upon the nations, * chastisements among the people:

6fd8734ebba02ce7f57d.latin: 149:8 Ad alligándos reges eórum in compédibus: * et nóbiles eórum in mánicis férreis.
6fd8734ebba02ce7f57d.english: 149:8 To bind their kings with fetters, * and their nobles with manacles of iron.

962163a7d2aec60995a4.latin: 149:9 Ut fáciant in eis iudícium conscríptum: * glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis eius.
962163a7d2aec60995a4.english: 149:9 To execute upon them the judgment that is written: * this glory is to all his saints.

cb4bc3d17b645cf24b48.latin: 150:1 Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis eius: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis eius.
cb4bc3d17b645cf24b48.english: 150:1 Praise ye the Lord in his holy places: * praise ye him in the firmament of his power.

f82324046a9b91ef1669.latin: 150:2 Laudáte eum in virtútibus eius: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
f82324046a9b91ef1669.english: 150:2 Praise ye him for his mighty acts: * praise ye him according to the multitude of his greatness.

d477e5ca7e5b913aa1a1.latin: 150:3 Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.
d477e5ca7e5b913aa1a1.english: 150:3 Praise him with sound of trumpet: * praise him with psaltery and harp.

c4c2776e063b057da0be.latin: 150:4 Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.
c4c2776e063b057da0be.english: 150:4 Praise him with timbrel and choir: * praise him with strings and organs.

8c3c97d98198da60a955.latin: 150:5 Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: laudáte eum in cýmbalis iubilatiónis: * omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
8c3c97d98198da60a955.english: 150:5 Praise him on high sounding cymbals: praise him on cymbals of joy: * let every spirit praise the Lord.

dc610db2cbaf0c881f30.latin: Ant. Laudáte Deum, omnes Angeli eius: laudáte eum, omnes Virtútes eius.
dc610db2cbaf0c881f30.english: Ant. Praise ye God, all His Angels Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

9d854671973c4d9c2dc2.latin:
Exod. 23:20-21
Ecce ego mittam Angelum meum, qui præcédat te, et custódiat in via, et introdúcat in locum, quem parávi. Obsérva eum et audi vocem eius.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Stetit Angelus * Iuxta aram templi.
℟. Stetit Angelus * Iuxta aram templi.
℣. Habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
℟. Iuxta aram templi.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Stetit Angelus * Iuxta aram templi.
Hymnus
Orbis Patrátor óptime,
Qui quidquid est poténtia
Magna creásti, nec regis
Minóre providéntia:
Adésto supplicántium
Tibi reórum cœ́tui,
Lucísque sub crepúsculum
Lucem novam da méntibus.
Tuúsque nobis Angelus
Signátus ad custódiam,
Hic adsit, a contágio
Qui críminum nos prótegat.
Serpéntis nobis ǽmuli
Calúmnias extérminet,
Ne rete frauduléntiæ
Incáuta nectat péctora.
Metum propéllat hóstium
Nostris procul de fínibus:
Pacem procúret cívium,
Fugétque pestiléntiam.
Deo Patri sit glória,
Qui quos redémit Fílius,
Et Sanctus unxit Spíritus,
Per Angelos custódiat.
Amen.
℣. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
℟. Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
9d854671973c4d9c2dc2.english:
Exod. 23:20-21
Behold I will send my angel, who shall go before thee, and keep thee in thy journey, and bring thee into the place that I have prepared. Take notice of him, and hear his voice.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟.br. An Angel stood * at the Altar of the Temple.
℟. An Angel stood * at the Altar of the Temple.
℣. Having a golden censer in his hand.
℟. At the Altar of the Temple.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. An Angel stood * at the Altar of the Temple.
Hymn
Ruler of the dread immense!
Maker of this mighty frame!
Whose eternal providence
Guides it, as from thee it came:
Low before thy throne we bend;
Hear our supplicating cries;
And thy light celestial send
With the freshly dawning skies.
King of kings, and Lord most high!
This of thy dear love we pray:
May thy guardian angel nigh,
Keep us from all sin this day.
May he crush the deadly wiles
Of the envious serpent's art,
Ever spreading cunning toils
Round about the thoughtless heart.
May he scatter ruthless war
Ere to this our land it come;
Plague and famine drive away,
Fix securely peace at home.
Father, Son, and Holy Ghost,
One eternal Trinity!
Guard by thy angelic host
Us who put our trust in thee.
Amen.
℣. Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.
℟. I will worship toward thy holy Temple, and praise thy Name.

68b61e401acf079d2995.latin: Ant. Revérsus est * Angelus qui loquebátur in me, et suscitávit me; quasi virum qui suscitátur a somno suo.
68b61e401acf079d2995.english: Ant. The Angel that talked * with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.

732434e047b7bea503bc.latin: 1:68 Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
732434e047b7bea503bc.english: 1:68 Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

589588114dae2a91f123.latin: 1:69 Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
589588114dae2a91f123.english: 1:69 And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

19d6258722303fade0cf.latin: 1:70 Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
19d6258722303fade0cf.english: 1:70 As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

60abdb30d7661917644b.latin: 1:71 Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
60abdb30d7661917644b.english: 1:71 Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

159cf23c80037e99fde3.latin: 1:72 Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
159cf23c80037e99fde3.english: 1:72 To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

fc3528e48701588b5729.latin: 1:73 Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
fc3528e48701588b5729.english: 1:73 The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

dfbddd1fa63b68ca6f5d.latin: 1:74 Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
dfbddd1fa63b68ca6f5d.english: 1:74 That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

504e9ccfa9af082c07d5.latin: 1:75 In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
504e9ccfa9af082c07d5.english: 1:75 In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

1dbb958168227322f0c0.latin: 1:76 Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
1dbb958168227322f0c0.english: 1:76 And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

027420adbe61be126894.latin: 1:77 Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
027420adbe61be126894.english: 1:77 To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

763df32c567498bbdb44.latin: 1:78 Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
763df32c567498bbdb44.english: 1:78 Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

5637d093cf796ad4c0b0.latin: 1:79 Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
5637d093cf796ad4c0b0.english: 1:79 To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

828230ee246893d6a56e.latin: Ant. Revérsus est Angelus qui loquebátur in me, et suscitávit me; quasi virum qui suscitátur a somno suo.
828230ee246893d6a56e.english: Ant. The Angel that talked with me came again, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.

83bd769f9ea4db2302a2.latin: Si descendendum sit a choro, concluditur dicendo.
83bd769f9ea4db2302a2.english: Then, in the public recitation of the Office, if the Community is to leave the Choir, the following Versicle is said.

07243d5c645c65ce4ec9.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

a2bb9bc6d922b8be9cc2.latin: ℟. Et cum frátribus nostris abséntibus. Amen.
a2bb9bc6d922b8be9cc2.english: ℟. And with our brothers, who are absent. Amen.

aa03adb607bdf1a469bb.latin:
Iam lucis orto sídere,
Deum precémur súpplices,
Ut in diúrnis áctibus
Nos servet a nocéntibus.
Linguam refrénans témperet,
Ne litis horror ínsonet:
Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
Ne vanitátes háuriat.
Sint pura cordis íntima,
Absístat et vecórdia;
Carnis terat supérbiam
Potus cibíque párcitas.
Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
Noctémque sors redúxerit,
Mundi per abstinéntiam
Ipsi canámus glóriam.
Deo Patri sit glória,
Eiúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Et nunc et in perpétuum.
Amen.
aa03adb607bdf1a469bb.english:
Now in the sun's new dawning ray,
Lowly of heart, our God we pray
That he from harm may keep us free
In all the deeds this day shall see.
May fear of him our tongues restrain,
Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:
His favouring care our guardian be,
Lest our eyes feed on vanity.
May every heart be pure from sin
And folly find no place therein:
Scant need of food, excess denied,
Wear down in us the body's pride.
That when the light of day is gone,
And night in course shall follow on.
We, free from cares the world affords,
May chant the praise that is our Lord's.
All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To God the holy Paraclete.
Amen.

184f222c088a399335d4.latin: 15:1 Consérva me, Dómine, quóniam sperávi in te. * Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu, quóniam bonórum meórum non eges.
184f222c088a399335d4.english: 15:1 Preserve me, O Lord, for I have put my trust in thee. * I have said to the Lord, thou art my God, for thou hast no need of my goods.

74b7de0eaa90ca87230f.latin: 15:3 Sanctis, qui sunt in terra eius, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas in eis.
74b7de0eaa90ca87230f.english: 15:3 To the saints, who are in his land, * he hath made wonderful all my desires in them.

7f37e31672b769544e5e.latin: 15:4 Multiplicátæ sunt infirmitátes eórum: * póstea acceleravérunt.
7f37e31672b769544e5e.english: 15:4 Their infirmities were multiplied: * afterwards they made haste.

e32aab83d16b8d56e928.latin: 15:4 Non congregábo conventícula eórum de sanguínibus, * nec memor ero nóminum eórum per lábia mea.
e32aab83d16b8d56e928.english: 15:4 I will not gather together their meetings for blood offerings: * nor will I be mindful of their names by my lips.

7184a84aa26fafeef98a.latin: 15:5 Dóminus pars hereditátis meæ, et cálicis mei: * tu es, qui restítues hereditátem meam mihi.
7184a84aa26fafeef98a.english: 15:5 The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: * it is thou that wilt restore my inheritance to me.

e2cf3c09a95f747bd20c.latin: 15:6 Funes cecidérunt mihi in præcláris: * étenim heréditas mea præclára est mihi.
e2cf3c09a95f747bd20c.english: 15:6 The lines are fallen unto me in goodly places: * for my inheritance is goodly to me.

e32c6eb066a07d4adf48.latin: 15:7 Benedícam Dóminum, qui tríbuit mihi intelléctum: * ínsuper et usque ad noctem increpuérunt me renes mei.
e32c6eb066a07d4adf48.english: 15:7 I will bless the Lord, who hath given me understanding: * moreover my reins also have corrected me even till night.

1dbc19d133cfd0b9c952.latin: 15:8 Providébam Dóminum in conspéctu meo semper: * quóniam a dextris est mihi, ne commóvear.
1dbc19d133cfd0b9c952.english: 15:8 I set the Lord always in my sight: * for he is at my right hand, that I be not moved.

7ea2968981df597ee20f.latin: 15:9 Propter hoc lætátum est cor meum, et exsultávit lingua mea: * ínsuper et caro mea requiéscet in spe.
7ea2968981df597ee20f.english: 15:9 Therefore my heart hath been glad, and my tongue hath rejoiced: * moreover my flesh also shall rest in hope.

556bc04d60e41e18d332.latin: 15:10 Quóniam non derelínques ánimam meam in inférno: * nec dabis sanctum tuum vidére corruptiónem.
556bc04d60e41e18d332.english: 15:10 Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; * nor wilt thou give thy holy one to see corruption.

f9f7e52d1e7e8e6845f7.latin: 15:11 Notas mihi fecísti vias vitæ, adimplébis me lætítia cum vultu tuo: * delectatiónes in déxtera tua usque in finem.
f9f7e52d1e7e8e6845f7.english: 15:11 Thou hast made known to me the ways of life, thou shalt fill me with joy with thy countenance: * at thy right hand are delights even to the end.

f04ac64e96fc7aa83f2e.latin: 16:1 Exáudi, Dómine, iustítiam meam: * inténde deprecatiónem meam.
f04ac64e96fc7aa83f2e.english: 16:1 Hear, O Lord, my justice: * attend to my supplication.

4090fb6adccc83b446ba.latin: 16:1 Áuribus pércipe oratiónem meam, * non in lábiis dolósis.
4090fb6adccc83b446ba.english: 16:1 Give ear unto my prayer, * which proceedeth not from deceitful lips.

7d5c3b8c4a8d46225fce.latin: 16:2 De vultu tuo iudícium meum pródeat: * óculi tui vídeant æquitátes.
7d5c3b8c4a8d46225fce.english: 16:2 Let my judgment come forth from thy countenance: * let thy eyes behold the things that are equitable.

cdacbdea7f7b3aee18e5.latin: 16:3 Probásti cor meum, et visitásti nocte: * igne me examinásti, et non est invénta in me iníquitas.
cdacbdea7f7b3aee18e5.english: 16:3 Thou hast proved my heart, and visited it by night, * thou hast tried me by fire: and iniquity hath not been found in me.

a7649e69e95110c75e20.latin: 16:4 Ut non loquátur os meum ópera hóminum: * propter verba labiórum tuórum ego custodívi vias duras.
a7649e69e95110c75e20.english: 16:4 That my mouth may not speak the works of men: * for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.

f1e9cc240242fb3046f5.latin: 16:5 Pérfice gressus meos in sémitis tuis: * ut non moveántur vestígia mea.
f1e9cc240242fb3046f5.english: 16:5 Perfect thou my goings in thy paths: * that my footsteps be not moved.

4207c4a47254ead5cb0f.latin: 16:6 Ego clamávi, quóniam exaudísti me, Deus: * inclína aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
4207c4a47254ead5cb0f.english: 16:6 I have cried to thee, for thou, O God, hast heard me: * O incline thy ear unto me, and hear my words.

6cdcc5c3f7880c8301d4.latin: 16:7 Mirífica misericórdias tuas, * qui salvos facis sperántes in te.
6cdcc5c3f7880c8301d4.english: 16:7 Shew forth thy wonderful mercies; * thou who savest them that trust in thee.

ab86a743102e391e3997.latin: 16:8 A resisténtibus déxteræ tuæ custódi me, * ut pupíllam óculi.
ab86a743102e391e3997.english: 16:8 From them that resist thy right hand keep me, * as the apple of thy eye.

f2e42232a06c610fce5f.latin: 16:8 Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege me: * a fácie impiórum qui me afflixérunt.
f2e42232a06c610fce5f.english: 16:8 Protect me under the shadow of thy wings: * from the face of the wicked who have afflicted me.

64a5541226ca42daebbc.latin: 16:9 Inimíci mei ánimam meam circumdedérunt, ádipem suum conclusérunt: * os eórum locútum est supérbiam.
64a5541226ca42daebbc.english: 16:9 My enemies have surrounded my soul: They have shut up their fat: * their mouth hath spoken proudly.

fa44016558f1a2cc7250.latin: 16:11 Proiciéntes me nunc circumdedérunt me: * óculos suos statuérunt declináre in terram.
fa44016558f1a2cc7250.english: 16:11 They have cast me forth, and now they have surrounded me: * they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth.

2163d627377145152c8a.latin: 16:12 Suscepérunt me sicut leo parátus ad prædam: * et sicut cátulus leónis hábitans in ábditis.
2163d627377145152c8a.english: 16:12 They have taken me, as a lion prepared for the prey; * and as a young lion dwelling in secret places.

42db4da7a7c8cb917d6d.latin: 16:13 Exsúrge, Dómine, prǽveni eum, et supplánta eum: * éripe ánimam meam ab ímpio, frámeam tuam ab inimícis manus tuæ.
42db4da7a7c8cb917d6d.english: 16:13 Arise, O Lord, disappoint him and supplant him; * deliver my soul from the wicked one; thy sword from the enemies of thy hand.

dceec539db05ad0fe7a6.latin: 16:14 Dómine, a paucis de terra dívide eos in vita eórum: * de abscónditis tuis adimplétus est venter eórum.
dceec539db05ad0fe7a6.english: 16:14 O Lord, divide them from the few of the earth in their life: * their belly is filled from thy hidden stores.

eb0ea177fd44343b2f2d.latin: 16:14 Saturáti sunt fíliis: * et dimisérunt relíquias suas párvulis suis.
eb0ea177fd44343b2f2d.english: 16:14 They are full of children: * and they have left to their little ones the rest of their substance.

c677a03d99beee6118f5.latin: 16:15 Ego autem in iustítia apparébo conspéctui tuo: * satiábor cum apparúerit glória tua.
c677a03d99beee6118f5.english: 16:15 But as for me, I will appear before thy sight in justice: * I shall be satisfied when thy glory shall appear.

64d0a11dd919051070aa.latin: 17:2 Díligam te, Dómine, fortitúdo mea: * Dóminus firmaméntum meum, et refúgium meum, et liberátor meus.
64d0a11dd919051070aa.english: 17:2 I will love thee, O Lord, my strength: * The Lord is my firmament, my refuge, and my deliverer.

12375e8bc9e451d5d36f.latin: 17:3 Deus meus adiútor meus, * et sperábo in eum.
12375e8bc9e451d5d36f.english: 17:3 My God is my helper, * and in him will I put my trust.

e18bbca58f10fcfe3171.latin: 17:3 Protéctor meus, et cornu salútis meæ, * et suscéptor meus.
e18bbca58f10fcfe3171.english: 17:3 My protector, and the horn of my salvation, * and my support.

f86c162d26c559659f9e.latin: 17:4 Laudans invocábo Dóminum: * et ab inimícis meis salvus ero.
f86c162d26c559659f9e.english: 17:4 Praising, I will call upon the Lord: * and I shall be saved from my enemies.

f94f786099fdbfebeebc.latin: 17:5 Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et torréntes iniquitátis conturbavérunt me.
f94f786099fdbfebeebc.english: 17:5 The sorrows of death surrounded me: * and the torrents of iniquity troubled me.

870c824054b08099cd17.latin: 17:6 Dolóres inférni circumdedérunt me: * præoccupavérunt me láquei mortis.
870c824054b08099cd17.english: 17:6 The sorrows of hell encompassed me: * and the snares of death prevented me.

7a7118c6aabab19b5e35.latin: 17:7 In tribulatióne mea invocávi Dóminum, * et ad Deum meum clamávi.
7a7118c6aabab19b5e35.english: 17:7 In my affliction I called upon the Lord, * and I cried to my God:

d74f8f4aafba8292de87.latin: 17:7 Et exaudívit de templo sancto suo vocem meam: * et clamor meus in conspéctu eius, introívit in aures eius.
d74f8f4aafba8292de87.english: 17:7 And he heard my voice from his holy temple: * and my cry before him came into his ears.

fd9b96ac94fe5189f1b1.latin: 17:8 Commóta est, et contrémuit terra: * fundaménta móntium conturbáta sunt, et commóta sunt, quóniam irátus est eis.
fd9b96ac94fe5189f1b1.english: 17:8 The earth shook and trembled: * the foundations of the mountains were troubled and were moved, because he was angry with them.

5726615bfff84d9cfc71.latin: 17:9 Ascéndit fumus in ira eius: et ignis a fácie eius exársit: * carbónes succénsi sunt ab eo.
5726615bfff84d9cfc71.english: 17:9 There went up a smoke in his wrath: and a fire flamed from his face: * coals were kindled by it.

fc7b4142c231442412c7.latin: 17:10 Inclinávit cælos, et descéndit: * et calígo sub pédibus eius.
fc7b4142c231442412c7.english: 17:10 He bowed the heavens, and came down, * and darkness was under his feet.

6443603968ff6f4a31f4.latin: 17:11 Et ascéndit super Chérubim, et volávit: * volávit super pennas ventórum.
6443603968ff6f4a31f4.english: 17:11 And he ascended upon the cherubim, and he flew; * he flew upon the wings of the winds.

de24d73ff12fbaab04ab.latin: 17:12 Et pósuit ténebras latíbulum suum, in circúitu eius tabernáculum eius: * tenebrósa aqua in núbibus áëris.
de24d73ff12fbaab04ab.english: 17:12 And he made darkness his covert, his pavilion round about him: * dark waters in the clouds of the air.

73e1937f9b95c07de20b.latin: 17:13 Præ fulgóre in conspéctu eius nubes transiérunt, * grando et carbónes ignis.
73e1937f9b95c07de20b.english: 17:13 At the brightness that was before him the clouds passed, * hail and coals of fire.

a55fe8d01c05adfc56c6.latin: 17:14 Et intónuit de cælo Dóminus, et Altíssimus dedit vocem suam: * grando et carbónes ignis.
a55fe8d01c05adfc56c6.english: 17:14 And the Lord thundered from heaven, and the Highest gave his voice: * hail and coals of fire.

3b39ef8d2d7e352da033.latin: 17:15 Et misit sagíttas suas, et dissipávit eos: * fúlgura multiplicávit, et conturbávit eos.
3b39ef8d2d7e352da033.english: 17:15 And he sent forth his arrows, and he scattered them: * he multiplied lightnings, and troubled them.

42efdc0d1ff6b7942bc3.latin: 17:16 Et apparuérunt fontes aquárum, * et reveláta sunt fundaménta orbis terrárum:
42efdc0d1ff6b7942bc3.english: 17:16 Then the fountains of waters appeared, * and the foundations of the world were discovered:

906c4aa93c780d1042d1.latin: 17:16 Ab increpatióne tua, Dómine, * ab inspiratióne spíritus iræ tuæ.
906c4aa93c780d1042d1.english: 17:16 At thy rebuke, O Lord, * at the blast of the spirit of thy wrath.

25b81b2aa1bce959f916.latin: 17:17 Misit de summo, et accépit me: * et assúmpsit me de aquis multis.
25b81b2aa1bce959f916.english: 17:17 He sent from on high, and took me: * and received me out of many waters.

32b0bcca0542b68e6b6d.latin: 17:18 Erípuit me de inimícis meis fortíssimis, et ab his qui odérunt me: * quóniam confortáti sunt super me.
32b0bcca0542b68e6b6d.english: 17:18 He delivered me from my strongest enemies, and from them that hated me: * for they were too strong for me.

94568d9feb40fd55b344.latin: 17:19 Prævenérunt me in die afflictiónis meæ: * et factus est Dóminus protéctor meus.
94568d9feb40fd55b344.english: 17:19 They prevented me in the day of my affliction: * and the Lord became my protector.

8fd89bbbc25a3e0d3c17.latin: 17:20 Et edúxit me in latitúdinem: * salvum me fecit, quóniam vóluit me.
8fd89bbbc25a3e0d3c17.english: 17:20 And he brought me forth into a large place: * he saved me, because he was well pleased with me.

17611db059f9dd3e7a76.latin: 17:21 Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum iustítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum retríbuet mihi:
17611db059f9dd3e7a76.english: 17:21 And the Lord will reward me according to my justice; * and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands:

86de2fe1e92120f7f10e.latin: 17:22 Quia custodívi vias Dómini, * nec ímpie gessi a Deo meo.
86de2fe1e92120f7f10e.english: 17:22 Because I have kept the ways of the Lord; * and have not done wickedly against my God.

361b074107bfb7598a70.latin: 17:23 Quóniam ómnia iudícia eius in conspéctu meo: * et iustítias eius non répuli a me.
361b074107bfb7598a70.english: 17:23 For all his judgments are in my sight: * and his justices I have not put away from me.

82326dc0ddf75e0d4759.latin: 17:24 Et ero immaculátus cum eo: * et observábo me ab iniquitáte mea.
82326dc0ddf75e0d4759.english: 17:24 And I shall be spotless with him: * and shall keep myself from my iniquity.

02fefe875c86c3c78af8.latin: 17:25 Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum iustítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum in conspéctu oculórum eius.
02fefe875c86c3c78af8.english: 17:25 And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: * and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.

f282a56db3da61bf4e34.latin:
1 Tim. 1:17
Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Exsúrge, Christe, ádiuva nos.
℟. Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
f282a56db3da61bf4e34.english:
1 Tim. 1:17
Now to the king of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
℟. And deliver us for thy name's sake.

39a705c2e54a127cf6a1.latin: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium huius diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam iustítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera.
39a705c2e54a127cf6a1.english: O Lord, our heavenly Father, Almighty and everlasting God, who has safely brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us by thy mighty power; and grant that this day we fall into no sin, but that all our doings may be ordered by thy governance, to do always what is righteous in thy sight.

537348980633ca7eebe7.latin: Deinde in Choro legitur Martyrologium, quod laudabiliter fit etiam extra Chorum.
537348980633ca7eebe7.english: Then the Martyrology is read in Choir.

861fdfda61c590bfebc5.latin:
Quinto Nonas Octóbris Luna vicésima prima. Anno Dómini 2026
Sanctæ Terésiæ a Iesu Infánte, ex Ordine Carmelitárum Excalceatórum, Vírginis, peculiáris ómnium Missiónum Patrónæ; cuius dies natális prídie Kaléndas Octóbris recensétur.
Romæ, ad Ursum pileátum, sancti Cándidi Mártyris.
Apud antíquos Sáxones sanctórum Mártyrum duórum Ewaldórum, qui, cum essent Presbýteri et Christum ibi prædicáre cœpíssent, comprehénsi sunt a Pagánis et occísi; ad quorum córpora noctu lux multa, diu appárens, et ubi essent et cuius essent mériti, declarávit.
Eódem die sanctórum Mártyrum Dionýsii, Fausti, Caii, Petri, Pauli et aliórum quátuor, qui primum, sub Décio, multa passi sunt, ac demum, sub Valeriáno, ab Æmiliáno Prǽside diu torméntis vexáti, martýrii palmam meruérunt.
In Africa sancti Maximiáni, Epíscopi Bagaiénsis, qui, a Donatístis íterum atque íterum sævíssima perpéssus, ex alta dénique turri præcipitátus est, et pro mórtuo derelíctus; sed, póstmodum a transeúntibus colléctus et pia curatióne sanátus, cathólicam fidem propugnáre non déstitit, donec, glória confessiónis clarus, quiévit in Dómino.
Legióne, in Hispánia, sancti Froiláni, eiúsdem civitátis Epíscopi, monásticæ vitæ propagándæ stúdio, beneficéntia in páuperes, ceterísque virtútibus et miráculis clari.
In diœcési Namurcénsi, apud Belgas, sancti Gerárdi Abbátis.
In Palæstína sancti Hesýchii Confessóris, qui fuit sancti Hilariónis discípulus et in peregrinatióne sócius.
Savónæ, in Ligúria, sanctæ Maríæ Ioséphæ Rosséllo, Institúti Filiárum Nostræ Dóminæ a Misericórdia Fundatrícis, quam, caritátis opéribus præcláram, Pius Papa Duodécimus sanctis Virgínibus adnumerávit.
℣. Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
℟. Deo grátias.
861fdfda61c590bfebc5.english:
October 3rd 2026, the 21st day of the Moon,
On the morrow we keep the feast of the holy Confessor Thomas, Bishop of Hereford, in England, of whom mention was made yesterday.
Upon the same 3rd day of October, were born into the better life:
At Rome, at the Bear-and-Cap, the holy martyr Candidus, (in the third century.) Upon the same day, the holy martyrs Denis, Faustus, Caius, Peter, Paul, and four others, (in the third century.) They originally suffered much under the Emperor Decius, and then, under the Emperor Valerian, were put to a long course of torments by the President Emilian.
Among the ancient Saxons, (in Westphalia,) the two holy (English) brethren, both named Ewald, (about the year 695,) (one surnamed the white, and the other the black.) They were priests, and had gone to preach Christ in that country, where they suffered martyrdom, being murdered by the heathen. A bright light was seen around their bodies by night to show where they were, and of what worthiness.
In Africa, holy Maximian, Bishop of Bagaia, who again and again suffered great cruelties at the hands of the Donatists, and was at last thrown off the top of a lofty tower, and left for dead, but afterwards fell asleep in the Lord, famous for his glorious confession.
In Palestine, the holy Confessor Hesychius, (in the fourth century,) a disciple of holy Hilarion, and his companion in his journeyings.
At Brogne, in the diocese of Namur, in Belgium, (in the year 959,) holy Gerard, (Founder and) Abbot, (of the monastery at that place, who introduced a new and most exact discipline into many monasteries of Flanders, Champagne, Lorraine, and Picardy. He reformed some abbeys in Flanders.)
℣. And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
℟. Thanks be to God.

d6375e82d55562374393.latin:
℣. Iube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. Dies et actus nostros in sua pace dispónat Dóminus omnípotens.
℟. Amen.
Ex Cápite 7 Régulæ Sancti Patri Nostri Benedícti: De humilitáte
Quartus humilitátis gradus est, si in ipsa obœdiéntia duris et contráriis rebus vel étiam quibúslibet inrogátis iniúriis, tácite consciéntia patiéntiam amplectátur et sústinens non lasséscat vel discédat, dicénte Scriptúra: Qui perseveráverit usque in finem, hic salvus erit. Item: Confortétur cor tuum et sústine Dóminum. Et osténdens fidélem pro Dómino univérsa étiam contrária sustinére debére, dicit ex persóna sufferéntium: Propter te morte adfícimur tota die, æstimáti sumus ut oves occisiónis. Et secúri de spe retributiónis divínæ subsequúntur gaudéntes et dicéntes: Sed in his ómnibus superámus propter eum qui diléxit nos. Et item álio loco Scriptúra: Probásti nos, Deus, igne nos examinásti sicut igne examinátur argéntum; induxísti nos in láqueum; posuísti tribulatiónes in dorso nostro. Et ut osténdat sub prióre debére nos esse, subséquitur dicens: Inposuísti hómines super cápita nostra. Sed et præcéptum Dómini in advérsis et iniúriis per patiéntiam adimpléntes, qui percússi in maxíllam præbent et áliam, auferénti túnicam dimíttunt et pállium, angarizáti militário vadunt duo, cum Paulo apóstolo falsos fratres sústinent et persecutiónem sústinent, et maledicéntes se benedícent.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
Extra Chorum etiam laudabiliter dicitur lectio ex S. Regulæ; secus dicitur Lectio brevis.
2 Thess 3:5
Dóminus autem dírigat corda et córpora nostra in caritáte Dei et patiéntia Christi.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
d6375e82d55562374393.english:
℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benediction. May Almighty God arrange our deeds and our day in His peace.
℟. Amen.
The Rule of our Holy Father Benedict. Chapter 7: Concerning Humility. Continued.
The fourth step in humility is if in that same obedience, though things hard and contrary and even injuries, no matter of what kind, have been inflicted, he keep patience with a quiet conscience and enduring grows not weary nor gives in, for Scripture says: “He who perseveres to the end, the same shall be saved.” And again: “Let thy heart be comforted and wait for the Lord.” And showing that the faithful man ought for the Lord’s sake to wait patiently, seem all things never so contrary, it says in the name of the suffering: “For Thy sake we are afflicted all the day; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”
And they, secure in their hope of divine retribution, gladly follow on and say: “But in all these things we overcome by Him Who loved us.”
And again in another place: “Thou, O God, hast tested us,” says Scripture, “Thou hast examined us with fire, as silver is examined with fire. Thou hast led us into the snare, Thou hast placed troubles upon our back.” And to show that we ought to be under a superior, it follows on, saying: “Thou hast placed men over our heads.” Moreover, fulfilling the Lord’s command by patience amid adversities and injuries those struck on the cheek offer the other also; with him who deprives them of their tunic they leave their cloak in addition; constrained to go a thousand paces, they go two thousand; with Paul the Apostle, they endure false brethren and bless those that curse them.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.
Even outside of Choir, it is laudible to read the Holy Regula; otherwise, the Short Reading is prayed
2 Thess 3:5
And the Lord direct your hearts, in the charity of God, and the patience of Christ.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.

3bc1f6b7a7a77abe2a83.latin:
Nunc, Sancte, nobis, Spíritus,
Unum Patri cum Fílio,
Dignáre promptus íngeri
Nostro refúsus péctori.
Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor
Confessiónem pérsonent.
Flamméscat igne cáritas,
Accéndat ardor próximos.
Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
3bc1f6b7a7a77abe2a83.english:
Come Holy Ghost who ever One
Art with the Father and the Son,
It is the hour, our souls possess
With thy full flood of holiness.
Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
Sound forth our witness to mankind;
And love light up our mortal frame,
Till others catch the living flame.
Almighty Father, hear our cry,
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.
Amen.

0fff6a7803b46ed08df1.latin:
Rector potens, verax Deus,
Qui témperas rerum vices,
Splendóre mane ínstruis,
Et ígnibus merídiem:
Exstíngue flammas lítium,
Aufer calórem nóxium,
Confer salútem córporum,
Verámque pacem córdium.
Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
0fff6a7803b46ed08df1.english:
O God of truth, O Lord of might,
Who orderest time and change aright,
Who send’st the early morning ray,
And light’st the glow of perfect day:
Extinguish thou each sinful fire,
And banish every ill desire;
And while thou keep’st the body whole,
Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.
Almighty Father, hear our cry,
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.
Amen.
