9da205ae87dd489e265e.english: 123:2 When men rose up against us, * perhaps they had swallowed us up alive.

7655ce04d41628a7a499.latin: 123:3 Cum irascerétur furor eórum in nos, * fórsitan aqua absorbuísset nos.
7655ce04d41628a7a499.english: 123:3 When their fury was enkindled against us, * perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

7d0852904aed0c345df7.latin: 123:5 Torréntem pertransívit ánima nostra: * fórsitan pertransísset ánima nostra aquam intolerábilem.
7d0852904aed0c345df7.english: 123:5 Our soul hath passed through a torrent: * perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.

828d05ffcc56e2d63988.latin: 123:6 Benedíctus Dóminus * qui non dedit nos in captiónem déntibus eórum.
828d05ffcc56e2d63988.english: 123:6 Blessed be the Lord, * who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.

930ec7de244aff0beea3.latin: 123:7 Ánima nostra sicut passer erépta est * de láqueo venántium:
930ec7de244aff0beea3.english: 123:7 Our soul hath been delivered as a sparrow * out of the snare of the fowlers.

7a3968b6f6ab322583f8.latin: 123:7 Láqueus contrítus est, * et nos liberáti sumus.
7a3968b6f6ab322583f8.english: 123:7 The snare is broken, * and we are delivered.

c419c620df31209c2a13.latin: 123:8 Adiutórium nostrum in nómine Dómini, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
c419c620df31209c2a13.english: 123:8 Our help is in the name of the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

5f3aba540fc196e1201d.latin: 124:1 Qui confídunt in Dómino, sicut mons Sion: * non commovébitur in ætérnum, qui hábitat in Ierúsalem.
5f3aba540fc196e1201d.english: 124:1 They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: * he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth in Jerusalem.

1de440d6e572bf08c169.latin: 124:2 Montes in circúitu eius: * et Dóminus in circúitu pópuli sui, ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
1de440d6e572bf08c169.english: 124:2 Mountains are round about it: * so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth now and for ever.

981c932cce7da44fff6d.latin: 124:3 Quia non relínquet Dóminus virgam peccatórum super sortem iustórum: * ut non exténdant iusti ad iniquitátem manus suas.
981c932cce7da44fff6d.english: 124:3 For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just: * that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

32a1eab30a673fec5f0e.latin: 124:4 Bénefac, Dómine, bonis, * et rectis corde.
32a1eab30a673fec5f0e.english: 124:4 Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, * and to the upright of heart.

64eb746ffe9413dc8757.latin: 124:5 Declinántes autem in obligatiónes addúcet Dóminus cum operántibus iniquitátem: * pax super Israël.
64eb746ffe9413dc8757.english: 124:5 But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity: * peace upon Israel.

3106c9058e319df59289.latin:
Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
Immótus in te pérmanens,
Lucis diúrnæ témpora
Succéssibus detérminans:
Largíre clarum véspere,
Quo vita nusquam décidat,
Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
Perénnis instet glória.
Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
3106c9058e319df59289.english:
O strength and stay upholding all creation,
Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,
Yet day by day the light in due gradation
From hour to hour through all its changes guide:
Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,
An eve untouched by shadows of decay,
The brightness of a holy death-bed blending
With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.
Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,
And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,
Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living
Now and to endless ages art adored.
Amen.

da19efa19a5780806538.latin: 125:1 In converténdo Dóminus captivitátem Sion: * facti sumus sicut consoláti:
da19efa19a5780806538.english: 125:1 When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, * we became like men comforted.

962b6b516015b2a2fe31.latin: 125:2 Tunc replétum est gáudio os nostrum: * et lingua nostra exsultatióne.
962b6b516015b2a2fe31.english: 125:2 Then was our mouth filled with gladness; * and our tongue with joy.

f8bd57a581104086cfc1.latin: 125:2 Tunc dicent inter gentes: * Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
f8bd57a581104086cfc1.english: 125:2 Then shall they say among the Gentiles: * The Lord hath done great things for them.

c654c1e2a042661dd13f.latin: 125:3 Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobíscum: * facti sumus lætántes.
c654c1e2a042661dd13f.english: 125:3 The Lord hath done great things for us: * we are become joyful.

292365af0235f61494bb.latin: 125:4 Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, * sicut torrens in Austro.
292365af0235f61494bb.english: 125:4 Turn again our captivity, O Lord, * as a stream in the south.

c62a084c7088165cafa4.latin: 125:5 Qui séminant in lácrimis, * in exsultatióne metent.
c62a084c7088165cafa4.english: 125:5 They that sow in tears * shall reap in joy.

01af929521b99d3bd776.latin: 125:6 Eúntes ibant et flebant, * mitténtes sémina sua.
01af929521b99d3bd776.english: 125:6 Going they went and wept, * casting their seeds.

152202aa624f431141c4.latin: 125:6 Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, * portántes manípulos suos.
152202aa624f431141c4.english: 125:6 But coming they shall come with joyfulness, * carrying their sheaves.

47a2451bc0e2a8e803da.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.
47a2451bc0e2a8e803da.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord build the house, * they labour in vain that build it.

79eadd31b537b1478ba2.latin: 126:1 Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
79eadd31b537b1478ba2.english: 126:1 Unless the Lord keep the city, * he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

938ceb8b129182e6b6be.latin: 126:2 Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.
938ceb8b129182e6b6be.english: 126:2 It is vain for you to rise before light, * rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow.

b64be863d5c2f77c4aac.latin: 126:2 Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.
b64be863d5c2f77c4aac.english: 126:2 When he shall give sleep to his beloved, * behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.

01e45bf3e561d04f56cc.latin: 126:4 Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.
01e45bf3e561d04f56cc.english: 126:4 As arrows in the hand of the mighty, * so the children of them that have been shaken.

59bcb474ebcfb3b7d90f.latin: 126:5 Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
59bcb474ebcfb3b7d90f.english: 126:5 Blessed is the man that hath filled the desire with them; * he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

8c48030af648429763fe.latin: 127:1 Beáti, omnes, qui timent Dóminum, * qui ámbulant in viis eius.
8c48030af648429763fe.english: 127:1 Blessed are all they that fear the Lord: * that walk in his ways.

96c19560e1e78b48e1cf.latin: 127:2 Labóres mánuum tuárum quia manducábis: * beátus es, et bene tibi erit.
96c19560e1e78b48e1cf.english: 127:2 For thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: * blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

6d7f9e469269e97c910e.latin: 127:3 Uxor tua sicut vitis abúndans, * in latéribus domus tuæ.
6d7f9e469269e97c910e.english: 127:3 Thy wife as a fruitful vine, * on the sides of thy house.

263b4989d63f1024f1b9.latin: 127:3 Fílii tui sicut novéllæ olivárum, * in circúitu mensæ tuæ.
263b4989d63f1024f1b9.english: 127:3 Thy children as olive plants, * round about thy table.

995c1057b9ce028af7fa.latin: 127:4 Ecce, sic benedicétur homo, * qui timet Dóminum.
995c1057b9ce028af7fa.english: 127:4 Behold, thus shall the man be blessed * that feareth the Lord.

0af5ce520d96233e9cf3.latin: 127:5 Benedícat tibi Dóminus ex Sion: * et vídeas bona Ierúsalem ómnibus diébus vitæ tuæ.
0af5ce520d96233e9cf3.english: 127:5 May the Lord bless thee out of Sion: * and mayst thou see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

279128c3aabb42f33afc.latin: 127:6 Et vídeas fílios filiórum tuórum, * pacem super Israël.
279128c3aabb42f33afc.english: 127:6 And mayst thou see thy children’s children, * peace upon Israel.

f9e14e33facfa14a8385.latin:
Exod 23:22-23
Quod, si audíeris vocem eius et féceris ómnia quæ loquor, inimícus ero inimícis tuis et afflígam affligéntes te. Præcedétque te Angelus meus.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi, Deus meus.
℟. Adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
f9e14e33facfa14a8385.english:
Exod 23:22-23
But if thou wilt hear his voice, and do all that I speak, I will be an enemy to thy enemies, and will afflict them that afflict thee. And my angel shall go before thee.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. Before the Angels will I sing praise unto thee, O my God.
℟. I will worship toward thy holy Temple, and praise thy Name.

62778ac99caea9e33b4b.latin: Ant. Stetit Angelus * iuxta aram templi, habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
62778ac99caea9e33b4b.english: Ant. An Angel stood at the Altar * of the Temple, having a golden censer in his hand.

957be9a713afb68eea68.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
957be9a713afb68eea68.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

f0835d52b4e375cd1287.latin: 109:1 Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
f0835d52b4e375cd1287.english: 109:1 Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

d90acb877538c5484fef.latin: 109:2 Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
d90acb877538c5484fef.english: 109:2 The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

89bf59173957ccbeaa7c.latin: 109:3 Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
89bf59173957ccbeaa7c.english: 109:3 With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

6ae9965ec07bcbfa90bf.latin: 109:4 Iurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
6ae9965ec07bcbfa90bf.english: 109:4 The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

fb56d15df9c5e77d2ede.latin: 109:5 Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
fb56d15df9c5e77d2ede.english: 109:5 The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

6370071438635e932c18.latin: 109:6 Iudicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
6370071438635e932c18.english: 109:6 He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

f44ae5f6f6b04dc3e247.latin: 109:7 De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
f44ae5f6f6b04dc3e247.english: 109:7 He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

6d84f56dc7ff4defe15c.latin: Ant. Stetit Angelus iuxta aram templi, habens thuríbulum áureum in manu sua.
6d84f56dc7ff4defe15c.english: Ant. An Angel stood at the Altar of the Temple, having a golden censer in his hand.

c260958d9167fa782ac9.latin: Ant. Dum præliarétur * Míchaël Archángelus cum dracóne, audíta est vox dicéntium: Salus Deo nostro, allelúia.
c260958d9167fa782ac9.english: Ant. While as the Archangel Michael fought against the dragon, * I heard voices saying: Salvation unto our God. Alleluia.

572c51d22623eb0d390f.latin: 110:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio iustórum, et congregatióne.
572c51d22623eb0d390f.english: 110:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

a6eb9ed4d0b83fca10d4.latin: 110:2 Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes eius.
a6eb9ed4d0b83fca10d4.english: 110:2 Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

0895f045a6f4a6ff8d36.latin: 110:3 Conféssio et magnificéntia opus eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
0895f045a6f4a6ff8d36.english: 110:3 His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

8ab924f9c86b42345103.latin: 110:4 Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * escam dedit timéntibus se.
8ab924f9c86b42345103.english: 110:4 He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, being a merciful and gracious Lord: * he hath given food to them that fear him.

9a9c7042c887b98b96e5.latin: 110:5 Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
9a9c7042c887b98b96e5.english: 110:5 He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

18bede2d39f17cae0e34.latin: 110:7 Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum eius véritas, et iudícium.
18bede2d39f17cae0e34.english: 110:7 That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

d3329b40fa8a5bd77a8e.latin: 110:8 Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
d3329b40fa8a5bd77a8e.english: 110:8 All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

6f80788d7f8de576ddaf.latin: 110:9 Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
6f80788d7f8de576ddaf.english: 110:9 He hath sent redemption to his people: * he hath commanded his covenant for ever.

0428e01017837905d6bb.latin: 110:9 (fit reverentia) Sanctum, et terríbile nomen eius: * inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
0428e01017837905d6bb.english: 110:9 (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

05c51af037971a71b1f1.latin: 110:10 Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
05c51af037971a71b1f1.english: 110:10 A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

9e7f7ec575c130bf5157.latin: Ant. Dum præliarétur Míchaël Archángelus cum dracóne, audíta est vox dicéntium: Salus Deo nostro, allelúia.
9e7f7ec575c130bf5157.english: Ant. While as the Archangel Michael fought against the dragon, I heard voices saying: Salvation unto our God. Alleluia.

c64f12f6368b2e2892bb.latin: Ant. Archángele Míchaël, * constítui te príncipem super omnes ánimas suscipiéndas.
c64f12f6368b2e2892bb.english: Ant. Michael Mine Archangel, * I have appointed thee for a prince over the ingathering of souls.

aabd5724f18c60b57604.latin: 111:1 Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis eius volet nimis.
aabd5724f18c60b57604.english: 111:1 Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

07b6129ebf6a0df618d9.latin: 111:2 Potens in terra erit semen eius: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
07b6129ebf6a0df618d9.english: 111:2 His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

9d561e3edc51085f9e24.latin: 111:3 Glória, et divítiæ in domo eius: * et iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
9d561e3edc51085f9e24.english: 111:3 Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

42bb3896648de65d77fe.latin: 111:4 Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et iustus.
42bb3896648de65d77fe.english: 111:4 To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

3b16e144287fd5da5252.latin: 111:5 Iucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, dispónet sermónes suos in iudício: * quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
3b16e144287fd5da5252.english: 111:5 Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: he shall order his words with judgment: * because he shall not be moved for ever.

b24d0ab659c01c657e96.latin: 111:7 In memória ætérna erit iustus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
b24d0ab659c01c657e96.english: 111:7 The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear the evil hearing.

82b5c9e6e41e4705a6bd.latin: 111:7 Parátum cor eius speráre in Dómino, confirmátum est cor eius: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
82b5c9e6e41e4705a6bd.english: 111:7 His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

3d2c3395b34b24d89e05.latin: 111:9 Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: iustítia eius manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu eius exaltábitur in glória.
3d2c3395b34b24d89e05.english: 111:9 He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

f2787111603227fe0a2f.latin: 111:10 Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
f2787111603227fe0a2f.english: 111:10 The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

c282bbea6b26fc894e8b.latin: Ant. Archángele Míchaël, constítui te príncipem super omnes ánimas suscipiéndas.
c282bbea6b26fc894e8b.english: Ant. Michael Mine Archangel, I have appointed thee for a prince over the ingathering of souls.

892928d72c53ed5ede96.latin: Ant. Angeli, Archángeli, * Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúia.
892928d72c53ed5ede96.english: Ant. O ye Angels and Archangels, * O ye Thrones and Dominions, O ye Principalities and Powers, O ye mighty Ones of heaven, praise ye the Lord from the heavens. Alleluia.

e294b0cfba2db7b02efb.latin: 137:1 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * quóniam audísti verba oris mei.
e294b0cfba2db7b02efb.english: 137:1 I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * for thou hast heard the words of my mouth.

a3500e36d111fc7a6737.latin: 137:1 In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
a3500e36d111fc7a6737.english: 137:1 I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the Angels: * I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name.

c20ec190b031f735698c.latin: 137:2 Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
c20ec190b031f735698c.english: 137:2 For thy mercy, and for thy truth: * for thou hast magnified thy holy name.

b2e6566038fe013edac2.latin: 137:3 In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
b2e6566038fe013edac2.english: 137:3 In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: * thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

8d8cd227143d9160d338.latin: 137:4 Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
8d8cd227143d9160d338.english: 137:4 May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: * for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

f07c363ff6d3333611d2.latin: 137:5 Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
f07c363ff6d3333611d2.english: 137:5 And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: * for great is the glory of the Lord.

a50bc576038eb33b42fa.latin: 137:6 Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.
a50bc576038eb33b42fa.english: 137:6 For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: * and the high he knoweth afar off.

b39e754206d1616e622f.latin: 137:7 Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: * et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
b39e754206d1616e622f.english: 137:7 If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: * and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: and thy right hand hath saved me.

e30af17cd27c58400555.latin: 137:8 Dóminus retríbuet pro me: * Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
e30af17cd27c58400555.english: 137:8 The Lord will repay for me: * thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: O despise not the works of thy hands.

f739ccdfd938768a025c.latin: Ant. Angeli, Archángeli, Throni et Dominatiónes, Principátus et Potestátes, Virtútes cælórum, laudáte Dóminum de cælis, allelúia.
f739ccdfd938768a025c.english: Ant. O ye Angels and Archangels, O ye Thrones and Dominions, O ye Principalities and Powers, O ye mighty Ones of heaven, praise ye the Lord from the heavens. Alleluia.

ac82280f69712520673a.latin:
Exod. 23:20-21
Ecce ego mittam Angelum meum, qui præcédat te, et custódiat in via, et introdúcat in locum, quem parávi. Obsérva eum et audi vocem eius.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Ascéndit fumus arómatum * In conspéctu Dómini.
℟. Ascéndit fumus arómatum * In conspéctu Dómini.
℣. De manu Angeli.

Hymnus
Custódes hóminum psállimus Angelos,
Natúræ frágili quos Pater áddidit
Cæléstis cómites, insidiántibus
Ne succúmberet hóstibus.
Nam, quod corrúerit próditor ángelus,
Concéssis mérito pulsus honóribus,
Ardens invídia péllere nítitur
Quos cælo Deus ádvocat.
Huc, custos, ígitur pérvigil ádvola,
Avértens pátria de tibi crédita
Tam morbos ánimi quam requiéscere
Quidquid non sinit íncolas.
Sanctæ sit Tríadi laus pia iúgiter,
Cuius perpétuo númine máchina
Triplex hæc régitur, cuius in ómnia
Regnat glória sǽcula.
Amen.

Hymn
Angel-guardians of men, spirits and powers we sing,
Whom our Father hath sent, aids to our weakly frame,
Heavenly friends and guides, help from on high to bring,
Lest we fail through the foeman's wile.
He, the spoiler of souls, angel-traitor of old,
Cast in merited wrath out of his honoured place,
Burns with envy and hate, seeking their souls to gain
Whom God's mercy invites to heaven.
Therefore come to our help, watchful ward of our lives:
Turn aside from the land God to thy care confides
Sickness and woe of soul, yea, and what else of ill
Peace of heart to its folk denies.
Now to the Holy Three praise evermore resound:
Under whose hand divine resteth the triple world
Governed in wondrous wise: glory be theirs and might
While the ages unending run.
Amen.

0c350e3ef39ae17b8385.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.

Te lucis ante términum,
Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
Ut sólita cleméntia

Procul recédant sómnia,
Et nóctium phantásmata;
Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
Ne polluántur córpora.
Præsta, Pater omnípotens,
Per Iesum Christum Dóminum,
Qui tecum in perpétuum

8b8e111ecb962d02b280.english:
Before the ending of the day,
Creator of the world, we pray
That with thy wonted favor thou
Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.
From all ill dreams defend our eyes,
From nightly fears and fantasies;
Tread under foot our ghostly foe,
That no pollution we may know.
O Father, that we ask be done,
Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.
Amen.

42d29566250961c7fb97.latin:
Quem terra, pontus, ǽthera
Colunt, adórant, prædicant,
Trinam regéntem máchinam,
Claustrum Maríæ báiulat.
Cui luna, sol, et ómnia
Desérviunt per témpora,
Perfúsa cæli grátia,
Gestant puéllæ víscera.
Beáta Mater múnere,
Cuius supérnus ártifex
Mundum pugíllo cóntinens,
Ventris sub arca clausus est.
Beáta cæli núntio,
Fœcúnda sancto Spíritu,
Desiderátus géntibus,
Cuius per alvum fusus est.
Glória tibi, Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
42d29566250961c7fb97.english:
The God whom earth, and sea, and sky
Adore, and laud, and magnify,
Who o'er their threefold fabric reigns,
The Virgin's spotless womb contains.
The God, whose will by moon and sun
And all things in due course is done,
Is borne upon a maiden's breast,
By fullest heavenly grace possest.
How blest that mother, in whose shrine
The great artificer divine,
Whose hand contains the earth and sky,
Vouchsafed, as in his ark, to lie.
Blest, in the message Gabriel brought;
Blest, by the work the Spirit wrought;
From whom the great desire of earth
Took human flesh and human birth.
All honour, praise and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-Born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father, and to Paraclete.
Amen.

6a12a5200e06b2998a5d.latin: Ant. Clamor meus * ad te véniat, Deus.
6a12a5200e06b2998a5d.english: Ant. O God * let my cry come unto Thee.

59a9b9c1b582eda64b79.latin: 101:2 Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: * et clamor meus ad te véniat.
59a9b9c1b582eda64b79.english: 101:2 Hear, O Lord, my prayer: * and let my cry come to thee.

4d73cd4ff2a25809eff8.latin: 101:3 Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * in quacúmque die tríbulor, inclína ad me aurem tuam.
4d73cd4ff2a25809eff8.english: 101:3 Turn not away thy face from me: * in the day when I am in trouble, incline thy ear to me.

b2bae557e67abb794f54.latin: 101:3 In quacúmque die invocávero te, * velóciter exáudi me.
b2bae557e67abb794f54.english: 101:3 In what day soever I shall call upon thee, * hear me speedily.

74b32e647bdea537d102.latin: 101:4 Quia defecérunt sicut fumus dies mei: * et ossa mea sicut crémium aruérunt.
74b32e647bdea537d102.english: 101:4 For my days are vanished like smoke: * and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.

7c30385d9d801252a75b.latin: 101:5 Percússus sum ut fænum, et áruit cor meum: * quia oblítus sum comédere panem meum.
7c30385d9d801252a75b.english: 101:5 I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: * because I forgot to eat my bread.

6b76e32de873aed4502c.latin: 101:6 A voce gémitus mei * adhǽsit os meum carni meæ.
6b76e32de873aed4502c.english: 101:6 Through the voice of my groaning, * my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.

57ebbe21fa92307f0de5.latin: 101:7 Símilis factus sum pellicáno solitúdinis: * factus sum sicut nyctícorax in domicílio.
57ebbe21fa92307f0de5.english: 101:7 I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: * I am like a night raven in the house.

df3979d6b29984b6f3e3.latin: 101:8 Vigilávi, * et factus sum sicut passer solitárius in tecto.
df3979d6b29984b6f3e3.english: 101:8 I have watched, * and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.

661892e16fe9dad8496f.latin: 101:9 Tota die exprobrábant mihi inimíci mei: * et qui laudábant me, advérsum me iurábant.
661892e16fe9dad8496f.english: 101:9 All the day long my enemies reproached me: * and they that praised me did swear against me.

e022db8c26de5d687393.latin: 101:10 Quia cínerem tamquam panem manducábam, * et potum meum cum fletu miscébam.
e022db8c26de5d687393.english: 101:10 For I did eat ashes like bread, * and mingled my drink with weeping.

9adfe0762f42dc553209.latin: 101:11 A fácie iræ et indignatiónis tuæ: * quia élevans allisísti me.
9adfe0762f42dc553209.english: 101:11 Because of thy anger and indignation: * for having lifted me up thou hast thrown me down.

2a036781d71c15e1689c.latin: 101:12 Dies mei sicut umbra declinavérunt: * et ego sicut fænum árui.
2a036781d71c15e1689c.english: 101:12 My days have declined like a shadow, * and I am withered like grass.

bd2a302ddcd44c3ca3f5.latin: 101:13 Tu autem, Dómine, in ætérnum pérmanes: * et memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
bd2a302ddcd44c3ca3f5.english: 101:13 But thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: * and thy memorial to all generations.

c7252f835f0843437e26.latin: 101:14 Tu exsúrgens miseréberis Sion: * quia tempus miseréndi eius, quia venit tempus.
c7252f835f0843437e26.english: 101:14 Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: * for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.

f25101d8ba8f944b621d.latin: 101:15 Quóniam placuérunt servis tuis lápides eius: * et terræ eius miserebúntur.
f25101d8ba8f944b621d.english: 101:15 For the stones thereof have pleased thy servants: * and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.

4d5cb3719a513aefa57b.latin: 101:16 Et timébunt gentes nomen tuum, Dómine, * et omnes reges terræ glóriam tuam.
4d5cb3719a513aefa57b.english: 101:16 And the Gentiles shall fear thy name, O Lord, * and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

12f114c6d5d2c91dee20.latin: 101:17 Quia ædificávit Dóminus Sion: * et vidébitur in glória sua.
12f114c6d5d2c91dee20.english: 101:17 For the Lord hath built up Sion: * and he shall be seen in his glory.

b5738b46c7932c70c760.latin: 101:18 Respéxit in oratiónem humílium: * et non sprevit precem eórum.
b5738b46c7932c70c760.english: 101:18 He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: * and he hath not despised their petition.

2385133ae2ef81a11021.latin: 101:19 Scribántur hæc in generatióne áltera: * et pópulus, qui creábitur, laudábit Dóminum:
2385133ae2ef81a11021.english: 101:19 Let these things be written unto another generation: * and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:

46bf3beac58184e63c3d.latin: 101:20 Quia prospéxit de excélso sancto suo: * Dóminus de cælo in terram aspéxit:
46bf3beac58184e63c3d.english: 101:20 Because he hath looked forth from his high sanctuary: * from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.

13b21ade8977ea7fef42.latin: 101:21 Ut audíret gémitus compeditórum: * ut sólveret fílios interemptórum:
13b21ade8977ea7fef42.english: 101:21 That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: * that he might release the children of the slain:

ab70390f3ed8e66bc466.latin: 101:22 Ut annúntient in Sion nomen Dómini: * et laudem eius in Ierúsalem.
ab70390f3ed8e66bc466.english: 101:22 That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: * and his praise in Jerusalem;

737667dee517a4e0c603.latin: 101:23 In conveniéndo pópulos in unum, * et reges ut sérviant Dómino.
737667dee517a4e0c603.english: 101:23 When the people assemble together, * and kings, to serve the Lord.

825a21cab1a2d7ba551a.latin: 101:24 Respóndit ei in via virtútis suæ: * Paucitátem diérum meórum núntia mihi.
825a21cab1a2d7ba551a.english: 101:24 He answered him in the way of his strength: * Declare unto me the fewness of my days.

72e3e2430eeb09f86381.latin: 101:25 Ne révoces me in dimídio diérum meórum: * in generatiónem et generatiónem anni tui.
72e3e2430eeb09f86381.english: 101:25 Call me not away in the midst of my days: * thy years are unto generation and generation.

59554f524b2fc336223e.latin: 101:26 Inítio tu, Dómine, terram fundásti: * et ópera mánuum tuárum sunt cæli.
59554f524b2fc336223e.english: 101:26 In the beginning, O Lord, thou foundedst the earth: * and the heavens are the works of thy hands.

f4a674a6f3717492a5a9.latin: 101:27 Ipsi períbunt, tu autem pérmanes: * et omnes sicut vestiméntum veteráscent.
f4a674a6f3717492a5a9.english: 101:27 They shall perish but thou remainest: * and all of them shall grow old like a garment:

1709f09fc7f9436fe592.latin: 101:28 Et sicut opertórium mutábis eos, et mutabúntur: * tu autem idem ipse es, et anni tui non defícient.
1709f09fc7f9436fe592.english: 101:28 And as a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed. * But thou art always the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.

716a85e507fd4e5fb5bb.latin: 101:29 Fílii servórum tuórum habitábunt: * et semen eórum in sǽculum dirigétur.
716a85e507fd4e5fb5bb.english: 101:29 The children of thy servants shall continue: * and their seed shall be directed for ever.

adad9ab06022e4893264.latin: 102:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et ómnia, quæ intra me sunt, nómini sancto eius.
adad9ab06022e4893264.english: 102:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * and let all that is within me bless his holy name.

8778b2f82ec5a1cb9389.latin: 102:2 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * et noli oblivísci omnes retributiónes eius.
8778b2f82ec5a1cb9389.english: 102:2 Bless the Lord, O my soul, * and never forget all he hath done for thee.

dadf92eddcec4e3acb26.latin: 102:3 Qui propitiátur ómnibus iniquitátibus tuis: * qui sanat omnes infirmitátes tuas.
dadf92eddcec4e3acb26.english: 102:3 Who forgiveth all thy iniquities: * who healeth all thy diseases.

601441d7bffea8d82a05.latin: 102:4 Qui rédimit de intéritu vitam tuam: * qui corónat te in misericórdia et miseratiónibus.
601441d7bffea8d82a05.english: 102:4 Who redeemeth thy life from destruction: * who crowneth thee with mercy and compassion.

6ba593aa00ccbbe44ed8.latin: 102:5 Qui replet in bonis desidérium tuum: * renovábitur ut áquilæ iuvéntus tua:
6ba593aa00ccbbe44ed8.english: 102:5 Who satisfieth thy desire with good things: * thy youth shall be renewed like the eagle’s.

9466e763377551a1021a.latin: 102:6 Fáciens misericórdias Dóminus: * et iudícium ómnibus iniúriam patiéntibus.
9466e763377551a1021a.english: 102:6 The Lord doth mercies, * and judgment for all that suffer wrong.

8b4d92aaaa2944056e4e.latin: 102:7 Notas fecit vias suas Móysi, * fíliis Israël voluntátes suas.
8b4d92aaaa2944056e4e.english: 102:7 He hath made his ways known to Moses: * his wills to the children of Israel.

aace91e914a83ffd91e4.latin: 102:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * longánimis, et multum miséricors.
aace91e914a83ffd91e4.english: 102:8 The Lord is compassionate and merciful: * longsuffering and plenteous in mercy.

c15d1f8b1b3be9d15d4a.latin: 102:9 Non in perpétuum irascétur: * neque in ætérnum comminábitur.
c15d1f8b1b3be9d15d4a.english: 102:9 He will not always be angry: * nor will he threaten for ever.

231a9ccc0db299db8937.latin: 102:10 Non secúndum peccáta nostra fecit nobis: * neque secúndum iniquitátes nostras retríbuit nobis.
231a9ccc0db299db8937.english: 102:10 He hath not dealt with us according to our sins: * nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

cbb017f531379db40384.latin: 102:11 Quóniam secúndum altitúdinem cæli a terra: * corroborávit misericórdiam suam super timéntes se.
cbb017f531379db40384.english: 102:11 For according to the height of the heaven above the earth: * he hath strengthened his mercy towards them that fear him.

18373f17ede071349531.latin: 102:12 Quantum distat ortus ab occidénte: * longe fecit a nobis iniquitátes nostras.
18373f17ede071349531.english: 102:12 As far as the east is from the west, * so far hath he removed our iniquities from us.

d1bf0b8242d6db30f0db.latin: 102:13 Quómodo miserétur pater filiórum, misértus est Dóminus timéntibus se: * quóniam ipse cognóvit figméntum nostrum.
d1bf0b8242d6db30f0db.english: 102:13 As a father hath compassion on his children, so hath the Lord compassion on them that fear him: * for he knoweth our frame.

a8e0fa8f4bbddf3fca58.latin: 102:14 Recordátus est quóniam pulvis sumus: * homo, sicut fænum dies eius, tamquam flos agri sic efflorébit.
a8e0fa8f4bbddf3fca58.english: 102:14 He remembereth that we are dust: * man’s days are as grass, as the flower of the field so shall he flourish.

94d7c6a5fdf58fd5f143.latin: 102:16 Quóniam spíritus pertransíbit in illo, et non subsístet: * et non cognóscet ámplius locum suum.
94d7c6a5fdf58fd5f143.english: 102:16 For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: * and he shall know his place no more.

c73fcf05a8f631efce32.latin: 102:17 Misericórdia autem Dómini ab ætérno, * et usque in ætérnum super timéntes eum.
c73fcf05a8f631efce32.english: 102:17 But the mercy of the Lord is from eternity * and unto eternity upon them that fear him:

5ac854a398bf4492dbb4.latin: 102:17 Et iustítia illíus in fílios filiórum, * his qui servant testaméntum eius:
5ac854a398bf4492dbb4.english: 102:17 And his justice unto children’s children, * to such as keep his covenant,

f9cee8504c57fdc73ad4.latin: 102:18 Et mémores sunt mandatórum ipsíus, * ad faciéndum ea.
f9cee8504c57fdc73ad4.english: 102:18 And are mindful of his commandments * to do them.

fa4e483d8e978a50b12e.latin: 102:19 Dóminus in cælo parávit sedem suam: * et regnum ipsíus ómnibus dominábitur.
fa4e483d8e978a50b12e.english: 102:19 The Lord hath prepared his throne in heaven: * and his kingdom shall rule over all.

1dbcbb5d046c657bb369.latin: 102:20 Benedícite Dómino, omnes Ángeli eius: * poténtes virtúte, faciéntes verbum illíus, ad audiéndam vocem sermónum eius.
1dbcbb5d046c657bb369.english: 102:20 Bless the Lord, all ye his angels: * you that are mighty in strength, and execute his word, hearkening to the voice of his orders.

d22e905a293189fa7ac1.latin: 102:21 Benedícite Dómino, omnes virtútes eius: * minístri eius, qui fácitis voluntátem eius.
d22e905a293189fa7ac1.english: 102:21 Bless the Lord, all ye his hosts: * you ministers of his that do his will.

077a1cf5c03ae55a06fe.latin: 102:22 Benedícite Dómino, ómnia ópera eius: * in omni loco dominatiónis eius, bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
077a1cf5c03ae55a06fe.english: 102:22 Bless the Lord, all his works: * in every place of his dominion, O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

3c344369e6e1b777afa1.latin: Ant. Clamor meus ad te véniat, Deus.
3c344369e6e1b777afa1.english: Ant. O God let my cry come unto Thee.

d5079170add0305314fd.english: Ant. Bless the Lord, * O my soul. ‡

9a039708561ae96f3e52.latin: 103:1 Bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino: * ‡ Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter.
9a039708561ae96f3e52.english: 103:1 Bless the Lord, O my soul: * ‡ O Lord my God, thou art exceedingly great.

b00ff3cdaad12c7c60fb.latin: 103:1 Confessiónem, et decórem induísti: * amíctus lúmine sicut vestiménto:
b00ff3cdaad12c7c60fb.english: 103:1 Thou hast put on praise and beauty: * and art clothed with light as with a garment.

8b3bd5e0b0d9e543b558.latin: 103:2 Exténdens cælum sicut pellem: * qui tegis aquis superióra eius.
8b3bd5e0b0d9e543b558.english: 103:2 Who stretchest out the heaven like a pavilion: * who coverest the higher rooms thereof with water.

2de781b30de7fe40ff83.latin: 103:3 Qui ponis nubem ascénsum tuum: * qui ámbulas super pennas ventórum.
2de781b30de7fe40ff83.english: 103:3 Who makest the clouds thy chariot: * who walkest upon the wings of the winds.

0a103d5f21ef9c176ee1.latin: 103:4 Qui facis ángelos tuos, spíritus: * et minístros tuos ignem uréntem.
0a103d5f21ef9c176ee1.english: 103:4 Who makest thy angels spirits: * and thy ministers a burning fire.

894d80f2ced068f0e566.latin: 103:5 Qui fundásti terram super stabilitátem suam: * non inclinábitur in sǽculum sǽculi.
894d80f2ced068f0e566.english: 103:5 Who hast founded the earth upon its own bases: * it shall not be moved for ever and ever.

251a81c4e22f2a2750d6.latin: 103:6 Abýssus, sicut vestiméntum, amíctus eius: * super montes stabunt aquæ.
251a81c4e22f2a2750d6.english: 103:6 The deep like a garment is its clothing: * above the mountains shall the waters stand.

64f7b66818bd731b5487.latin: 103:7 Ab increpatióne tua fúgient: * a voce tonítrui tui formidábunt.
64f7b66818bd731b5487.english: 103:7 At thy rebuke they shall flee: * at the voice of thy thunder they shall fear.

2f2860ae0f4fab1dcbca.latin: 103:8 Ascéndunt montes: et descéndunt campi * in locum, quem fundásti eis.
2f2860ae0f4fab1dcbca.english: 103:8 The mountains ascend, and the plains descend * into the place which thou hast founded for them.

e9629d3a69190dee43c3.latin: 103:9 Términum posuísti, quem non transgrediéntur: * neque converténtur operíre terram.
e9629d3a69190dee43c3.english: 103:9 Thou hast set a bound which they shall not pass over; * neither shall they return to cover the earth.

a6c822578a142659e82d.latin: 103:10 Qui emíttis fontes in convállibus: * inter médium móntium pertransíbunt aquæ.
a6c822578a142659e82d.english: 103:10 Thou sendest forth springs in the vales: * between the midst of the hills the waters shall pass.

965c46fbbfc9e42c00d9.latin: 103:11 Potábunt omnes béstiæ agri: * exspectábunt ónagri in siti sua.
965c46fbbfc9e42c00d9.english: 103:11 All the beasts of the field shall drink: * the wild asses shall expect in their thirst.

d34c6c26b6d96a48d6dd.latin: 103:12 Super ea vólucres cæli habitábunt: * de médio petrárum dabunt voces.
d34c6c26b6d96a48d6dd.english: 103:12 Over them the birds of the air shall dwell: * from the midst of the rocks they shall give forth their voices.

dd84860cf29fb90a18c1.latin: 103:13 Rigans montes de superióribus suis: * de fructu óperum tuórum satiábitur terra:
dd84860cf29fb90a18c1.english: 103:13 Thou waterest the hills from thy upper rooms: * the earth shall be filled with the fruit of thy works:

b73186f673af559a5e8a.latin: 103:14 Prodúcens fænum iuméntis, * et herbam servitúti hóminum:
b73186f673af559a5e8a.english: 103:14 Bringing forth grass for cattle, * and herb for the service of men.

8eeddb9a578a58b657aa.latin: 103:14 Ut edúcas panem de terra: * et vinum lætíficet cor hóminis:
8eeddb9a578a58b657aa.english: 103:14 That thou mayst bring bread out of the earth: * and that wine may cheer the heart of man.

e428fd220a453cab01a7.latin: 103:15 Ut exhílaret fáciem in óleo: * et panis cor hóminis confírmet.
e428fd220a453cab01a7.english: 103:15 That he may make the face cheerful with oil: * and that bread may strengthen man’s heart.

bb7bfb53983ea824420a.latin: 103:16 Saturabúntur ligna campi, et cedri Líbani, quas plantávit: * illic pásseres nidificábunt.
bb7bfb53983ea824420a.english: 103:16 The trees of the field shall be filled, and the cedars of Libanus which he hath planted: * there the sparrows shall make their nests.

16cb6777d5a61cf0dc56.latin: 103:17 Heródii domus dux est eórum: * montes excélsi cervis: petra refúgium herináciis.
16cb6777d5a61cf0dc56.english: 103:17 The highest of them is the house of the heron. * The high hills are a refuge for the harts, the rock for the irchins.

96663735081ce69b98c4.latin: 103:19 Fecit lunam in témpora: * sol cognóvit occásum suum.
96663735081ce69b98c4.english: 103:19 He hath made the moon for seasons: * the sun knoweth his going down.

9104b27826afd6ca5f8d.latin: 103:20 Posuísti ténebras, et facta est nox: * in ipsa pertransíbunt omnes béstiæ silvæ.
9104b27826afd6ca5f8d.english: 103:20 Thou hast appointed darkness, and it is night: * in it shall all the beasts of the woods go about:

cecc0166a5c64256ba95.latin: 103:21 Cátuli leónum rugiéntes, ut rápiant, * et quærant a Deo escam sibi.
cecc0166a5c64256ba95.english: 103:21 The young lions roaring after their prey, * and seeking their meat from God.

405d40a4565125fda8f1.latin: 103:22 Ortus est sol, et congregáti sunt: * et in cubílibus suis collocabúntur.
405d40a4565125fda8f1.english: 103:22 The sun ariseth, and they are gathered together: * and they shall lie down in their dens.

70eab17afff92cfed0f3.latin: 103:23 Exíbit homo ad opus suum: * et ad operatiónem suam usque ad vésperum.
70eab17afff92cfed0f3.english: 103:23 Man shall go forth to his work, * and to his labour until the evening.

71ab0e43186f35072605.latin: 103:24 Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti: impléta est terra possessióne tua.
71ab0e43186f35072605.english: 103:24 How great are thy works, O Lord? * thou hast made all things in wisdom: the earth is filled with thy riches.

861fc855ea1dc2fa3f01.latin: 103:25 Hoc mare magnum, et spatiósum mánibus: * illic reptília, quorum non est númerus.
861fc855ea1dc2fa3f01.english: 103:25 So is this great sea, which stretcheth wide its arms: * there are creeping things without number:

2f13538f10f7781ef50f.latin: 103:26 Animália pusílla cum magnis: * illic naves pertransíbunt.
2f13538f10f7781ef50f.english: 103:26 Creatures little and great. * There the ships shall go.

339a3c053d071310a395.latin: 103:27 Draco iste, quem formásti ad illudéndum ei: * ómnia a te exspéctant ut des illis escam in témpore.
339a3c053d071310a395.english: 103:27 This sea dragon which thou hast formed to play therein. * All expect of thee that thou give them food in season.

5ce7ab8df01378727155.latin: 103:28 Dante te illis, cólligent: * aperiénte te manum tuam, ómnia implebúntur bonitáte.
5ce7ab8df01378727155.english: 103:28 What thou givest to them they shall gather up: * when thou openest thy hand, they shall all be filled with good.

f7c29ccbccd1c6fb0eb1.latin: 103:29 Averténte autem te fáciem, turbabúntur: * áuferes spíritum eórum, et defícient, et in púlverem suum reverténtur.
f7c29ccbccd1c6fb0eb1.english: 103:29 But if thou turnest away thy face, they shall be troubled: * thou shalt take away their breath, and they shall fail, and shall return to their dust.

504c3334c4a4ab486138.latin: 103:30 Emíttes spíritum tuum, et creabúntur: * et renovábis fáciem terræ.
504c3334c4a4ab486138.english: 103:30 Thou shalt send forth thy spirit, and they shall be created: * and thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

6c7835c3c005322ef0f3.latin: 103:31 Sit glória Dómini in sǽculum: * lætábitur Dóminus in opéribus suis:
6c7835c3c005322ef0f3.english: 103:31 May the glory of the Lord endure for ever: * the Lord shall rejoice in his works.

0413ea79184092941e9f.latin: 103:32 Qui réspicit terram, et facit eam trémere: * qui tangit montes, et fúmigant.
0413ea79184092941e9f.english: 103:32 He looketh upon the earth, and maketh it tremble: * he toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

b776591fa56ff31662c3.latin: 103:33 Cantábo Dómino in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo, quámdiu sum.
b776591fa56ff31662c3.english: 103:33 I will sing to the Lord as long as I live: * I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

6dc167fc709c401e46b3.latin: 103:34 Iucúndum sit ei elóquium meum: * ego vero delectábor in Dómino.
6dc167fc709c401e46b3.english: 103:34 Let my speech be acceptable to him: * but I will take delight in the Lord.

32e997473ce0daaed80f.latin: 103:35 Defíciant peccatóres a terra, et iníqui ita ut non sint: * bénedic, ánima mea, Dómino.
32e997473ce0daaed80f.english: 103:35 Let sinners be consumed out of the earth, and the unjust, so that they be no more: * O my soul, bless thou the Lord.

e3a3b685e8dc27986c43.english: Ant. Bless the Lord, O my soul.

7cf9af2b58cb64ef30bf.english: Ant. Let the heart of them rejoice, * that seek the Lord.

a26df4c30b8c85ce1fc2.latin: 104:1 Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen eius: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera eius.
a26df4c30b8c85ce1fc2.english: 104:1 Give glory to the Lord, and call upon his name: * declare his deeds among the Gentiles.

cfac3bceb75a413909b7.latin: 104:2 Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília eius.
cfac3bceb75a413909b7.english: 104:2 Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: * relate all his wondrous works.

45cd6411f58fc9c7c8d5.latin: 104:3 Laudámini in nómine sancto eius: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
45cd6411f58fc9c7c8d5.english: 104:3 Glory ye in his holy name: * let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

ae3b3349479a46a98c9b.latin: 104:4 Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem eius semper.
ae3b3349479a46a98c9b.english: 104:4 Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: * seek his face evermore.

73895aad59057bcadc84.latin: 104:5 Mementóte mirabílium eius, quæ fecit: * prodígia eius, et iudícia oris eius.
73895aad59057bcadc84.english: 104:5 Remember his marvellous works which he hath done; * his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

7175b182e05077a000c8.latin: 104:6 Semen Ábraham, servi eius: * fílii Iacob, elécti eius.
7175b182e05077a000c8.english: 104:6 O ye seed of Abraham his servant; * ye sons of Jacob his chosen.

bdf43f1e7f0d007bef88.latin: 104:7 Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra iudícia eius.
bdf43f1e7f0d007bef88.english: 104:7 He is the Lord our God: * his judgments are in all the earth.

9af0f3a5470683182770.latin: 104:8 Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
9af0f3a5470683182770.english: 104:8 He hath remembered his covenant for ever: * the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

65792adf5cec70c17ec9.latin: 104:9 Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et iuraménti sui ad Isaac:
65792adf5cec70c17ec9.english: 104:9 Which he made to Abraham; * and his oath to Isaac:

7c6cb6a34bf706334bc8.latin: 104:10 Et státuit illud Iacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
7c6cb6a34bf706334bc8.english: 104:10 And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, * and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

110230c8cafa6518e206.latin: 104:11 Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.
110230c8cafa6518e206.english: 104:11 Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, * the lot of your inheritance.

3c0eac19f9abf95bbac5.latin: 104:12 Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ eius:
3c0eac19f9abf95bbac5.english: 104:12 When they were but a small number: * yea very few, and sojourners therein:

5f833666a185c370ef65.latin: 104:13 Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
5f833666a185c370ef65.english: 104:13 And they passed from nation to nation, * and from one kingdom to another people.

d5f902618ecb7d9597af.latin: 104:14 Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.
d5f902618ecb7d9597af.english: 104:14 He suffered no man to hurt them: * and he reproved kings for their sakes.

f63983f1f251ff34caa5.latin: 104:15 Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
f63983f1f251ff34caa5.english: 104:15 Touch ye not my anointed: * and do no evil to my prophets.

34a9a0b62a11adb76c5f.latin: 104:16 Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
34a9a0b62a11adb76c5f.english: 104:16 And he called a famine upon the land: * and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.

00f5889614d644d20e53.latin: 104:17 Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Ioseph.
00f5889614d644d20e53.english: 104:17 He sent a man before them: * Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

6a222824eeca9d052b5f.latin: 104:18 Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes eius, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam eius * donec veníret verbum eius.
6a222824eeca9d052b5f.english: 104:18 They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, * until his word came.

7ce0c829b7d3009beb73.latin: 104:19 Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
7ce0c829b7d3009beb73.english: 104:19 The word of the Lord inflamed him: * the king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

19f98181af61be3ab17c.latin: 104:21 Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
19f98181af61be3ab17c.english: 104:21 He made him master of his house, * and ruler of all his possession.

e55ac3cc976005b31445.latin: 104:22 Ut erudíret príncipes eius sicut semetípsum: * et senes eius prudéntiam docéret.
e55ac3cc976005b31445.english: 104:22 That he might instruct his princes as himself, * and teach his ancients wisdom.

b18c93f476f7c7c252c0.latin: 104:23 Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Iacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
b18c93f476f7c7c252c0.english: 104:23 And Israel went into Egypt: * and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

a38d470eabaf70daf8ee.latin: 104:24 Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos eius.
a38d470eabaf70daf8ee.english: 104:24 And he increased his people exceedingly: * and strengthened them over their enemies,

1a602d8d4b13aa8a20e1.latin: 104:25 Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum eius: * et dolum fácerent in servos eius.
1a602d8d4b13aa8a20e1.english: 104:25 He turned their heart to hate his people: * and to deal deceitfully with his servants.

10a8e9a245aa041ff022.latin: 104:26 Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
10a8e9a245aa041ff022.english: 104:26 He sent Moses his servant: * Aaron the man whom he had chosen.

db52f83791af1b97ba18.latin: 104:27 Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
db52f83791af1b97ba18.english: 104:27 He gave them power to shew his signs, * and his wonders in the land of Cham.

5f837dbb18815ed65da5.latin: 104:28 Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
5f837dbb18815ed65da5.english: 104:28 He sent darkness, and made it obscure: * and grieved not his words.

adb92b2264e63cdeb199.latin: 104:29 Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.
adb92b2264e63cdeb199.english: 104:29 He turned their waters into blood, * and destroyed their fish.

bead278125e588cab8ea.latin: 104:30 Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
bead278125e588cab8ea.english: 104:30 Their land brought forth frogs, * in the inner chambers of their kings.

7059f45b7ca7d5f480ef.latin: 104:31 Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
7059f45b7ca7d5f480ef.english: 104:31 He spoke, and there came diverse sorts of flies, * and sciniphs in all their coasts.

5d26edf7c78708650bf6.latin: 104:32 Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
5d26edf7c78708650bf6.english: 104:32 He gave them hail for rain, * a burning fire in the land.

a23c3a31c41d39f8b951.latin: 104:33 Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
a23c3a31c41d39f8b951.english: 104:33 And he destroyed their vineyards, and their fig trees: * and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

1bbce982612a13ca0f07.latin: 104:34 Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cuius non erat númerus:
1bbce982612a13ca0f07.english: 104:34 He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, * of which there was no number.

097a8367409d73541f5b.latin: 104:35 Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
097a8367409d73541f5b.english: 104:35 And they devoured all the grass in their land, * and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

d7c5a5c4d5805cb5030b.latin: 104:36 Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.
d7c5a5c4d5805cb5030b.english: 104:36 And he slew all the firstborn in their land: * the firstfruits of all their labour.

b7c8ef1cd0bdf27300e5.latin: 104:37 Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
b7c8ef1cd0bdf27300e5.english: 104:37 And he brought them out with silver and gold: * and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

fb950944da1516bd0a13.latin: 104:38 Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
fb950944da1516bd0a13.english: 104:38 Egypt was glad when they departed: * for the fear of them lay upon them.

111c36433cd00632758f.latin: 104:39 Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
111c36433cd00632758f.english: 104:39 He spread a cloud for their protection, * and fire to give them light in the night.

a9c025c22edcd659311a.latin: 104:40 Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.
a9c025c22edcd659311a.english: 104:40 They asked, and the quail came: * and he filled them with the bread of heaven.

ed90c09a86cd503f362a.latin: 104:41 Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;
ed90c09a86cd503f362a.english: 104:41 He opened the rock, and waters flowed: * rivers ran down in the dry land.

097150aae2353d86a1af.latin: 104:42 Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
097150aae2353d86a1af.english: 104:42 Because he remembered his holy word, * which he had spoken to his servant Abraham.

af4ccc306401d5ab2b5a.latin: 104:43 Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.
af4ccc306401d5ab2b5a.english: 104:43 And he brought forth his people with joy, * and his chosen with gladness.

5b9cea326d829996b84e.latin: 104:44 Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:
5b9cea326d829996b84e.english: 104:44 And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles: * and they possessed the labours of the people:

f920b08fd72d182cbb06.latin: 104:45 Ut custódiant iustificatiónes eius, * et legem eius requírant.
f920b08fd72d182cbb06.english: 104:45 That they might observe his justifications, * and seek after his law.

a961d2bfee3e5cce8da2.english: Ant. Let the heart of them rejoice, that seek the Lord.

db727ccdb9428e7db60d.latin: Absolutio. Précibus et méritis beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis et ómnium Sanctórum, perdúcat nos Dóminus ad regna cælórum.
db727ccdb9428e7db60d.english: Absolution. May the prayers and merits of blessed Mary ever Virgin and all the Saints bring us to the kingdom of heaven.

e29366d0f44d8a3b7317.latin:
℣. Iube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. Per Vírginem matrem concédat nobis Dóminus salútem et pacem.
℟. Amen.
Lectio brevis
Sermo sancti Bernárdi Abbátis
Serm. in cap. 12 Apoc., ante med.
Amplectámur Maríæ vestígia, fratres mei, et devotíssima supplicatióne beátis illíus pédibus provolvámur. Teneámus eam nec dimittámus, donec benedíxerit nobis; potens est enim. Nempe vellus est médium inter rorem et áream: múlier inter solem et lunam: María inter Christum et Ecclésiam constitúta. Sed forte miráris, non tam vellus opértum rore, quam amíctam sole mulíerem. Magna síquidem familiáritas, sed mira omníno vicínitas solis et mulíeris. Quómodo enim in tam veheménti fervóre tam frágilis natúra subsístit? Mérito quidem admiráris, Móyses sancte, et curiósius desíderas intuéri. Verúmtamen solve calceaménta de pédibus tuis, et involúcra pone carnálium cogitatiónum, si accédere concupíscis.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟. Felix namque es, sacra Virgo María, et omni laude digníssima:
* Quia ex te ortus est sol iustítiæ, Christus, Deus noster.
℣. Ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu: séntiant omnes tuum iuvámen, quicúmque célebrant tuam sanctam commemoratiónem.
℟. Quia ex te ortus est sol iustítiæ.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Christus, Deus noster.
e29366d0f44d8a3b7317.english:
℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benediction. Through the Virgin Mother, the Lord grant us salvation and peace.
℟. Amen.
Short reading
A sermon of St. Bernard, Abbot
Sermon of ch. 12 of the Apocalypse, in the first half
My brothers, let us cast ourselves at Mary's blessed feet with the most devout supplication. Let us embrace them, let us hold fast to her, and not let go until she blesses us; for she has great power. Like the fleece between the dew and the threshing floor, like the woman between the sun and the moon, so Mary stands between Christ and the Church. But perhaps you wonder, not so much at the fleece covered with dew, but at the woman clothed with the sun. Any relationship between the sun and the woman would be striking enough, but this proximity is indeed something to be marveled at. How can so fragile a nature subsist in that excessive heat? You have a right to wonder, saintly Moses; it is only natural that in your curiosity you should want to look more closely. But “remove the sandals from your feet”, put aside the covering of fleshly thoughts, if you wish to draw near.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟. O Holy Virgin Mary, happy indeed art thou, and right worthy of all praise
* For out of thee rose the Sun of righteousness, even Christ our God.
℣. Pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God. Let all that are making this holy memorial of thee feel the might of thine assistance.
℟. For out of thee rose the Sun of righteousness.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Even Christ our God.

92f0e0c64e2f8a88c54a.latin: 105:1 Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
92f0e0c64e2f8a88c54a.english: 105:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

b46df55cd7f27b955cd5.latin: 105:2 Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes eius?
b46df55cd7f27b955cd5.english: 105:2 Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? * who shall set forth all his praises?

74c0ba47b630cd1fb46b.latin: 105:3 Beáti, qui custódiunt iudícium, * et fáciunt iustítiam in omni témpore.
74c0ba47b630cd1fb46b.english: 105:3 Blessed are they that keep judgment, * and do justice at all times.

8df5b7fc93da11133abb.latin: 105:4 Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:
8df5b7fc93da11133abb.english: 105:4 Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of thy people: * visit us with thy salvation.

1a069c55b922b0947ecd.latin: 105:5 Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
1a069c55b922b0947ecd.english: 105:5 That we may see the good of thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of thy nation: * that thou mayst be praised with thy inheritance.

80667ec82704b80cb428.latin: 105:6 Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * iniúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
80667ec82704b80cb428.english: 105:6 We have sinned with our fathers: * we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

c2b156647087f5576252.latin: 105:7 Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: * non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ.
c2b156647087f5576252.english: 105:7 Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt: * they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies:

60d3d663f98943eb896f.latin: 105:7 Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.
60d3d663f98943eb896f.english: 105:7 And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, * even the Red Sea.

7bfc1de07f5be1fcf6be.latin: 105:8 Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
7bfc1de07f5be1fcf6be.english: 105:8 And he saved them for his own name’s sake: * that he might make his power known.

51c4391ed954f11b6e16.latin: 105:9 Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
51c4391ed954f11b6e16.english: 105:9 And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: * and he led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

2ad81f644e976d76b9b5.latin: 105:10 Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
2ad81f644e976d76b9b5.english: 105:10 And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: * and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

68df39e7250dbd4648b2.latin: 105:11 Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.
68df39e7250dbd4648b2.english: 105:11 And the water covered them that afflicted them: * there was not one of them left.

a0b43a0f1cb13a6966e6.latin: 105:12 Et credidérunt verbis eius: * et laudavérunt laudem eius.
a0b43a0f1cb13a6966e6.english: 105:12 And they believed his words: * and they sang his praises.

b7cef615b8c9e9520b7c.latin: 105:13 Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum eius: * et non sustinuérunt consílium eius.
b7cef615b8c9e9520b7c.english: 105:13 They had quickly done, they forgot his works: * and they waited not for his counsels.

ea6058f9ad78e01e1165.latin: 105:14 Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
ea6058f9ad78e01e1165.english: 105:14 And they coveted their desire in the desert: * and they tempted God in the place without water.

693978594b0476e068be.latin: 105:15 Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
693978594b0476e068be.english: 105:15 And he gave them their request: * and sent fulness into their souls.

cf42409db3d3a4a29412.latin: 105:16 Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
cf42409db3d3a4a29412.english: 105:16 And they provoked Moses in the camp, * Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

f367c39b16407503d02e.latin: 105:17 Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
f367c39b16407503d02e.english: 105:17 The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: * and covered the congregation of Abiron.

b2d634f04fc85f525bba.latin: 105:18 Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.
b2d634f04fc85f525bba.english: 105:18 And a fire was kindled in their congregation: * the flame burned the wicked.

e7d2b3bf45f071032409.latin: 105:19 Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.
e7d2b3bf45f071032409.english: 105:19 They made also a calf in Horeb: * and they adored the graven thing.

12e4bcbabf44f6c23d73.latin: 105:20 Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
12e4bcbabf44f6c23d73.english: 105:20 And they changed their glory * into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

55e82071ab67f9fbdc0c.latin: 105:21 Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
55e82071ab67f9fbdc0c.english: 105:21 They forgot God, who saved them, * who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

89551c2cf22f426515fd.latin: 105:23 Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus eius, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu eius:
89551c2cf22f426515fd.english: 105:23 And he said that he would destroy them: * had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach:

2cbea2aa6cfbf39d0492.latin: 105:24 Ut avérteret iram eius ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:
2cbea2aa6cfbf39d0492.english: 105:24 To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them; * and they set at nought the desirable land.

0e7191464fa6ce28afd9.latin: 105:25 Non credidérunt verbo eius, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
0e7191464fa6ce28afd9.english: 105:25 They believed not his word, and they murmured in their tents: * they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

58072f56696137caf29d.latin: 105:26 Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
58072f56696137caf29d.english: 105:26 And he lifted up his hand over them: * to overthrow them in the desert;

87042aeda3f065a7271a.latin: 105:27 Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
87042aeda3f065a7271a.english: 105:27 And to cast down their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them in the countries.

70d9108d4452571cde3d.latin: 105:28 Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
70d9108d4452571cde3d.english: 105:28 They also were initiated to Beelphegor: * and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

12ca681149b4db513056.latin: 105:29 Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
12ca681149b4db513056.english: 105:29 And they provoked him with their inventions: * and destruction was multiplied among them.

048c64142f84f4bb2f92.latin: 105:30 Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.
048c64142f84f4bb2f92.english: 105:30 Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: * and the slaughter ceased.

1cc8c58483af04cc1b71.latin: 105:31 Et reputátum est ei in iustítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
1cc8c58483af04cc1b71.english: 105:31 And it was reputed to him unto justice, * to generation and generation for evermore.

b76e74b260baf52f5443.latin: 105:32 Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum eius.
b76e74b260baf52f5443.english: 105:32 They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: * and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

9740de59cedf02dcb772.latin: 105:33 Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
9740de59cedf02dcb772.english: 105:33 And he distinguished with his lips; * they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

b49fa44f678314ed580f.latin: 105:35 Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.
b49fa44f678314ed580f.english: 105:35 And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, * and it became a stumblingblock to them.

7b9c8c4bf79abdc5a143.latin: 105:37 Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.
7b9c8c4bf79abdc5a143.english: 105:37 And they sacrificed their sons, * and their daughters to devils.

36217e6fc34758ca044a.latin: 105:38 Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.
36217e6fc34758ca044a.english: 105:38 And they shed innocent blood: * the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan.

0d925268d646df4e39f8.latin: 105:39 Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
0d925268d646df4e39f8.english: 105:39 And the land was polluted with blood, and was defiled with their works: * and they went aside after their own inventions.

3db06463ac6940b7d07b.latin: 105:40 Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
3db06463ac6940b7d07b.english: 105:40 And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: * and he abhorred his inheritance.

25beab1fbcfd017c7153.latin: 105:41 Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
25beab1fbcfd017c7153.english: 105:41 And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: * and they that hated them had dominion over them.

71d5b7ee97beae06778f.latin: 105:42 Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.
71d5b7ee97beae06778f.english: 105:42 And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands: * many times did he deliver them.

4c9232a93e77dbae580f.latin: 105:43 Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
4c9232a93e77dbae580f.english: 105:43 But they provoked him with their counsel: * and they were brought low by their iniquities.

024e2f97cd90271176aa.latin: 105:44 Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.
024e2f97cd90271176aa.english: 105:44 And he saw when they were in tribulation: * and he heard their prayer.

c218f3c8b61cdf5343fa.latin: 105:45 Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
c218f3c8b61cdf5343fa.english: 105:45 And he was mindful of his covenant: * and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

86eeec96c54596461759.latin: 105:46 Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
86eeec96c54596461759.english: 105:46 And he gave them unto mercies, * in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

cb3a8e759b4adf8179cd.latin: 105:47 Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: * et cóngrega nos de natiónibus:
cb3a8e759b4adf8179cd.english: 105:47 Save us, O Lord, our God: * and gather us from among nations:

df7356674d12d7a8b53a.latin: 105:47 Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.
df7356674d12d7a8b53a.english: 105:47 That we may give thanks to thy holy name, * and may glory in thy praise.

f9c5ea617272df8b9cff.latin: 105:48 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
f9c5ea617272df8b9cff.english: 105:48 Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: * and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

f05c0f253f3bf652b7ef.latin: 106:1 Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia eius.
f05c0f253f3bf652b7ef.english: 106:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

037b1de0895f0f5e237d.latin: 106:2 Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
037b1de0895f0f5e237d.english: 106:2 Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: * and gathered out of the countries.

34474a8e118389ecda84.latin: 106:3 A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.
34474a8e118389ecda84.english: 106:3 From the rising and the setting of the sun, * from the north and from the sea.

7c9c6c3d85950d986b68.latin: 106:4 Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
7c9c6c3d85950d986b68.english: 106:4 They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: * they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

97044d2ae1172e0a9e02.latin: 106:5 Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
97044d2ae1172e0a9e02.english: 106:5 They were hungry and thirsty: * their soul fainted in them.

9a24af6140817d7e0ce7.latin: 106:6 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
9a24af6140817d7e0ce7.english: 106:6 And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

39958424cd487dc3af4f.latin: 106:7 Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
39958424cd487dc3af4f.english: 106:7 And he led them into the right way: * that they might go to a city of habitation.

41118fc1fe19359bef47.latin: 106:8 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
41118fc1fe19359bef47.english: 106:8 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

02fe7982c6b534b46f36.latin: 106:9 Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
02fe7982c6b534b46f36.english: 106:9 For he hath satisfied the empty soul, * and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

15c183c33ab9b8de3060.latin: 106:10 Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
15c183c33ab9b8de3060.english: 106:10 Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: * bound in want and in iron.

5389b9626b3a10b48380.latin: 106:11 Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
5389b9626b3a10b48380.english: 106:11 Because they had exasperated the words of God: * and provoked the counsel of the most High:

4e526ce6ecd4268f37e7.latin: 106:12 Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adiuváret.
4e526ce6ecd4268f37e7.english: 106:12 And their heart was humbled with labours: * they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

5a4e14786ccf9f2a4b48.latin: 106:13 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
5a4e14786ccf9f2a4b48.english: 106:13 Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

41355b0cd88abf99000f.latin: 106:14 Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.
41355b0cd88abf99000f.english: 106:14 And he brought them out of darkness, * and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

067d5cf110df379c811e.latin: 106:15 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
067d5cf110df379c811e.english: 106:15 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

ce9608b52b7a0d72eb59.latin: 106:16 Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.
ce9608b52b7a0d72eb59.english: 106:16 Because he hath broken gates of brass, * and burst the iron bars.

150ce22d9c9498f91cf5.latin: 106:17 Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter iniustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
150ce22d9c9498f91cf5.english: 106:17 He took them out of the way of their iniquity: * for they were brought low for their injustices.

a91317de1bffabc83e2a.latin: 106:18 Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
a91317de1bffabc83e2a.english: 106:18 Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: * and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

781ee965c48af199902d.latin: 106:19 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
781ee965c48af199902d.english: 106:19 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

739ce2b97e482aeef6fd.latin: 106:20 Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
739ce2b97e482aeef6fd.english: 106:20 He sent his word, and healed them: * and delivered them from their destructions.

8f8a12362b8b57bec9db.latin: 106:21 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
8f8a12362b8b57bec9db.english: 106:21 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

cfff626b2d1176b05617.latin: 106:22 Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera eius in exsultatióne.
cfff626b2d1176b05617.english: 106:22 And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: * and declare his works with joy.

b211f482388f6277bd0c.latin: 106:23 Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
b211f482388f6277bd0c.english: 106:23 They that go down to the sea in ships, * doing business in the great waters:

9c72a064b89d5dd18a12.latin: 106:24 Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília eius in profúndo.
9c72a064b89d5dd18a12.english: 106:24 These have seen the works of the Lord, * and his wonders in the deep.

32f1147e38b459a1d5e0.latin: 106:25 Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus eius.
32f1147e38b459a1d5e0.english: 106:25 He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: * and the waves thereof were lifted up.

7ba8a3aa565bf424b182.latin: 106:26 Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
7ba8a3aa565bf424b182.english: 106:26 They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: * their soul pined away with evils.

8d41f6b2f8af8f06fc62.latin: 106:27 Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
8d41f6b2f8af8f06fc62.english: 106:27 They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; * and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

cda64fd35d94d7958fb1.latin: 106:28 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
cda64fd35d94d7958fb1.english: 106:28 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he brought them out of their distresses.

fd138dde553f7f13c8fe.latin: 106:29 Et státuit procéllam eius in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus eius.
fd138dde553f7f13c8fe.english: 106:29 And he turned the storm into a breeze: * and its waves were still.

78240856994981dabb4e.latin: 106:30 Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
78240856994981dabb4e.english: 106:30 And they rejoiced because they were still: * and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.

189493790dc0efe35cf5.latin: 106:31 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ eius: * et mirabília eius fíliis hóminum.
189493790dc0efe35cf5.english: 106:31 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

1a297d9facb8785c2dce.latin: 106:32 Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
1a297d9facb8785c2dce.english: 106:32 And let them exalt him in the church of the people: * and praise him in the chair of the ancients.

e5004cf95b650672cff7.latin: 106:33 Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
e5004cf95b650672cff7.english: 106:33 He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: * and the sources of water into dry ground:

96e3f4beaded5f0980ae.latin: 106:34 Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
96e3f4beaded5f0980ae.english: 106:34 A fruitful land into barrenness, * for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

e57374c9945067eb06cb.latin: 106:35 Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
e57374c9945067eb06cb.english: 106:35 He hath turned a wilderness into pools of water, * and a dry land into water springs.

3268e0a8b440aa69bde2.latin: 106:36 Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
3268e0a8b440aa69bde2.english: 106:36 And hath placed there the hungry; * and they made a city for their habitation.

a2f803b20635396dc533.latin: 106:37 Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
a2f803b20635396dc533.english: 106:37 And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: * and they yielded fruit of birth.

b56ac8d9fbd92abea35c.latin: 106:38 Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et iuménta eórum non minorávit.
b56ac8d9fbd92abea35c.english: 106:38 And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: * and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.

ef249279af09f447ddfb.latin: 106:39 Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.
ef249279af09f447ddfb.english: 106:39 Then they were brought to be few: * and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

4bec7f15ca22acbc2181.latin: 106:40 Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
4bec7f15ca22acbc2181.english: 106:40 Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: * and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.

68d79f6680a5e3f3a117.latin: 106:41 Et adiúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
68d79f6680a5e3f3a117.english: 106:41 And he helped the poor out of poverty: * and made him families like a flock of sheep.

ba535f936374e7c63a6e.latin: 106:42 Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
ba535f936374e7c63a6e.english: 106:42 The just shall see, and shall rejoice, * and all iniquity shall stop their mouth.
