e3716d7b652cfa1e4995.latin: 106:43 Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.
e3716d7b652cfa1e4995.english: 106:43 Who is wise, and will keep these things: * and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

3564dec12fe1317aad28.latin: 107:2 Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psallam in glória mea.
3564dec12fe1317aad28.english: 107:2 My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and will give praise, with my glory.

93daef034a25450980f8.latin: 107:3 Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
93daef034a25450980f8.english: 107:3 Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and harp * I will arise in the morning early.

3f9202cd36e014d874f7.latin: 107:4 Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psallam tibi in natiónibus.
3f9202cd36e014d874f7.english: 107:4 I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: * and I will sing unto thee among the nations.

68b830f031882e588ac5.latin: 107:5 Quia magna est super cælos misericórdia tua: * et usque ad nubes véritas tua:
68b830f031882e588ac5.english: 107:5 For thy mercy is great above the heavens: * and thy truth even unto the clouds.

25215324a6d10f5e32a9.latin: 107:6 Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram glória tua: * ut liberéntur dilécti tui.
25215324a6d10f5e32a9.english: 107:6 Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, and thy glory over all the earth: * that thy beloved may be delivered.

a03b4d9a1efc93c3b14e.latin: 107:7 Salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me: * Deus locútus est in sancto suo:
a03b4d9a1efc93c3b14e.english: 107:7 Save with thy right hand and hear me. * God hath spoken in his holiness.

442d517a6b6025ce5e27.latin: 107:8 Exsultábo, et dívidam Síchimam, * et convállem tabernaculórum dimétiar.
442d517a6b6025ce5e27.english: 107:8 I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem * and I will mete out the vale of tabernacles.

95932522c5dc56c25f2e.latin: 107:9 Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim suscéptio cápitis mei.
95932522c5dc56c25f2e.english: 107:9 Galaad is mine: and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim the protection of my head.

a854bf5d94e8b09ef512.latin: 107:10 Iuda rex meus: * Moab lebes spei meæ.
a854bf5d94e8b09ef512.english: 107:10 Juda is my king: * Moab the pot of my hope.

611a911b2547b59209a9.latin: 107:10 In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ amíci facti sunt.
611a911b2547b59209a9.english: 107:10 Over Edom I will stretch out my shoe: * the aliens are become my friends.

ea9c8ea112e94ae4301d.latin: 107:11 Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
ea9c8ea112e94ae4301d.english: 107:11 Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?

f5cd2cdeabfb46b3155c.latin: 107:12 Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos, * et non exíbis, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
f5cd2cdeabfb46b3155c.english: 107:12 Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our armies?

7f249b45b3b2c47b2a75.latin: 107:13 Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
7f249b45b3b2c47b2a75.english: 107:13 O grant us help from trouble: * for vain is the help of man.

679af00f285204765198.latin: 107:14 In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet inimícos nostros.
679af00f285204765198.english: 107:14 Through God we shall do mightily: * and he will bring our enemies to nothing.

84e177b9c863e64e8fd2.latin: 108:2 Deus, laudem meam ne tacúeris: * quia os peccatóris, et os dolósi super me apértum est.
84e177b9c863e64e8fd2.english: 108:2 God, be not thou silent in my praise: * for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.

4ce78b87d775c029b3c7.latin: 108:3 Locúti sunt advérsum me lingua dolósa, et sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me: * et expugnavérunt me gratis.
4ce78b87d775c029b3c7.english: 108:3 They have spoken against me with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; * and have fought against me without cause.

ac5126506225e6dbc5a9.latin: 108:4 Pro eo ut me dilígerent, detrahébant mihi: * ego autem orábam.
ac5126506225e6dbc5a9.english: 108:4 Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: * but I gave myself to prayer.

8f436ddb183067814730.latin: 108:5 Et posuérunt advérsum me mala pro bonis: * et ódium pro dilectióne mea.
8f436ddb183067814730.english: 108:5 And they repaid me evil for good: * and hatred for my love.

992de97a54c7485fe0c9.latin: 108:6 Constítue super eum peccatórem: * et diábolus stet a dextris eius.
992de97a54c7485fe0c9.english: 108:6 Set thou the sinner over him: * and may the devil stand at his right hand.

649ff78f69af887eff3b.latin: 108:7 Cum iudicátur, éxeat condemnátus: * et orátio eius fiat in peccátum.
649ff78f69af887eff3b.english: 108:7 When he is judged, may he go out condemned; * and may his prayer be turned to sin.

1af1bf1f52db81325344.latin: 108:8 Fiant dies eius pauci: * et episcopátum eius accípiat alter.
1af1bf1f52db81325344.english: 108:8 May his days be few: * and his bishopric let another take.

47fa07df118d9f17b25f.latin: 108:9 Fiant fílii eius órphani: * et uxor eius vídua.
47fa07df118d9f17b25f.english: 108:9 May his children be fatherless, * and his wife a widow.

9f7f62a2d8e8bb102c28.latin: 108:10 Nutántes transferántur fílii eius, et mendícent: * et eiciántur de habitatiónibus suis.
9f7f62a2d8e8bb102c28.english: 108:10 Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; * and let them be cast out of their dwellings.

59b2e1ad15325171460a.latin: 108:11 Scrutétur fænerátor omnem substántiam eius: * et dirípiant aliéni labóres eius.
59b2e1ad15325171460a.english: 108:11 May the usurer search all his substance: * and let strangers plunder his labours.

461075a60dd3a3970043.latin: 108:12 Non sit illi adiútor: * nec sit qui misereátur pupíllis eius.
461075a60dd3a3970043.english: 108:12 May there be none to help him: * nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.

6cc6a90af127c8adaeb8.latin: 108:13 Fiant nati eius in intéritum: * in generatióne una deleátur nomen eius.
6cc6a90af127c8adaeb8.english: 108:13 May his posterity be cut off; * in one generation may his name be blotted out.

ada24bb29f56c7ba308f.latin: 108:14 In memóriam rédeat iníquitas patrum eius in conspéctu Dómini: * et peccátum matris eius non deleátur.
ada24bb29f56c7ba308f.english: 108:14 May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: * and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

823bdc4de06206a6d2eb.latin: 108:15 Fiant contra Dóminum semper, et dispéreat de terra memória eórum: * pro eo quod non est recordátus fácere misericórdiam.
823bdc4de06206a6d2eb.english: 108:15 May they be before the Lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth: * because he remembered not to shew mercy,

69fa90e8ac4bdf120115.latin: 108:17 Et persecútus est hóminem ínopem, et mendícum, * et compúnctum corde mortificáre.
69fa90e8ac4bdf120115.english: 108:17 But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; * and the broken in heart, to put him to death.

dfb0a4a273bde5dc8478.latin: 108:18 Et diléxit maledictiónem, et véniet ei: * et nóluit benedictiónem, et elongábitur ab eo.
dfb0a4a273bde5dc8478.english: 108:18 And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: * and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him.

dcd50fd48eeec804f49f.latin: 108:18 Et índuit maledictiónem sicut vestiméntum, * et intrávit sicut aqua in interióra eius, et sicut óleum in óssibus eius.
dcd50fd48eeec804f49f.english: 108:18 And he put on cursing, like a garment: * and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.

dac827a37e96a0f67c71.latin: 108:19 Fiat ei sicut vestiméntum, quo operítur: * et sicut zona, qua semper præcíngitur.
dac827a37e96a0f67c71.english: 108:19 May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; * and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.

49b99b67cb1483bd353e.latin: 108:20 Hoc opus eórum, qui détrahunt mihi apud Dóminum: * et qui loquúntur mala advérsus ánimam meam.
49b99b67cb1483bd353e.english: 108:20 This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; * and who speak evils against my soul.

4a128266e7b70b038adb.latin: 108:21 Et tu, Dómine, Dómine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum: * quia suávis est misericórdia tua.
4a128266e7b70b038adb.english: 108:21 But thou, O Lord, do with me for thy name’s sake: * because thy mercy is sweet.

cff20890d2044fa639b2.latin: 108:22 Líbera me quia egénus, et pauper ego sum: * et cor meum conturbátum est intra me.
cff20890d2044fa639b2.english: 108:22 Do thou deliver me, for I am poor and needy, * and my heart is troubled within me.

289ced81d6f3cfd4fb07.latin: 108:23 Sicut umbra cum declínat, ablátus sum: * et excússus sum sicut locústæ.
289ced81d6f3cfd4fb07.english: 108:23 I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: * and I am shaken off as locusts.

c4aacb0c965fa1ecb43f.latin: 108:24 Génua mea infirmáta sunt a ieiúnio: * et caro mea immutáta est propter óleum.
c4aacb0c965fa1ecb43f.english: 108:24 My knees are weakened through fasting: * and my flesh is changed for oil.

10d34879753aadd333fb.latin: 108:25 Et ego factus sum oppróbrium illis: * vidérunt me, et movérunt cápita sua.
10d34879753aadd333fb.english: 108:25 And I am become a reproach to them: * they saw me and they shaked their heads.

6ac7fa2183c7de68c42b.latin: 108:26 Ádiuva me, Dómine, Deus meus: * salvum me fac secúndum misericórdiam tuam.
6ac7fa2183c7de68c42b.english: 108:26 Help me, O Lord my God; * save me according to thy mercy.

e8204083cb215becf9cd.latin: 108:27 Et sciant quia manus tua hæc: * et tu, Dómine, fecísti eam.
e8204083cb215becf9cd.english: 108:27 And let them know that this is thy hand: * and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.

7fb032b59d49c7df1234.latin: 108:28 Maledícent illi, et tu benedíces: * qui insúrgunt in me, confundántur: servus autem tuus lætábitur.
7fb032b59d49c7df1234.english: 108:28 They will curse and thou wilt bless: * let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.

b7a9d34c476aae1252f7.latin: 108:29 Induántur qui détrahunt mihi, pudóre: * et operiántur sicut diplóide confusióne sua.
b7a9d34c476aae1252f7.english: 108:29 Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: * and let them be covered with their confusion as with a double cloak.

226c9601c79cce563d25.latin: 108:30 Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo: * et in médio multórum laudábo eum.
226c9601c79cce563d25.english: 108:30 I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: * and in the midst of many I will praise him.

75fa231d754e6e0d7259.latin: 108:31 Quia ástitit a dextris páuperis, * ut salvam fáceret a persequéntibus ánimam meam.
75fa231d754e6e0d7259.english: 108:31 Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, * to save my soul from persecutors.

f080b217ab4cf33a3635.latin:
Eccli 24:26-28
Transíte ad me, omnes qui concupíscitis me, et a generatiónibus meis implémini: spíritus enim meus super mel dulcis, et heréditas mea super mel et favum: memória mea in generatióne sæculórum.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Speciósa facta es et suávis.
℟. In delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
f080b217ab4cf33a3635.english:
Sir 24:26-28
Come over to me, all ye that desire me, and be filled with my fruits. For my spirit is sweet above honey, and my inheritance above honey and the honeycomb. My memory is unto everlasting generations.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. You are beautiful and sweet.
℟. In your delights O holy mother of God.

d9c1dcf26bdf72f3bfcd.latin: Concéde nos fámulos tuos, quǽsumus, Dómine Deus, perpétua mentis et córporis sanitáte gaudére: et, gloriósa beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis intercessióne, a præsénti liberári tristítia, et ætérna pérfrui lætítia.
d9c1dcf26bdf72f3bfcd.english: Grant, we beseech thee, O Lord God, unto all thy servants, that they may remain continually in the enjoyment of soundness both of mind and body, and by the glorious intercession of the Blessed Mary, always a Virgin, may be delivered from present sadness, and enter into the joy of thine eternal gladness.

7ec13503a96c1af33818.latin: Ant. Benígne fac * in bona voluntáte tua, Dómine.
7ec13503a96c1af33818.english: Ant. In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

d08a109e0febc2e76730.latin: 50:3 Miserére mei, Deus, * secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
d08a109e0febc2e76730.english: 50:3 Have mercy on me, O God, * according to thy great mercy.

d7b6c88cf6159a801f66.latin: 50:3 Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.
d7b6c88cf6159a801f66.english: 50:3 And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

f18bca8ab144aaaea9bd.latin: 50:4 Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.
f18bca8ab144aaaea9bd.english: 50:4 Wash me yet more from my iniquity, * and cleanse me from my sin.

234c5979a0e12a3b2233.latin: 50:5 Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
234c5979a0e12a3b2233.english: 50:5 For I know my iniquity, * and my sin is always before me.

0ccb5be5f169a4f58d24.latin: 50:6 Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut iustificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum iudicáris.
0ccb5be5f169a4f58d24.english: 50:6 To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: * that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

d23f8677a8ee1a1b1383.latin: 50:7 Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
d23f8677a8ee1a1b1383.english: 50:7 For behold I was conceived in iniquities; * and in sins did my mother conceive me.

96a522c0f2bfbd11d199.latin: 50:8 Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
96a522c0f2bfbd11d199.english: 50:8 For behold thou hast loved truth: * the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

e0b43f24549cc94e6661.latin: 50:9 Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
e0b43f24549cc94e6661.english: 50:9 Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: * thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

48719093b5bbb8998f66.latin: 50:10 Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
48719093b5bbb8998f66.english: 50:10 To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: * and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

92948a5770890c723d81.latin: 50:11 Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
92948a5770890c723d81.english: 50:11 Turn away thy face from my sins, * and blot out all my iniquities.

35606c110f20abd6df1a.latin: 50:12 Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
35606c110f20abd6df1a.english: 50:12 Create a clean heart in me, O God: * and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

27b039914e013eb5380b.latin: 50:13 Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
27b039914e013eb5380b.english: 50:13 Cast me not away from thy face; * and take not thy holy spirit from me.

bd710224d8abd00f1a32.latin: 50:14 Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.
bd710224d8abd00f1a32.english: 50:14 Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, * and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

c1014287fdaed99e5482.latin: 50:15 Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.
c1014287fdaed99e5482.english: 50:15 I will teach the unjust thy ways: * and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

dc99b61cefc7ba37cd27.latin: 50:16 Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea iustítiam tuam.
dc99b61cefc7ba37cd27.english: 50:16 Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: * and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

d06a94f16d9e4d1831b1.latin: 50:17 Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
d06a94f16d9e4d1831b1.english: 50:17 O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: * and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

dd74f629291a345b1613.latin: 50:18 Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.
dd74f629291a345b1613.english: 50:18 For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: * with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

0b2be41f50da6a445411.latin: 50:19 Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
0b2be41f50da6a445411.english: 50:19 A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: * a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

7ff733d0fb90c2e0efb5.latin: 50:20 Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Ierúsalem.
7ff733d0fb90c2e0efb5.english: 50:20 Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; * that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

98a251ce2f2fab63f691.latin: 50:21 Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium iustítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
98a251ce2f2fab63f691.english: 50:21 Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: * then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

96fb2f800977cb48182f.latin: Ant. Benígne fac in bona voluntáte tua, Dómine.
96fb2f800977cb48182f.english: Ant. In thy good will, O Lord, deal favourably with Sion.

efe612e669df2d8d3928.latin: Ant. In veritáte tua * exáudi me, Dómine.
efe612e669df2d8d3928.english: Ant. In thy truth, O Lord, * listen unto me.

4f9abd7d0bff550b0771.latin: 142:1 Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua iustítia.
4f9abd7d0bff550b0771.english: 142:1 Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: * hear me in thy justice.

712dea319e945589cf46.latin: 142:2 Et non intres in iudícium cum servo tuo: * quia non iustificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
712dea319e945589cf46.english: 142:2 And enter not into judgment with thy servant: * for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

15851221d8d65bc27a8a.latin: 142:3 Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
15851221d8d65bc27a8a.english: 142:3 For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: * he hath brought down my life to the earth.

d32add338c99605bdf2d.latin: 142:3 Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
d32add338c99605bdf2d.english: 142:3 He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: * and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

48fecfdb1321b7c93b20.latin: 142:5 Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
48fecfdb1321b7c93b20.english: 142:5 I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: * I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

719b6cc7d14a224186bd.latin: 142:6 Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
719b6cc7d14a224186bd.english: 142:6 I stretched forth my hands to thee: * my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

268f6bfb774f21fa5b77.latin: 142:7 Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.
268f6bfb774f21fa5b77.english: 142:7 Hear me speedily, O Lord: * my spirit hath fainted away.

948ad37e59509676f2d2.latin: 142:7 Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
948ad37e59509676f2d2.english: 142:7 Turn not away thy face from me, * lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

6e764cb80750c42df4d8.latin: 142:8 Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: * quia in te sperávi.
6e764cb80750c42df4d8.english: 142:8 Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; * for in thee have I hoped.

b91aa06d76fcf26731c5.latin: 142:8 Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
b91aa06d76fcf26731c5.english: 142:8 Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: * for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

5835224b472c9013d1ec.latin: 142:9 Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
5835224b472c9013d1ec.english: 142:9 Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: * teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

9451c3a98eff8ce7bfbc.latin: 142:10 Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.
9451c3a98eff8ce7bfbc.english: 142:10 Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: * for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

89f7267fac45f3e4bc81.latin: 142:11 Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
89f7267fac45f3e4bc81.english: 142:11 Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: * and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

a47d9bc4b4a35e80003c.latin: 142:12 Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: * quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
a47d9bc4b4a35e80003c.english: 142:12 And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: * for I am thy servant.

b21d6d171d781df9c8e8.latin: Ant. In veritáte tua exáudi me, Dómine.
b21d6d171d781df9c8e8.english: Ant. In thy truth, O Lord, listen unto me.

06567b0339aace8a5500.latin: Ant. Osténde nobis, Dómine, * lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
06567b0339aace8a5500.english: Ant. Show us, O Lord * thy mercy; and grant us thy salvation.

be8dbc7a25397096f1a6.latin: 36:1 Miserére nostri, Deus ómnium, et réspice nos, * et osténde nobis lucem miseratiónum tuárum:
be8dbc7a25397096f1a6.english: 36:1 Have mercy upon us, O God of all, and behold us, * and shew us the light of thy mercies:

a0be0b6bb87cb7d4271f.latin: 36:2 Et immítte timórem tuum super gentes, * quæ non exquisiérunt te,
a0be0b6bb87cb7d4271f.english: 36:2 And send thy fear upon the nations, * that have not sought after thee:

b751f5e53c07636faee6.latin: 36:3 Ut cognóscant quia non est Deus nisi tu, * et enárrent magnália tua.
b751f5e53c07636faee6.english: 36:3 That they may know that there is no God beside thee, * and that they may shew forth thy wonders.

3c9a21bb9d6c61b1c36f.latin: 36:4 Álleva manum tuam super gentes aliénas, * ut vídeant poténtiam tuam.
3c9a21bb9d6c61b1c36f.english: 36:4 Lift up thy hand over the strange nations, * that they may see thy power.

e0c33e7244125a836bcb.latin: 36:5 Sicut enim in conspéctu eórum sanctificátus es in nobis, * sic in conspéctu nostro magnificáberis in eis,
e0c33e7244125a836bcb.english: 36:5 For as thou hast been sanctified in us in their sight, * so thou shalt be magnified among them in our presence,

f1184fd245800122e5ec.latin: 36:6 Ut cognóscant te, sicut et nos cognóvimus, * quóniam non est Deus præter te, Dómine.
f1184fd245800122e5ec.english: 36:6 That they may know thee, as we also have known thee, * that there is no God beside thee, O Lord.

5ad8d60b1541fe45754c.latin: 36:7 Ínnova signa, et immúta mirabília. * Glorífica manum, et brácchium dextrum.
5ad8d60b1541fe45754c.english: 36:7 Renew thy signs, and work new miracles. * Glorify thy hand, and thy right arm.

d67ead34444090bdd5cc.latin: 36:8 Éxcita furórem, et effúnde iram. * Tolle adversárium, et afflíge inimícum.
d67ead34444090bdd5cc.english: 36:8 Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath. * Take away the adversary, and crush the enemy.

e71c2f1edd9a435e4fa2.latin: 36:9 Festína tempus, et meménto finis, * ut enárrent mirabília tua.
e71c2f1edd9a435e4fa2.english: 36:9 Hasten the time, and remember the end, * that they may declare thy wonderful works.

3e173918e33a4a7044c6.latin: 36:10 In ira flammæ devorétur qui salvátur: * et qui péssimant plebem tuam, invéniant perditiónem.
3e173918e33a4a7044c6.english: 36:10 Let him that escapeth be consumed by the rage of the fire: * and let them perish that oppress thy people.

11e2b71c02b1b4f2e6e1.latin: 36:11 Cóntere caput príncipum inimicórum, * dicéntium: Non est álius præter nos.
11e2b71c02b1b4f2e6e1.english: 36:11 Crush the head of the princes of the enemies * that say: There is no other beside us.

99fa970aaa2afc6829e7.latin: 36:12 Cóngrega omnes tribus Iacob: ut cognóscant quia non est Deus nisi tu, * et enárrent magnália tua:
99fa970aaa2afc6829e7.english: 36:12 Gather together all the tribes of Jacob: that they may know that there is no God besides thee, * and may declare thy great works.

5fa355f5d902b6011802.latin: 36:13 Et hereditábis eos, * sicut ab inítio.
5fa355f5d902b6011802.english: 36:13 And thou shalt inherit them * as from the beginning.

ac898582fef23697fb92.latin: Ant. Osténde nobis, Dómine, lucem miseratiónum tuárum.
ac898582fef23697fb92.english: Ant. Show us, O Lord thy mercy; and grant us thy salvation.

deda45d8e90bb5df6483.latin: Ant. In cýmbalis * benesonántibus laudáte Deum.
deda45d8e90bb5df6483.english: Ant. Praise God * upon the resounding cymbals.

e87183fbc546be2738bf.latin: Ant. In cýmbalis benesonántibus laudáte Deum.
e87183fbc546be2738bf.english: Ant. Praise God upon the resounding cymbals.

006f3ec6761e676f93f2.latin:
Sir 24:14
Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
℟. Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
℣. Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui
℟. Dóminus tecum.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Ave María, grátia plena, * Dóminus tecum.
Hymnus
O gloriósa Dómina,
Excélsa super sídera:
Qui te creávit, próvide
Lactásti sacro úbere.
Quod Heva tristis ábstulit,
Tu reddis almo gérmine:
Intrent ut astra flébiles,
Cæli fenéstra facta es.
Tu Regis alti iánua,
Et porta lucis fúlgida:
Vitam datam per Vírginem,
Gentes redémptæ, pláudite.
Glória tibi Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
℣. Benedícta tu in muliéribus.
℟. Et benedíctus fructus ventris tui.
006f3ec6761e676f93f2.english:
Sir 24:14
From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟.br. Hail Mary full of grace, * the Lord is with thee.
℟. Hail Mary full of grace, * the Lord is with thee.
℣. Benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui
℟. The Lord is with thee.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Hail Mary full of grace, * the Lord is with thee.
Hymn
O glorious lady! throned on high
Above the star-illumined sky;
Thereto ordained, thy bosom lent
To thy Creator nourishment.
Through thy sweet offspring we receive
The bliss once lost through hapless Eve;
And heaven to mortals open lies
Now thou art portal of the skies.
Thou art the door of heaven's high King,
Light's gateway fair and glistering;
Life through a Virgin is restored;
Ye ransomed nations, praise the Lord!
All honour, laud, and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father and to Paraclete.
Amen.
℣. Blessed art thou amongst women,
℟. And blessed is the fruit of thy womb.

2566ebe9d60e1aec9714.latin: Ant. Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, * Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Iesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
2566ebe9d60e1aec9714.english: Ant. O Blessed Mary, * Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

223e428b7c4977474a95.latin: Ant. Beáta Dei Génetrix, María, Virgo perpétua, templum Dómini, sacrárium Spíritus Sancti, sola sine exémplo placuísti Dómino nostro Iesu Christo: ora pro pópulo, intérveni pro clero, intercéde pro devóto femíneo sexu.
223e428b7c4977474a95.english: Ant. O Blessed Mary, Mother of God, Virgin for ever, temple of the Lord, sanctuary of the Holy Ghost, thou, without any example before thee, didst make thyself well-pleasing in the sight of our Lord Jesus Christ; pray for the people, plead for the clergy, make intercession for all women vowed to God.

f97d7361e8e99f66ccd2.latin: Commemoratio S. Theresiæ a Iesu Infante Virginis
f97d7361e8e99f66ccd2.english: Commemoration of St. Thérèse of the Child Jesus, Virgin

ded0fa7863640b96341b.latin: Ant. Símile est regnum cælórum * hómini negotiatóri quærénti bonas margarítas: invénta una pretiósa, dedit ómnia sua, et comparávit eam.
ded0fa7863640b96341b.english: Ant. The kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchantman * seeking goodly pearls, who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

0f6e21ad197c2ecaec4a.latin: ℣. Diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis.
0f6e21ad197c2ecaec4a.english: ℣. Grace is poured into thy lips.

4b4a3c3f610b02f48021.latin: ℟. Proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
4b4a3c3f610b02f48021.english: ℟. Therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.

2fbbdea2ceb2ad5618e4.latin: Dómine, qui dixísti: Nisi efficiámini sicut párvuli, non intrábitis in regnum cælórum: da nobis, quǽsumus: ita sanctæ Terésiæ Vírginis in humilitáte et simplicitáte cordis vestígia sectári, ut prǽmia consequámur ætérna.
2fbbdea2ceb2ad5618e4.english: O Lord, who hast said: Unless you become as little children you shall not enter the kingdom of heaven, grant us, we pray, so to follow, in humility and simplicity of heart, the footsteps of the virgin blessed Theresa, that we may attain to an everlasting reward.

0f3bfd4b96cbace9884f.latin: Qui vivis et regnas cum Deo Patre, in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
0f3bfd4b96cbace9884f.english: Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

fc2236133be69db10f86.latin:
Iam lucis orto sídere,
Deum precémur súpplices,
Ut in diúrnis áctibus
Nos servet a nocéntibus.
Linguam refrénans témperet,
Ne litis horror ínsonet:
Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
Ne vanitátes háuriat.
Sint pura cordis íntima,
Absístat et vecórdia;
Carnis terat supérbiam
Potus cibíque párcitas.
Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
Noctémque sors redúxerit,
Mundi per abstinéntiam
Ipsi canámus glóriam.
Glória tibi, Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
fc2236133be69db10f86.english:
Now in the sun's new dawning ray,
Lowly of heart, our God we pray
That he from harm may keep us free
In all the deeds this day shall see.
May fear of him our tongues restrain,
Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:
His favouring care our guardian be,
Lest our eyes feed on vanity.
May every heart be pure from sin
And folly find no place therein:
Scant need of food, excess denied,
Wear down in us the body's pride.
That when the light of day is gone,
And night in course shall follow on.
We, free from cares the world affords,
May chant the praise that is our Lord's.
All honour, praise and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-Born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father, and to Paraclete.
Amen.

43e559ab5e7dd666b72f.latin: Ant. Dum esset Rex * in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
43e559ab5e7dd666b72f.english: Ant. While the King sitteth at his table, * my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

2ff32fac09776deb2cc2.latin: 17:26 Cum sancto sanctus eris, * et cum viro innocénte ínnocens eris:
2ff32fac09776deb2cc2.english: 17:26 With the holy thou wilt be holy; * and with the innocent man thou wilt be innocent:

b230a5d86af0216959ae.latin: 17:27 Et cum elécto eléctus eris: * et cum pervérso pervertéris.
b230a5d86af0216959ae.english: 17:27 And with the elect thou wilt be elect: * and with the perverse thou wilt be perverted.

ef59bb5d3b5c979c866f.latin: 17:28 Quóniam tu pópulum húmilem salvum fácies: * et óculos superbórum humiliábis.
ef59bb5d3b5c979c866f.english: 17:28 For thou wilt save the humble people; * but wilt bring down the eyes of the proud.

8a208f870d21dcc6cdd3.latin: 17:29 Quóniam tu illúminas lucérnam meam, Dómine: * Deus meus, illúmina ténebras meas.
8a208f870d21dcc6cdd3.english: 17:29 For thou lightest my lamp, O Lord: * O my God, enlighten my darkness.

19d6b7e1afadca374265.latin: 17:30 Quóniam in te erípiar a tentatióne, * et in Deo meo transgrédiar murum.
19d6b7e1afadca374265.english: 17:30 For by thee I shall be delivered from temptation; * and through my God I shall go over a wall.

1a3bd301b8a6b3cd9526.latin: 17:31 Deus meus, impollúta via eius: elóquia Dómini igne examináta: * protéctor est ómnium sperántium in se.
1a3bd301b8a6b3cd9526.english: 17:31 As for my God, his way is undefiled: the words of the Lord are fire-tried: * he is the protector of all that trust in him.

66f5cef9b3ae7cf9e14f.latin: 17:32 Quóniam quis Deus præter Dóminum? * aut quis Deus præter Deum nostrum?
66f5cef9b3ae7cf9e14f.english: 17:32 For who is God but the Lord? * or who is God but our God?

28a8a94d4710f7028093.latin: 17:33 Deus, qui præcínxit me virtúte: * et pósuit immaculátam viam meam.
28a8a94d4710f7028093.english: 17:33 God, who hath girt me with strength; * and made my way blameless.

b0599d8e50bb0ebb946f.latin: 17:34 Qui perfécit pedes meos tamquam cervórum, * et super excélsa státuens me.
b0599d8e50bb0ebb946f.english: 17:34 Who hath made my feet like the feet of harts: * and who setteth me upon high places.

0eaf4e465d6e98e96fd6.latin: 17:35 Qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium: * et posuísti, ut arcum ǽreum, brácchia mea.
0eaf4e465d6e98e96fd6.english: 17:35 Who teacheth my hands to war: * and thou hast made my arms like a brazen bow.

fd99784b4d82a17b9a25.latin: 17:36 Et dedísti mihi protectiónem salútis tuæ: * et déxtera tua suscépit me:
fd99784b4d82a17b9a25.english: 17:36 Thou hast given me the protection of thy salvation: * and thy right hand hath held me up:

b7ca7f495df52a454030.latin: 17:36 Et disciplína tua corréxit me in finem: * et disciplína tua ipsa me docébit.
b7ca7f495df52a454030.english: 17:36 And thy discipline hath corrected me unto the end: * and thy discipline, the same shall teach me.

3ebef5970c06d9d1e5c4.latin: 17:37 Dilatásti gressus meos subtus me: * et non sunt infirmáta vestígia mea:
3ebef5970c06d9d1e5c4.english: 17:37 Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; * and my feet are not weakened.

e5d184116c2526ee6fd3.latin: 17:38 Pérsequar inimícos meos et comprehéndam illos: * et non convértar, donec defíciant.
e5d184116c2526ee6fd3.english: 17:38 I will pursue after my enemies, and overtake them: * and I will not turn again till they are consumed.

70b1f0a808d89e5fab2f.latin: 17:39 Confríngam illos, nec póterunt stare: * cadent subtus pedes meos.
70b1f0a808d89e5fab2f.english: 17:39 I will break them, and they shall not be able to stand: * they shall fall under my feet.

b3ec8afcbe03620e93a7.latin: 17:40 Et præcinxísti me virtúte ad bellum: * et supplantásti insurgéntes in me subtus me.
b3ec8afcbe03620e93a7.english: 17:40 And thou hast girded me with strength unto battle; * and hast subdued under me them that rose up against me.

bc282ba2ca8efb7c3f73.latin: 17:41 Et inimícos meos dedísti mihi dorsum, * et odiéntes me disperdidísti.
bc282ba2ca8efb7c3f73.english: 17:41 And thou hast made my enemies turn their back upon me, * and hast destroyed them that hated me.

8d5518ffc865585ee051.latin: 17:42 Clamavérunt, nec erat qui salvos fáceret ad Dóminum: * nec exaudívit eos.
8d5518ffc865585ee051.english: 17:42 They cried, but there was none to save them, to the Lord: * but he heard them not.

45dc6c45536c6a6c0ce4.latin: 17:43 Et commínuam eos, ut púlverem ante fáciem venti: * ut lutum plateárum delébo eos.
45dc6c45536c6a6c0ce4.english: 17:43 And I shall beat them as small as the dust before the wind; * I shall bring them to nought, like the dirt in the streets.

bbec43a2c2d340331823.latin: 17:44 Erípies me de contradictiónibus pópuli: * constítues me in caput géntium.
bbec43a2c2d340331823.english: 17:44 Thou wilt deliver me from the contradictions of the people; * thou wilt make me head of the Gentiles.

1d7816ca8913cc6e26f7.latin: 17:45 Pópulus quem non cognóvi servívit mihi: * in audítu auris obedívit mihi.
1d7816ca8913cc6e26f7.english: 17:45 A people which I knew not, hath served me: * at the hearing of the ear they have obeyed me.

3bc2fea7aacb5bd3991b.latin: 17:46 Fílii aliéni mentíti sunt mihi, * fílii aliéni inveteráti sunt, et claudicavérunt a sémitis suis.
3bc2fea7aacb5bd3991b.english: 17:46 The children that are strangers have lied to me, * strange children have faded away, and have halted from their paths.

4150b3e9c8a02559ed5e.latin: 17:47 Vivit Dóminus, et benedíctus Deus meus: * et exaltétur Deus salútis meæ.
4150b3e9c8a02559ed5e.english: 17:47 The Lord liveth, and blessed be my God, * and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

e0d74c570d4cfaa474cd.latin: 17:48 Deus, qui das vindíctas mihi, et subdis pópulos sub me: * liberátor meus de inimícis meis iracúndis.
e0d74c570d4cfaa474cd.english: 17:48 O God, who avengest me, and subduest the people under me, * my deliverer from my enraged enemies.

b9e4ad331c7ffb51e52a.latin: 17:49 Et ab insurgéntibus in me exaltábis me: * a viro iníquo erípies me.
b9e4ad331c7ffb51e52a.english: 17:49 And thou wilt lift me up above them that rise up against me: * from the unjust man thou wilt deliver me.

b3919e501933e627f92b.latin: 17:50 Proptérea confitébor tibi in natiónibus, Dómine: * et nómini tuo psalmum dicam.
b3919e501933e627f92b.english: 17:50 Therefore will I give glory to thee, O Lord, among the nations, * and I will sing a psalm to thy name.

ef81ec316cd50e961d9d.latin: 17:51 Magníficans salútes Regis eius, et fáciens misericórdiam Christo suo David: * et sémini eius usque in sǽculum.
ef81ec316cd50e961d9d.english: 17:51 Giving great deliverance to his king, and shewing mercy to David, his anointed: * and to his seed for ever.

38f1ff66ad012dbbb8c7.latin: 18:2 Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum eius annúntiat firmaméntum.
38f1ff66ad012dbbb8c7.english: 18:2 The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

fd4d52c89f2e97dc1c04.latin: 18:3 Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
fd4d52c89f2e97dc1c04.english: 18:3 Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

48e61323b2681298a98f.latin: 18:4 Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
48e61323b2681298a98f.english: 18:4 There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

db20e169c85a4a5d0f9a.latin: 18:5 In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
db20e169c85a4a5d0f9a.english: 18:5 Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

a4656b6de537d9d505d6.latin: 18:6 In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:
a4656b6de537d9d505d6.english: 18:6 He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: * and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber,

477a5d94d5a8ef7bdb53.latin: 18:6 Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * a summo cælo egréssio eius:
477a5d94d5a8ef7bdb53.english: 18:6 Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * his going out is from the end of heaven,

f7aa27826bca98fed15a.latin: 18:7 Et occúrsus eius usque ad summum eius: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre eius.
f7aa27826bca98fed15a.english: 18:7 And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

3a997b817ea5cb08c3bb.latin: 18:8 Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
3a997b817ea5cb08c3bb.english: 18:8 The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

be794bfa4581e8077f3b.latin: 18:9 Iustítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
be794bfa4581e8077f3b.english: 18:9 The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

653d5180ff932091d0f1.latin: 18:10 Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * iudícia Dómini vera, iustificáta in semetípsa.
653d5180ff932091d0f1.english: 18:10 The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

af02a74adf958e9953be.latin: 18:11 Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
af02a74adf958e9953be.english: 18:11 More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

a8342514cefefdcfffa0.latin: 18:12 Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
a8342514cefefdcfffa0.english: 18:12 For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

a902fedfc5c86f2445f3.latin: 18:13 Delícta quis intéllegit? ab occúltis meis munda me: * et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
a902fedfc5c86f2445f3.english: 18:13 Who can understand sins? from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * and from those of others spare thy servant.

49926c77d0ab25fb9843.latin: 18:14 Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
49926c77d0ab25fb9843.english: 18:14 If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

cf7feac0f56f8fe7704f.latin: 18:15 Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.
cf7feac0f56f8fe7704f.english: 18:15 And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: * and the meditation of my heart always in thy sight.

988aa27220184fa49991.latin: 18:15 Dómine, adiútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
988aa27220184fa49991.english: 18:15 O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

bfdad426b3b4ae18c5c5.latin: 19:2 Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis: * prótegat te nomen Dei Iacob.
bfdad426b3b4ae18c5c5.english: 19:2 May the Lord hear thee in the day of tribulation: * may the name of the God of Jacob protect thee.

79d1dc8448347eaf800b.latin: 19:3 Mittat tibi auxílium de sancto: * et de Sion tueátur te.
79d1dc8448347eaf800b.english: 19:3 May he send thee help from the sanctuary: * and defend thee out of Sion.

393061a497b1c009370b.latin: 19:4 Memor sit omnis sacrifícii tui: * et holocáustum tuum pingue fiat.
393061a497b1c009370b.english: 19:4 May he be mindful of all thy sacrifices: * and may thy whole burnt offering be made fat.

dad104bd103e3db98349.latin: 19:5 Tríbuat tibi secúndum cor tuum: * et omne consílium tuum confírmet.
dad104bd103e3db98349.english: 19:5 May he give thee according to thy own heart; * and confirm all thy counsels.

426fb55763ac7e7f60c4.latin: 19:6 Lætábimur in salutári tuo: * et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur.
426fb55763ac7e7f60c4.english: 19:6 We will rejoice in thy salvation; * and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.

ba9b0755f790f741482d.latin: 19:7 Ímpleat Dóminus omnes petitiónes tuas: * nunc cognóvi quóniam salvum fecit Dóminus Christum suum.
ba9b0755f790f741482d.english: 19:7 The Lord fulfil all thy petitions: * now have I known that the Lord hath saved his anointed.

156fb4626e9b13a49104.latin: 19:7 Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo: * in potentátibus salus déxteræ eius.
156fb4626e9b13a49104.english: 19:7 He will hear him from his holy heaven: * the salvation of his right hand is in powers.

7971040329caf3d526ee.latin: 19:8 Hi in cúrribus, et hi in equis: * nos autem in nómine Dómini, Dei nostri invocábimus.
7971040329caf3d526ee.english: 19:8 Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: * but we will call upon the name of the Lord, our God.

0768f8e64cef9c670043.latin: 19:9 Ipsi obligáti sunt, et cecidérunt: * nos autem surréximus et erécti sumus.
0768f8e64cef9c670043.english: 19:9 They are bound, and have fallen: * but we are risen, and are set upright.

80ef0f5a57b7cea6218c.latin: 19:10 Dómine, salvum fac regem: * et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.
80ef0f5a57b7cea6218c.english: 19:10 O Lord, save the king: * and hear us in the day that we shall call upon thee.

1adf2d22aa159fd1c1dc.latin: Ant. Dum esset Rex in accúbitu suo, nardus mea dedit odórem suavitátis.
1adf2d22aa159fd1c1dc.english: Ant. While the King sitteth at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.

4c671829cb0a83a63908.latin: Quarto Nonas Octóbris Luna vicésima secúnda. Anno Dómini 2026
4c671829cb0a83a63908.english: October 4th 2026, the 22nd day of the Moon, were born into the better life:

021f8c5fa60f2c3b3a48.latin: Assísii, in Umbria, natális sancti Francísci, Levítæ et Confessóris; qui trium Ordinum, scílicet Fratrum Minórum, Páuperum Dominárum, ac Fratrum et Sorórum de Pæniténtia, Fundátor éxstitit. Ipsíus autem vitam, sanctitáte ac miráculis plenam, sanctus Bonaventúra conscrípsit.
021f8c5fa60f2c3b3a48.english: At Assisi, in Umbria, the holy Confessor Francis, (1182-1226,) Founder of the Order of Friars Minor, whose life, full of holiness and miracles, hath been written by St. Bonaventure.

2105e5086c8fc20688a0.latin: Corínthi item natális sanctórum Crispi et Caii, quorum méminit sanctus Paulus Apóstolus ad Corínthios scribens.
2105e5086c8fc20688a0.english: At Corinth, holy Crispus and Caius, (first century,) of whom the holy Apostle Paul maketh mention in writing unto the Corinthians.

655d976c28bf0b727957.latin: Athénis sancti Hieróthei, qui fuit discípulus ipsíus beáti Pauli Apóstoli.
655d976c28bf0b727957.english: In Egypt, the holy brethren Mark and Marcian, (in the year 304,) and a multitude of other holy martyrs which is almost countless, both of men and of women, of old and of young some after stripes and some after horrid torments of diverse kinds were burnt, some cast into the sea, a few beheaded, many starved to death, others crucified (some of these with their head downward), and so earned a most blessed crown of martyrdom.

806588d17677bf9ce54f.latin: Damásci sancti Petri, Epíscopi et Mártyris; qui, accusátus apud Agarenórum Príncipem quod fidem Christi docéret, ídeo, lingua et mánibus pedibúsque amputátis, cruci affíxus martýrium consummávit.
806588d17677bf9ce54f.english: At Damascus, the holy Bishop and martyr Peter, (in the year 742) he was accused of teaching the faith of Christ, before the Prince of the Hagarenes. His tongue, hands, and feet were cut off, and he was fastened to a cross, and there finished his testimony.

533854bd9502226a35d1.latin: Alexandríæ sanctórum Presbyterórum, et Diaconórum Caii, Fausti, Eusébii, Chærémonis, Lúcii et Sociórum; ex quibus álii, in persecutióne Valeriáni, Mártyres facti sunt, álii, Martýribus serviéntes, mercédem Mártyrum recepérunt.
533854bd9502226a35d1.english: At Alexandria, the holy Priests and Deacons Caius, Faustus, Eusebius, Chaeremon, Lucius, and their Companions, of whom some suffered martyrdom in the persecution under the Emperor Valerian, and others by serving the martyrs gained the martyr's reward.

449f7994c7d08150d1cf.latin: In Ægýpto sanctórum Mártyrum Marci et Marciáni fratrum, et aliórum ferme innumerabílium utriúsque sexus atque omnis ætátis; quorum álii post vérbera, álii post divérsa géneris horríbiles cruciátus flammis tráditi, álii in mare præcipitáti, nonnúlli cápite cæsi, plúrimi inédia consúmpti, álii patíbulis affíxi, quidam étiam, cápite deórsum verso et pédibus in sublíme sublátis, appénsi, beatíssimam martýrii corónam meruérunt.
449f7994c7d08150d1cf.english: At Athens, holy Hierotheus, a disciple of the blessed Apostle Paul.

82050c7264aa445041ad.latin: Bonóniæ sancti Petrónii, Epíscopi et Confessóris; qui doctrína, miráculis et sanctitáte cláruit.
82050c7264aa445041ad.english: At Bologna, (in the fifth century,) the holy Confessor Petronius, Bishop (of that see,) who was famous for his teaching, his miracles, and his holiness.

661385f3a3cda65dc170.english: At Paris, (in the year 666,) the holy Virgin Aurea, (Abbess at Paris.)

09c5fd78b6f9fbf1102e.latin: ℣. Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
09c5fd78b6f9fbf1102e.english: ℣. And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.

5255232ff9f7bc900f3b.latin: Benedictio. Dies et actus nostros in sua pace dispónat Dóminus omnípotens.
5255232ff9f7bc900f3b.english: Benediction. May Almighty God arrange our deeds and our day in His peace.

9056919fb9592217cb65.latin: Ex Cápite 7 Régulæ Sancti Patri Nostri Benedícti: De humilitáte
9056919fb9592217cb65.english: The Rule of our Holy Father Benedict. Chapter 7: Concerning Humility. Continued.

6a3606e42a39df934cc5.latin: Quintus humilitátis gradus est, si omnes cogitatiónes malas cordi suo adveniéntes vel mala a se abscónse commíssa per húmilem confessiónem abbátem non celáverit suum. Hortans nos de hac re Scriptúra dicens: Revéla ad Dóminum viam tuam et spera in eum. Et item dicit: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus, quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia eius. Et item Prophéta: Delíctum meum cógnitum tibi feci et iniustítias meas non opérui. Dixi: pronuntiábo advérsum me iniustítias meas Dómino, et tu remisísti impietátem cordis mei.
6a3606e42a39df934cc5.english: The fifth step in humility is if one shall have discovered to his abbot, by humble admission, any evil thoughts that come to the heart, or evil deeds done by him in secret. The Scripture makes exhortation concerning this matter, saying: “Reveal to the Lord thy way and hope in Him.” And again it saith: “Confess to the Lord since He is good and since His mercy is for ever.” And again the prophet saith: “My fault I made known to Thee and hid not mine unrighteousness. I said, Against myself I will denounce mine unrighteousness to the Lord, and Thou forgavest the unfilialness of my heart.”

56f41d89c82da72a1eb5.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

c3d376f372cd78534bde.latin: Extra Chorum etiam laudabiliter dicitur lectio ex S. Regulæ; secus dicitur Lectio brevis.
c3d376f372cd78534bde.english: Even outside of Choir, it is laudible to read the Holy Regula; otherwise, the Short Reading is prayed

1bd53938d70ad40f095f.latin: Dóminus autem dírigat corda et córpora nostra in caritáte Dei et patiéntia Christi.
1bd53938d70ad40f095f.english: And the Lord direct your hearts, in the charity of God, and the patience of Christ.

a448f4451121fe50030c.latin:
Nunc, Sancte, nobis, Spíritus,
Unum Patri cum Fílio,
Dignáre promptus íngeri
Nostro refúsus péctori.
Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor
Confessiónem pérsonent.
Flamméscat igne cáritas,
Accéndat ardor próximos.
Glória tibi, Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
a448f4451121fe50030c.english:
Come Holy Ghost who ever One
Art with the Father and the Son,
It is the hour, our souls possess
With thy full flood of holiness.
Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
Sound forth our witness to mankind;
And love light up our mortal frame,
Till others catch the living flame.
All honour, praise and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-Born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father, and to Paraclete.
Amen.

6e3ec7d17ee041607cbe.latin: Ant. Læva eius * sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me.
6e3ec7d17ee041607cbe.english: Ant. His left hand is under my head, * and his right hand doth embrace me.

6910c525dae9373db5d4.latin: Ant. Læva eius sub cápite meo, et déxtera illíus amplexábitur me.
6910c525dae9373db5d4.english: Ant. His left hand is under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.

e18f8670274512e98c9b.latin:
Sir 24:14
Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua.
℟. Inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
e18f8670274512e98c9b.english:
Sir 24:14
From the beginning, and before the world, was I created, and unto the world to come I shall not cease to be, and in the holy dwelling place I have ministered before him.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. In thy comeliness and thy beauty.
℟. Go forward, fare prosperously, and reign.

df1cb93bde759b6bf5ae.latin:
Rector potens, verax Deus,
Qui témperas rerum vices,
Splendóre mane ínstruis,
Et ígnibus merídiem:
Exstíngue flammas lítium,
Aufer calórem nóxium,
Confer salútem córporum,
Verámque pacem córdium.
Glória tibi, Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
df1cb93bde759b6bf5ae.english:
O God of truth, O Lord of might,
Who orderest time and change aright,
Who send’st the early morning ray,
And light’st the glow of perfect day:
Extinguish thou each sinful fire,
And banish every ill desire;
And while thou keep’st the body whole,
Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.
All honour, praise and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-Born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father, and to Paraclete.
Amen.

7dfbf282337aeafa3283.latin: Ant. Nigra sum, * sed formósa, fíliæ Ierúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
7dfbf282337aeafa3283.english: Ant. I am black but comely, * O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

ef1a4286f9c70ac9d252.latin: Ant. Nigra sum, sed formósa, fíliæ Ierúsalem; ídeo diléxit me Rex, et introdúxit me in cubículum suum.
ef1a4286f9c70ac9d252.english: Ant. I am black but comely, O ye daughters of Jerusalem; therefore hath the King loved me, and brought me into his chamber.

0142617ecacc65d433e4.latin:
Sir 24:15-16
Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Ierúsalem potéstas mea. Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Adiuvábit eam Deus vultu suo.
℟. Deus in médio eius, non commovébitur.
0142617ecacc65d433e4.english:
Sir 24:15-16
And so was I established in Sion, and in the holy city likewise I rested, and my power was in Jerusalem. And I took root in an honourable people, and in the portion of my God his inheritance, and my abode is in the full assembly of saints.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. God shall help her with His countenance.
℟. God is in the midst of her she shall not be moved.

cd26e797cccc81adfc47.latin:
Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
Immótus in te pérmanens,
Lucis diúrnæ témpora
Succéssibus detérminans:
Largíre clarum véspere,
Quo vita nusquam décidat,
Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
Perénnis instet glória.
Glória tibi, Dómine,
Qui natus es de Vírgine,
Cum Patre, et Sancto Spíritu,
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
cd26e797cccc81adfc47.english:
O strength and stay upholding all creation,
Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,
Yet day by day the light in due gradation
From hour to hour through all its changes guide:
Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,
An eve untouched by shadows of decay,
The brightness of a holy death-bed blending
With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.
All honour, praise and glory be,
O Jesu, Virgin-Born, to thee;
All glory, as is ever meet,
To Father, and to Paraclete.
Amen.

9f8ef610f19e6ced6648.latin: Ant. Speciósa * facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
9f8ef610f19e6ced6648.english: Ant. O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful * and gentle in thy gladness.

8829892fbdf0ebcfe273.latin: Ant. Speciósa facta es et suávis in delíciis tuis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
8829892fbdf0ebcfe273.english: Ant. O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful and gentle in thy gladness.

4d816f608e3cd5b4c57a.latin:
Sir 24:19-20
In platéis sicut cinnamómum et bálsamum aromatízans odórem dedi: quasi myrrha elécta, dedi suavitátem odóris.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Elégit eam Deus, et præelégit eam.
℟. In tabernáculo suo habitáre facit eam.
4d816f608e3cd5b4c57a.english:
Sir 24:19-20
As a plane tree by the water in the streets, I gave a sweet smell like cinnamon. and aromatical balm: I yielded a sweet odour like the best myrrh.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. God hath chosen her, and fore-chosen her.
℟. He hath made her to dwell in His tabernacle.

86213059e690b5ba6238.latin: Ant. Regnum tuum, * Dómine, regnum ómnium sæculórum.
86213059e690b5ba6238.english: Ant. Thy kingdom, * O Lord, is a kingdom for all ages.

8a2bb932195afcc58b86.latin: 144:10 Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: * et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
8a2bb932195afcc58b86.english: 144:10 Let all thy works, O Lord, praise thee: * and let thy saints bless thee.

0b327787038cd8c44b94.latin: 144:11 Glóriam regni tui dicent: * et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
0b327787038cd8c44b94.english: 144:11 They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom: * and shall tell of thy power:

39aa6b744b46a6fb7b6d.latin: 144:12 Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: * et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
39aa6b744b46a6fb7b6d.english: 144:12 To make thy might known to the sons of men: * and the glory of the magnificence of thy kingdom.

a08f94f4a5ce677a3fd3.latin: 144:13 Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: * et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
a08f94f4a5ce677a3fd3.english: 144:13 Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: * and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

1ee89d2d19254f91e083.latin: 144:13 Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
1ee89d2d19254f91e083.english: 144:13 The Lord is faithful in all his words: * and holy in all his works.

192eb54986f6d21a84d6.latin: 144:14 Állevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: * et érigit omnes elísos.
192eb54986f6d21a84d6.english: 144:14 The Lord lifteth up all that fall: * and setteth up all that are cast down.

b0372ecad8f6c27ef4d3.latin: 144:15 Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: * et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
b0372ecad8f6c27ef4d3.english: 144:15 The eyes of all hope in thee, O Lord: * and thou givest them meat in due season.

f50d94dce1c7aee2cb6b.latin: 144:16 Áperis tu manum tuam: * et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
f50d94dce1c7aee2cb6b.english: 144:16 Thou openest thy hand, * and fillest with blessing every living creature.

0951e7a61731798790ba.latin: 144:17 Iustus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
0951e7a61731798790ba.english: 144:17 The Lord is just in all his ways: * and holy in all his works.

440ae80c3fcc868c0a3a.latin: 144:18 Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: * ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
440ae80c3fcc868c0a3a.english: 144:18 The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him: * to all that call upon him in truth.

6a7fe7537894af48550f.latin: 144:19 Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: * et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet: et salvos fáciet eos.
6a7fe7537894af48550f.english: 144:19 He will do the will of them that fear him: * and he will hear their prayer, and save them.

4ad4c9614ae85a058c5a.latin: 144:20 Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: * et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
4ad4c9614ae85a058c5a.english: 144:20 The Lord keepeth all them that love him; * but all the wicked he will destroy.

e18366b08996babb6d90.latin: 144:21 Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: * et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto eius in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
e18366b08996babb6d90.english: 144:21 My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: * and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

dc2e8dbbc849ee92fa8b.latin: Ant. Regnum tuum, Dómine, regnum ómnium sæculórum.
dc2e8dbbc849ee92fa8b.english: Ant. Thy kingdom, O Lord, is a kingdom for all ages.

2df91b25eff9d40a4c31.latin: Ant. Laudábo * Deum meum in vita mea.
2df91b25eff9d40a4c31.english: Ant. I shall praise the Lord * in my life.

135a6ac954987c872a00.latin: 145:2 Lauda, ánima mea, Dóminum, laudábo Dóminum in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo quámdiu fúero.
135a6ac954987c872a00.english: 145:2 Praise the Lord, O my soul, in my life I will praise the Lord: * I will sing to my God as long as I shall be.

c8f11c6cb6bd36ee4769.latin: 145:2 Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
c8f11c6cb6bd36ee4769.english: 145:2 Put not your trust in princes: * in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.

6c60e9808b1d5e4cf1d4.latin: 145:4 Exíbit spíritus eius, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
6c60e9808b1d5e4cf1d4.english: 145:4 His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.

b0eee606a1c2e2188da7.latin: 145:5 Beátus, cuius Deus Iacob adiútor eius, spes eius in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
b0eee606a1c2e2188da7.english: 145:5 Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, whose hope is in the Lord his God: * who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.

47c450169caabcae1aba.latin: 145:7 Qui custódit veritátem in sǽculum, facit iudícium iniúriam patiéntibus: * dat escam esuriéntibus.
47c450169caabcae1aba.english: 145:7 Who keepeth truth for ever: who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: * who giveth food to the hungry.

52a4405f701176d14451.latin: 145:7 Dóminus solvit compedítos: * Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
52a4405f701176d14451.english: 145:7 The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * the Lord enlighteneth the blind.

1ea5bb67f83c149e5f42.latin: 145:8 Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit iustos.
1ea5bb67f83c149e5f42.english: 145:8 The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down: * the Lord loveth the just.

f97ccab4509f6cf66559.latin: 145:9 Dóminus custódit ádvenas, pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
f97ccab4509f6cf66559.english: 145:9 The Lord keepeth the strangers, he will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners he will destroy.

75582b262a7695e03fdf.latin: 145:10 Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
75582b262a7695e03fdf.english: 145:10 The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.

07ab8ed427486a1b463c.latin: Ant. Laudábo Deum meum in vita mea.
07ab8ed427486a1b463c.english: Ant. I shall praise the Lord in my life.

533c0df577a317faec77.latin: Ant. Deo nostro * iucúnda sit laudátio.
533c0df577a317faec77.english: Ant. To our God * be joyful and fitting praise.

2a54d5bc1f7817b24be9.latin: 146:1 Laudáte Dóminum quóniam bonus est psalmus: * Deo nostro sit iucúnda, decóraque laudátio.
2a54d5bc1f7817b24be9.english: 146:1 Praise ye the Lord, because psalm is good: * to our God be joyful and comely praise.

ae81807fb61ed8728404.latin: 146:2 Ædíficans Ierúsalem Dóminus: * dispersiónes Israélis congregábit.
ae81807fb61ed8728404.english: 146:2 The Lord buildeth up Jerusalem: * he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.

4490f665fe582aad3229.latin: 146:3 Qui sanat contrítos corde: * et álligat contritiónes eórum.
4490f665fe582aad3229.english: 146:3 Who healeth the broken of heart, * and bindeth up their bruises.

0a72636996e6044fcbd2.latin: 146:4 Qui númerat multitúdinem stellárum: * et ómnibus eis nómina vocat.
0a72636996e6044fcbd2.english: 146:4 Who telleth the number of the stars: * and calleth them all by their names.

87dafc4deec5cd0a014a.latin: 146:5 Magnus Dóminus noster, et magna virtus eius: * et sapiéntiæ eius non est númerus.
87dafc4deec5cd0a014a.english: 146:5 Great is our Lord, and great is his power: * and of his wisdom there is no number.

de07308572a5b5b4dc08.latin: 146:6 Suscípiens mansuétos Dóminus: * humílians autem peccatóres usque ad terram.
de07308572a5b5b4dc08.english: 146:6 The Lord lifteth up the meek, * and bringeth the wicked down even to the ground.

e663eebe75e3fd1c579f.latin: 146:7 Præcínite Dómino in confessióne: * psállite Deo nostro in cíthara.
e663eebe75e3fd1c579f.english: 146:7 Sing ye to the Lord with praise: * sing to our God upon the harp.

1135d5cea170e59736d8.latin: 146:8 Qui óperit cælum núbibus: * et parat terræ plúviam.
1135d5cea170e59736d8.english: 146:8 Who covereth the heaven with clouds, * and prepareth rain for the earth.

0fefefdc4723c7d81129.latin: 146:8 Qui prodúcit in móntibus fænum: * et herbam servitúti hóminum.
0fefefdc4723c7d81129.english: 146:8 Who maketh grass to grow on the mountains, * and herbs for the service of men.

13fb9b45eaed0822478c.latin: 146:9 Qui dat iuméntis escam ipsórum: * et pullis corvórum invocántibus eum.
13fb9b45eaed0822478c.english: 146:9 Who giveth to beasts their food: * and to the young ravens that call upon him.

96aa14591afea01d3860.latin: 146:10 Non in fortitúdine equi voluntátem habébit: * nec in tíbiis viri beneplácitum erit ei.
96aa14591afea01d3860.english: 146:10 He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: * nor take pleasure in the legs of a man.

610fbf4b035521abede1.latin: 146:11 Beneplácitum est Dómino super timéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius.
610fbf4b035521abede1.english: 146:11 The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him: * and in them that hope in his mercy.

475c622c357f14dc27e4.latin: Ant. Deo nostro iucúnda sit laudátio.
475c622c357f14dc27e4.english: Ant. To our God be joyful and fitting praise.

37cb1c950a3a3474a166.english: Ant. Praise the Lord, * O Jerusalem. ‡

a488bc0bc3cc4980da9b.latin: 147:1 Lauda, Ierúsalem, Dóminum: * ‡ lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
a488bc0bc3cc4980da9b.english: 147:1 Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * ‡ praise thy God, O Sion.

9853c153142e9fe31b7f.latin: 147:2 Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
9853c153142e9fe31b7f.english: 147:2 Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

74e95801d796d263ff15.latin: 147:3 Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
74e95801d796d263ff15.english: 147:3 Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

c65e5014bd477be9dd1c.latin: 147:4 Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo eius.
c65e5014bd477be9dd1c.english: 147:4 Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

005a1fc1d7a7a7500572.latin: 147:5 Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
005a1fc1d7a7a7500572.english: 147:5 Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

4d74ba87bb7eaf262d7c.latin: 147:6 Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris eius quis sustinébit?
4d74ba87bb7eaf262d7c.english: 147:6 He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

c02cc8e383ce21e7d8e1.latin: 147:7 Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus eius, et fluent aquæ.
c02cc8e383ce21e7d8e1.english: 147:7 He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

3cc978bab5baa69d8834.latin: 147:8 Qui annúntiat verbum suum Iacob: * iustítias, et iudícia sua Israël.
3cc978bab5baa69d8834.english: 147:8 Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

ff489551b98504b8266e.latin: 147:9 Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et iudícia sua non manifestávit eis.
ff489551b98504b8266e.english: 147:9 He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

ddd00427134fb16378dd.english: Ant. Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem.

d4caf1e056b3ddaf48fe.latin:
Rom 11:33
O Altitúdo divitiárum sapiéntiæ, et sciéntiæ Dei, quam incomprehensibília sunt iudícia eius, et investigábiles viæ eius!
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Magnus Dóminus noster, * et magna virtus eius.
℟. Magnus Dóminus noster, * et magna virtus eius.
℣. Et sapiéntiæ eius non est númerus.
℟. Et magna virtus eius.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Magnus Dóminus noster, * et magna virtus eius.
Hymnus
O lux beáta Trínitas,
Et principális Únitas,
Iam sol recédit ígneus,
Infúnde lumen córdibus.
Te mane laudum cármine,
Te deprecémur véspere:
Te nostra supplex glória
Per cuncta laudet sǽcula.
Deo Patri sit glória,
Eiúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Et nunc, et in perpétuum.
Amen.
℣. Vespertína orátio ascéndat ad te, Dómine.
℟. Et descéndat super nos misericórdia tua.
d4caf1e056b3ddaf48fe.english:
Rom 11:33
O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are his judgments, and how unsearchable his ways!
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟.br. Great is our Lord, and great is his power.
℟. Great is our Lord, and great is his power.
℣. and of his wisdom there is no number.
℟. And great is his power.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Great is our Lord, and great is his power.
Hymn
O Trinity of blessed Light,
O Unity of sovereign might,
as now the fiery sun departs,
shed Thou Thy beams within our hearts.
To Thee our morning song of praise,
to Thee our evening prayer we raise;
Thee may our glory evermore
in lowly reverence adore.
All laud to God the Father be;
all praise, Eternal Son, to Thee;
all glory, as is ever meet,
to God the Holy Paraclete.
Amen.
℣. Let the evening prayer ascend unto thee, O Lord.
℟. And let there descend upon us thy mercy.

0ff55b722cab3e59d250.latin: Ant. Adapériat Dóminus * cor vestrum in lege sua et in præcéptis suis et fáciat pacem Dóminus Deus noster.
0ff55b722cab3e59d250.english: Ant. The Lord open your hearts * in His law and commandments, and may the Lord our God send peace.

6324e6f48a3af530462f.latin: Ant. Adapériat Dóminus cor vestrum in lege sua et in præcéptis suis et fáciat pacem Dóminus Deus noster.
6324e6f48a3af530462f.english: Ant. The Lord open your hearts in His law and commandments, and may the Lord our God send peace.

ba7b0e7139da02b6cfef.latin: Omnípotens et miséricors Deus, univérsa nobis adversántia propitiátus exclúde: ut mente et córpore páriter expedíti, quæ tua sunt, líberis méntibus exsequámur.
ba7b0e7139da02b6cfef.english: O Almighty and most merciful God, of thy bountiful goodness keep us, we beseech thee, from all things that may hurt us; that we, being ready both in body and soul, may cheerfully accomplish those things that Thou wouldest have done.

eef38433171c18e9eb54.latin: Ant. Adorémus Dóminum, * Qui fecit nos.
eef38433171c18e9eb54.english: Ant. Let us worship the Lord, for * He is our Maker.

3605322e8e7b4e9e6180.latin:
Primo diérum ómnium,
Quo mundus extat cónditus,
Vel quo resúrgens Cónditor
Nos morte victa líberat.
Pulsis procul torpóribus
Surgámus omnes ócius,
Et nocte quærámus pium
Sicut prophétam nóvimus.
Nostras preces ut áudiat,
Suámque dextram pórrigat:
Et expiátos sórdibus
Reddat polórum sédibus.
Ut quique sacratíssimo
Huius diéi témpore
Horis quiétis psállimus,
Donis beátis múneret.
Iam nunc patérna cláritas
Te postulámus áffatim:
Absit libído sórdidans
Et omnis actus nóxius.
Ne fœda sit, vel lúbrica
Compágo nostri córporis,
Per quem Avérni ígnibus
Ipsi cremémur ácrius.
Ob hoc Redémptor, quǽsumus,
Ut probra nostra díluas,
Vitæ perénnis cómmoda
Nobis benígne cónferas.
Quo carnis actu éxsules
Effécti ipsi cælibes,
Ut præstolámur cérnui,
Melos canámus glóriæ.
Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
3605322e8e7b4e9e6180.english:
Hail day! whereon the One in Three
First formed the earth by sure decree,
The day its Maker rose again,
And vanquished death, and burst our chain.
Away with sleep and slothful ease
We raise our hearts and bend our knees,
And early seek the Lord of all,
Obedient to the Prophet's call.
That He may hearken to our prayer,
Stretch forth His strong right arm to spare,
And ev'ry past offense forgiven,
Restore us to our home in heaven.
Assembled here this holy day,
This holiest hour we raise the lay,
And O that He to whom we sing,
May now reward our offering!
O Father of unclouded light!
Keep us this day as in thy sight,
In word and deed that we may be
From ev'ry touch of evil free.
That this our body's mortal frame
May know no sin, and fear no shame,
Nor fire hereafter be the end
Of passions which our bosom rend.
Redeemer of the world, we pray
That thou wouldst wash our sins away,
And give us, of Thy boundless grace,
The blessings of the heavenly place.
Most Holy Father, hear our cry,
Through Jesus Christ our Lord most High
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee
Shall live and reign eternally.
Amen.

196c41a5957399479a78.latin: Ant. Dómine * in virtúte tua lætábitur rex. ‡
196c41a5957399479a78.english: Ant. The king rejoices * in Thy strength, O Lord. ‡

d096a886401eaaaadb32.latin: 20:2 Dómine, in virtúte tua lætábitur rex: * ‡ et super salutáre tuum exsultábit veheménter.
d096a886401eaaaadb32.english: 20:2 The king rejoices in thy strength, O Lord; * ‡ and in thy salvation he shall rejoice exceedingly.

ef8c4ee05414548a360b.latin: 20:3 Desidérium cordis eius tribuísti ei: * et voluntáte labiórum eius non fraudásti eum.
ef8c4ee05414548a360b.english: 20:3 Thou hast given him his heart’s desire: * and hast not withholden from him the will of his lips.

feaee268af21e2c51bf5.latin: 20:4 Quóniam prævenísti eum in benedictiónibus dulcédinis: * posuísti in cápite eius corónam de lápide pretióso.
feaee268af21e2c51bf5.english: 20:4 For thou hast prevented him with blessings of sweetness: * thou hast set on his head a crown of precious stones.

9f297560fc2ffb1800aa.latin: 20:5 Vitam pétiit a te: * et tribuísti ei longitúdinem diérum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
9f297560fc2ffb1800aa.english: 20:5 He asked life of thee: * and thou hast given him length of days for ever and ever.

699e83eaedc4f0e99230.latin: 20:6 Magna est glória eius in salutári tuo: * glóriam et magnum decórem impónes super eum.
699e83eaedc4f0e99230.english: 20:6 His glory is great in thy salvation: * glory and great beauty shalt thou lay upon him.

0b8105497c06c9bcc5c0.latin: 20:7 Quóniam dabis eum in benedictiónem in sǽculum sǽculi: * lætificábis eum in gáudio cum vultu tuo.
0b8105497c06c9bcc5c0.english: 20:7 For thou shalt give him to be a blessing for ever and ever: * thou shalt make him joyful in gladness with thy countenance.

591a6c27b6b842d9b207.latin: 20:8 Quóniam rex sperat in Dómino: * et in misericórdia Altíssimi non commovébitur.
591a6c27b6b842d9b207.english: 20:8 For the king hopeth in the Lord: * and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

fa54c0b6f1e869cae0cb.latin: 20:9 Inveniátur manus tua ómnibus inimícis tuis: * déxtera tua invéniat omnes, qui te odérunt.
fa54c0b6f1e869cae0cb.english: 20:9 Let thy hand be found by all thy enemies: * let thy right hand find out all them that hate thee.

c755558955659af87665.latin: 20:10 Pones eos ut clíbanum ignis in témpore vultus tui: * Dóminus in ira sua conturbábit eos, et devorábit eos ignis.
c755558955659af87665.english: 20:10 Thou shalt make them as an oven of fire, * in the time of thy anger: the Lord shall trouble them in his wrath, and fire shall devour them.

8dc8ebb2fc69b5064282.latin: 20:11 Fructum eórum de terra perdes: * et semen eórum a fíliis hóminum.
8dc8ebb2fc69b5064282.english: 20:11 Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth: * and their seed from among the children of men.

bc2ea29505c0b3e8a457.latin: 20:12 Quóniam declinavérunt in te mala: * cogitavérunt consília, quæ non potuérunt stabilíre.
bc2ea29505c0b3e8a457.english: 20:12 For they have intended evils against thee: * they have devised counsels which they have not been able to establish.

f82bee58c954cc277818.latin: 20:13 Quóniam pones eos dorsum: * in relíquiis tuis præparábis vultum eórum.
f82bee58c954cc277818.english: 20:13 For thou shalt make them turn their back: * in thy remnants thou shalt prepare their face.

5fd07d873e3c461c17b9.latin: 20:14 Exaltáre, Dómine, in virtúte tua: * cantábimus et psallémus virtútes tuas.
5fd07d873e3c461c17b9.english: 20:14 Be thou exalted, O Lord, in thy own strength: * we will sing and praise thy power.

ff6986252c1c6b316cd1.latin: 21:2 Deus, Deus meus, réspice in me: quare me dereliquísti? * longe a salúte mea verba delictórum meórum.
ff6986252c1c6b316cd1.english: 21:2 O God my God, look upon me: why hast thou forsaken me? * Far from my salvation are the words of my sins.

250689c3bd82cf1cf310.latin: 21:3 Deus meus, clamábo per diem, et non exáudies: * et nocte, et non ad insipiéntiam mihi.
250689c3bd82cf1cf310.english: 21:3 O my God, I shall cry by day, and thou wilt not hear: * and by night, and it shall not be reputed as folly in me.

bb73b6f329169861243d.latin: 21:4 Tu autem in sancto hábitas, * laus Israël.
bb73b6f329169861243d.english: 21:4 But thou dwellest in the holy place, * the praise of Israel.

8ae0228de0e8cb2f817d.latin: 21:5 In te speravérunt patres nostri: * speravérunt, et liberásti eos.
8ae0228de0e8cb2f817d.english: 21:5 In thee have our fathers hoped: * they have hoped, and thou hast delivered them.

b4e8f2aa8b22f4b83023.latin: 21:6 Ad te clamavérunt, et salvi facti sunt: * in te speravérunt, et non sunt confúsi.
b4e8f2aa8b22f4b83023.english: 21:6 They cried to thee, and they were saved: * they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

6dae4cde6a4d30ac9c86.latin: 21:7 Ego autem sum vermis, et non homo: * oppróbrium hóminum, et abiéctio plebis.
6dae4cde6a4d30ac9c86.english: 21:7 But I am a worm, and no man: * the reproach of men, and the outcast of the people.

5d2baa6975642627e7f6.latin: 21:8 Omnes vidéntes me, derisérunt me: * locúti sunt lábiis, et movérunt caput.
5d2baa6975642627e7f6.english: 21:8 All they that saw me have laughed me to scorn: * they have spoken with the lips, and wagged the head.

a5cd3b64d5759f685865.latin: 21:9 Sperávit in Dómino, erípiat eum: * salvum fáciat eum, quóniam vult eum.
a5cd3b64d5759f685865.english: 21:9 He hoped in the Lord, let him deliver him: * let him save him, seeing he delighteth in him.

49a2b08b8b489bff2074.latin: 21:10 Quóniam tu es, qui extraxísti me de ventre: * spes mea ab ubéribus matris meæ. In te proiéctus sum ex útero:
49a2b08b8b489bff2074.english: 21:10 For thou art he that hast drawn me out of the womb: * my hope from the breasts of my mother. I was cast upon thee from the womb.

a650a8278ea718046727.latin: 21:11 De ventre matris meæ Deus meus es tu, * ne discésseris a me:
a650a8278ea718046727.english: 21:11 From my mother’s womb thou art my God, * depart not from me.

f892d23ef270cb289b66.latin: 21:12 Quóniam tribulátio próxima est: * quóniam non est qui ádiuvet.
f892d23ef270cb289b66.english: 21:12 For tribulation is very near: * for there is none to help me.

126ce0ef0ccdebc01135.latin: 21:13 Circumdedérunt me vítuli multi: * tauri pingues obsedérunt me.
126ce0ef0ccdebc01135.english: 21:13 Many calves have surrounded me: * fat bulls have besieged me.

f408f41543baf4c1b2ef.latin: 21:14 Aperuérunt super me os suum, * sicut leo rápiens et rúgiens.
f408f41543baf4c1b2ef.english: 21:14 They have opened their mouths against me, * as a lion ravening and roaring.

854ba12ae4f2b5d310af.latin: 21:15 Sicut aqua effúsus sum: * et dispérsa sunt ómnia ossa mea.
854ba12ae4f2b5d310af.english: 21:15 I am poured out like water; * and all my bones are scattered.

fba979405ec5fcdbfdad.latin: 21:15 Factum est cor meum tamquam cera liquéscens * in médio ventris mei.
fba979405ec5fcdbfdad.english: 21:15 My heart is become like wax melting * in the midst of my bowels.

0a2238dd53c28cf122dd.latin: 21:16 Áruit tamquam testa virtus mea, et lingua mea adhǽsit fáucibus meis: * et in púlverem mortis deduxísti me.
0a2238dd53c28cf122dd.english: 21:16 My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue hath cleaved to my jaws: * and thou hast brought me down into the dust of death.

c80813797628fbb49d74.latin: 21:17 Quóniam circumdedérunt me canes multi: * concílium malignántium obsédit me.
c80813797628fbb49d74.english: 21:17 For many dogs have encompassed me: * the council of the malignant hath besieged me.

3b013ce0f63912599a15.latin: 21:17 Fodérunt manus meas et pedes meos: * dinumeravérunt ómnia ossa mea.
3b013ce0f63912599a15.english: 21:17 They have dug my hands and feet. * They have numbered all my bones.

2957225c816f94280b49.latin: 21:18 Ipsi vero consideravérunt et inspexérunt me: * divisérunt sibi vestiménta mea, et super vestem meam misérunt sortem.
2957225c816f94280b49.english: 21:18 And they have looked and stared upon me. * They parted my garments amongst them; and upon my vesture they cast lots.

cb2be7799e1e307440d5.latin: 21:20 Tu autem, Dómine, ne elongáveris auxílium tuum a me: * ad defensiónem meam cónspice.
cb2be7799e1e307440d5.english: 21:20 But thou, O Lord, remove not thy help to a distance from me; * look towards my defence.

71753eeaf7eb4923e2b3.latin: 21:21 Érue a frámea, Deus, ánimam meam: * et de manu canis únicam meam:
