8d3218589db710478f48.latin: 118:1 (Aleph) Beáti immaculáti in via: * qui ámbulant in lege Dómini.
8d3218589db710478f48.english: 118:1 (Aleph) Blessed are the undefiled in the way, * who walk in the law of the Lord.

a7db1b7d4ae0437dc4bb.latin: 118:2 Beáti, qui scrutántur testimónia eius: * in toto corde exquírunt eum.
a7db1b7d4ae0437dc4bb.english: 118:2 Blessed are they that search his testimonies: * that seek him with their whole heart.

d0cdd732c506af644e5c.latin: 118:3 Non enim qui operántur iniquitátem, * in viis eius ambulavérunt.
d0cdd732c506af644e5c.english: 118:3 For they that work iniquity, * have not walked in his ways.

54bfa20537cca11b7622.latin: 118:4 Tu mandásti * mandáta tua custodíri nimis.
54bfa20537cca11b7622.english: 118:4 Thou hast commanded * thy commandments to be kept most diligently.

c7bcf0d057a5c604a425.latin: 118:5 Útinam dirigántur viæ meæ, * ad custodiéndas iustificatiónes tuas!
c7bcf0d057a5c604a425.english: 118:5 O! that my ways may be directed * to keep thy justifications.

daaebd50c926008bbbd6.latin: 118:6 Tunc non confúndar, * cum perspéxero in ómnibus mandátis tuis.
daaebd50c926008bbbd6.english: 118:6 Then shall I not be confounded, * when I shall look into all thy commandments.

25179fe2b0f52b57c8f3.latin: 118:7 Confitébor tibi in directióne cordis: * in eo quod dídici iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
25179fe2b0f52b57c8f3.english: 118:7 I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, * when I shall have learned the judgments of thy justice.

a113345f63fd6b28ab77.latin: 118:8 Iustificatiónes tuas custódiam: * non me derelínquas usquequáque.
a113345f63fd6b28ab77.english: 118:8 I will keep thy justifications: * O! do not thou utterly forsake me.

2cf9c2f0caf618674041.latin: 118:9 (Beth) In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.
2cf9c2f0caf618674041.english: 118:9 (Béth) By what doth a young man correct his way? * By observing thy words.

ff54020fbb3532401b89.latin: 118:10 In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.
ff54020fbb3532401b89.english: 118:10 With my whole heart have I sought after thee: * let me not stray from thy commandments.

bab984097345467ea375.latin: 118:11 In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.
bab984097345467ea375.english: 118:11 Thy words have I hidden in my heart, * that I may not sin against thee.

b676cff31bfcfc14d49a.latin: 118:12 Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
b676cff31bfcfc14d49a.english: 118:12 Blessed art thou, O Lord: * teach me thy justifications.

0c099f827eefeed42244.latin: 118:13 In lábiis meis, * pronuntiávi ómnia iudícia oris tui.
0c099f827eefeed42244.english: 118:13 With my lips * I have pronounced all the judgments of thy mouth.

72c61d189f1b3e12aa42.latin: 118:14 In via testimoniórum tuórum delectátus sum, * sicut in ómnibus divítiis.
72c61d189f1b3e12aa42.english: 118:14 I have been delighted in the way of thy testimonies, * as in all riches.

513315669faab1984c88.latin: 118:15 In mandátis tuis exercébor: * et considerábo vias tuas.
513315669faab1984c88.english: 118:15 I will meditate on thy commandments: * and I will consider thy ways.

1ec3160f32f30a6a30eb.latin: 118:16 In iustificatiónibus tuis meditábor: * non oblivíscar sermónes tuos.
1ec3160f32f30a6a30eb.english: 118:16 I will think of thy justifications: * I will not forget thy words.

45eb811c3a7ecba40f99.latin: 118:17 (Ghimel) Retríbue servo tuo, vivífica me: * et custódiam sermónes tuos:
45eb811c3a7ecba40f99.english: 118:17 (Ghimel) Give bountifully to thy servant, enliven me * and I shall keep thy words.

53cd024e2850d7ed8157.latin: 118:18 Revéla óculos meos: * et considerábo mirabília de lege tua.
53cd024e2850d7ed8157.english: 118:18 Open thou my eyes: * and I will consider the wondrous things of thy law.

707f34370baebd30ea8d.latin: 118:19 Íncola ego sum in terra: * non abscóndas a me mandáta tua.
707f34370baebd30ea8d.english: 118:19 I am a sojourner on the earth: * hide not thy commandments from me.

7ff1ec2cf15c970a00f5.latin: 118:20 Concupívit ánima mea desideráre iustificatiónes tuas, * in omni témpore.
7ff1ec2cf15c970a00f5.english: 118:20 My soul hath coveted to long for thy justifications, * at all times.

6f2d06906301a618a93c.latin: 118:21 Increpásti supérbos: * maledícti qui declínant a mandátis tuis.
6f2d06906301a618a93c.english: 118:21 Thou hast rebuked the proud: * they are cursed who decline from thy commandments.

7d24a0e5959499533452.latin: 118:22 Aufer a me oppróbrium, et contémptum: * quia testimónia tua exquisívi.
7d24a0e5959499533452.english: 118:22 Remove from me reproach and contempt: * because I have sought after thy testimonies.

59d6494c0a60ed3ce3da.latin: 118:23 Étenim sedérunt príncipes, et advérsum me loquebántur: * servus autem tuus exercebátur in iustificatiónibus tuis.
59d6494c0a60ed3ce3da.english: 118:23 For princes sat, and spoke against me: * but thy servant was employed in thy justifications.

9c5a90176f97f69e1a77.latin: 118:24 Nam et testimónia tua meditátio mea est: * et consílium meum iustificatiónes tuæ.
9c5a90176f97f69e1a77.english: 118:24 For thy testimonies are my meditation: * and thy justifications my counsel.

1b926220cfc2143fc8d4.latin: 118:25 (Daleth) Adhǽsit paviménto ánima mea: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
1b926220cfc2143fc8d4.english: 118:25 (Daleth) My soul hath cleaved to the pavement: * quicken thou me according to thy word.

96be1c0f51d9b5780592.latin: 118:26 Vias meas enuntiávi, et exaudísti me: * doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
96be1c0f51d9b5780592.english: 118:26 I have declared my ways, and thou hast heard me: * teach me thy justifications.

0dc81eac620569c1e207.latin: 118:27 Viam iustificatiónum tuárum ínstrue me: * et exercébor in mirabílibus tuis.
0dc81eac620569c1e207.english: 118:27 Make me to understand the way of thy justifications: * and I shall be exercised in thy wondrous works.

1b61eca1b02f4d8dd2c8.latin: 118:28 Dormitávit ánima mea præ tǽdio: * confírma me in verbis tuis.
1b61eca1b02f4d8dd2c8.english: 118:28 My soul hath slumbered through heaviness: * strengthen thou me in thy words.

f208c307c91294983727.latin: 118:29 Viam iniquitátis ámove a me: * et de lege tua miserére mei.
f208c307c91294983727.english: 118:29 Remove from me the way of iniquity: * and out of thy law have mercy on me.

274f39aa76157cad9a79.latin: 118:30 Viam veritátis elégi: * iudícia tua non sum oblítus.
274f39aa76157cad9a79.english: 118:30 I have chosen the way of truth: * thy judgments I have not forgotten.

6e0e0e1b60453660029d.latin: 118:31 Adhǽsi testimóniis tuis, Dómine: * noli me confúndere.
6e0e0e1b60453660029d.english: 118:31 I have stuck to thy testimonies, O Lord: * put me not to shame.

987dc1f64afeae13cff3.latin: 118:32 Viam mandatórum tuórum cucúrri, * cum dilatásti cor meum.
987dc1f64afeae13cff3.english: 118:32 I have run the way of thy commandments, * when thou didst enlarge my heart.

b6becbcae2501ed355fd.latin:
Tértio Nonas Octóbris Luna vicésima tértia. Anno Dómini 2026
Messánæ, in Sicília, natális sanctórum Mártyrum Plácidi Mónachi, e beáti Benedícti Abbátis discípulis, et eius fratrum Eutýchii et Victoríni, ac soróris eórum Fláviæ Vírginis, itémque Donáti, Firmáti Diáconi, Fausti et aliórum trigínta Monachórum, qui omnes a Manúcha piráta, pro Christi fide, necáti sunt.
Apud Smyrnam item natális beáti Thraséæ, Epíscopi Euméniæ, martýrio consummáti.
Antisiodóri deposítio sanctórum germanórum Firmáti Diáconi, et Flaviánæ Vírginis.
Tréviris sanctórum Mártyrum Palmátii et Sociórum; qui, in persecutióne Diocletiáni, sub Rictiováro Prǽside, martýrium subiérunt.
Eódem die pássio sanctæ Charitínæ Vírginis, quæ, sub Diocletiáno Imperatóre et Domítio Consulári, ígnibus est cruciáta et in mare proiécta, et, cum inde incólumis evasísset, tandem, mánibus et pédibus abscíssis dentibúsque convúlsis, in oratióne spíritum emísit.
Ravénnæ sancti Marcellíni, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
Valéntiæ, in Gállia, sancti Apollináris Epíscopi, cuius vita virtútibus fuit illústris, et mors signis ac prodígiis decoráta.
Eódem die sancti Attiláni, Epíscopi Zamorénsis, quem beátus Urbánus Papa Secúndus in Sanctórum númerum rétulit.
Romæ sanctæ Gallæ Víduæ, fíliæ Sýmmachi Cónsulis, quæ, viro suo defúncto, apud Ecclésiam beáti Petri multis annis oratióni, eleemósynis, ieiúniis aliísque sanctis opéribus inténta permánsit; cuius felicíssimum tránsitum sanctus Gregórius Papa descrípsit.
℣. Et álibi aliórum plurimórum sanctórum Mártyrum et Confessórum, atque sanctárum Vírginum.
℟. Deo grátias.
b6becbcae2501ed355fd.english:
October 5th 2026, the 23rd day of the Moon, were born into the better life:
At Messina, in Sicily, (in the year 546,) the holy monk Placidus, a disciple of the blessed Abbot Benedict, his brothers Eutychius and Victorinus, and the Virgin Flavia, their sister, along with Donatus, the Deacon Firmatus, Faustus, and thirty other monks, all martyrs, who were massacred for Christ's faith's sake, by the pirate Manucha.
Upon the same day, (in the year 171,) blessed Thraseas, Bishop of Eumenia, who achieved his martyrdom at Smyrna.
At Trier, the holy martyrs Palmatius and his Companions, who underwent martyrdom under the President Rictiovarus, in the persecution under the Emperor Diocletian.
On the same day, the holy Virgin Charitina, under the Emperor Diocletian and the Consular Domitius. She was tormented with fire, and cast into the sea, whence she came forth unharmed, then her hands and feet were cut off, and her teeth shaken, and she gave up her soul in prayer to God.
At Auxerre, the holy Deacon Firmatus, (in the fifth or sixth century,) and the Virgin Flaviana his sister.
At Ravenna, the holy Confessor Marcellinus, Bishop of (that see.)
At Valence, in Gaul, holy Apollinaris, (about the year 520,) Bishop (of that see) his life was famous for his graces, and his death was marked by signs and wonders.
Upon the same day holy Attilan, Bishop of Zamora, whose name Urban II. numbered with those of the Saints.
At Leon, (in the year 1006,) in Spain, holy Froilan, Bishop of that city, famous for his zeal in spreading the monastic life, his goodness toward the poor, and other graces and wonders.
At Rome, the holy widow Galla, daughter of the Consul Symmachus after the death of her husband she passed many years at the church of blessed Peter, intent upon prayer, alms, fastings, and other holy works. Holy Pope Gregory hath written of her right blessed passage hence.
℣. And elsewhere many other holy martyrs, confessors, and holy virgins.
℟. Thanks be to God.

ffa54ecc2687a7e8ee91.latin: Sextus humilitátis gradus est, si omni vilitáte vel extremitáte conténtus sit mónachus, et ad ómnia quæ sibi iniungúntur velut operárium malum se iúdicet et indígnum, dicens sibi cum Prophéta: Ad níhilum redáctus sum et nescívi; ut iuméntum factus sum apud te et ego semper tecum.
ffa54ecc2687a7e8ee91.english: The sixth step in humility is if a monk be content with the meanest and worst of everything and with respect to everything enjoined him adjudge himself a profitless workman and unworthy, saying to himself with the prophet: “I was brought to nothing and was ignorant: I became as a beast of burden before Thee and I am always with Thee.”

461f178a40e93b09d6e5.latin: 118:33 (He) Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam iustificatiónum tuárum: * et exquíram eam semper.
461f178a40e93b09d6e5.english: 118:33 (He) Set before me for a law the way of thy justifications, O Lord: * and I will always seek after it.

29ed2839a70fedc536a4.latin: 118:34 Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam: * et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.
29ed2839a70fedc536a4.english: 118:34 Give me understanding, and I will search thy law; * and I will keep it with my whole heart.

46f5aae9d4a460e4a112.latin: 118:35 Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum: * quia ipsam vólui.
46f5aae9d4a460e4a112.english: 118:35 Lead me into the path of thy commandments; * for this same I have desired.

5a5656eba773a632d2a8.latin: 118:36 Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua: * et non in avarítiam.
5a5656eba773a632d2a8.english: 118:36 Incline my heart into thy testimonies * and not to covetousness.

d9104787d61f79c825a6.latin: 118:37 Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: * in via tua vivífica me.
d9104787d61f79c825a6.english: 118:37 Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: * quicken me in thy way.

d6c0399cff55245e3457.latin: 118:38 Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, * in timóre tuo.
d6c0399cff55245e3457.english: 118:38 Establish thy word to thy servant, * in thy fear.

82f35abcad04febdd5e0.latin: 118:39 Ámputa oppróbrium meum quod suspicátus sum: * quia iudícia tua iucúnda.
82f35abcad04febdd5e0.english: 118:39 Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: * for thy judgments are delightful.

91b613f02ce75104288c.latin: 118:40 Ecce, concupívi mandáta tua: * in æquitáte tua vivífica me.
91b613f02ce75104288c.english: 118:40 Behold I have longed after thy precepts: * quicken me in thy justice.

0d772648c7f968cb159e.latin: 118:41 (Vav) Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine: * salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.
0d772648c7f968cb159e.english: 118:41 (Vau) Let thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord: * thy salvation according to thy word.

39ad51eb224100dbad31.latin: 118:42 Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum: * quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.
39ad51eb224100dbad31.english: 118:42 So shall I answer them that reproach me in any thing; * that I have trusted in thy words.

4f65f1af02eb6037d777.latin: 118:43 Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque: * quia in iudíciis tuis supersperávi.
4f65f1af02eb6037d777.english: 118:43 And take not thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: * for in thy words, I have hoped exceedingly.

ba75ac863df68470b135.latin: 118:44 Et custódiam legem tuam semper: * in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
ba75ac863df68470b135.english: 118:44 So shall I always keep thy law, * for ever and ever.

7804fab1a493d2a26a4a.latin: 118:45 Et ambulábam in latitúdine: * quia mandáta tua exquisívi.
7804fab1a493d2a26a4a.english: 118:45 And I walked at large: * because I have sought after thy commandments.

52b57b03b471ea73c78a.latin: 118:46 Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum: * et non confundébar.
52b57b03b471ea73c78a.english: 118:46 And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings: * and I was not ashamed.

23c061e796f05e47354c.latin: 118:47 Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, * quæ diléxi.
23c061e796f05e47354c.english: 118:47 I meditated also on thy commandments, * which I loved.

1304c6caba05694a6df5.latin: 118:48 Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi: * et exercébar in iustificatiónibus tuis.
1304c6caba05694a6df5.english: 118:48 And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments, which I loved: * and I was exercised in thy justifications.

760a1d2817da34d99033.latin: 118:49 (Zai) Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, * in quo mihi spem dedísti.
760a1d2817da34d99033.english: 118:49 (Zai) Be thou mindful of thy word to thy servant, * in which thou hast given me hope.

33bc6491817c8a572e41.latin: 118:50 Hæc me consoláta est in humilitáte mea: * quia elóquium tuum vivificávit me.
33bc6491817c8a572e41.english: 118:50 This hath comforted me in my humiliation: * because thy word hath enlivened me.

951c6664df0888fef921.latin: 118:51 Supérbi iníque agébant usquequáque: * a lege autem tua non declinávi.
951c6664df0888fef921.english: 118:51 The proud did iniquitously altogether: * but I declined not from thy law.

7d64cb7d7de6da95af5d.latin: 118:52 Memor fui iudiciórum tuórum a sǽculo, Dómine: * et consolátus sum.
7d64cb7d7de6da95af5d.english: 118:52 I remembered, O Lord, thy judgments of old: * and I was comforted.

ac3b741083614694adf9.latin: 118:53 Deféctio ténuit me, * pro peccatóribus derelinquéntibus legem tuam.
ac3b741083614694adf9.english: 118:53 A fainting hath taken hold of me, * because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

9683fcf74e497be3adcf.latin: 118:54 Cantábiles mihi erant iustificatiónes tuæ, * in loco peregrinatiónis meæ.
9683fcf74e497be3adcf.english: 118:54 Thy justifications were the subject of my song, * in the place of my pilgrimage.

daa0164fee5f0ab9df98.latin: 118:55 Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine: * et custodívi legem tuam.
daa0164fee5f0ab9df98.english: 118:55 In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord: * and have kept thy law.

01b4d86225424999c28b.latin: 118:56 Hæc facta est mihi: * quia iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
01b4d86225424999c28b.english: 118:56 This happened to me: * because I sought after thy justifications.

ac8a3012f124ec99be33.latin:
1 Ioann. 4:16
Deus cáritas est: et qui manet in caritáte, in Deo manet, et Deus in eo.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
℟. Sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
ac8a3012f124ec99be33.english:
1 John. 4:16
God is charity: and he that abideth in charity, abideth in God, and God in him.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. I said: O Lord, be thou merciful to me.
℟. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.

b154fa2ffe685f7a9ec1.latin: 118:57 (Heth) Pórtio mea, Dómine, * dixi custodíre legem tuam.
b154fa2ffe685f7a9ec1.english: 118:57 (Heth) O Lord, my portion, * I have said, I would keep thy law.

52bf9766b4827ad43066.latin: 118:58 Deprecátus sum fáciem tuam in toto corde meo: * miserére mei secúndum elóquium tuum.
52bf9766b4827ad43066.english: 118:58 I entreated thy face with all my heart: * have mercy on me according to thy word.

61b3fbc8ad7e83e9c201.latin: 118:59 Cogitávi vias meas: * et convérti pedes meos in testimónia tua.
61b3fbc8ad7e83e9c201.english: 118:59 I have thought on my ways: * and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

f3f9487b7989a7844c9e.latin: 118:60 Parátus sum, et non sum turbátus: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
f3f9487b7989a7844c9e.english: 118:60 I am ready, and am not troubled: * that I may keep thy commandments.

70fe72f7aacd20bedf33.latin: 118:61 Funes peccatórum circumpléxi sunt me: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
70fe72f7aacd20bedf33.english: 118:61 The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: * but I have not forgotten thy law.

01f04088605b2c18ff0f.latin: 118:62 Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi, * super iudícia iustificatiónis tuæ.
01f04088605b2c18ff0f.english: 118:62 I rose at midnight to give praise to thee; * for the judgments of thy justification.

8562b2e709e5e8b6c379.latin: 118:63 Párticeps ego sum ómnium timéntium te: * et custodiéntium mandáta tua.
8562b2e709e5e8b6c379.english: 118:63 I am a partaker with all them that fear thee, * and that keep thy commandments.

5bf556c08d17859fd817.latin: 118:64 Misericórdia tua, Dómine, plena est terra: * iustificatiónes tuas doce me.
5bf556c08d17859fd817.english: 118:64 The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: * teach me thy justifications.

8a773294cde7836a1dba.latin: 118:65 (Teth) Bonitátem fecísti cum servo tuo, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum.
8a773294cde7836a1dba.english: 118:65 (Teth) Thou hast done well with thy servant, O Lord, * according to thy word.

7bb11b1f72b50bc14a17.latin: 118:66 Bonitátem, et disciplínam, et sciéntiam doce me: * quia mandátis tuis crédidi.
7bb11b1f72b50bc14a17.english: 118:66 Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge; * for I have believed thy commandments.

e797c6eac4dcb8defcd8.latin: 118:67 Priúsquam humiliárer ego delíqui: * proptérea elóquium tuum custodívi.
e797c6eac4dcb8defcd8.english: 118:67 Before I was humbled I offended; * therefore have I kept thy word.

85d343c03ea0da97e336.latin: 118:68 Bonus es tu: * et in bonitáte tua doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
85d343c03ea0da97e336.english: 118:68 Thou art good; * and in thy goodness teach me thy justifications.

91227f1321fcbd4c4b0d.latin: 118:69 Multiplicáta est super me iníquitas superbórum: * ego autem in toto corde meo scrutábor mandáta tua.
91227f1321fcbd4c4b0d.english: 118:69 The iniquity of the proud hath been multiplied over me: * but I will seek thy commandments with my whole heart.

f6ffcc3415690db3cf7e.latin: 118:70 Coagulátum est sicut lac cor eórum: * ego vero legem tuam meditátus sum.
f6ffcc3415690db3cf7e.english: 118:70 Their heart is curdled like milk: * but I have meditated on thy law.

06bc700e28ad2f4bb3b1.latin: 118:71 Bonum mihi quia humiliásti me: * ut discam iustificatiónes tuas.
06bc700e28ad2f4bb3b1.english: 118:71 It is good for me that thou hast humbled me, * that I may learn thy justifications.

a378d43904b6e82b2553.latin: 118:72 Bonum mihi lex oris tui, * super míllia auri et argénti.
a378d43904b6e82b2553.english: 118:72 The law of thy mouth is good to me, * above thousands of gold and silver.

4f0c7bfa75bdd2942400.latin: 118:73 (Ioth) Manus tuæ fecérunt me, et plasmavérunt me: * da mihi intelléctum, et discam mandáta tua.
4f0c7bfa75bdd2942400.english: 118:73 (Jod) Thy hands have made me and formed me: * give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

4cc861666f3fb6014840.latin: 118:74 Qui timent te vidébunt me, et lætabúntur: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
4cc861666f3fb6014840.english: 118:74 They that fear thee shall see me, and shall be glad: * because I have greatly hoped in thy words.

98888c7d668d7cf1923d.latin: 118:75 Cognóvi, Dómine, quia ǽquitas iudícia tua: * et in veritáte tua humiliásti me.
98888c7d668d7cf1923d.english: 118:75 I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are equity: * and in thy truth thou hast humbled me.

ab6f5283889e2222548c.latin: 118:76 Fiat misericórdia tua ut consolétur me, * secúndum elóquium tuum servo tuo.
ab6f5283889e2222548c.english: 118:76 O! let thy mercy be for my comfort, * according to thy word unto thy servant.

decc71329dd1e8c73308.latin: 118:77 Véniant mihi miseratiónes tuæ, et vivam: * quia lex tua meditátio mea est.
decc71329dd1e8c73308.english: 118:77 Let thy tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: * for thy law is my meditation.

3ff60054b1eb937f9ffb.latin: 118:78 Confundántur supérbi, quia iniúste iniquitátem fecérunt in me: * ego autem exercébor in mandátis tuis.
3ff60054b1eb937f9ffb.english: 118:78 Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: * but I will be employed in thy commandments.

f674906f00971e55e86f.latin: 118:79 Convertántur mihi timéntes te: * et qui novérunt testimónia tua.
f674906f00971e55e86f.english: 118:79 Let them that fear thee turn to me: * and they that know thy testimonies.

d18ff866358ebfa5b884.latin: 118:80 Fiat cor meum immaculátum in iustificatiónibus tuis, * ut non confúndar.
d18ff866358ebfa5b884.english: 118:80 Let my heart be undefiled in thy justifications, * that I may not be confounded.

6bbb1e825f556eae371d.latin:
Gal 6:2
Alter altérius ónera portáte, et sic adimplébitis legem Christi.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit.
℟. In loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
6bbb1e825f556eae371d.english:
Gal 6:2
Bear ye one another's burdens; and so you shall fulfill the law of Christ.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.
℟. He hath set me in a place of pasture.

1b878912a34cf98e82f6.latin: 118:81 (Caph) Defécit in salutáre tuum ánima mea: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
1b878912a34cf98e82f6.english: 118:81 (Caph) My soul hath fainted after thy salvation: * and in thy word I have very much hoped.

59c74b6462b6fc7f3066.latin: 118:82 Defecérunt óculi mei in elóquium tuum, * dicéntes: Quando consoláberis me?
59c74b6462b6fc7f3066.english: 118:82 My eyes have failed for thy word, * saying: When wilt thou comfort me?

071039f79b98d864886e.latin: 118:83 Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruína: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
071039f79b98d864886e.english: 118:83 For I am become like a bottle in the frost: * I have not forgotten thy justifications.

ad22a32528d76e234954.latin: 118:84 Quot sunt dies servi tui? * quando fácies de persequéntibus me iudícium?
ad22a32528d76e234954.english: 118:84 How many are the days of thy servant: * when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

a8743f16d56659d9856d.latin: 118:85 Narravérunt mihi iníqui fabulatiónes: * sed non ut lex tua.
a8743f16d56659d9856d.english: 118:85 The wicked have told me fables: * but not as thy law.

c68154b8f0f4e203361e.latin: 118:86 Ómnia mandáta tua véritas: * iníque persecúti sunt me, ádiuva me.
c68154b8f0f4e203361e.english: 118:86 All thy statutes are truth: * they have persecuted me unjustly, do thou help me.

22cda3ddad155c719da1.latin: 118:87 Paulo minus consummavérunt me in terra: * ego autem non derelíqui mandáta tua.
22cda3ddad155c719da1.english: 118:87 They had almost made an end of me upon earth: * but I have not forsaken thy commandments.

ae367900515739ec0e79.latin: 118:88 Secúndum misericórdiam tuam vivífica me: * et custódiam testimónia oris tui.
ae367900515739ec0e79.english: 118:88 Quicken thou me according to thy mercy: * and I shall keep the testimonies of thy mouth.

26b3cd9a46b39740bd20.latin: 118:89 (Lamed) In ætérnum, Dómine, * verbum tuum pérmanet in cælo.
26b3cd9a46b39740bd20.english: 118:89 (Lamed) For ever, O Lord, * thy word standeth firm in heaven.

f6341dad1da68beccb45.latin: 118:90 In generatiónem et generatiónem véritas tua: * fundásti terram, et pérmanet.
f6341dad1da68beccb45.english: 118:90 Thy truth unto all generations: * thou hast founded the earth, and it continueth.

c4002a87a7df7566c9a4.latin: 118:91 Ordinatióne tua persevérat dies: * quóniam ómnia sérviunt tibi.
c4002a87a7df7566c9a4.english: 118:91 By thy ordinance the day goeth on: * for all things serve thee.

9acea67e907e2a839ca6.latin: 118:92 Nisi quod lex tua meditátio mea est: * tunc forte periíssem in humilitáte mea.
9acea67e907e2a839ca6.english: 118:92 Unless thy law had been my meditation, * I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.

1a46c7a56a1a25243bb5.latin: 118:93 In ætérnum non oblivíscar iustificatiónes tuas: * quia in ipsis vivificásti me.
1a46c7a56a1a25243bb5.english: 118:93 Thy justifications I will never forget: * for by them thou hast given me life.

5e75779deb3d95d743a6.latin: 118:94 Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac: * quóniam iustificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
5e75779deb3d95d743a6.english: 118:94 I am thine, save thou me: * for I have sought thy justifications.

1c1255b3657c746e01f1.latin: 118:95 Me exspectavérunt peccatóres ut pérderent me: * testimónia tua intelléxi.
1c1255b3657c746e01f1.english: 118:95 The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: * but I have understood thy testimonies.

d23b7084223aae3d47b0.latin: 118:96 Omnis consummatiónis vidi finem: * latum mandátum tuum nimis.
d23b7084223aae3d47b0.english: 118:96 I have seen an end of all perfection: * thy commandment is exceeding broad.

337deeb4840f603c06f4.latin: 118:97 (Mem) Quómodo diléxi legem tuam, Dómine? * tota die meditátio mea est.
337deeb4840f603c06f4.english: 118:97 (Mem) How have I loved thy law, O Lord! * it is my meditation all the day.

72716d1e43c19b9be2f0.latin: 118:98 Super inimícos meos prudéntem me fecísti mandáto tuo: * quia in ætérnum mihi est.
72716d1e43c19b9be2f0.english: 118:98 Through thy commandment, thou hast made me wiser than my enemies: * for it is ever with me.

5e843c0b6e13696bb5b0.latin: 118:99 Super omnes docéntes me intelléxi: * quia testimónia tua meditátio mea est.
5e843c0b6e13696bb5b0.english: 118:99 I have understood more than all my teachers: * because thy testimonies are my meditation.

ca20a76014298550cb82.latin: 118:100 Super senes intelléxi: * quia mandáta tua quæsívi.
ca20a76014298550cb82.english: 118:100 I have had understanding above ancients: * because I have sought thy commandments.

9eacb71c4b4a1d269038.latin: 118:101 Ab omni via mala prohíbui pedes meos: * ut custódiam verba tua.
9eacb71c4b4a1d269038.english: 118:101 I have restrained my feet from every evil way: * that I may keep thy words.

6dfa72fe387e7a41d632.latin: 118:102 A iudíciis tuis non declinávi: * quia tu legem posuísti mihi.
6dfa72fe387e7a41d632.english: 118:102 I have not declined from thy judgments, * because thou hast set me a law.

63586145fd8f64e86952.latin: 118:103 Quam dúlcia fáucibus meis elóquia tua, * super mel ori meo!
63586145fd8f64e86952.english: 118:103 How sweet are thy words to my palate! * more than honey to my mouth.

084aa8706d9be919cb0f.latin: 118:104 A mandátis tuis intelléxi: * proptérea odívi omnem viam iniquitátis.
084aa8706d9be919cb0f.english: 118:104 By thy commandments I have had understanding: * therefore have I hated every way of iniquity.

8f7e8663cea8d5acd87e.latin:
1 Cor 6:20
Empti enim estis prétio magno. Glorificáte et portáte Deum in córpore vestro.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.
℟. Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
8f7e8663cea8d5acd87e.english:
1 Cor 6:20
For you are bought with a great price. Glorify and bear God in your body.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord.
℟. And from those of others spare thy servant.

dec19792f9da2f3e6203.latin: Ant. Dixit Dóminus * Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis. ‡
dec19792f9da2f3e6203.english: Ant. The Lord said * to my Lord: Sit thou at my right hand. ‡

47ae3ddfe865c7bfaa38.latin: 109:1 Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis:
47ae3ddfe865c7bfaa38.english: 109:1 The Lord said to my Lord: Sit thou at my right hand:

d64939e33a0cc474ad04.latin: 109:1 ‡ Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
d64939e33a0cc474ad04.english: 109:1 ‡ Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

1f14e6596acb6c953ede.latin: Ant. Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: Sede a dextris meis.
1f14e6596acb6c953ede.english: Ant. The Lord said to my Lord: Sit thou at my right hand.

a49a62897f5f535b7f83.latin: Ant. Fidélia * ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sæculum sæculi.
a49a62897f5f535b7f83.english: Ant. All his commandments are faithful: * confirmed for ever and ever.

0c5aca0aee04b5c7f51a.latin: Ant. Fidélia ómnia mandáta eius: confirmáta in sæculum sæculi.
0c5aca0aee04b5c7f51a.english: Ant. All his commandments are faithful: confirmed for ever and ever.

d0599c66cfac76b62e44.latin: Ant. In mandátis * eius cupit nimis.
d0599c66cfac76b62e44.english: Ant. He shall delight * exceedingly in his commandments.

d5c711eff8696170b1fe.latin: Ant. In mandátis eius cupit nimis.
d5c711eff8696170b1fe.english: Ant. He shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

7534ac6931239aff5f12.latin: Ant. Sit nomen Dómini * benedíctum in sæcula.
7534ac6931239aff5f12.english: Ant. Blessed be the name of the Lord * from henceforth now and for ever.

64a000b460125ee21eb0.latin: 112:1 Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
64a000b460125ee21eb0.english: 112:1 Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

e15a8e0553482895586d.latin: 112:2 (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
e15a8e0553482895586d.english: 112:2 (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

c1c2920a03f1991bdfe4.latin: 112:3 A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
c1c2920a03f1991bdfe4.english: 112:3 From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

91e0fbae8eb0b28d53ec.latin: 112:4 Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória eius.
91e0fbae8eb0b28d53ec.english: 112:4 The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

3e57b367249be39967e3.latin: 112:5 Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
3e57b367249be39967e3.english: 112:5 Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

f5a6c0e53396188bbf1a.latin: 112:7 Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
f5a6c0e53396188bbf1a.english: 112:7 Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

b9955e0876074fcf1ecd.latin: 112:8 Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
b9955e0876074fcf1ecd.english: 112:8 That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

429d7c8a5540fc7a607b.latin: 112:9 Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
429d7c8a5540fc7a607b.english: 112:9 Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

29bf080359be19ccadbc.latin: Ant. Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum in sæcula.
29bf080359be19ccadbc.english: Ant. Blessed be the name of the Lord from henceforth now and for ever.

991dc6786d551c81ba47.latin:
2 Cor 1:3-4
Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Quam magnificáta sunt * ópera tua, Dómine.
℟. Quam magnificáta sunt * ópera tua, Dómine.
℣. Ómnia in sapiéntia fecísti.
℟. Ópera tua Dómine.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Quam magnificáta sunt * ópera tua, Dómine.
Hymnus
Lucis Creátor óptime,
Lucem diérum próferens,
Primórdiis lucis novæ,
Mundi parans oríginem:
Qui mane iunctum vésperi
Diem vocári prǽcipis:
Tetrum chaos illábitur,
Audi preces cum flétibus.
Ne mens graváta crímine,
Vitæ sit exsul múnere,
Dum nil perénne cógitat,
Seséque culpis ílligat.
Cælórum pulset íntimum,
Vitále tollat prǽmium:
Vitémus omne nóxium:
Purgémus omne péssimum.
Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
℣. Dirigátur, Dómine, orátio mea.
℟. Sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo.
991dc6786d551c81ba47.english:
2 Cor 1:3-4
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟.br. How great are thy works, O Lord.
℟. How great are thy works, O Lord.
℣. Thou hast made all things in wisdom.
℟. Thy works, O Lord.
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. How great are thy works, O Lord.
Hymn
O blest Creator of the light,
Who mak’st the day with radiance bright,
And o’er the forming world didst call
The light from chaos first of all;
Whose wisdom joined in meet array
The morn and eve, and named them day:
Night comes with all its darkling fears;
Regard thy people’s prayers and tears.
Lest, sunk in sin, and whelmed with strife,
They lose the gift of endless life;
While thinking but the thoughts of time,
They weave new chains of woe and crime.
But grant them grace that they may strain
The heavenly gate and prize to gain:
Each harmful lure aside to cast,
And purge away each error past.
O Father, that we ask be done,
Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.
Amen.
℣. O Lord, direct my prayer.
℟. As incense in thy sight.

0852486a6719f6206232.latin: Ant. Intrávit autem rex * ut vidéret discumbéntes, et vidit ibi hóminem non vestítum veste nuptiáli et ait illi: Amíce, quómodo huc intrásti non habens vestem nuptiálem?
0852486a6719f6206232.english: Ant. And the King came in * to see the guests, and he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment. And he saith unto him: Friend, how camest thou in hither, not having a wedding garment?

55467f2a1e555b71d060.latin: Ant. Intrávit autem rex ut vidéret discumbéntes, et vidit ibi hóminem non vestítum veste nuptiáli et ait illi: Amíce, quómodo huc intrásti non habens vestem nuptiálem?
55467f2a1e555b71d060.english: Ant. And the King came in to see the guests, and he saw there a man which had not on a wedding garment. And he saith unto him: Friend, how camest thou in hither, not having a wedding garment?

12eafb7a962d934fafc7.latin: Ant. Regem Confessórum Dóminum, * Veníte, adorémus.
12eafb7a962d934fafc7.english: Ant. The Lord, the King of Confessors, * O come, let us worship.

27e72712104c27b3eed4.english: Ant. O come, let us worship.

3c8cd78e853a373396e3.latin:
Inclytos Christi fámulos canámus,
Quos, fide claros nitidísque gestis,
Hac die tellus sociáta cælo
Láudibus ornat.
Quippe qui mites, húmiles, pudíci,
Nésciam culpæ coluére vitam,
Donec e terris ánimus volávit
Liber ad astra.
Inde iam gaudent míseris adésse,
Fléntium tergunt lácrimas, medéntur
Méntium plagis, vitiáta reddunt
Membra salúti.
Nostra laus ergo résonet benígnis
His Dei servis referátque grates,
Qui pia pergant ope nos iuváre
Rebus in arctis.
Sit Deo soli decus et potéstas,
Laus in excélsis honor ac perénnis,
Qui suis totum móderans gubérnat
Légibus orbem.
Amen.

His Dei servis referátque grates,

Légibus orbem.
Amen.

539b19d51215fc7af3fa.english: Ant. Praise is comely * for the upright.

a6e13ecf9af69ec87325.latin: 32:1 Exsultáte, iusti, in Dómino: * rectos decet collaudátio.
a6e13ecf9af69ec87325.english: 32:1 Rejoice in the Lord, O ye just: * praise becometh the upright.

45494e5a71e0014859bf.latin: 32:2 Confitémini Dómino in cíthara: * in psaltério decem chordárum psállite illi.
45494e5a71e0014859bf.english: 32:2 Give praise to the Lord on the harp; * sing to him with the psaltery, the instrument of ten strings.

ed3874ad30610c8500dd.latin: 32:3 Cantáte ei cánticum novum: * bene psállite ei in vociferatióne.
ed3874ad30610c8500dd.english: 32:3 Sing to him a new canticle, * sing well unto him with a loud noise.

100f738d5972c61a4e0d.latin: 32:4 Quia rectum est verbum Dómini, * et ómnia ópera eius in fide.
100f738d5972c61a4e0d.english: 32:4 For the word of the Lord is right, * and all his works are done with faithfulness.

b8b86c9f602c77a0860b.latin: 32:5 Díligit misericórdiam et iudícium: * misericórdia Dómini plena est terra.
b8b86c9f602c77a0860b.english: 32:5 He loveth mercy and judgment; * the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.

65d2317f75f75c5dea6c.latin: 32:6 Verbo Dómini cæli firmáti sunt: * et spíritu oris eius omnis virtus eórum.
65d2317f75f75c5dea6c.english: 32:6 By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; * and all the power of them by the spirit of his mouth:

3fa4a81c0586e54c68ae.latin: 32:7 Cóngregans sicut in utre aquas maris: * ponens in thesáuris abýssos.
3fa4a81c0586e54c68ae.english: 32:7 Gathering together the waters of the sea, as in a vessel; * laying up the depths in storehouses.

0201965cf50cba1aba7d.latin: 32:8 Tímeat Dóminum omnis terra: * ab eo autem commoveántur omnes inhabitántes orbem.
0201965cf50cba1aba7d.english: 32:8 Let all the earth fear the Lord, * and let all the inhabitants of the world be in awe of him.

a32992aa13db900b3f1c.latin: 32:9 Quóniam ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
a32992aa13db900b3f1c.english: 32:9 For he spoke and they were made: * he commanded and they were created.

1d034407001d130f03dd.latin: 32:10 Dóminus díssipat consília géntium: * réprobat autem cogitatiónes populórum, et réprobat consília príncipum.
1d034407001d130f03dd.english: 32:10 The Lord bringeth to nought the counsels of nations; * and he rejecteth the devices of people, and casteth away the counsels of princes.

0b6c80f3593ef269c103.latin: 32:11 Consílium autem Dómini in ætérnum manet: * cogitatiónes cordis eius in generatióne et generatiónem.
0b6c80f3593ef269c103.english: 32:11 But the counsel of the Lord standeth for ever: * the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

0949e951bf684bf79146.latin: 32:12 Beáta gens, cuius est Dóminus, Deus eius: * pópulus, quem elégit in hereditátem sibi.
0949e951bf684bf79146.english: 32:12 Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord: * the people whom he hath chosen for his inheritance.

080f724f02546b8d0109.latin: 32:13 De cælo respéxit Dóminus: * vidit omnes fílios hóminum.
080f724f02546b8d0109.english: 32:13 The Lord hath looked from heaven: * he hath beheld all the sons of men.

933f711e10eda2766d05.latin: 32:14 De præparáto habitáculo suo * respéxit super omnes, qui hábitant terram.
933f711e10eda2766d05.english: 32:14 From his habitation which he hath prepared, * he hath looked upon all that dwell on the earth.

f52335c0dd98a9a33dc0.latin: 32:15 Qui finxit sigillátim corda eórum: * qui intéllegit ómnia ópera eórum.
f52335c0dd98a9a33dc0.english: 32:15 He who hath made the hearts of every one of them: * who understandeth all their works.

0f6bf9385945a3aa148e.latin: 32:16 Non salvátur rex per multam virtútem: * et gigas non salvábitur in multitúdine virtútis suæ.
0f6bf9385945a3aa148e.english: 32:16 The king is not saved by a great army: * nor shall the giant be saved by his own great strength.

e7eba1ad59f9cedfc290.latin: 32:17 Fallax equus ad salútem: * in abundántia autem virtútis suæ non salvábitur.
e7eba1ad59f9cedfc290.english: 32:17 Vain is the horse for safety: * neither shall he be saved by the abundance of his strength.

309ae470936ebdcfbbee.latin: 32:18 Ecce, óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius:
309ae470936ebdcfbbee.english: 32:18 Behold the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him: * and on them that hope in his mercy.

038b748cc55e485c8f01.latin: 32:19 Ut éruat a morte ánimas eórum: * et alat eos in fame.
038b748cc55e485c8f01.english: 32:19 To deliver their souls from death; * and feed them in famine.

11847bdb427acfc2d83f.latin: 32:20 Ánima nostra sústinet Dóminum: * quóniam adiútor et protéctor noster est.
11847bdb427acfc2d83f.english: 32:20 Our soul waiteth for the Lord: * for he is our helper and protector.

d4bbb32d8297d63b479c.latin: 32:21 Quia in eo lætábitur cor nostrum: * et in nómine sancto eius sperávimus.
d4bbb32d8297d63b479c.english: 32:21 For in him our heart shall rejoice: * and in his holy name we have trusted.

9d453d510de278834f30.latin: 32:22 Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos: * quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
9d453d510de278834f30.english: 32:22 Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, * as we have hoped in thee.

216c91b09eb62a399af3.latin: 33:2 Benedícam Dóminum in omni témpore: * semper laus eius in ore meo.
216c91b09eb62a399af3.english: 33:2 I will bless the Lord at all times, * his praise shall be always in my mouth.

f378fc36a50d1c00bbe5.latin: 33:3 In Dómino laudábitur ánima mea: * áudiant mansuéti, et læténtur.
f378fc36a50d1c00bbe5.english: 33:3 In the Lord shall my soul be praised: * let the meek hear and rejoice.

385cbf9e03ea82973ed1.latin: 33:4 Magnificáte Dóminum mecum: * et exaltémus nomen eius in idípsum.
385cbf9e03ea82973ed1.english: 33:4 O magnify the Lord with me; * and let us extol his name together.

54d00ca67ff8105e4d2c.latin: 33:5 Exquisívi Dóminum, et exaudívit me: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus meis erípuit me.
54d00ca67ff8105e4d2c.english: 33:5 I sought the Lord, and he heard me; * and he delivered me from all my troubles.

17fca40b79ae164646f2.latin: 33:6 Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini: * et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.
17fca40b79ae164646f2.english: 33:6 Come ye to him and be enlightened: * and your faces shall not be confounded.

c4f67ffa9ccc114711b8.latin: 33:7 Iste pauper clamávit, et Dóminus exaudívit eum: * et de ómnibus tribulatiónibus eius salvávit eum.
c4f67ffa9ccc114711b8.english: 33:7 This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him: * and saved him out of all his troubles.

f42daa7ca2397ac4725b.latin: 33:8 Immíttet Ángelus Dómini in circúitu timéntium eum: * et erípiet eos.
f42daa7ca2397ac4725b.english: 33:8 The Angel of the Lord shall encamp round about them that fear him: * and shall deliver them.

52c89087935738924329.latin: 33:9 Gustáte, et vidéte quóniam suávis est Dóminus: * beátus vir, qui sperat in eo.
52c89087935738924329.english: 33:9 O taste, and see that the Lord is sweet: * blessed is the man that hopeth in him.

aa662ca1958960ffe7eb.latin: 33:10 Timéte Dóminum, omnes sancti eius: * quóniam non est inópia timéntibus eum.
aa662ca1958960ffe7eb.english: 33:10 Fear the Lord, all ye his saints: * for there is no want to them that fear him.

f3078d610d439881f080.latin: 33:11 Dívites eguérunt et esuriérunt: * inquiréntes autem Dóminum non minuéntur omni bono.
f3078d610d439881f080.english: 33:11 The rich have wanted, and have suffered hunger: * but they that seek the Lord shall not be deprived of any good.

0bfdc6c67b41759a0826.latin: 33:12 Veníte, fílii, audíte me: * timórem Dómini docébo vos.
0bfdc6c67b41759a0826.english: 33:12 Come, children, hearken to me: * I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

5cede01da85c7ce751db.latin: 33:13 Quis est homo qui vult vitam: * díligit dies vidére bonos?
5cede01da85c7ce751db.english: 33:13 Who is the man that desireth life: * who loveth to see good days?

eb084494536457c543ee.latin: 33:14 Próhibe linguam tuam a malo: * et lábia tua ne loquántur dolum.
eb084494536457c543ee.english: 33:14 Keep thy tongue from evil, * and thy lips from speaking guile.

40653f10253f223e12d5.latin: 33:15 Divérte a malo, et fac bonum: * inquíre pacem, et perséquere eam.
40653f10253f223e12d5.english: 33:15 Turn away from evil and do good: * seek after peace and pursue it.

4ae9eb0e1670bcf6d5ff.latin: 33:16 Óculi Dómini super iustos: * et aures eius in preces eórum.
4ae9eb0e1670bcf6d5ff.english: 33:16 The eyes of the Lord are upon the just: * and his ears unto their prayers.

fd6c46d7cf8e6551d6d8.latin: 33:17 Vultus autem Dómini super faciéntes mala: * ut perdat de terra memóriam eórum.
fd6c46d7cf8e6551d6d8.english: 33:17 But the countenance of the Lord is against them that do evil things: * to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

6149f9f8578e92e58a7a.latin: 33:18 Clamavérunt iusti, et Dóminus exaudívit eos: * et ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus eórum liberávit eos.
6149f9f8578e92e58a7a.english: 33:18 The just cried, and the Lord heard them: * and delivered them out of all their troubles.

e34e5adc9de8ab63bc04.latin: 33:19 Iuxta est Dóminus iis, qui tribuláto sunt corde: * et húmiles spíritu salvábit.
e34e5adc9de8ab63bc04.english: 33:19 The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a contrite heart: * and he will save the humble of spirit.

fa9ad92dc1aea2fc2ef4.latin: 33:20 Multæ tribulatiónes iustórum: * et de ómnibus his liberábit eos Dóminus.
fa9ad92dc1aea2fc2ef4.english: 33:20 Many are the afflictions of the just; * but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.

1c53c9b81b844cb86fa3.latin: 33:21 Custódit Dóminus ómnia ossa eórum: * unum ex his non conterétur.
1c53c9b81b844cb86fa3.english: 33:21 The Lord keepeth all their bones, * not one of them shall be broken.

7ed7e899509e5ad6b187.latin: 33:22 Mors peccatórum péssima: * et qui odérunt iustum, delínquent.
7ed7e899509e5ad6b187.english: 33:22 The death of the wicked is very evil: * and they that hate the just shall be guilty.

22713542dc8ca29fb75e.latin: 33:23 Rédimet Dóminus ánimas servórum suórum: * et non delínquent omnes qui sperant in eo.
22713542dc8ca29fb75e.english: 33:23 The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: * and none of them that trust in him shall offend.

2cb5436c2ddfc61a73d1.english: Ant. Praise is comely for the upright.

95d08e447e1177698b33.english: Ant. Fight against them * that fight against me.

4505a100004828b34acd.latin: 34:1 Iúdica, Dómine, nocéntes me, * expúgna impugnántes me.
4505a100004828b34acd.english: 34:1 Judge thou, O Lord, them that wrong me: * overthrow them that fight against me.

9c855c7a86516f95185f.latin: 34:2 Apprehénde arma et scutum: * et exsúrge in adiutórium mihi.
9c855c7a86516f95185f.english: 34:2 Take hold of arms and shield: * and rise up to help me.

31b30f7098ae9e3ff4a7.latin: 34:3 Effúnde frámeam, et conclúde advérsus eos, qui persequúntur me: * dic ánimæ meæ: Salus tua ego sum.
31b30f7098ae9e3ff4a7.english: 34:3 Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: * say to my soul: I am thy salvation.

33b05464e29f09bd89f7.latin: 34:4 Confundántur et revereántur, * quæréntes ánimam meam.
33b05464e29f09bd89f7.english: 34:4 Let them be confounded and ashamed * that seek after my soul.

73cfff189602e95f4f0d.latin: 34:4 Avertántur retrórsum, et confundántur * cogitántes mihi mala.
73cfff189602e95f4f0d.english: 34:4 Let them be turned back and be confounded * that devise against me.

c37effd6e4bfd4e31708.latin: 34:5 Fiant tamquam pulvis ante fáciem venti: * et Ángelus Dómini coárctans eos.
c37effd6e4bfd4e31708.english: 34:5 Let them become as dust before the wind: * and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.

f0723cdaebc607738e87.latin: 34:6 Fiat via illórum ténebræ et lúbricum: * et Ángelus Dómini pérsequens eos.
f0723cdaebc607738e87.english: 34:6 Let their way become dark and slippery; * and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

1e9cb1289a112042f18e.latin: 34:7 Quóniam gratis abscondérunt mihi intéritum láquei sui: * supervácue exprobravérunt ánimam meam.
1e9cb1289a112042f18e.english: 34:7 For without cause they have hidden their net for me unto destruction: * without cause they have upbraided my soul.

7dad69f20012c0f348a8.latin: 34:8 Véniat illi láqueus, quem ignórat: et cáptio, quam abscóndit, apprehéndat eum: * et in láqueum cadat in ipsum.
7dad69f20012c0f348a8.english: 34:8 Let the snare which he knoweth not come upon him: and let the net which he hath hidden catch him: * and into that very snare let them fall.

21e5cd3e4f6a2f8a9b02.latin: 34:9 Ánima autem mea exsultábit in Dómino: * et delectábitur super salutári suo.
21e5cd3e4f6a2f8a9b02.english: 34:9 But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; * and shall be delighted in his salvation.

6604922e1fc839cdbe78.latin: 34:10 Ómnia ossa mea dicent: * Dómine, quis símilis tibi?
6604922e1fc839cdbe78.english: 34:10 All my bones shall say: * Lord, who is like to thee?

1fb8fb35286a0aeeb44c.latin: 34:10 Erípiens ínopem de manu fortiórum eius: * egénum et páuperem a diripiéntibus eum.
1fb8fb35286a0aeeb44c.english: 34:10 Who deliverest the poor from the hand of them that are stronger than he; * the needy and the poor from them that strip him.

fadec1920cc6d696f389.latin: 34:11 Surgéntes testes iníqui, * quæ ignorábam interrogábant me.
fadec1920cc6d696f389.english: 34:11 Unjust witnesses rising up * have asked me things I knew not.

1aaf3e6ca252ec35499d.latin: 34:12 Retribuébant mihi mala pro bonis: * sterilitátem ánimæ meæ.
1aaf3e6ca252ec35499d.english: 34:12 They repaid me evil for good: * to the depriving me of my soul.

f6af8069fba20b0cf3f6.latin: 34:13 Ego autem cum mihi molésti essent, * induébar cilício.
f6af8069fba20b0cf3f6.english: 34:13 But as for me, when they were troublesome to me, * I was clothed with haircloth.

0765543130fae7c75023.latin: 34:13 Humiliábam in ieiúnio ánimam meam: * et orátio mea in sinu meo convertétur.
0765543130fae7c75023.english: 34:13 I humbled my soul with fasting; * and my prayer shall be turned into my bosom.

299539662d785ba99d8b.latin: 34:14 Quasi próximum, et quasi fratrem nostrum, sic complacébam: * quasi lugens et contristátus, sic humiliábar.
299539662d785ba99d8b.english: 34:14 As a neighbour and as an own brother, so did I please: * as one mourning and sorrowful so was I humbled.

f2d1cd1d2270d003609d.latin: 34:15 Et advérsum me lætáti sunt, et convenérunt: * congregáta sunt super me flagélla, et ignorávi.
f2d1cd1d2270d003609d.english: 34:15 But they rejoiced against me, and came together: * scourges were gathered together upon me, and I knew not.

52c681d39f1fccc14d1f.latin: 34:16 Dissipáti sunt, nec compúncti, tentavérunt me, subsannavérunt me subsannatióne: * frenduérunt super me déntibus suis.
52c681d39f1fccc14d1f.english: 34:16 They were separated, and repented not: they tempted me, they scoffed at me with scorn: * they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

effba6c49d35e6a5aa66.latin: 34:17 Dómine, quando respícies? * restítue ánimam meam a malignitáte eórum, a leónibus únicam meam.
effba6c49d35e6a5aa66.english: 34:17 Lord, when wilt thou look upon me? * rescue thou my soul from their malice: my only one from the lions.

423505e142c4d1d6dabd.latin: 34:18 Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, * in pópulo gravi laudábo te.
423505e142c4d1d6dabd.english: 34:18 I will give thanks to thee in a great church; * I will praise thee in a strong people.

4965e13965f881c8e629.latin: 34:19 Non supergáudeant mihi qui adversántur mihi iníque: * qui odérunt me gratis et ánnuunt óculis.
4965e13965f881c8e629.english: 34:19 Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: * who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.

bc94b536d28f613aa57f.latin: 34:20 Quóniam mihi quidem pacífice loquebántur: * et in iracúndia terræ loquéntes, dolos cogitábant.
bc94b536d28f613aa57f.english: 34:20 For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; * and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.

82e56f2e8348f335a880.latin: 34:21 Et dilatavérunt super me os suum: * dixérunt: Euge, euge, vidérunt óculi nostri.
82e56f2e8348f335a880.english: 34:21 And they opened their mouth wide against me; * they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.

2ca3a8ac05a51d011948.latin: 34:22 Vidísti, Dómine, ne síleas: * Dómine, ne discédas a me.
2ca3a8ac05a51d011948.english: 34:22 Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not thou silent: * O Lord, depart not from me.

400c1a624a8842904791.latin: 34:23 Exsúrge et inténde iudício meo: * Deus meus, et Dóminus meus in causam meam.
400c1a624a8842904791.english: 34:23 Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: * to my cause, my God, and my Lord.

589ec4c76e99d9fa7540.latin: 34:24 Iúdica me secúndum iustítiam tuam, Dómine, Deus meus, * et non supergáudeant mihi.
589ec4c76e99d9fa7540.english: 34:24 Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, * and let them not rejoice over me.

d6ee765a3c2f53ab0b37.latin: 34:25 Non dicant in córdibus suis: Euge, euge, ánimæ nostræ: * nec dicant: Devorávimus eum.
d6ee765a3c2f53ab0b37.english: 34:25 Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: * neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.

5735ea93bdfb4e613b12.latin: 34:26 Erubéscant et revereántur simul, * qui gratulántur malis meis.
5735ea93bdfb4e613b12.english: 34:26 Let them blush: and be ashamed together, * who rejoice at my evils.

6a35cc4577fbaa98096b.latin: 34:26 Induántur confusióne et reveréntia * qui magna loquúntur super me.
6a35cc4577fbaa98096b.english: 34:26 Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, * who speak great things against me.

f4c66ced13d39f283bd5.latin: 34:27 Exsúltent et læténtur qui volunt iustítiam meam: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus qui volunt pacem servi eius.
f4c66ced13d39f283bd5.english: 34:27 Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, * and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.

3158cfecd71b9db3fc9a.latin: 34:28 Et lingua mea meditábitur iustítiam tuam, * tota die laudem tuam.
3158cfecd71b9db3fc9a.english: 34:28 And my tongue shall meditate thy justice, * thy praise all the day long.

ead3f120a8453c3d952f.english: Ant. Fight against them that fight against me.

433de6684ed06eeb9337.english: Ant. Commit my way * to the Lord.

0b2fbd54b7fd0e2c38c9.latin: 36:1 Noli æmulári in malignántibus: * neque zeláveris faciéntes iniquitátem.
0b2fbd54b7fd0e2c38c9.english: 36:1 Be not emulous of evildoers; * nor envy them that work iniquity.

c6ad1634830f2735e8c8.latin: 36:2 Quóniam tamquam fænum velóciter aréscent: * et quemádmodum ólera herbárum cito décident.
c6ad1634830f2735e8c8.english: 36:2 For they shall shortly wither away as grass, * and as the green herbs shall quickly fall.

d95f8b724637f3e67876.latin: 36:3 Spera in Dómino, et fac bonitátem: * et inhábita terram, et pascéris in divítiis eius.
d95f8b724637f3e67876.english: 36:3 Trust in the Lord, and do good, * and dwell in the land, and thou shalt be fed with its riches.

741c3926fbd697b63594.latin: 36:4 Delectáre in Dómino: * et dabit tibi petitiónes cordis tui.
741c3926fbd697b63594.english: 36:4 Delight in the Lord, * and he will give thee the requests of thy heart.

309aa9a828b2b30f5abe.latin: 36:5 Revéla Dómino viam tuam, et spera in eo: * et ipse fáciet.
309aa9a828b2b30f5abe.english: 36:5 Commit thy way to the Lord, and trust in him, * and he will do it.

0658f61ed8722a0360c5.latin: 36:6 Et edúcet quasi lumen iustítiam tuam: et iudícium tuum tamquam merídiem: * súbditus esto Dómino, et ora eum.
0658f61ed8722a0360c5.english: 36:6 And he will bring forth thy justice as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday: * be subject to the Lord and pray to him.

8f0422ba2c978271da27.latin: 36:7 Noli æmulári in eo, qui prosperátur in via sua: * in hómine faciénte iniustítias.
8f0422ba2c978271da27.english: 36:7 Envy not the man who prospereth in his way; * the man who doth unjust things.

dce24d92cdefafd8ef26.latin: 36:8 Désine ab ira, et derelínque furórem: * noli æmulári ut malignéris.
dce24d92cdefafd8ef26.english: 36:8 Cease from anger, and leave rage; * have no emulation to do evil.

3efc9401d343dddb324d.latin: 36:9 Quóniam qui malignántur, exterminabúntur: * sustinéntes autem Dóminum, ipsi hereditábunt terram.
3efc9401d343dddb324d.english: 36:9 For the evildoers shall be cut off: * but they that wait upon the Lord shall inherit the land.

8a7ea740a85fd8d0a021.latin: 36:10 Et adhuc pusíllum, et non erit peccátor: * et quæres locum eius et non invénies.
8a7ea740a85fd8d0a021.english: 36:10 For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: * and thou shalt seek his place, and shalt not find it.

8db8f7c1f174991b36f7.latin: 36:11 Mansuéti autem hereditábunt terram: * et delectabúntur in multitúdine pacis.
8db8f7c1f174991b36f7.english: 36:11 But the meek shall inherit the land, * and shall delight in abundance of peace.

b40b053594815e613c9d.latin: 36:12 Observábit peccátor iustum: * et stridébit super eum déntibus suis.
b40b053594815e613c9d.english: 36:12 The sinner shall watch the just man: * and shall gnash upon him with his teeth.

2364b692e2fd0eb370d6.latin: 36:13 Dóminus autem irridébit eum: * quóniam próspicit quod véniet dies eius.
2364b692e2fd0eb370d6.english: 36:13 But the Lord shall laugh at him: * for he foreseeth that his day shall come.

fd9995fd149a374b75eb.latin: 36:14 Gládium evaginavérunt peccatóres: * intendérunt arcum suum,
fd9995fd149a374b75eb.english: 36:14 The wicked have drawn out the sword: * they have bent their bow.

078a52ef01d7eac11324.latin: 36:14 Ut deíciant páuperem et ínopem: * ut trucídent rectos corde.
078a52ef01d7eac11324.english: 36:14 To cast down the poor and needy, * to kill the upright of heart.

8b5bca2958b21d023685.latin: 36:15 Gládius eórum intret in corda ipsórum: * et arcus eórum confringátur.
8b5bca2958b21d023685.english: 36:15 Let their sword enter into their own hearts, * and let their bow be broken.

db7195129011fbde9a92.latin: 36:16 Mélius est módicum iusto, * super divítias peccatórum multas.
db7195129011fbde9a92.english: 36:16 Better is a little to the just, * than the great riches of the wicked.

47287e58cb701953491a.latin: 36:17 Quóniam brácchia peccatórum conteréntur: * confírmat autem iustos Dóminus.
47287e58cb701953491a.english: 36:17 For the arms of the wicked shall be broken in pieces; * but the Lord strengtheneth the just.

565877353245c7ba91e2.latin: 36:18 Novit Dóminus dies immaculatórum: * et heréditas eórum in ætérnum erit.
565877353245c7ba91e2.english: 36:18 The Lord knoweth the days of the undefiled; * and their inheritance shall be for ever.

9b69a0f298a29f9dd18b.latin: 36:19 Non confundéntur in témpore malo, et in diébus famis saturabúntur: * quia peccatóres períbunt.
9b69a0f298a29f9dd18b.english: 36:19 They shall not be confounded in the evil time; and in the days of famine they shall be filled, * because the wicked shall perish.

fa0423f998b39281c379.latin: 36:20 Inimíci vero Dómini mox ut honorificáti fúerint et exaltáti: * deficiéntes, quemádmodum fumus defícient.
fa0423f998b39281c379.english: 36:20 And the enemies of the Lord, presently after they shall be honoured and exalted, * shall come to nothing and vanish like smoke.

da62b89e49f57c37b08e.latin: 36:21 Mutuábitur peccátor, et non solvet: * iustus autem miserétur et tríbuet.
da62b89e49f57c37b08e.english: 36:21 The sinner shall borrow, and not pay again; * but the just sheweth mercy and shall give.

2d3b343e7dcf3e2dab35.latin: 36:22 Quia benedicéntes ei hereditábunt terram: * maledicéntes autem ei disperíbunt.
2d3b343e7dcf3e2dab35.english: 36:22 For such as bless him shall inherit the land: * but such as curse him shall perish.

d93d5b57294da9ead922.latin: 36:23 Apud Dóminum gressus hóminis dirigéntur: * et viam eius volet.
d93d5b57294da9ead922.english: 36:23 With the Lord shall the steps of a man be directed, * and he shall like well his way.

eef19a14defd69fc26fe.latin: 36:24 Cum cecíderit non collidétur: * quia Dóminus suppónit manum suam.
eef19a14defd69fc26fe.english: 36:24 When he shall fall he shall not be bruised, * for the Lord putteth his hand under him.

745625abd4bf98f0b3dd.latin: 36:25 Iúnior fui, étenim sénui: * et non vidi iustum derelíctum, nec semen eius quærens panem.
745625abd4bf98f0b3dd.english: 36:25 I have been young, and now am old; * and I have not seen the just forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread.

d8f53d303c26dd76683a.latin: 36:26 Tota die miserétur et cómmodat: * et semen illíus in benedictióne erit.
d8f53d303c26dd76683a.english: 36:26 He sheweth mercy, and lendeth all the day long; * and his seed shall be in blessing.

362c555791e5cb95348e.latin: 36:27 Declína a malo, et fac bonum: * et inhábita in sǽculum sǽculi.
362c555791e5cb95348e.english: 36:27 Decline from evil and do good, * and dwell for ever and ever.

17604765c6720cbcbd1e.latin: 36:28 Quia Dóminus amat iudícium, et non derelínquet sanctos suos: * in ætérnum conservabúntur.
17604765c6720cbcbd1e.english: 36:28 For the Lord loveth judgment, and will not forsake his saints: * they shall be preserved for ever.

223e200c4876153e5954.latin: 36:28 Iniústi puniéntur: * et semen impiórum períbit.
223e200c4876153e5954.english: 36:28 The unjust shall be punished, * and the seed of the wicked shall perish.

707d0d0095dbc6a6bdcb.latin: 36:29 Iusti autem hereditábunt terram: * et inhabitábunt in sǽculum sǽculi super eam.
707d0d0095dbc6a6bdcb.english: 36:29 But the just shall inherit the land, * and shall dwell therein for evermore.

7eefe8c5c73132ace958.latin: 36:30 Os iusti meditábitur sapiéntiam, * et lingua eius loquétur iudícium.
7eefe8c5c73132ace958.english: 36:30 The mouth of the just shall meditate wisdom: * and his tongue shall speak judgment.

8b0d90af94bc37b483a5.latin: 36:31 Lex Dei eius in corde ipsíus, * et non supplantabúntur gressus eius.
8b0d90af94bc37b483a5.english: 36:31 The law of his God is in his heart, * and his steps shall not be supplanted.

c4fe32a2e139d77da2e6.latin: 36:32 Consíderat peccátor iustum: * et quærit mortificáre eum.
c4fe32a2e139d77da2e6.english: 36:32 The wicked watcheth the just man, * and seeketh to put him to death.

ceccd1c560ec350f2595.latin: 36:33 Dóminus autem non derelínquet eum in mánibus eius: * nec damnábit eum, cum iudicábitur illi.
ceccd1c560ec350f2595.english: 36:33 But the Lord will not leave him in his hands; * nor condemn him when he shall be judged.

a4d1407de1e477d40c2a.latin: 36:34 Exspécta Dóminum, et custódi viam eius: et exaltábit te ut hereditáte cápias terram: * cum períerint peccatóres vidébis.
a4d1407de1e477d40c2a.english: 36:34 Expect the Lord and keep his way: and he will exalt thee to inherit the land: * when the sinners shall perish thou shalt see.

b96d77bfc728d1f4c83d.latin: 36:35 Vidi ímpium superexaltátum, * et elevátum sicut cedros Líbani.
b96d77bfc728d1f4c83d.english: 36:35 I have seen the wicked highly exalted, * and lifted up like the cedars of Libanus.

4d8ab09c45353e5f122b.latin: 36:36 Et transívi, et ecce non erat: * et quæsívi eum, et non est invéntus locus eius.
4d8ab09c45353e5f122b.english: 36:36 And I passed by, and lo, he was not: * and I sought him and his place was not found.

01cb192760358978798f.latin: 36:37 Custódi innocéntiam, et vide æquitátem: * quóniam sunt relíquiæ hómini pacífico.
01cb192760358978798f.english: 36:37 Keep innocence, and behold justice: * for there are remnants for the peaceable man.

80466abca673928ba056.latin: 36:38 Iniústi autem disperíbunt simul: * relíquiæ impiórum interíbunt.
80466abca673928ba056.english: 36:38 But the unjust shall be destroyed together: * the remnants of the wicked shall perish.

f080b8bf5f60a6dd4fce.latin: 36:39 Salus autem iustórum a Dómino: * et protéctor eórum in témpore tribulatiónis.
f080b8bf5f60a6dd4fce.english: 36:39 But the salvation of the just is from the Lord, * and he is their protector in the time of trouble.

d04464a24f167a618ae9.latin: 36:40 Et adiuvábit eos Dóminus et liberábit eos: * et éruet eos a peccatóribus, et salvábit eos: quia speravérunt in eo.
d04464a24f167a618ae9.english: 36:40 And the Lord will help them and deliver them: * and he will rescue them from the wicked, and save them, because they have hoped in him.

38676c0bf2eb8ce40db6.english: Ant. Commit my way to the Lord.

287911a58a7afaf6a375.latin: Ant. Ne in ira tua * árguas me Dómine.
287911a58a7afaf6a375.english: Ant. Do not chastise me * in thy wrath.

cadf817ee2eeeb9912b0.latin: 37:2 Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
cadf817ee2eeeb9912b0.english: 37:2 Rebuke me not, O Lord, in thy indignation; * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

15603165e62c88a78ac1.latin: 37:3 Quóniam sagíttæ tuæ infíxæ sunt mihi: * et confirmásti super me manum tuam.
15603165e62c88a78ac1.english: 37:3 For thy arrows are fastened in me: * and thy hand hath been strong upon me.

8b4d197361c45d1ad5a3.latin: 37:4 Non est sánitas in carne mea a fácie iræ tuæ: * non est pax óssibus meis a fácie peccatórum meórum.
8b4d197361c45d1ad5a3.english: 37:4 There is no health in my flesh, because of thy wrath: * there is no peace for my bones, because of my sins.

bd433cdbc76e165235e0.latin: 37:5 Quóniam iniquitátes meæ supergréssæ sunt caput meum: * et sicut onus grave gravátæ sunt super me.
bd433cdbc76e165235e0.english: 37:5 For my iniquities are gone over my head: * and as a heavy burden are become heavy upon me.

87c477d1d5c39792d360.latin: 37:6 Putruérunt et corrúptæ sunt cicatríces meæ, * a fácie insipiéntiæ meæ.
87c477d1d5c39792d360.english: 37:6 My sores are putrified and corrupted, * because of my foolishness.

c83b3b7841fd0fd7938a.latin: 37:7 Miser factus sum, et curvátus sum usque in finem: * tota die contristátus ingrediébar.
c83b3b7841fd0fd7938a.english: 37:7 I am become miserable, and am bowed down even to the end: * I walked sorrowful all the day long.

475295997a6c0f1a4921.latin: 37:8 Quóniam lumbi mei impléti sunt illusiónibus: * et non est sánitas in carne mea.
475295997a6c0f1a4921.english: 37:8 For my loins are filled with illusions; * and there is no health in my flesh.

bd7d2c5ff968f2f6495e.latin: 37:9 Afflíctus sum, et humiliátus sum nimis: * rugiébam a gémitu cordis mei.
bd7d2c5ff968f2f6495e.english: 37:9 I am afflicted and humbled exceedingly: * I roared with the groaning of my heart.

37271d743b33e0b4c822.latin: 37:10 Dómine, ante te omne desidérium meum: * et gémitus meus a te non est abscónditus.
37271d743b33e0b4c822.english: 37:10 Lord, all my desire is before thee, * and my groaning is not hidden from thee.

037c4e8af217932f899b.latin: 37:11 Cor meum conturbátum est, derelíquit me virtus mea: * et lumen oculórum meórum, et ipsum non est mecum.
037c4e8af217932f899b.english: 37:11 My heart is troubled, my strength hath left me, * and the light of my eyes itself is not with me.

0f05349680d322c230ea.latin: 37:12 Amíci mei, et próximi mei * advérsum me appropinquavérunt, et stetérunt.
0f05349680d322c230ea.english: 37:12 My friends and my neighbours * have drawn near, and stood against me.

74c790f15cdd8bd33519.latin: 37:12 Et qui iuxta me erant, de longe stetérunt: * et vim faciébant qui quærébant ánimam meam.
74c790f15cdd8bd33519.english: 37:12 And they that were near me stood afar off: * and they that sought my soul used violence.

8ee352cac98b6cb4ab2a.latin: 37:13 Et qui inquirébant mala mihi, locúti sunt vanitátes: * et dolos tota die meditabántur.
8ee352cac98b6cb4ab2a.english: 37:13 And they that sought evils to me spoke vain things, * and studied deceits all the day long.

de675d54bdcbdedd5127.latin: 37:14 Ego autem tamquam surdus non audiébam: * et sicut mutus non apériens os suum.
de675d54bdcbdedd5127.english: 37:14 But I, as a deaf man, heard not: * and as a dumb man not opening his mouth.

66595187fd942d3879ee.latin: 37:15 Et factus sum sicut homo non áudiens: * et non habens in ore suo redargutiónes.
66595187fd942d3879ee.english: 37:15 And I became as a man that heareth not: * and that hath no reproofs in his mouth.

5f1ae661e2732e114ac6.latin: 37:16 Quóniam in te, Dómine, sperávi: * tu exáudies me, Dómine, Deus meus.
5f1ae661e2732e114ac6.english: 37:16 For in thee, O Lord, have I hoped: * thou wilt hear me, O Lord my God.

36371cfb6159515345fb.latin: 37:17 Quia dixi: Nequándo supergáudeant mihi inimíci mei: * et dum commovéntur pedes mei, super me magna locúti sunt.
36371cfb6159515345fb.english: 37:17 For I said: Lest at any time my enemies rejoice over me: * and whilst my feet are moved, they speak great things against me.

5ebcaf1dbdc578aded88.latin: 37:18 Quóniam ego in flagélla parátus sum: * et dolor meus in conspéctu meo semper.
5ebcaf1dbdc578aded88.english: 37:18 For I am ready for scourges: * and my sorrow is continually before me.

5acd6f9ffaa05f48d508.latin: 37:19 Quóniam iniquitátem meam annuntiábo: * et cogitábo pro peccáto meo.
5acd6f9ffaa05f48d508.english: 37:19 For I will declare my iniquity: * and I will think for my sin.

2e0069bab82ea6c9d6bf.latin: 37:20 Inimíci autem mei vivunt, et confirmáti sunt super me: * et multiplicáti sunt qui odérunt me iníque.
2e0069bab82ea6c9d6bf.english: 37:20 But my enemies live, and are stronger than I: * and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

7b1a4c1571d33db9007c.latin: 37:21 Qui retríbuunt mala pro bonis, detrahébant mihi: * quóniam sequébar bonitátem.
7b1a4c1571d33db9007c.english: 37:21 They that render evil for good, have detracted me, * because I followed goodness.

70e06d8f022bf219d193.latin: 37:22 Ne derelínquas me, Dómine, Deus meus: * ne discésseris a me.
70e06d8f022bf219d193.english: 37:22 Forsake me not, O Lord my God: * do not thou depart from me.

1f362af173c342ea0d83.latin: 37:23 Inténde in adiutórium meum, * Dómine, Deus, salútis meæ.
1f362af173c342ea0d83.english: 37:23 Attend unto my help, * O Lord, the God of my salvation.

d4055de0d2d5c9237df9.latin: Ant. Ne in ira tua árguas me Dómine.
d4055de0d2d5c9237df9.english: Ant. Do not chastise me in thy wrath.

5dcc84a5cebc8132ab03.english: ℣. O Lord, thy mercy is in heaven,

7378159f894ac5befb09.latin: ℟. Et véritas tua usque ad nubes.
7378159f894ac5befb09.english: ℟. And thy truth reacheth even to the clouds.

42dc38a356e64de29777.latin:
℣. Iube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. In unitáte Sancti Spíritus, benedícat nos Pater et Fílius.
℟. Amen.
Lectio unica
De libro secúndo Dialogórum sancti Gregórii Papæ
Lib. 2, Cap. 7.
Quadam vero die dum idem venerábilis Benedíctus in cella consísteret, Plácidus puer, sancti viri mónachus, ad hauriéndam de lacu aquam egréssus est: qui vas, quod tenébat, in aquam incáute submíttens, ipse quoque cadéndo secútus est. Quem mox unda rápuit, et pæne ad uníus sagíttæ cursum, eum a terra intrórsus traxit. Vir autem Dei intra cellam pósitus, hoc prótinus agnóvit, et Maurum festíne vocávit, dicens: Frater Maure, curre, quia puer ille, qui ad hauriéndam aquam perréxerat, in lacum cécidit: iamque eum lóngius unda trahit. Res mira, et post Petrum Apóstolum inusitáta! Benedictióne étenim postuláta atque percépta, ad Patris sui impérium cóncitus perréxit Maurus, atque usque ad eum locum quo ab unda deducebátur puer, per terram se ire exístimans, super aquam cucúrrit, eúmque per capíllos tenens, cursu rápido rédiit. Qui mox ut terram tétigit, ad se revérsus, post tergum respéxit, et quia super aquas cucurrísset agnóvit: et quod præsúmere non potuísset ut fíeret, mirátus extrémuit factum. Revérsus ítaque ad Patrem, rem gestam rétulit. Vir autem venerábilis Benedíctus hoc non suis méritis, sed illíus obediéntiæ deputáre coepit; at contra Maurus pro solo eius império factum dicébat: seque cónscium in illa virtúte non esse, quam néscius feciíset. Sed in hac mútuæ humilitátis et amíca contentióne accéssit árbiter puer, qui eréptus est, namque dicébat: Ego cum ex aqua tráherer, super caput meum Abbátis melótem vidébam, atque ipsum me ex aquis edúcere considerábam.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟. Prolápsu in lacum Plácido, Maurus ádvolans, † spíritu Dei ferebátur super aquas,
* Dum Patri suo in audítu auris obedíret.
℣. Aquæ multæ non potuérunt extínguere caritátem eius, † neque flúmina eam obrúere.
℟. Dum Patri suo in audítu auris obedíret.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Dum Patri suo in audítu auris obedíret.
42dc38a356e64de29777.english:
℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benediction. In the unity of the Holy Ghost, may the Father and the Son bless us.
℟. Amen.
Lectio unica
De libro secúndo Dialogórum sancti Gregórii Papæ
Lib. 2, Cap. 7.

Vir autem venerábilis Benedíctus hoc non suis méritis, sed illíus obediéntiæ deputáre coepit; at contra Maurus pro solo ejus império factum dicébat: seque cónscium in illa virtúte non esse, quam néscius feciíset. Sed in hac mútuæ humilitátis et amíca contentióne accéssit árbiter puer, qui eréptus est, namque dicébat: Ego cum ex aqua tráherer, super caput meum Abbátis melótem vidébam, atque ipsum me ex aquis edúcere considerábam.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟. Prolápsu in lacum Plácido, Maurus ádvolans, † spíritu Dei ferebátur super aquas,
