5a0346cce299deb92375.latin: 38:2 Dixi: Custódiam vias meas: * ut non delínquam in lingua mea.
5a0346cce299deb92375.english: 38:2 I said: I will take heed to my ways: * that I sin not with my tongue.

d4b94a045c6bce1367c3.latin: 38:2 Pósui ori meo custódiam, * cum consísteret peccátor advérsum me.
d4b94a045c6bce1367c3.english: 38:2 I have set guard to my mouth, * when the sinner stood against me.

89cb2b3eff81d0df2f33.latin: 38:3 Obmútui, et humiliátus sum, et sílui a bonis: * et dolor meus renovátus est.
89cb2b3eff81d0df2f33.english: 38:3 I was dumb, and was humbled, and kept silence from good things: * and my sorrow was renewed.

12a85f77bbfd3699f1a8.latin: 38:4 Concáluit cor meum intra me: * et in meditatióne mea exardéscet ignis.
12a85f77bbfd3699f1a8.english: 38:4 My heart grew hot within me: * and in my meditation a fire shall flame out.

02326e8efb6476e33f71.latin: 38:5 Locútus sum in lingua mea: * Notum fac mihi, Dómine, finem meum.
02326e8efb6476e33f71.english: 38:5 I spoke with my tongue: * O Lord, make me know my end.

e1758db990672d6b7338.latin: 38:5 Et númerum diérum meórum quis est: * ut sciam quid desit mihi.
e1758db990672d6b7338.english: 38:5 And what is the number of my days: * that I may know what is wanting to me.

54f300ad6607db2260b2.latin: 38:6 Ecce mensurábiles posuísti dies meos: * et substántia mea tamquam níhilum ante te.
54f300ad6607db2260b2.english: 38:6 Behold thou hast made my days measurable: * and my substance is as nothing before thee.

cdad82c45ce35206deb9.latin: 38:6 Verúmtamen univérsa vánitas, * omnis homo vivens.
cdad82c45ce35206deb9.english: 38:6 And indeed all things are vanity: * every man living.

788cf8c5d45782e095e3.latin: 38:7 Verúmtamen in imágine pertránsit homo: * sed et frustra conturbátur.
788cf8c5d45782e095e3.english: 38:7 Surely man passeth as an image: * yea, and he is disquieted in vain.

c4e8dae69038397511be.latin: 38:7 Thesaurízat: * et ignórat cui congregábit ea.
c4e8dae69038397511be.english: 38:7 He storeth up: * and he knoweth not for whom he shall gather these things.

834db4ef3d7e6cade935.latin: 38:8 Et nunc quæ est exspectátio mea? Nonne Dóminus? * Et substántia mea apud te est.
834db4ef3d7e6cade935.english: 38:8 And now what is my hope? Is it not the Lord? * And my substance is with thee.

6090f19db35ca9509def.latin: 38:9 Ab ómnibus iniquitátibus meis érue me: * oppróbrium insipiénti dedísti me.
6090f19db35ca9509def.english: 38:9 Deliver thou me from all my iniquities: * thou hast made me a reproach to the fool.

3665ceeff0383c24d8a7.latin: 38:10 Obmútui, et non apérui os meum, quóniam tu fecísti: * ámove a me plagas tuas.
3665ceeff0383c24d8a7.english: 38:10 I was dumb, and I opened not my mouth, because thou hast done it: * remove thy scourges from me.

04297427ee42fe82a5b5.latin: 38:12 A fortitúdine manus tuæ ego deféci in increpatiónibus: * propter iniquitátem corripuísti hóminem.
04297427ee42fe82a5b5.english: 38:12 The strength of thy hand hath made me faint in rebukes: * thou hast corrected man for iniquity.

2a1442345bdbf8580c3b.latin: 38:12 Et tabéscere fecísti sicut aráneam ánimam eius: * verúmtamen vane conturbátur omnis homo.
2a1442345bdbf8580c3b.english: 38:12 And thou hast made his soul to waste away like a spider: * surely in vain is any man disquieted.

9dcd5ee1f3148bfafea9.latin: 38:13 Exáudi oratiónem meam, Dómine, et deprecatiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe lácrimas meas.
9dcd5ee1f3148bfafea9.english: 38:13 Hear my prayer, O Lord, and my supplication: * give ear to my tears.

da65e86c11265494a53d.latin: 38:13 Ne síleas: quóniam ádvena ego sum apud te, et peregrínus, * sicut omnes patres mei.
da65e86c11265494a53d.english: 38:13 Be not silent: for I am a stranger with thee, * and a sojourner as all my fathers were.

cbdb2c3f95d58e323ebf.latin: 38:14 Remítte mihi, ut refrígerer priúsquam ábeam, * et ámplius non ero.
cbdb2c3f95d58e323ebf.english: 38:14 O forgive me, that I may be refreshed, before I go hence, * and be no more.

11afe965542a64c04265.latin: 39:2 Exspéctans exspectávi Dóminum, * et inténdit mihi.
11afe965542a64c04265.english: 39:2 With expectation I have waited for the Lord, * and he was attentive to me.

09d121f12ae01fc59a1f.latin: 39:3 Et exaudívit preces meas: * et edúxit me de lacu misériæ, et de luto fæcis.
09d121f12ae01fc59a1f.english: 39:3 And he heard my prayers, * and brought me out of the pit of misery and the mire of dregs.

a4fabc57ed87c4728bcf.latin: 39:3 Et státuit super petram pedes meos: * et diréxit gressus meos.
a4fabc57ed87c4728bcf.english: 39:3 And he set my feet upon a rock, * and directed my steps.

a031c2f1a63ae5b3c154.latin: 39:4 Et immísit in os meum cánticum novum, * carmen Deo nostro.
a031c2f1a63ae5b3c154.english: 39:4 And he put a new canticle into my mouth, * a song to our God.

99a2a2617f87cd72d92b.latin: 39:4 Vidébunt multi, et timébunt: * et sperábunt in Dómino.
99a2a2617f87cd72d92b.english: 39:4 Many shall see, and shall fear: * and they shall hope in the Lord.

aa0cd2e79a91fba3c282.latin: 39:5 Beátus vir, cuius est nomen Dómini spes eius: * et non respéxit in vanitátes et insánias falsas.
aa0cd2e79a91fba3c282.english: 39:5 Blessed is the man whose trust is in the name of the Lord; * and who hath not had regard to vanities, and lying follies.

6c28b30fff96260cbf7e.latin: 39:6 Multa fecísti tu, Dómine, Deus meus, mirabília tua: * et cogitatiónibus tuis non est qui símilis sit tibi.
6c28b30fff96260cbf7e.english: 39:6 Thou hast multiplied thy wonderful works, O Lord my God: * and in thy thoughts there is no one like to thee.

4608cd686f14618763ed.latin: 39:6 Annuntiávi et locútus sum: * multiplicáti sunt super númerum.
4608cd686f14618763ed.english: 39:6 I have declared and I have spoken * they are multiplied above number.

96a5e0a8c08f24e2b90c.latin: 39:7 Sacrifícium et oblatiónem noluísti: * aures autem perfecísti mihi.
96a5e0a8c08f24e2b90c.english: 39:7 Sacrifice and oblation thou didst not desire; * but thou hast pierced ears for me.

8b7be3a8163b28ee9934.latin: 39:7 Holocáustum et pro peccáto non postulásti: * tunc dixi: Ecce, vénio.
8b7be3a8163b28ee9934.english: 39:7 Burnt offering and sin offering thou didst not require: * then said I, Behold I come.

0f5e1e6d0974f06790ff.latin: 39:8 In cápite libri scriptum est de me ut fácerem voluntátem tuam: * Deus meus, vólui, et legem tuam in médio cordis mei.
0f5e1e6d0974f06790ff.english: 39:8 In the head of the book it is written of me that I should do thy will: * O my God, I have desired it, and thy law in the midst of my heart.

7dd207a4a4c3d5ffab79.latin: 39:10 Annuntiávi iustítiam tuam in ecclésia magna, * ecce, lábia mea non prohibébo: Dómine, tu scisti.
7dd207a4a4c3d5ffab79.english: 39:10 I have declared thy justice in a great church, * lo, I will not restrain my lips: O Lord, thou knowest it.

46476450379388f92096.latin: 39:11 Iustítiam tuam non abscóndi in corde meo: * veritátem tuam et salutáre tuum dixi.
46476450379388f92096.english: 39:11 I have not hid thy justice within my heart: * I have declared thy truth and thy salvation.

8be7732b861700a312cb.latin: 39:11 Non abscóndi misericórdiam tuam et veritátem tuam * a concílio multo.
8be7732b861700a312cb.english: 39:11 I have not concealed thy mercy and thy truth * from a great council.

8bb5cc44ef461d2980f9.latin: 39:12 Tu autem, Dómine, ne longe fácias miseratiónes tuas a me: * misericórdia tua et véritas tua semper suscepérunt me.
8bb5cc44ef461d2980f9.english: 39:12 Withhold not thou, O Lord, thy tender mercies from me: * thy mercy and thy truth have always upheld me.

364a1879f8c2f01df46f.latin: 39:13 Quóniam circumdedérunt me mala, quorum non est númerus: * comprehendérunt me iniquitátes meæ, et non pótui ut vidérem.
364a1879f8c2f01df46f.english: 39:13 For evils without number have surrounded me; * my iniquities have overtaken me, and I was not able to see.

334ef7c652df82b43249.latin: 39:13 Multiplicátæ sunt super capíllos cápitis mei: * et cor meum derelíquit me.
334ef7c652df82b43249.english: 39:13 They are multiplied above the hairs of my head: * and my heart hath forsaken me.

225f0ab146931d842f76.latin: 39:14 Compláceat tibi, Dómine, ut éruas me: * Dómine, ad adiuvándum me réspice.
225f0ab146931d842f76.english: 39:14 Be pleased, O Lord to deliver me: * look down, O Lord, to help me.

d37d52439ff45704af0e.latin: 39:15 Confundántur et revereántur simul, qui quærunt ánimam meam, * ut áuferant eam.
d37d52439ff45704af0e.english: 39:15 Let them be confounded and ashamed together, that seek after my soul * to take it away.

f9a92d1fbfd67263ca0d.latin: 39:15 Convertántur retrórsum, et revereántur, * qui volunt mihi mala.
f9a92d1fbfd67263ca0d.english: 39:15 Let them be turned backward and be ashamed * that desire evils to me.

c320a82ecd4c2c29d615.latin: 39:16 Ferant conféstim confusiónem suam, * qui dicunt mihi: Euge, euge.
c320a82ecd4c2c29d615.english: 39:16 Let them immediately bear their confusion, * that say to me: ’T is well, ’t is well.

424e5b7ba4816d3eca53.latin: 39:17 Exsúltent et læténtur super te omnes quæréntes te: * et dicant semper: Magnificétur Dóminus: qui díligunt salutáre tuum.
424e5b7ba4816d3eca53.english: 39:17 Let all that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: * and let such as love thy salvation say always: The Lord be magnified.

dd58ab4bc0d04c915e5a.latin: 39:18 Ego autem mendícus sum, et pauper: * Dóminus sollícitus est mei.
dd58ab4bc0d04c915e5a.english: 39:18 But I am a beggar and poor: * the Lord is careful for me.

15efd076153367c2d3b5.latin: 39:18 Adiútor meus, et protéctor meus tu es: * Deus meus, ne tardáveris.
15efd076153367c2d3b5.english: 39:18 Thou art my helper and my protector: * O my God, be not slack.

a63b20e9d4516039b733.latin: 40:2 Beátus qui intéllegit super egénum, et páuperem: * in die mala liberábit eum Dóminus.
a63b20e9d4516039b733.english: 40:2 Blessed is he that understandeth concerning the needy and the poor: * the Lord will deliver him in the evil day.

6867c4893fd19c946f2b.latin: 40:3 Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra: * et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum eius.
6867c4893fd19c946f2b.english: 40:3 The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: * and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.

35410c8144c58736b583.latin: 40:4 Dóminus opem ferat illi super lectum dolóris eius: * univérsum stratum eius versásti in infirmitáte eius.
35410c8144c58736b583.english: 40:4 The Lord help him on his bed of sorrow: * thou hast turned all his couch in his sickness.

cd4622f688b837c9cc25.latin: 40:5 Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei: * sana ánimam meam, quia peccávi tibi.
cd4622f688b837c9cc25.english: 40:5 I said: O Lord, be thou merciful to me: * heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.

00cfa326e7ecf32f7c6f.latin: 40:6 Inimíci mei dixérunt mala mihi: * Quando moriétur, et períbit nomen eius?
00cfa326e7ecf32f7c6f.english: 40:6 My enemies have spoken evils against me: * when shall he die and his name perish?

78b37241d01887ba3f1d.latin: 40:7 Et si ingrediebátur ut vidéret, vana loquebátur: * cor eius congregávit iniquitátem sibi.
78b37241d01887ba3f1d.english: 40:7 And if he came in to see me, he spoke vain things: * his heart gathered together iniquity to itself.

21a2edaf4bf50822c307.latin: 40:7 Egrediebátur foras, * et loquebátur in idípsum.
21a2edaf4bf50822c307.english: 40:7 He went out * and spoke to the same purpose.

1f3467d25de0c8bf35b3.latin: 40:8 Advérsum me susurrábant omnes inimíci mei: * advérsum me cogitábant mala mihi.
1f3467d25de0c8bf35b3.english: 40:8 All my enemies whispered together against me: * they devised evils to me.

1178b25f63b5c501f443.latin: 40:9 Verbum iníquum constituérunt advérsum me: * Numquid qui dormit non adíciet ut resúrgat?
1178b25f63b5c501f443.english: 40:9 They determined against me an unjust word: * shall he that sleepeth rise again no more?

d83780e15bd87bba397b.latin: 40:10 Étenim homo pacis meæ, in quo sperávi: * qui edébat panes meos, magnificávit super me supplantatiónem.
d83780e15bd87bba397b.english: 40:10 For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, * who ate my bread, hath greatly supplanted me.

5039f574383bfb15eaea.latin: 40:11 Tu autem, Dómine, miserére mei, et resúscita me: * et retríbuam eis.
5039f574383bfb15eaea.english: 40:11 But thou, O Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up again: * and I will requite them.

7f94574414db4ae8f11f.latin: 40:12 In hoc cognóvi quóniam voluísti me: * quóniam non gaudébit inimícus meus super me.
7f94574414db4ae8f11f.english: 40:12 By this I know, that thou hast had a good will for me: * because my enemy shall not rejoice over me.

2827484a5cb3d5ebb043.latin: 40:13 Me autem propter innocéntiam suscepísti: * et confirmásti me in conspéctu tuo in ætérnum.
2827484a5cb3d5ebb043.english: 40:13 But thou hast upheld me by reason of my innocence: * and hast established me in thy sight for ever.

82f49b4b4ffc5ed53eae.latin: 40:14 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * fiat, fiat.
82f49b4b4ffc5ed53eae.english: 40:14 Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel from eternity to eternity. * So be it. So be it.

2b96c84096d398748526.latin: 41:2 Quemádmodum desíderat cervus ad fontes aquárum: * ita desíderat ánima mea ad te, Deus.
2b96c84096d398748526.english: 41:2 As the hart panteth after the fountains of water; * so my soul panteth after thee, O God.

b943199df517c0a7a339.latin: 41:3 Sitívit ánima mea ad Deum fortem vivum: * quando véniam, et apparébo ante fáciem Dei?
b943199df517c0a7a339.english: 41:3 My soul hath thirsted after the strong living God; * when shall I come and appear before the face of God?

cabd92d95b4580acc7e4.latin: 41:4 Fuérunt mihi lácrimæ meæ panes die ac nocte: * dum dícitur mihi cotídie: Ubi est Deus tuus?
cabd92d95b4580acc7e4.english: 41:4 My tears have been my bread day and night, * whilst it is said to me daily: Where is thy God?

6e6d9d9b5e728607f831.latin: 41:5 Hæc recordátus sum, et effúdi in me ánimam meam: * quóniam transíbo in locum tabernáculi admirábilis, usque ad domum Dei.
6e6d9d9b5e728607f831.english: 41:5 These things I remembered, and poured out my soul in me: * for I shall go over into the place of the wonderful tabernacle, even to the house of God:

087d5df992e3101351aa.latin: 41:5 In voce exsultatiónis, et confessiónis: * sonus epulántis.
087d5df992e3101351aa.english: 41:5 With the voice of joy and praise; * the noise of one feasting.

3315f108131931fd86f7.latin: 41:6 Quare tristis es, ánima mea? * et quare contúrbas me?
3315f108131931fd86f7.english: 41:6 Why art thou sad, O my soul? * and why dost thou trouble me?

479955c2632c454addad.latin: 41:6 Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
479955c2632c454addad.english: 41:6 Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

fe86855e8ddca7c83de9.latin: 41:7 Ad meípsum ánima mea conturbáta est: * proptérea memor ero tui de terra Iordánis, et Hermóniim a monte módico.
fe86855e8ddca7c83de9.english: 41:7 My soul is troubled within myself: * therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan and Hermoniim, from the little hill.

b2d5d16d9efc1302af53.latin: 41:8 Abýssus abýssum ínvocat, * in voce cataractárum tuárum.
b2d5d16d9efc1302af53.english: 41:8 Deep calleth on deep, * at the noise of thy flood-gates.

177455b9c2f8567d5311.latin: 41:8 Ómnia excélsa tua, et fluctus tui * super me transiérunt.
177455b9c2f8567d5311.english: 41:8 All thy heights and thy billows * have passed over me.

5a3c3d36e19841a168df.latin: 41:9 In die mandávit Dóminus misericórdiam suam: * et nocte cánticum eius.
5a3c3d36e19841a168df.english: 41:9 In the daytime the Lord hath commanded his mercy; * and a canticle to him in the night.

51c3ffed68d6d213b955.latin: 41:9 Apud me orátio Deo vitæ meæ, * dicam Deo: Suscéptor meus es.
51c3ffed68d6d213b955.english: 41:9 With me is prayer to the God of my life. * I will say to God: Thou art my support.

d29644377980cc94bf7a.latin: 41:10 Quare oblítus es mei? * et quare contristátus incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?
d29644377980cc94bf7a.english: 41:10 Why hast thou forgotten me? * and why go I mourning, whilst my enemy afflicteth me?

930022dc7d6bf1bf5d04.latin: 41:11 Dum confringúntur ossa mea, * exprobravérunt mihi qui tríbulant me inimíci mei.
930022dc7d6bf1bf5d04.english: 41:11 Whilst my bones are broken, * my enemies who trouble me have reproached me;

e1456f4093e60776b5c9.latin: 41:11 Dum dicunt mihi per síngulos dies: Ubi est Deus tuus? * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?
e1456f4093e60776b5c9.english: 41:11 Whilst they say to me day by day: Where is thy God? * Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me?

6b582fb8ac3fd2e39f4c.latin: 41:12 Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
6b582fb8ac3fd2e39f4c.english: 41:12 Hope thou in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

1ca06f214206ada651ac.latin: 43:2 Deus áuribus nostris audívimus: * patres nostri annuntiavérunt nobis.
1ca06f214206ada651ac.english: 43:2 We have heard, O God, with our ears: * our fathers have declared to us,

43b7a8f82c52f8bc1f57.latin: 43:2 Opus, quod operátus es in diébus eórum, * et in diébus antíquis.
43b7a8f82c52f8bc1f57.english: 43:2 The work thou hast wrought in their days, * and in the days of old.

6d28d8951bd217732eed.latin: 43:3 Manus tua gentes dispérdidit, et plantásti eos: * afflixísti pópulos, et expulísti eos.
6d28d8951bd217732eed.english: 43:3 Thy hand destroyed the Gentiles, and thou plantedst them: * thou didst afflict the people and cast them out.

02e1bb8b59b3858bd406.latin: 43:4 Nec enim in gládio suo possedérunt terram, * et brácchium eórum non salvávit eos:
02e1bb8b59b3858bd406.english: 43:4 For they got not the possession of the land by their own sword: * neither did their own arm save them.

f0f5605a07d1039ee4ec.latin: 43:4 Sed déxtera tua, et brácchium tuum, et illuminátio vultus tui: * quóniam complacuísti in eis.
f0f5605a07d1039ee4ec.english: 43:4 But thy right hand and thy arm, and the light of thy countenance: * because thou wast pleased with them.

fb5a89999a4f3e3fce05.latin: 43:5 Tu es ipse Rex meus et Deus meus: * qui mandas salútes Iacob.
fb5a89999a4f3e3fce05.english: 43:5 Thou art thyself my king and my God, * who commandest the saving of Jacob.

7fb49f83bdfa66e12757.latin: 43:6 In te inimícos nostros ventilábimus cornu: * et in nómine tuo spernémus insurgéntes in nobis.
7fb49f83bdfa66e12757.english: 43:6 Through thee we will push down our enemies with the horn: * and through thy name we will despise them that rise up against us.

9bb5319841957530ca2b.latin: 43:7 Non enim in arcu meo sperábo: * et gládius meus non salvábit me.
9bb5319841957530ca2b.english: 43:7 For I will not trust in my bow: * neither shall my sword save me.

3367d2be9a2ff6e0951d.latin: 43:8 Salvásti enim nos de affligéntibus nos: * et odiéntes nos confudísti.
3367d2be9a2ff6e0951d.english: 43:8 But thou hast saved us from them that afflict us: * and hast put them to shame that hate us.

48c521bd69eb02912fca.latin: 43:9 In Deo laudábimur tota die: * et in nómine tuo confitébimur in sǽculum.
48c521bd69eb02912fca.english: 43:9 In God shall we glory all the day long: * and in thy name we will give praise for ever.

21a38b95bd22a0a55a05.latin: 43:10 Nunc autem repulísti et confudísti nos: * et non egrediéris, Deus, in virtútibus nostris.
21a38b95bd22a0a55a05.english: 43:10 But now thou hast cast us off, and put us to shame: * and thou, O God, wilt not go out with our armies.

8cb8ba039b2cb603ea86.latin: 43:11 Avertísti nos retrórsum post inimícos nostros: * et qui odérunt nos, diripiébant sibi.
8cb8ba039b2cb603ea86.english: 43:11 Thou hast made us turn our back to our enemies: * and they that hated us plundered for themselves.

ee25bb654cf9d0220775.latin: 43:12 Dedísti nos tamquam oves escárum: * et in géntibus dispersísti nos.
ee25bb654cf9d0220775.english: 43:12 Thou hast given us up like sheep to be eaten: * thou hast scattered us among the nations.

fb41edd5434e7544f792.latin: 43:13 Vendidísti pópulum tuum sine prétio: * et non fuit multitúdo in commutatiónibus eórum.
fb41edd5434e7544f792.english: 43:13 Thou hast sold thy people for no price: * and there was no reckoning in the exchange of them.

a1f186266b629c8db939.latin: 43:14 Posuísti nos oppróbrium vicínis nostris, * subsannatiónem et derísum his, qui sunt in circúitu nostro.
a1f186266b629c8db939.english: 43:14 Thou hast made us a reproach to our neighbours, * a scoff and derision to them that are round about us.

d174b13e3b7a4b281e93.latin: 43:15 Posuísti nos in similitúdinem géntibus: * commotiónem cápitis in pópulis.
d174b13e3b7a4b281e93.english: 43:15 Thou hast made us a byword among the Gentiles: * a shaking of the head among the people.

9932dd4d044bfe4fa3f6.latin: 43:16 Tota die verecúndia mea contra me est, * et confúsio faciéi meæ coopéruit me.
9932dd4d044bfe4fa3f6.english: 43:16 All the day long my shame is before me: * and the confusion of my face hath covered me.

b6a80c0f6329d9a1914f.latin: 43:17 A voce exprobrántis, et obloquéntis: * a fácie inimíci, et persequéntis.
b6a80c0f6329d9a1914f.english: 43:17 At the voice of him that reproacheth and detracteth me: * at the face of the enemy and persecutor.

9e774fc707707823056e.latin: 43:18 Hæc ómnia venérunt super nos, nec oblíti sumus te: * et iníque non égimus in testaménto tuo.
9e774fc707707823056e.english: 43:18 All these things have come upon us, yet we have not forgotten thee: * and we have not done wickedly in thy covenant.

c7311e81b29e64900c59.latin: 43:19 Et non recéssit retro cor nostrum: * et declinásti sémitas nostras a via tua:
c7311e81b29e64900c59.english: 43:19 And our heart hath not turned back: * neither hast thou turned aside our steps from thy way.

acf714aa8d9eaa3695d2.latin: 43:20 Quóniam humiliásti nos in loco afflictiónis, * et coopéruit nos umbra mortis.
acf714aa8d9eaa3695d2.english: 43:20 For thou hast humbled us in the place of affliction: * and the shadow of death hath covered us.

e27095964e909cbcffb1.latin: 43:21 Si oblíti sumus nomen Dei nostri, * et si expándimus manus nostras ad deum aliénum:
e27095964e909cbcffb1.english: 43:21 If we have forgotten the name of our God, * and if we have spread forth our hands to a strange god:

fe45e3b2f29b16b8002b.latin: 43:22 Nonne Deus requíret ista? * ipse enim novit abscóndita cordis.
fe45e3b2f29b16b8002b.english: 43:22 Shall not God search out these things: * for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.

1f71e32de2e24c8023cb.latin: 43:22 Quóniam propter te mortificámur tota die: * æstimáti sumus sicut oves occisiónis.
1f71e32de2e24c8023cb.english: 43:22 Because for thy sake we are killed all the day long: * we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

adb83517a9260a60a790.latin: 43:23 Exsúrge, quare obdórmis, Dómine? * exsúrge, et ne repéllas in finem.
adb83517a9260a60a790.english: 43:23 Arise, why sleepest thou, O Lord? * arise, and cast us not off to the end.

f92da17c9525e37229c9.latin: 43:24 Quare fáciem tuam avértis, * oblivísceris inópiæ nostræ, et tribulatiónis nostræ?
f92da17c9525e37229c9.english: 43:24 Why turnest thou thy face away? * and forgettest our want and our trouble?

fb042a6d541b07a45f2c.latin: 43:25 Quóniam humiliáta est in púlvere ánima nostra: * conglutinátus est in terra venter noster.
fb042a6d541b07a45f2c.english: 43:25 For our soul is humbled down to the dust: * our belly cleaveth to the earth.

d72e77e5fba437eb64e9.latin: 43:26 Exsúrge, Dómine, ádiuva nos: * et rédime nos propter nomen tuum.
d72e77e5fba437eb64e9.english: 43:26 Arise, O Lord, help us * and redeem us for thy name’s sake.

89dbe677e18f5d5887ed.latin: 44:2 Eructávit cor meum verbum bonum: * dico ego ópera mea Regi.
89dbe677e18f5d5887ed.english: 44:2 My heart hath uttered a good word; * I speak my works to the King.

f5b9929cf479c5c75b12.latin: 44:2 Lingua mea cálamus scribæ: * velóciter scribéntis.
f5b9929cf479c5c75b12.english: 44:2 My tongue is the pen of a scrivener * that writeth swiftly.

018d0f1e132cd05c8b54.latin: 44:3 Speciósus forma præ fíliis hóminum, diffúsa est grátia in lábiis tuis: * proptérea benedíxit te Deus in ætérnum.
018d0f1e132cd05c8b54.english: 44:3 Thou art beautiful above the sons of men: grace is poured abroad in thy lips; * therefore hath God blessed thee for ever.

28453ba2bbae3163cc14.latin: 44:4 Accíngere gládio tuo super femur tuum, * potentíssime.
28453ba2bbae3163cc14.english: 44:4 Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, * O thou most mighty.

ff84d5f1a672f0b55734.latin: 44:5 Spécie tua et pulchritúdine tua: * inténde, próspere procéde, et regna.
ff84d5f1a672f0b55734.english: 44:5 With thy comeliness and thy beauty * set out, proceed prosperously, and reign.

98d131f80afff8220243.latin: 44:5 Propter veritátem, et mansuetúdinem, et iustítiam: * et dedúcet te mirabíliter déxtera tua.
98d131f80afff8220243.english: 44:5 Because of truth and meekness and justice: * and thy right hand shall conduct thee wonderfully.

daaeadc58a5a6d6d539b.latin: 44:6 Sagíttæ tuæ acútæ, pópuli sub te cadent: * in corda inimicórum Regis.
daaeadc58a5a6d6d539b.english: 44:6 Thy arrows are sharp: under thee shall people fall, * into the hearts of the king’s enemies.

520ca1999b976f501334.latin: 44:7 Sedes tua, Deus, in sǽculum sǽculi: * virga directiónis virga regni tui.
520ca1999b976f501334.english: 44:7 Thy throne, O God, is for ever and ever: * the sceptre of thy kingdom is a sceptre of uprightness.

846257e688e82174a00b.latin: 44:8 Dilexísti iustítiam, et odísti iniquitátem: * proptérea unxit te Deus, Deus tuus, óleo lætítiæ præ consórtibus tuis.
846257e688e82174a00b.english: 44:8 Thou hast loved justice, and hated iniquity: * therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.

40043d3fb4634e30ae1b.latin: 44:9 Myrrha, et gutta, et cásia a vestiméntis tuis, a dómibus ebúrneis: * ex quibus delectavérunt te fíliæ regum in honóre tuo.
40043d3fb4634e30ae1b.english: 44:9 Myrrh and stacte and cassia perfume thy garments, from the ivory houses: * out of which the daughters of kings have delighted thee in thy glory.

a7676b40544aaa63eab4.latin: 44:10 Ástitit regína a dextris tuis in vestítu deauráto: * circúmdata varietáte.
a7676b40544aaa63eab4.english: 44:10 The queen stood on thy right hand, in gilded clothing; * surrounded with variety.

a6eb3de6e5e52583af16.latin: 44:11 Audi fília, et vide, et inclína aurem tuam: * et oblivíscere pópulum tuum et domum patris tui.
a6eb3de6e5e52583af16.english: 44:11 Hearken, O daughter, and see, and incline thy ear: * and forget thy people and thy father’s house.

9b54c499e60fed1f51b6.latin: 44:12 Et concupíscet Rex decórem tuum: * quóniam ipse est Dóminus Deus tuus, et adorábunt eum.
9b54c499e60fed1f51b6.english: 44:12 And the king shall greatly desire thy beauty; * for he is the Lord thy God, and him they shall adore.

dcdf1a0b4492d2c0f51e.latin: 44:13 Et fíliæ Tyri in munéribus * vultum tuum deprecabúntur: omnes dívites plebis.
dcdf1a0b4492d2c0f51e.english: 44:13 And the daughters of Tyre with gifts, * yea, all the rich among the people, shall entreat thy countenance.

74716d8512090c4458fa.latin: 44:14 Omnis glória eius fíliæ Regis ab intus, * in fímbriis áureis circumamícta varietátibus.
74716d8512090c4458fa.english: 44:14 All the glory of the king’s daughter is within, * in golden borders, clothed round about with varieties.

5b8b89a0ee8b4ab5ca2a.latin: 44:15 Adducéntur Regi vírgines post eam: * próximæ eius afferéntur tibi.
5b8b89a0ee8b4ab5ca2a.english: 44:15 After her shall virgins be brought to the king: * her neighbours shall be brought to thee.

a88951086911dcfe185f.latin: 44:16 Afferéntur in lætítia et exsultatióne: * adducéntur in templum Regis.
a88951086911dcfe185f.english: 44:16 They shall be brought with gladness and rejoicing: * they shall be brought into the temple of the king.

b8b669d8b29dbf7c8771.latin: 44:17 Pro pátribus tuis nati sunt tibi fílii: * constítues eos príncipes super omnem terram.
b8b669d8b29dbf7c8771.english: 44:17 Instead of thy fathers, sons are born to thee: * thou shalt make them princes over all the earth.

7c55080370e32e66d028.latin: 44:18 Mémores erunt nóminis tui: * in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
7c55080370e32e66d028.english: 44:18 They shall remember thy name * throughout all generations.

d0d519ad48b3ac26a957.latin: 44:18 Proptérea pópuli confitebúntur tibi in ætérnum: * et in sǽculum sǽculi.
d0d519ad48b3ac26a957.english: 44:18 Therefore shall people praise thee for ever; yea, * for ever and ever.

Qui timétis Dóminum, speráte in illum: et in oblectatiónem véniet vobis misericórdia. Qui timétis Dóminum, dilígite illum: et illuminabúntur corda vestra.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini.

℣. Accédite ad eum, et illuminámini.
℟. Et fácies vestræ non confundéntur.

efd45cbcc997b616b1ed.latin: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut ad meliórem vitam beatórum Mauri et Plácidi Confessórum tuórum exémpla nos próvocent; quátenus, quorum memóriam ágimus, étiam actus imitémur.

0d22bfeee05eba4c0d04.latin: Ant. Iusti * fulgébunt sicut sol in regno Patris eórum.
0d22bfeee05eba4c0d04.english: Ant. Justi * fulgébunt sicut sol in regno Patris eórum.

f9787b70ef633cf041f2.latin: Ant. Iusti fulgébunt sicut sol in regno Patris eórum.
f9787b70ef633cf041f2.english: Ant. Justi fulgébunt sicut sol in regno Patris eórum.

963071310eff901265ce.latin: Ant. Grátia Dei, * et misericórdia est in Sanctos eius, et respéctus in eléctos illíus.
963071310eff901265ce.english: Ant. Grátia Dei, * et misericórdia est in Sanctos ejus, et respéctus in eléctos illíus.

040836e516c3c2745cbf.english: Ant. Grátia Dei, et misericórdia est in Sanctos ejus, et respéctus in eléctos illíus.

e0e2ae228369a7b8edbf.latin: Ant. Ideo accípient regnum decóris, et diadéma speciéi de manu Dómini.

5bbcafae7fb006b6b111.latin: Ant. Benidícite, * sancti et húmiles corde, Dómino ; laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

2fca653f216f3422d21c.latin: Ant. Benidícite, sancti et húmiles corde, Dómino ; laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.

4ea7c5ac1f28fcb5f71c.latin: Ant. Gaudéte * et exsultáte quóniam merces vestra copiósa est in cælis.

ab7c8a02730f979850f5.latin: Ant. Gaudéte et exsultáte quóniam merces vestra copiósa est in cælis.

426630bb38107b298780.latin:
Sir 2:7-8
Metuéntes Dóminum, sustinéte misericórdiam eius: et non deflectátis ab illo, ne cadátis. Qui timétis Dóminum, crédite illi: et non evacuábitur merces vestra.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Firmaméntum est Dóminus * Timéntibus eum.
℟. Firmaméntum est Dóminus * Timéntibus eum.
℣. Et testaméntum ipsíus ut manifestétur illis.
℟. Timéntibus eum.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Firmaméntum est Dóminus * Timéntibus eum.
Hymnus
Beáta cæli gáudia,
Confessiónis prǽmium,
Christi o fidéles ásseclæ
Iam possidétis áffatim.
Laudes benígnis áuribus
Audíte, quas effúndimus
Nos éxsules de pátria
Vobis sacráto cántico.
Amóre Christi pérciti
Crucem tulístis ásperam,
Obœdiéntes, ímpigri
Et caritáte férvidi.
Spevístis artes dǽmonum
Sævúmque avérni príncipem
Christum faténdo móribus,
Migrástis inter sídera.
Iam nunc potíti glória,
Adéste votis ómnium
Ardénter exoptántium
Exémpla vestra prósequi.
Ut Christe, Rex piíssime,
Horum precátu, nóxia
Nobis remíttis crímina,
Clamámus ore súpplici.
Sit laus, honor, sit glória
Deo Patri cum Fílio
Sancto simul Paráclito
In sempitérna sǽcula.
Amen.
℣. Iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo, Dómine.
℟. Et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.

℟. Thanks be to God.

46bcf3cade97f7663b77.latin: Ant. Beáti servi illi * quos, cum vénerit Dóminus, invénerit vigilántes.

dedcdbc078ebff9b05f8.latin: Ant. Beáti servi illi quos, cum vénerit Dóminus, invénerit vigilántes.

136a0291d9c2a1c3489f.latin: 1:1 Beátus vir, qui non ábiit in consílio impiórum, et in via peccatórum non stetit, * et in cáthedra pestiléntiæ non sedit:
136a0291d9c2a1c3489f.english: 1:1 Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stood in the way of sinners, * nor sat in the chair of pestilence.

225a99be286bedbb452a.latin: 1:2 Sed in lege Dómini volúntas eius, * et in lege eius meditábitur die ac nocte.
225a99be286bedbb452a.english: 1:2 But his will is in the law of the Lord, * and on his law he shall meditate day and night.

ca0f5c9388bf114d538e.latin: 1:3 Et erit tamquam lignum, quod plantátum est secus decúrsus aquárum, * quod fructum suum dabit in témpore suo:
ca0f5c9388bf114d538e.english: 1:3 And he shall be like a tree which is planted near the running waters, * which shall bring forth its fruit, in due season.

a3e46c864f9ae03331ee.latin: 1:3 Et fólium eius non défluet: * et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, prosperabúntur.
a3e46c864f9ae03331ee.english: 1:3 And his leaf shall not fall off: * and all whatsoever he shall do shall prosper.

bd0a87e032fadcdea810.latin: 1:4 Non sic ímpii, non sic: * sed tamquam pulvis, quem próicit ventus a fácie terræ.
bd0a87e032fadcdea810.english: 1:4 Not so the wicked, not so: * but like the dust, which the wind driveth from the face of the earth.

7bb913f09daa88748eb0.latin: 1:5 Ídeo non resúrgent ímpii in iudício: * neque peccatóres in concílio iustórum.
7bb913f09daa88748eb0.english: 1:5 Therefore the wicked shall not rise again in judgment: * nor sinners in the council of the just.

e7fc502a5f109e453b43.latin: 1:6 Quóniam novit Dóminus viam iustórum: * et iter impiórum períbit.
e7fc502a5f109e453b43.english: 1:6 For the Lord knoweth the way of the just: * and the way of the wicked shall perish.

6507b5cc99627fe5cc8d.latin: 2:1 Quare fremuérunt gentes: * et pópuli meditáti sunt inánia?
6507b5cc99627fe5cc8d.english: 2:1 Why have the Gentiles raged, * and the people devised vain things?

0c5458234e36eebe3036.latin: 2:2 Astitérunt reges terræ, et príncipes convenérunt in unum * advérsus Dóminum, et advérsus Christum eius.
0c5458234e36eebe3036.english: 2:2 The kings of the earth stood up, and the princes met together, * against the Lord and against his Christ.

4cf6824933b02b8f9a73.latin: 2:3 Dirumpámus víncula eórum: * et proiciámus a nobis iugum ipsórum.
4cf6824933b02b8f9a73.english: 2:3 Let us break their bonds asunder: * and let us cast away their yoke from us.

abf4856643cfa0930e9c.latin: 2:4 Qui hábitat in cælis, irridébit eos: * et Dóminus subsannábit eos.
abf4856643cfa0930e9c.english: 2:4 He that dwelleth in heaven shall laugh at them: * and the Lord shall deride them.

b03155e8bff344377fd0.latin: 2:5 Tunc loquétur ad eos in ira sua, * et in furóre suo conturbábit eos.
b03155e8bff344377fd0.english: 2:5 Then shall he speak to them in his anger, * and trouble them in his rage.

20ca7cd97b96f0811bd7.latin: 2:6 Ego autem constitútus sum Rex ab eo super Sion montem sanctum eius, * prǽdicans præcéptum eius.
20ca7cd97b96f0811bd7.english: 2:6 But I am appointed king by him over Sion his holy mountain, * preaching his commandment.

a8ca2bf5535ded9a024d.latin: 2:7 Dóminus dixit ad me: * Fílius meus es tu, ego hódie génui te.
a8ca2bf5535ded9a024d.english: 2:7 The Lord hath said to me: * Thou art my son, this day have I begotten thee.

50702c54307370a2275e.latin: 2:8 Póstula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hereditátem tuam, * et possessiónem tuam términos terræ.
50702c54307370a2275e.english: 2:8 Ask of me, and I will give thee the Gentiles for thy inheritance, * and the utmost parts of the earth for thy possession.

96ba453b1b5e9a3c4ddd.latin: 2:9 Reges eos in virga férrea, * et tamquam vas fíguli confrínges eos.
96ba453b1b5e9a3c4ddd.english: 2:9 Thou shalt rule them with a rod of iron, * and shalt break them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

65089404b30decd9f6a0.latin: 2:10 Et nunc, reges, intellégite: * erudímini, qui iudicátis terram.
65089404b30decd9f6a0.english: 2:10 And now, O ye kings, understand: * receive instruction, you that judge the earth.

620aad649cc4be20e699.latin: 2:11 Servíte Dómino in timóre: * et exsultáte ei cum tremóre.
620aad649cc4be20e699.english: 2:11 Serve ye the Lord with fear: * and rejoice unto him with trembling.

ea20140667142dde1617.latin: 2:12 Apprehéndite disciplínam, nequándo irascátur Dóminus, * et pereátis de via iusta.
ea20140667142dde1617.english: 2:12 Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord be angry, * and you perish from the just way.

ef17b92cbc80f2365189.latin: 2:13 Cum exárserit in brevi ira eius: * beáti omnes qui confídunt in eo.
ef17b92cbc80f2365189.english: 2:13 When his wrath shall be kindled in a short time, * blessed are all they that trust in him.

d8f5ac8ccc40a4903bc9.latin: 6:2 Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
d8f5ac8ccc40a4903bc9.english: 6:2 Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

634ee7011c642aa6e6aa.latin: 6:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
634ee7011c642aa6e6aa.english: 6:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: * heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

0782a37bbfa73199891f.latin: 6:4 Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
0782a37bbfa73199891f.english: 6:4 And my soul is troubled exceedingly: * but thou, O Lord, how long?

6ee4c31ebd9bc2046882.latin: 6:5 Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
6ee4c31ebd9bc2046882.english: 6:5 Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: * O save me for thy mercy’s sake.

0002b16a90a8201b68e9.latin: 6:6 Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
0002b16a90a8201b68e9.english: 6:6 For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: * and who shall confess to thee in hell?

8eb4ae3f071cdeadd9fb.latin: 6:7 Laborávi in gémitu meo, lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
8eb4ae3f071cdeadd9fb.english: 6:7 I have laboured in my groanings, every night I will wash my bed: * I will water my couch with my tears.

1fa030c98584d88743ed.latin: 6:8 Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
1fa030c98584d88743ed.english: 6:8 My eye is troubled through indignation: * I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

cb91ff49854066a833af.latin: 6:9 Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
cb91ff49854066a833af.english: 6:9 Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: * for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

9e7f904c4ef76d5cdf3d.latin: 6:10 Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
9e7f904c4ef76d5cdf3d.english: 6:10 The Lord hath heard my supplication: * the Lord hath received my prayer.

88965cb998efd8d2e044.latin: 6:11 Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
88965cb998efd8d2e044.english: 6:11 Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: * let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

b08793a2f8d92b030e8b.latin: Prídie Nonas Octóbris Luna vicésima quarta. Anno Dómini 2026
b08793a2f8d92b030e8b.english: October 6th 2026, the 24th day of the Moon, were born into the better life:

d90ac02623c1541ec6b0.latin: In monastério Turris, diœcésis Squillacénsis, in Calábria, sancti Brunónis Confessóris, qui Ordinis Carthusianórum fuit Institútor.
d90ac02623c1541ec6b0.english: In Calabria, (in the year 1101,) the holy Confessor Bruno, Founder of the Order of Monks of the Charterhouse.

04eb0edaea20ba69e3a9.latin: Laodicéæ, in Phrýgia, beáti Ságaris, Epíscopi et Mártyris; qui éxstitit unus de antíquis Pauli Apóstoli discípulis.
04eb0edaea20ba69e3a9.english: At Laodicea, the blessed martyr Sagaris, Bishop (of that see,) who was one of the disciples of the Apostle Paul.

9f3799c1c35106b8a2a3.latin: Antisiodóri sancti Románi, Epíscopi et Mártyris.
9f3799c1c35106b8a2a3.english: At Capua, (in the fourth century,) the holy martyrs Marcellus, Castus, Emilius, and Saturninus.

cba6e584fe80d3f0815f.latin: Cápuæ natális sanctórum Mártyrum Marcélli, Casti, Æmílii et Saturníni.
cba6e584fe80d3f0815f.english: At Agen, in Gaul, (towards the end of the third century,) the holy Virgin and martyr Faith, by whose example blessed Caprasius was so stirred up to suffer martyrdom, that he finished his contending with joy.

c0781cc285d81625f2b9.latin: Tréviris commemorátio innumerabílium fere Mártyrum, qui, in persecutióne Diocletiáni, sub Rictiováro Prǽside, ob Christi fidem, vario mortis génere necáti sunt.
c0781cc285d81625f2b9.english: Likewise the holy martyr Erotis, in whom the love of Christ was so kindled that she triumphed over the flames of fire.

30b2a46b8584ad431dee.latin: Agénni, in Gállia, natális sanctæ Fídei, Vírginis et Mártyris; cuius exémplo beátus Caprásius, ad martýrium animátus, agónem suum tertiodécimo Kaléndas Novémbris felíciter consummávit.
30b2a46b8584ad431dee.english: At Trier is kept the memorial of a great multitude of martyrs, which man can scarcely number, who for Christ's faith's sake were put to death in diverse ways by the President Rictiovarus in the persecution under the Emperor Diocletian.

bb55dbfe9b80a0d7ab00.latin: Item sanctæ Erótidis Mártyris, quæ, Christi amóre succénsa, ignis superávit incéndium.
bb55dbfe9b80a0d7ab00.english: At Auxerre, the holy martyr Romanus, Bishop (of that see, who succeeded Eleutherius and was Bishop three years.)

f3a2aff9d88b47d9bb9f.latin: Opitérgii, in Venetórum fínibus, sancti Magni Epíscopi, cuius corpus Venétiis requiéscit.
f3a2aff9d88b47d9bb9f.english: At Oderzo, (about the year 660,) holy Magnus, Bishop (of that see,) whose body lieth at Venice.

55fd9098ee888b1d39af.latin: Neápoli, in Campánia, deposítio sanctæ Maríæ-Francíscæ a Quinque Vulnéribus Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Vírginis, ex tértio Ordine sancti Francísci, quæ, virtútibus et miráculis clara, a Pio Papa Nono sanctis Virgínibus adscrípta fuit.
55fd9098ee888b1d39af.english: At Naples, (in the year 1791,) holy Mary Frances, of the Five Wounds of our Lord Jesus Christ, of the Third Order of Bare-footed Friars Minor of St. Peter of Alcantara, she was famous for graces and miracles, and Pope Pius IX. enrolled her name among those of the holy virgins.

1a1938eeb316d524585f.latin: Séptimus humilitátis gradus est: si ómnibus se inferiórem et viliórem non solum sua lingua pronúntiet, sed étiam íntimo cordis credat afféctu, humílians se et dicens cum Prophéta: Ego autem sum vermis et non homo, obpróbrium hóminum et abiéctio plebis. Exaltátus sum et humiliátus et confúsus. Et item: Bonum mihi quod humiliásti me, et discam mandáta tua.
1a1938eeb316d524585f.english: The seventh step in humility is if he not only with his mouth denounce himself as inferior to all and more worthless, but also believe it in his inner consciousness, humbling himself and saying with the prophet: “But I am a worm and not a man, a shame of men and an outcast of the people: I was exalted and humbled and confounded.” And again: “It is good for me that Thou didst humble me, that I may learn Thy commandments.”

1274de04b8a35132bd05.latin: 118:105 (Nun) Lucérna pédibus meis verbum tuum, * et lumen sémitis meis.
1274de04b8a35132bd05.english: 118:105 (Nun) Thy word is a lamp to my feet, * and a light to my paths.

aca384b5f4bd35e6f0ff.latin: 118:106 Iurávi, et státui * custodíre iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
aca384b5f4bd35e6f0ff.english: 118:106 I have sworn and am determined * to keep the judgments of thy justice.

50dbb6eb3f64fa093cba.latin: 118:107 Humiliátus sum usquequáque, Dómine: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
50dbb6eb3f64fa093cba.english: 118:107 I have been humbled, O Lord, exceedingly: * quicken thou me according to thy word.

076aa47d3cd10af091df.latin: 118:108 Voluntária oris mei beneplácita fac, Dómine: * et iudícia tua doce me.
076aa47d3cd10af091df.english: 118:108 The free offerings of my mouth make acceptable, O Lord: * and teach me thy judgments.

02ebf8537a565fd06f1a.latin: 118:109 Ánima mea in mánibus meis semper: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
02ebf8537a565fd06f1a.english: 118:109 My soul is continually in my hands: * and I have not forgotten thy law.

d0bad3fecb11a79d8b7b.latin: 118:110 Posuérunt peccatóres láqueum mihi: * et de mandátis tuis non errávi.
d0bad3fecb11a79d8b7b.english: 118:110 Sinners have laid a snare for me: * but I have not erred from thy precepts.

5bd3e0ef6fd257f22b97.latin: 118:111 Hereditáte acquisívi testimónia tua in ætérnum: * quia exsultátio cordis mei sunt.
5bd3e0ef6fd257f22b97.english: 118:111 I have purchased thy testimonies for an inheritance for ever: * because they are the joy of my heart.

4d21c502f662ad727a41.latin: 118:112 Inclinávi cor meum ad faciéndas iustificatiónes tuas in ætérnum, * propter retributiónem.
4d21c502f662ad727a41.english: 118:112 I have inclined my heart to do thy justifications for ever, * for the reward.

27d260faa4445fd002f2.latin: 118:113 (Samech) Iníquos ódio hábui: * et legem tuam diléxi.
27d260faa4445fd002f2.english: 118:113 (Samech) I have hated the unjust: * and I have loved thy law.

0d4f9f55e3cbc5b51a13.latin: 118:114 Adiútor et suscéptor meus es tu: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
0d4f9f55e3cbc5b51a13.english: 118:114 Thou art my helper and my protector: * and in thy word I have greatly hoped.

633b423da32b73bb5ca9.latin: 118:115 Declináte a me, malígni: * et scrutábor mandáta Dei mei.
633b423da32b73bb5ca9.english: 118:115 Depart from me, ye malignant: * and I will search the commandments of my God.

6e0f45f16b418cac5d1a.latin: 118:116 Súscipe me secúndum elóquium tuum, et vivam: * et non confúndas me ab exspectatióne mea.
6e0f45f16b418cac5d1a.english: 118:116 Uphold me according to thy word, and I shall live: * and let me not be confounded in my expectation.

f87ef4d5573bd7c62ae4.latin: 118:117 Ádiuva me, et salvus ero: * et meditábor in iustificatiónibus tuis semper.
f87ef4d5573bd7c62ae4.english: 118:117 Help me, and I shall be saved: * and I will meditate always on thy justifications.

dee62f06d0b408fd0ca4.latin: 118:118 Sprevísti omnes discedéntes a iudíciis tuis: * quia iniústa cogitátio eórum.
dee62f06d0b408fd0ca4.english: 118:118 Thou hast despised all them that fall off from thy judgments; * for their thought is unjust.

5774f5fd4c9e92911a53.latin: 118:119 Prævaricántes reputávi omnes peccatóres terræ: * ídeo diléxi testimónia tua.
5774f5fd4c9e92911a53.english: 118:119 I have accounted all the sinners of the earth prevaricators: * therefore have I loved thy testimonies.

440dd7c81213ea2bba93.latin: 118:120 Confíge timóre tuo carnes meas: * a iudíciis enim tuis tímui.
440dd7c81213ea2bba93.english: 118:120 Pierce thou my flesh with thy fear: * for I am afraid of thy judgments.

93857fbd88bcfa95a1a7.latin: 118:121 (Ain) Feci iudícium et iustítiam: * non tradas me calumniántibus me.
93857fbd88bcfa95a1a7.english: 118:121 (Ain) I have done judgment and justice: * give me not up to them that slander me.

d5b7db2465d86b5cfa8d.latin: 118:122 Súscipe servum tuum in bonum: * non calumniéntur me supérbi.
d5b7db2465d86b5cfa8d.english: 118:122 Uphold thy servant unto good: * let not the proud calumniate me.

70be4e7c27fd1fa02372.latin: 118:123 Óculi mei defecérunt in salutáre tuum: * et in elóquium iustítiæ tuæ.
70be4e7c27fd1fa02372.english: 118:123 My eyes have fainted after thy salvation: * and for the word of thy justice.

62e0ec1e60b6f9b5a6b3.latin: 118:124 Fac cum servo tuo secúndum misericórdiam tuam: * et iustificatiónes tuas doce me.
62e0ec1e60b6f9b5a6b3.english: 118:124 Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy: * and teach me thy justifications.

7f6397166d26d1f43829.latin: 118:125 Servus tuus sum ego: * da mihi intelléctum, ut sciam testimónia tua.
7f6397166d26d1f43829.english: 118:125 I am thy servant: * give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.

0583762ae9c5fd29e392.latin: 118:126 Tempus faciéndi, Dómine: * dissipavérunt legem tuam.
0583762ae9c5fd29e392.english: 118:126 It is time, O Lord, to do: * they have dissipated thy law.

8295d91449c4014770c5.latin: 118:127 Ídeo diléxi mandáta tua, * super aurum et topázion.
8295d91449c4014770c5.english: 118:127 Therefore have I loved thy commandments * above gold and the topaz.

8d35b7819842f453639b.latin: 118:128 Proptérea ad ómnia mandáta tua dirigébar: * omnem viam iníquam ódio hábui.
8d35b7819842f453639b.english: 118:128 Therefore was I directed to all thy commandments: * I have hated all wicked ways.

0328d07dd818ebb5e8df.latin:
Sir 2:7-8
Metuéntes Dóminum, sustinéte misericórdiam eius: et non deflectátis ab illo, ne cadátis. Qui timétis Dóminum, crédite illi: et non evacuábitur merces vestra.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum.
℟. Et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius.
0328d07dd818ebb5e8df.english:
Sir 2:7-8
Metuéntes Dóminum, sustinéte misericórdiam ejus: et non deflectátis ab illo, ne cadátis. Qui timétis Dóminum, crédite illi: et non evacuábitur merces vestra.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. Óculi Dómini super metuéntes eum.
℟. Et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia ejus.

8193c7511b67d55ca1e2.latin: 118:129 (Phe) Mirabília testimónia tua: * ídeo scrutáta est ea ánima mea.
8193c7511b67d55ca1e2.english: 118:129 (Phe) Thy testimonies are wonderful: * therefore my soul hath sought them.

3f2e48221c49bc570f80.latin: 118:130 Declarátio sermónum tuórum illúminat: * et intelléctum dat párvulis.
3f2e48221c49bc570f80.english: 118:130 The declaration of thy words giveth light: * and giveth understanding to little ones.

945fe2a3decc91ce3f5a.latin: 118:131 Os meum apérui, et attráxi spíritum: * quia mandáta tua desiderábam.
945fe2a3decc91ce3f5a.english: 118:131 I opened my mouth, and panted: * because I longed for thy commandments.

21310af16184820ac5c8.latin: 118:132 Áspice in me, et miserére mei, * secúndum iudícium diligéntium nomen tuum.
21310af16184820ac5c8.english: 118:132 Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me, * according to the judgment of them that love thy name.

0e85fffb9b68504c8806.latin: 118:133 Gressus meos dírige secúndum elóquium tuum: * et non dominétur mei omnis iniustítia.
0e85fffb9b68504c8806.english: 118:133 Direct my steps according to thy word: * and let no iniquity have dominion over me.

9b848939fd2bddc92d88.latin: 118:134 Rédime me a calúmniis hóminum: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
9b848939fd2bddc92d88.english: 118:134 Redeem me from the calumnies of men: * that I may keep thy commandments.

ac005d10f007e6d4dc36.latin: 118:135 Fáciem tuam illúmina super servum tuum: * et doce me iustificatiónes tuas.
ac005d10f007e6d4dc36.english: 118:135 Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: * and teach me thy justifications.

b8f8c4b7114857ec6f17.latin: 118:136 Éxitus aquárum deduxérunt óculi mei: * quia non custodiérunt legem tuam.
b8f8c4b7114857ec6f17.english: 118:136 My eyes have sent forth springs of water: * because they have not kept thy law.

a6a16c9a70cb4d2cc437.latin: 118:137 (Sade) Iustus es, Dómine: * et rectum iudícium tuum.
a6a16c9a70cb4d2cc437.english: 118:137 (Sade) Thou art just, O Lord: * and thy judgment is right.

24ccfd2bbd634745456a.latin: 118:138 Mandásti iustítiam testimónia tua: * et veritátem tuam nimis.
24ccfd2bbd634745456a.english: 118:138 Thou hast commanded justice thy testimonies: * and thy truth exceedingly.

866a4f848212ccb6da71.latin: 118:139 Tabéscere me fecit zelus meus: * quia oblíti sunt verba tua inimíci mei.
866a4f848212ccb6da71.english: 118:139 My zeal hath made me pine away: * because my enemies forgot thy words.

55a0b7f5b8656d438210.latin: 118:140 Ignítum elóquium tuum veheménter: * et servus tuus diléxit illud.
55a0b7f5b8656d438210.english: 118:140 Thy word is exceedingly refined: * and thy servant hath loved it.

f79b19f84e2944ed00f3.latin: 118:141 Adolescéntulus sum ego et contémptus: * iustificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
f79b19f84e2944ed00f3.english: 118:141 I am very young and despised; but * I forget not thy justifications.

e05e54d020aa2b30951e.latin: 118:142 Iustítia tua, iustítia in ætérnum: * et lex tua véritas.
e05e54d020aa2b30951e.english: 118:142 Thy justice is justice for ever: * and thy law is the truth.

857745056e88ad88c6cc.latin: 118:143 Tribulátio, et angústia invenérunt me: * mandáta tua meditátio mea est.
857745056e88ad88c6cc.english: 118:143 Trouble and anguish have found me: * thy commandments are my meditation.

0b8b7ec8867715a99608.latin: 118:144 Ǽquitas testimónia tua in ætérnum: * intelléctum da mihi, et vivam.
0b8b7ec8867715a99608.english: 118:144 Thy testimonies are justice for ever: * give me understanding, and I shall live.

598a37a4c67e6483467a.latin: 118:145 (Coph) Clamávi in toto corde meo, exáudi me, Dómine: * iustificatiónes tuas requíram.
598a37a4c67e6483467a.english: 118:145 (Coph) I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord: * I will seek thy justifications.

c2a67f8b83f764375e50.latin: 118:146 Clamávi ad te, salvum me fac: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
c2a67f8b83f764375e50.english: 118:146 I cried unto thee, save me: * that I may keep thy commandments.

dfc4a0c94f39a209aaed.latin: 118:147 Prævéni in maturitáte, et clamávi: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
dfc4a0c94f39a209aaed.english: 118:147 I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: * because in thy words I very much hoped.

c64a25c5ce02931ffff5.latin: 118:148 Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo: * ut meditárer elóquia tua.
c64a25c5ce02931ffff5.english: 118:148 My eyes to thee have prevented the morning: * that I might meditate on thy words.

d99d84a0999f7640c413.latin: 118:149 Vocem meam audi secúndum misericórdiam tuam, Dómine: * et secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.
d99d84a0999f7640c413.english: 118:149 Hear thou my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy: * and quicken me according to thy judgment.

f2562f90f609ea34bd37.latin: 118:150 Appropinquavérunt persequéntes me iniquitáti: * a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.
f2562f90f609ea34bd37.english: 118:150 They that persecute me have drawn nigh to iniquity; * but they are gone far off from thy law.

20d442bfb60d53339084.latin: 118:151 Prope es tu, Dómine: * et omnes viæ tuæ véritas.
20d442bfb60d53339084.english: 118:151 Thou art near, O Lord: * and all thy ways are truth.

af877ae991e76d3410f8.latin: 118:152 Inítio cognóvi de testimóniis tuis: * quia in ætérnum fundásti ea.
af877ae991e76d3410f8.english: 118:152 I have known from the beginning concerning thy testimonies: * that thou hast founded them for ever.

53ff2630429489e1245f.latin: 118:153 (Res) Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me: * quia legem tuam non sum oblítus.
53ff2630429489e1245f.english: 118:153 (Res) See my humiliation and deliver me: * for I have not forgotten thy law.

595147516150a428ed2b.latin: 118:154 Iúdica iudícium meum, et rédime me: * propter elóquium tuum vivífica me.
595147516150a428ed2b.english: 118:154 Judge my judgment and redeem me: * quicken thou me for thy word’s sake.

02e592d1615d969a7f99.latin: 118:155 Longe a peccatóribus salus: * quia iustificatiónes tuas non exquisiérunt.
02e592d1615d969a7f99.english: 118:155 Salvation is far from sinners; * because they have not sought thy justifications.

281c88ae591a776dc693.latin: 118:156 Misericórdiæ tuæ multæ, Dómine: * secúndum iudícium tuum vivífica me.
281c88ae591a776dc693.english: 118:156 Many, O Lord, are thy mercies: * quicken me according to thy judgment.

7c59cdf2ffb82941f339.latin: 118:157 Multi qui persequúntur me, et tríbulant me: * a testimóniis tuis non declinávi.
7c59cdf2ffb82941f339.english: 118:157 Many are they that persecute me, and afflict me; * but I have not declined from thy testimonies.

2efdc60fc705b88f97f1.latin: 118:158 Vidi prævaricántes, et tabescébam: * quia elóquia tua non custodiérunt.
2efdc60fc705b88f97f1.english: 118:158 I beheld the transgressors, and I pined away; * because they kept not thy word.

ee62d8fed903317a7e1b.latin: 118:159 Vide quóniam mandáta tua diléxi, Dómine: * in misericórdia tua vivífica me.
ee62d8fed903317a7e1b.english: 118:159 Behold I have loved thy commandments, O Lord; * quicken me thou in thy mercy.

86debf7b94b49bb1ee02.latin: 118:160 Princípium verbórum tuórum, véritas: * in ætérnum ómnia iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
86debf7b94b49bb1ee02.english: 118:160 The beginning of thy words is truth: * all the judgments of thy justice are for ever.

cbab29fd0ed72b4d38a8.latin: 118:161 (Sin) Príncipes persecúti sunt me gratis: * et a verbis tuis formidávit cor meum.
cbab29fd0ed72b4d38a8.english: 118:161 (Sin) Princes have persecuted me without cause: * and my heart hath been in awe of thy words.

499cf5f26f80bccc52c6.latin: 118:162 Lætábor ego super elóquia tua: * sicut qui invénit spólia multa.
499cf5f26f80bccc52c6.english: 118:162 I will rejoice at thy words, * as one that hath found great spoil.

79c57a643c1c67783cf1.latin: 118:163 Iniquitátem ódio hábui, et abominátus sum: * legem autem tuam diléxi.
79c57a643c1c67783cf1.english: 118:163 I have hated and abhorred iniquity; * but I have loved thy law.

b4eb3c42a669348a3688.latin: 118:164 Sépties in die laudem dixi tibi, * super iudícia iustítiæ tuæ.
b4eb3c42a669348a3688.english: 118:164 Seven times a day I have given praise to thee, * for the judgments of thy justice.

c830e1263906e1f70acf.latin: 118:165 Pax multa diligéntibus legem tuam: * et non est illis scándalum.
c830e1263906e1f70acf.english: 118:165 Much peace have they that love thy law, * and to them there is no stumbling-block.

c822e669a697fe7fa4c1.latin: 118:166 Exspectábam salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et mandáta tua diléxi.
c822e669a697fe7fa4c1.english: 118:166 I looked for thy salvation, O Lord: * and I loved thy commandments.

127e80a2749854115efa.latin: 118:167 Custodívit ánima mea testimónia tua: * et diléxit ea veheménter.
127e80a2749854115efa.english: 118:167 My soul hath kept thy testimonies: * and hath loved them exceedingly.

4de0bd6b17dfa4323fc9.latin: 118:168 Servávi mandáta tua, et testimónia tua: * quia omnes viæ meæ in conspéctu tuo.
4de0bd6b17dfa4323fc9.english: 118:168 I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies: * because all my ways are in thy sight.

cf9643b66fee165b0dda.latin: 118:169 (Thau) Appropínquet deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine: * iuxta elóquium tuum da mihi intelléctum.
cf9643b66fee165b0dda.english: 118:169 (Tau) Let my supplication, O Lord, come near in thy sight: * give me understanding according to thy word.

2a60bc849b48d3635646.latin: 118:170 Intret postulátio mea in conspéctu tuo: * secúndum elóquium tuum éripe me.
2a60bc849b48d3635646.english: 118:170 Let my request come in before thee; * deliver thou me according to thy word.

7b635ea4899459fd7137.latin: 118:171 Eructábunt lábia mea hymnum, * cum docúeris me iustificatiónes tuas.
7b635ea4899459fd7137.english: 118:171 My lips shall utter a hymn, * when thou shalt teach me thy justifications.

3576ae817f56a149a2e4.latin: 118:172 Pronuntiábit lingua mea elóquium tuum: * quia ómnia mandáta tua ǽquitas.
3576ae817f56a149a2e4.english: 118:172 My tongue shall pronounce thy word: * because all thy commandments are justice.

428b360cbed89a16dd2e.latin: 118:173 Fiat manus tua ut salvet me: * quóniam mandáta tua elégi.
428b360cbed89a16dd2e.english: 118:173 Let thy hand be with me to save me; * for I have chosen thy precepts.

7b42b9b3ce50d17965a5.latin: 118:174 Concupívi salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et lex tua meditátio mea est.
7b42b9b3ce50d17965a5.english: 118:174 I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; * and thy law is my meditation.

a75ac7c9a379f4529760.latin: 118:175 Vivet ánima mea, et laudábit te: * et iudícia tua adiuvábunt me.
a75ac7c9a379f4529760.english: 118:175 My soul shall live and shall praise thee: * and thy judgments shall help me.

f858803ccc12fd16f5e4.latin: 118:176 Errávi, sicut ovis, quæ périit: * quære servum tuum, quia mandáta tua non sum oblítus.
f858803ccc12fd16f5e4.english: 118:176 I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: * seek thy servant, because I have not forgotten thy commandments.

b5a3ceef94ec37b89a81.latin:
Sir 2:11
Respícite fílii natiónes hóminum: et scitóte quia nullus sperávit in Dómino et confúsus est.
℟. Deo grátias.
℣. Iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo, Dómine.
℟. Et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
b5a3ceef94ec37b89a81.english:
Sir 2:11
Respícite fílii natiónes hóminum: et scitóte quia nullus sperávit in Dómino et confúsus est.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℣. Justi confitebúntur nómini tuo, Dómine.
℟. Et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.

70631e24995224792b25.latin:
Sir 2:7-8
Metuéntes Dóminum, sustinéte misericórdiam eius: et non deflectátis ab illo, ne cadátis. Qui timétis Dóminum, crédite illi: et non evacuábitur merces vestra.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Óculi Dómini * Super metuéntes eum.
℟. Óculi Dómini * Super metuéntes eum.
℣. Et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia eius.
℟. Super metuéntes eum.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Óculi Dómini * Super metuéntes eum.
Hymnus
Inclytos Christi fámulos canámus,
Quos, fide claros nitidísque gestis,
Hac die tellus sociáta cælo
Láudibus ornat.
Quippe qui mites, húmiles, pudíci,
Nésciam culpæ coluére vitam,
Donec e terris ánimus volávit
Liber ad astra.
Inde iam gaudent míseris adésse,
Fléntium tergunt lácrimas, medéntur
Méntium plagis, vitiáta reddunt
Membra salúti.
Nostra laus ergo résonet benígnis
His Dei servis referátque grates,
Qui pia pergant ope nos iuváre
Rebus in arctis.
Sit Deo soli decus et potéstas,
Laus in excélsis honor ac perénnis,
Qui suis totum móderans gubérnat
Légibus orbem.
Amen.
℣. Iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo, Dómine.
℟. Et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
70631e24995224792b25.english:
Sir 2:7-8
