6c6e9515feb8f9842fe8.english: 73:11 Why dost thou turn away thy hand: and thy right hand * out of the midst of thy bosom for ever?

ed96527e55e90449f9aa.latin: 73:12 Deus autem Rex noster ante sǽcula: * operátus est salútem in médio terræ.
ed96527e55e90449f9aa.english: 73:12 But God is our king before ages: * he hath wrought salvation in the midst of the earth.

75ffd857c82c8928f3ee.latin: 73:13 Tu confirmásti in virtúte tua mare: * contribulásti cápita dracónum in aquis.
75ffd857c82c8928f3ee.english: 73:13 Thou by thy strength didst make the sea firm: * thou didst crush the heads of the dragons in the waters.

97450984726198500ddf.latin: 73:14 Tu confregísti cápita dracónis: * dedísti eum escam pópulis Æthíopum.
97450984726198500ddf.english: 73:14 Thou hast broken the heads of the dragon: * thou hast given him to be meat for the people of the Ethiopians.

c57aeab716535bdadba2.latin: 73:15 Tu dirupísti fontes, et torréntes: * tu siccásti flúvios Ethan.
c57aeab716535bdadba2.english: 73:15 Thou hast broken up the fountains and the torrents: * thou hast dried up the Ethan rivers.

1dfaaab1915f89af1c1e.latin: 73:16 Tuus est dies, et tua est nox: * tu fabricátus es auróram et solem.
1dfaaab1915f89af1c1e.english: 73:16 Thine is the day, and thine is the night: * thou hast made the morning light and the sun.

36a85b6bdc8cee7a199f.latin: 73:17 Tu fecísti omnes términos terræ: * æstátem et ver tu plasmásti ea.
36a85b6bdc8cee7a199f.english: 73:17 Thou hast made all the borders of the earth: * the summer and the spring were formed by thee.

245b67e8a89bad4d37d1.latin: 73:18 Memor esto huius, inimícus improperávit Dómino: * et pópulus insípiens incitávit nomen tuum.
245b67e8a89bad4d37d1.english: 73:18 Remember this, the enemy hath reproached the Lord: * and a foolish people hath provoked thy name.

b0284c60510c897f836f.latin: 73:19 Ne tradas béstiis ánimas confiténtes tibi, * et ánimas páuperum tuórum ne obliviscáris in finem.
b0284c60510c897f836f.english: 73:19 Deliver not up to beasts the souls that confess to thee: * and forget not to the end the souls of thy poor.

ea4127c11ba4a86ed68a.latin: 73:20 Réspice in testaméntum tuum: * quia repléti sunt, qui obscuráti sunt terræ dómibus iniquitátum.
ea4127c11ba4a86ed68a.english: 73:20 Have regard to thy covenant: * for they that are the obscure of the earth have been filled with dwellings of iniquity.

fcf6b8b2bd47df459e93.latin: 73:21 Ne avertátur húmilis factus confúsus: * pauper et inops laudábunt nomen tuum.
fcf6b8b2bd47df459e93.english: 73:21 Let not the humble be turned away with confusion: * the poor and needy shall praise thy name.

6333575f618e40a733e6.latin: 73:22 Exsúrge, Deus, iúdica causam tuam: * memor esto improperiórum tuórum, eórum quæ ab insipiénte sunt tota die.
6333575f618e40a733e6.english: 73:22 Arise, O God, judge thy own cause: * remember thy reproaches with which the foolish man hath reproached thee all the day.

c3885d40d343eb3481f6.latin: 73:23 Ne obliviscáris voces inimicórum tuórum: * supérbia eórum, qui te odérunt, ascéndit semper.
c3885d40d343eb3481f6.english: 73:23 Forget not the voices of thy enemies: * the pride of them that hate thee ascendeth continually.

38a669a431c134b8b1db.latin: 74:2 Confitébimur tibi, Deus: * confitébimur, et invocábimus nomen tuum.
38a669a431c134b8b1db.english: 74:2 We will praise thee, O God: * we will praise, and we will call upon thy name.

1cb52a69b5c5e3552c6b.latin: 74:3 Narrábimus mirabília tua: * cum accépero tempus, ego iustítias iudicábo.
1cb52a69b5c5e3552c6b.english: 74:3 We will relate thy wondrous works: * when I shall take a time, I will judge justices.

7f4da4937936075767db.latin: 74:4 Liquefácta est terra, et omnes qui hábitant in ea: * ego confirmávi colúmnas eius.
7f4da4937936075767db.english: 74:4 The earth is melted, and all that dwell therein: * I have established the pillars thereof.

313c4cde0c46ee8a21da.latin: 74:5 Dixi iníquis: Nolíte iníque ágere: * et delinquéntibus: Nolíte exaltáre cornu:
313c4cde0c46ee8a21da.english: 74:5 I said to the wicked: Do not act wickedly: * and to the sinners: Lift not up the horn.

2a64d4ab9eec01bd1853.latin: 74:6 Nolíte extóllere in altum cornu vestrum: * nolíte loqui advérsus Deum iniquitátem.
2a64d4ab9eec01bd1853.english: 74:6 Lift not up your horn on high: * speak not iniquity against God.

c2e2f85338830dc90317.latin: 74:7 Quia neque ab Oriénte, neque ab Occidénte, neque a desértis móntibus: * quóniam Deus iudex est.
c2e2f85338830dc90317.english: 74:7 For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the desert hills: * for God is the judge.

f3fa389298c7c3f4663a.latin: 74:8 Hunc humíliat, et hunc exáltat: * quia calix in manu Dómini vini meri plenus misto.
f3fa389298c7c3f4663a.english: 74:8 One he putteth down, and another he lifteth up: * for in the hand of the Lord there is a cup of strong wine full of mixture.

563ce2f062fe74d1fd17.latin: 74:9 Et inclinávit ex hoc in hoc: verúmtamen fæx eius non est exinaníta: * bibent omnes peccatóres terræ.
563ce2f062fe74d1fd17.english: 74:9 And he hath poured it out from this to that: but the dregs thereof are not emptied: * all the sinners of the earth shall drink.

063d858ee178736f80a9.latin: 74:10 Ego autem annuntiábo in sǽculum: * cantábo Deo Iacob.
063d858ee178736f80a9.english: 74:10 But I will declare for ever: * I will sing to the God of Jacob.

3895c12cca6c10fc0a75.latin: 74:11 Et ómnia córnua peccatórum confríngam: * et exaltabúntur córnua iusti.
3895c12cca6c10fc0a75.english: 74:11 And I will break all the horns of sinners: * but the horns of the just shall be exalted.

4e8ff66a4890de9a5888.english: Ant. Thou hast redeemed the rod of Thine inheritance.

d597feb0e4325d872288.latin: Ant. Tu es Deus * qui facis mirabília.
d597feb0e4325d872288.english: Ant. Thou art the God * That doest wonders.

85da2285f0ccd6875e7a.latin: 76:2 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Deum, et inténdit mihi.
85da2285f0ccd6875e7a.english: 76:2 I cried to the Lord with my voice; * to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

10f015ce9ac36b53a905.latin: 76:3 In die tribulatiónis meæ Deum exquisívi, mánibus meis nocte contra eum: * et non sum decéptus.
10f015ce9ac36b53a905.english: 76:3 In the day of my trouble I sought God, with my hands lifted up to him in the night, * and I was not deceived.

f72699e4e2c293d68ae2.latin: 76:4 Rénuit consolári ánima mea, * memor fui Dei, et delectátus sum, et exercitátus sum: et defécit spíritus meus.
f72699e4e2c293d68ae2.english: 76:4 My soul refused to be comforted: * I remembered God, and was delighted, and was exercised, and my spirit swooned away.

c3ab26e67f1d9eeae2c6.latin: 76:5 Anticipavérunt vigílias óculi mei: * turbátus sum, et non sum locútus.
c3ab26e67f1d9eeae2c6.english: 76:5 My eyes prevented the watches: * I was troubled, and I spoke not.

7af298e1ba61c8567799.latin: 76:6 Cogitávi dies antíquos: * et annos ætérnos in mente hábui.
7af298e1ba61c8567799.english: 76:6 I thought upon the days of old: * and I had in my mind the eternal years.

4f50625d45732aee94a2.latin: 76:7 Et meditátus sum nocte cum corde meo, * et exercitábar, et scopébam spíritum meum.
4f50625d45732aee94a2.english: 76:7 And I meditated in the night with my own heart: * and I was exercised and I swept my spirit.

7aed88ce4dc70c3a2c62.latin: 76:8 Numquid in ætérnum proíciet Deus: * aut non appónet ut complacítior sit adhuc?
7aed88ce4dc70c3a2c62.english: 76:8 Will God then cast off for ever? * or will he never be more favourable again?

ed29f25d7d5cbf6d9b38.latin: 76:9 Aut in finem misericórdiam suam abscíndet, * a generatióne in generatiónem?
ed29f25d7d5cbf6d9b38.english: 76:9 Or will he cut off his mercy for ever, * from generation to generation?

43ca323034499299e202.latin: 76:10 Aut obliviscétur miseréri Deus? * aut continébit in ira sua misericórdias suas?
43ca323034499299e202.english: 76:10 Or will God forget to shew mercy? * or will he in his anger shut up his mercies?

e4a41c0406062ece8323.latin: 76:11 Et dixi: Nunc cœpi: * hæc mutátio déxteræ Excélsi.
e4a41c0406062ece8323.english: 76:11 And I said, Now have I begun: * this is the change of the right hand of the most High.

9ff7ba532391c7497232.latin: 76:12 Memor fui óperum Dómini: * quia memor ero ab inítio mirabílium tuórum.
9ff7ba532391c7497232.english: 76:12 I remembered the works of the Lord: * for I will be mindful of thy wonders from the beginning.

8e5ca762a90f59744387.latin: 76:13 Et meditábor in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * et in adinventiónibus tuis exercébor.
8e5ca762a90f59744387.english: 76:13 And I will meditate on all thy works: * and will be employed in thy inventions.

d2c8721086a15b16db6c.latin: 76:14 Deus, in sancto via tua: quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster? * tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.
d2c8721086a15b16db6c.english: 76:14 Thy way, O God, is in the holy place: who is the great God like our God? * Thou art the God that dost wonders.

92536dbf952063a81dbd.latin: 76:15 Notam fecísti in pópulis virtútem tuam: * redemísti in brácchio tuo pópulum tuum, fílios Iacob et Ioseph.
92536dbf952063a81dbd.english: 76:15 Thou hast made thy power known among the nations: * with thy arm thou hast redeemed thy people, the children of Jacob and of Joseph.

2f649c9990662d797100.latin: 76:17 Vidérunt te aquæ, Deus, vidérunt te aquæ: * et timuérunt, et turbátæ sunt abýssi.
2f649c9990662d797100.english: 76:17 The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee: * and they were afraid, and the depths were troubled.

546badbca7d4c26ea145.latin: 76:18 Multitúdo sónitus aquárum: * vocem dedérunt nubes.
546badbca7d4c26ea145.english: 76:18 Great was the noise of the waters: * the clouds sent out a sound.

27c6452e58ea74bb805e.latin: 76:18 Étenim sagíttæ tuæ tránseunt: * vox tonítrui tui in rota.
27c6452e58ea74bb805e.english: 76:18 For thy arrows pass: * the voice of thy thunder in a wheel.

cb470e0bea5c01f37bb1.latin: 76:19 Illuxérunt coruscatiónes tuæ orbi terræ: * commóta est, et contrémuit terra.
cb470e0bea5c01f37bb1.english: 76:19 Thy lightnings enlightened the world: * the earth shook and trembled.

b9103c527c2192e9d8cf.latin: 76:20 In mari via tua, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: * et vestígia tua non cognoscéntur.
b9103c527c2192e9d8cf.english: 76:20 Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters: * and thy footsteps shall not be known.

ba918b86b48df327cf08.latin: 76:21 Deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum, * in manu Móysi et Aaron.
ba918b86b48df327cf08.english: 76:21 Thou hast conducted thy people like sheep, * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

453569386bd6c44993b5.latin: Ant. Tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.
453569386bd6c44993b5.english: Ant. Thou art the God That doest wonders.

8d56c033bd3ce750799a.latin: Ant. Inclináte * aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
8d56c033bd3ce750799a.english: Ant. Incline your ears * to the words of My mouth.

f2c2325686a98905aaad.latin: 77:1 Atténdite, pópule meus, legem meam: * inclináte aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
f2c2325686a98905aaad.english: 77:1 Attend, O my people, to my law: * incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

8b8cc7ceb0e0fa1e039e.latin: 77:2 Apériam in parábolis os meum: * loquar propositiónes ab inítio.
8b8cc7ceb0e0fa1e039e.english: 77:2 I will open my mouth in parables: * I will utter propositions from the beginning.

6b4416a6e5e23295c9e4.latin: 77:3 Quanta audívimus et cognóvimus ea: * et patres nostri narravérunt nobis.
6b4416a6e5e23295c9e4.english: 77:3 How great things have we heard and known, * and our fathers have told us.

026acfbe413edad99b05.latin: 77:4 Non sunt occultáta a fíliis eórum: * in generatióne áltera.
026acfbe413edad99b05.english: 77:4 They have not been hidden from their children, * in another generation.

48e0ff8a5891c164ec2b.latin: 77:4 Narrántes laudes Dómini, et virtútes eius: * et mirabília eius, quæ fecit.
48e0ff8a5891c164ec2b.english: 77:4 Declaring the praises of the Lord, and his powers, * and his wonders which he hath done.

96d57273c58c9b5381cb.latin: 77:5 Et suscitávit testimónium in Iacob: * et legem pósuit in Israël.
96d57273c58c9b5381cb.english: 77:5 And he set up a testimony in Jacob: * and made a law in Israel.

727aadcfdd29f20d44f7.latin: 77:5 Quanta mandávit pátribus nostris nota fácere ea fíliis suis: * ut cognóscat generátio áltera.
727aadcfdd29f20d44f7.english: 77:5 How great things he commanded our fathers, that they should make the same known to their children: * that another generation might know them.

b8c31c2e48ec913e9c9f.latin: 77:6 Fílii qui nascéntur, et exsúrgent, * et narrábunt fíliis suis.
b8c31c2e48ec913e9c9f.english: 77:6 The children that should be born and should rise up, * and declare them to their children.

cfbb33f67df709345f85.latin: 77:7 Ut ponant in Deo spem suam, et non obliviscántur óperum Dei: * et mandáta eius exquírant.
cfbb33f67df709345f85.english: 77:7 That they may put their hope in God and may not forget the works of God: * and may seek his commandments.

cfe86949a05bc1992a4f.latin: 77:8 Ne fiant sicut patres eórum: * generátio prava et exásperans.
cfe86949a05bc1992a4f.english: 77:8 That they may not become like their fathers, * a perverse and exasperating generation.

81c946dffa11a8fde905.latin: 77:8 Generátio, quæ non diréxit cor suum: * et non est créditus cum Deo spíritus eius.
81c946dffa11a8fde905.english: 77:8 A generation that set not their heart aright: * and whose spirit was not faithful to God.

552eb9d3ef86eeed8853.latin: 77:9 Fílii Ephrem intendéntes et mitténtes arcum: * convérsi sunt in die belli.
552eb9d3ef86eeed8853.english: 77:9 The sons of Ephraim who bend and shoot with the bow: * they have turned back in the day of battle.

5b641dfdb069bd3e8f18.latin: 77:10 Non custodiérunt testaméntum Dei: * et in lege eius noluérunt ambuláre.
5b641dfdb069bd3e8f18.english: 77:10 They kept not the covenant of God: * and in his law they would not walk.

b3c64c825bc974f1d120.latin: 77:11 Et oblíti sunt benefactórum eius: * et mirabílium eius quæ osténdit eis.
b3c64c825bc974f1d120.english: 77:11 And they forgot his benefits, * and his wonders that he had shewn them.

a89f09c25b7b66bf5eb3.latin: 77:12 Coram pátribus eórum fecit mirabília in terra Ægýpti: * in campo Táneos.
a89f09c25b7b66bf5eb3.english: 77:12 Wonderful things did he do in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, * in the field of Tanis.

12d12203c7b332b5b57a.latin: 77:13 Interrúpit mare, et perdúxit eos: * et státuit aquas quasi in utre.
12d12203c7b332b5b57a.english: 77:13 He divided the sea and brought them through: * and he made the waters to stand as in a vessel.

055e795d5c7a637d28a6.latin: 77:14 Et dedúxit eos in nube diéi: * et tota nocte in illuminatióne ignis.
055e795d5c7a637d28a6.english: 77:14 And he conducted them with a cloud by day: * and all the night with a light of fire.

27b3efd0d809534fca13.latin: 77:15 Interrúpit petram in erémo: * et adaquávit eos velut in abýsso multa.
27b3efd0d809534fca13.english: 77:15 He struck the rock in the wilderness: * and gave them to drink, as out of the great deep.

5362546449d79ad5b3eb.latin: 77:16 Et edúxit aquam de petra: * et dedúxit tamquam flúmina aquas.
5362546449d79ad5b3eb.english: 77:16 He brought forth water out of the rock: * and made streams run down as rivers.

18a0cfb5bca3faf313bd.latin: 77:17 Et apposuérunt adhuc peccáre ei: * in iram excitavérunt Excélsum in inaquóso.
18a0cfb5bca3faf313bd.english: 77:17 And they added yet more sin against him: * they provoked the most High to wrath in the place without water.

db4bf8643aeba88070ed.latin: 77:18 Et tentavérunt Deum in córdibus suis, * ut péterent escas animábus suis.
db4bf8643aeba88070ed.english: 77:18 And they tempted God in their hearts, * by asking meat for their desires.

381f41dd56d5662cc4a5.latin: 77:19 Et male locúti sunt de Deo: * dixérunt: Numquid póterit Deus paráre mensam in desérto?
381f41dd56d5662cc4a5.english: 77:19 And they spoke ill of God: * they said: Can God furnish a table in the wilderness?

168459ec7bd46786f09e.latin: 77:20 Quóniam percússit petram, et fluxérunt aquæ: * et torréntes inundavérunt.
168459ec7bd46786f09e.english: 77:20 Because he struck the rock, and the waters gushed out, * and the streams overflowed.

35765d9bb33441fc2c31.latin: 77:20 Numquid et panem póterit dare, * aut paráre mensam pópulo suo?
35765d9bb33441fc2c31.english: 77:20 Can he also give bread, * or provide a table for his people?

dcf9767defbff941b394.latin: 77:21 Ídeo audívit Dóminus, et dístulit: * et ignis accénsus est in Iacob, et ira ascéndit in Israël.
dcf9767defbff941b394.english: 77:21 Therefore the Lord heard, and was angry: * and a fire was kindled against Jacob, and wrath came up against Israel.

9ab05996cbe0319a3b68.latin: 77:22 Quia non credidérunt in Deo: * nec speravérunt in salutári eius:
9ab05996cbe0319a3b68.english: 77:22 Because they believed not in God: * and trusted not in his salvation.

9d3931afafdda5a61f6e.latin: 77:23 Et mandávit núbibus désuper: * et iánuas cæli apéruit.
9d3931afafdda5a61f6e.english: 77:23 And he had commanded the clouds from above, * and had opened the doors of heaven.

4c179a4123c3d1fea652.latin: 77:24 Et pluit illis manna ad manducándum: * et panem cæli dedit eis.
4c179a4123c3d1fea652.english: 77:24 And had rained down manna upon them to eat, * and had given them the bread of heaven.

a282e847e09776b4b9a9.latin: 77:25 Panem Angelórum manducávit homo, * cibária misit eis in abundántia.
a282e847e09776b4b9a9.english: 77:25 Man ate the bread of angels: * he sent them provisions in abundance.

f23078b0c3d96c5dceb0.latin: 77:26 Tránstulit Austrum de cælo: * et indúxit in virtúte sua Áfricum.
f23078b0c3d96c5dceb0.english: 77:26 He removed the south wind from heaven: * and by his power brought in the southwest wind.

956d0c0aafc0a904ad03.latin: 77:27 Et pluit super eos sicut púlverem carnes: * et sicut arénam maris volatília pennáta.
956d0c0aafc0a904ad03.english: 77:27 And he rained upon them flesh as dust: * and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea.

93c1f23b144b45fb8cc4.latin: 77:28 Et cecidérunt in médio castrórum eórum: * circa tabernácula eórum.
93c1f23b144b45fb8cc4.english: 77:28 And they fell in the midst of their camp, * round about their pavilions.

ccaf239af6e8092a4522.latin: 77:29 Et manducavérunt, et saturáti sunt nimis, et desidérium eórum áttulit eis: * non sunt fraudáti a desidério suo.
ccaf239af6e8092a4522.english: 77:29 So they did eat, and were filled exceedingly, and he gave them their desire: * they were not defrauded of that which they craved.

1ad70c500a66a39d22d4.latin: 77:30 Adhuc escæ eórum erant in ore ipsórum: * et ira Dei ascéndit super eos.
1ad70c500a66a39d22d4.english: 77:30 As yet their meat was in their mouth: * and the wrath of God came upon them.

024db169d2dbb417a849.latin: 77:31 Et occídit pingues eórum, * et eléctos Israël impedívit.
024db169d2dbb417a849.english: 77:31 And he slew the fat ones amongst them, * and brought down the chosen men of Israel.

8602ffeb39032fd78967.latin: 77:32 In ómnibus his peccavérunt adhuc: * et non credidérunt in mirabílibus eius.
8602ffeb39032fd78967.english: 77:32 In all these things they sinned still: * and they believed not for his wondrous works.

8a05fdd76a712904ce1d.latin: 77:33 Et defecérunt in vanitáte dies eórum: * et anni eórum cum festinatióne.
8a05fdd76a712904ce1d.english: 77:33 And their days were consumed in vanity, * and their years in haste.

2d724b251dd641bce2b2.latin: 77:34 Cum occíderet eos, quærébant eum: * et revertebántur, et dilúculo veniébant ad eum.
2d724b251dd641bce2b2.english: 77:34 When he slew them, then they sought him: * and they returned, and came to him early in the morning.

9abe228e2d2d4055e486.latin: 77:35 Et rememoráti sunt quia Deus adiútor est eórum: * et Deus excélsus redémptor eórum est.
9abe228e2d2d4055e486.english: 77:35 And they remembered that God was their helper: * and the most high God their redeemer.

10f829a2d0c5b45daf17.latin: 77:36 Et dilexérunt eum in ore suo, * et lingua sua mentíti sunt ei.
10f829a2d0c5b45daf17.english: 77:36 And they loved him with their mouth: * and with their tongue they lied unto him:

c5380e930e1eff1851a9.latin: 77:37 Cor autem eórum non erat rectum cum eo: * nec fidéles hábiti sunt in testaménto eius.
c5380e930e1eff1851a9.english: 77:37 But their heart was not right with him: * nor were they counted faithful in his covenant.

613d60b105428b58e538.latin: 77:38 Ipse autem est miséricors, et propítius fiet peccátis eórum: * et non dispérdet eos.
613d60b105428b58e538.english: 77:38 But he is merciful, and will forgive their sins: * and will not destroy them.

04ae8299f7128cb1be16.latin: 77:38 Et abundávit ut avérteret iram suam: * et non accéndit omnem iram suam:
04ae8299f7128cb1be16.english: 77:38 And many a time did he turn away his anger: * and did not kindle all his wrath.

9e39be324a65125274b1.latin: 77:39 Et recordátus est quia caro sunt: * spíritus vadens et non rédiens.
9e39be324a65125274b1.english: 77:39 And he remembered that they are flesh: * a wind that goeth and returneth not.

20aa5b9280044ee09ed7.latin: 77:40 Quóties exacerbavérunt eum in desérto, * in iram concitavérunt eum in inaquóso?
20aa5b9280044ee09ed7.english: 77:40 How often did they provoke him in the desert: * and move him to wrath in the place without water?

67a60bdf03011f53363a.latin: 77:41 Et convérsi sunt, et tentavérunt Deum: * et Sanctum Israël exacerbavérunt.
67a60bdf03011f53363a.english: 77:41 And they turned back and tempted God: * and grieved the holy one of Israel.

721b8261eb1ecbeffd1b.latin: 77:42 Non sunt recordáti manus eius, * die qua redémit eos de manu tribulántis.
721b8261eb1ecbeffd1b.english: 77:42 They remembered not his hand, * in the day that he redeemed them from the hand of him that afflicted them:

c07c0bcb69e1c3723ca9.latin: 77:43 Sicut pósuit in Ægýpto signa sua, * et prodígia sua in campo Táneos.
c07c0bcb69e1c3723ca9.english: 77:43 How he wrought his signs in Egypt, * and his wonders in the field of Tanis.

cb459aa6b3f321a6bfba.latin: 77:44 Et convértit in sánguinem flúmina eórum: * et imbres eórum, ne bíberent.
cb459aa6b3f321a6bfba.english: 77:44 And he turned their rivers into blood, * and their showers that they might not drink.

e91123fbecbd2157351d.latin: 77:45 Misit in eos cœnomyíam, et comédit eos: * et ranam, et dispérdidit eos.
e91123fbecbd2157351d.english: 77:45 He sent amongst them diverse sorts of flies, which devoured them: * and frogs which destroyed them.

16ba5a16c8ec60c33fa9.latin: 77:46 Et dedit ærúgini fructus eórum: * et labóres eórum locústæ.
16ba5a16c8ec60c33fa9.english: 77:46 And he gave up their fruits to the blast, * and their labours to the locust.

cfa37a8124a6d0c74beb.latin: 77:47 Et occídit in grándine víneas eórum: * et moros eórum in pruína.
cfa37a8124a6d0c74beb.english: 77:47 And he destroyed their vineyards with hail, * and their mulberry trees with hoarfrost.

fb5e307f8533715c9064.latin: 77:48 Et trádidit grándini iuménta eórum: * et possessiónem eórum igni.
fb5e307f8533715c9064.english: 77:48 And he gave up their cattle to the hail, * and their stock to the fire.

7255af8a8b7bac73fcc7.latin: 77:49 Misit in eos iram indignatiónis suæ: * indignatiónem, et iram, et tribulatiónem: immissiónes per ángelos malos.
7255af8a8b7bac73fcc7.english: 77:49 And he sent upon them the wrath of his indignation: * indignation and wrath and trouble, which he sent by evil angels.

649f6d3d7a8d2faa98b0.latin: 77:50 Viam fecit sémitæ iræ suæ, non pepércit a morte animábus eórum: * et iuménta eórum in morte conclúsit.
649f6d3d7a8d2faa98b0.english: 77:50 He made a way for a path to his anger: * he spared not their souls from death, and their cattle he shut up in death.

b69c5d732f25cdcfeff7.latin: 77:51 Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra Ægýpti: * primítias omnis labóris eórum in tabernáculis Cham.
b69c5d732f25cdcfeff7.english: 77:51 And he killed all the firstborn in the land of Egypt: * the firstfruits of all their labour in the tabernacles of Cham.

0d2b3736c21da7288348.latin: 77:52 Et ábstulit sicut oves pópulum suum: * et perdúxit eos tamquam gregem in desérto.
0d2b3736c21da7288348.english: 77:52 And he took away his own people as sheep: * and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

1a07757ec9d2eae5962b.latin: 77:53 Et dedúxit eos in spe, et non timuérunt: * et inimícos eórum opéruit mare.
1a07757ec9d2eae5962b.english: 77:53 And he brought them out in hope, and they feared not: * and the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

2266fd318da794c1d8d0.latin: 77:54 Et indúxit eos in montem sanctificatiónis suæ: * montem, quem acquisívit déxtera eius.
2266fd318da794c1d8d0.english: 77:54 And he brought them into the mountain of his sanctuary: * the mountain which his right hand had purchased.

f25e450ed535f4423e6d.latin: 77:54 Et eiécit a fácie eórum gentes: * et sorte divísit eis terram in funículo distributiónis.
f25e450ed535f4423e6d.english: 77:54 And he cast out the Gentiles before them: * and by lot divided to them their land by a line of distribution.

b287a54761e5763c7e29.latin: 77:55 Et habitáre fecit in tabernáculis eórum: * tribus Israël.
b287a54761e5763c7e29.english: 77:55 And he made the tribes of Israel * to dwell in their tabernacles.

a13b45360af7225fd619.latin: 77:56 Et tentavérunt, et exacerbavérunt Deum excélsum: * et testimónia eius non custodiérunt.
a13b45360af7225fd619.english: 77:56 Yet they tempted, and provoked the most high God: * and they kept not his testimonies.

4f4cd0e4a00f6b0320ba.latin: 77:57 Et avertérunt se, et non servavérunt pactum: * quemádmodum patres eórum convérsi sunt in arcum pravum.
4f4cd0e4a00f6b0320ba.english: 77:57 And they turned away, and kept not the covenant: * even like their fathers they were turned aside as a crooked bow.

b33d29585be0311b209b.latin: 77:58 In iram concitavérunt eum in cóllibus suis: * et in sculptílibus suis ad æmulatiónem eum provocavérunt.
b33d29585be0311b209b.english: 77:58 They provoked him to anger on their hills: * and moved him to jealousy with their graven things.

360109f3992c08e84368.latin: 77:59 Audívit Deus, et sprevit: * et ad níhilum redégit valde Israël.
360109f3992c08e84368.english: 77:59 God heard, and despised them, * and he reduced Israel exceedingly as it were to nothing.

ae3df19591f5da3d9c68.latin: 77:60 Et répulit tabernáculum Silo: * tabernáculum suum, ubi habitávit in homínibus.
ae3df19591f5da3d9c68.english: 77:60 And he put away the tabernacle of Silo, * his tabernacle where he dwelt among men.

82aa73f2444472a66bfe.latin: 77:61 Et trádidit in captivitátem virtútem eórum: * et pulchritúdinem eórum in manus inimíci.
82aa73f2444472a66bfe.english: 77:61 And he delivered their strength into captivity: * and their beauty into the hands of the enemy.

5ce06d7fcafec9950dbb.latin: 77:62 Et conclúsit in gládio pópulum suum: * et hereditátem suam sprevit.
5ce06d7fcafec9950dbb.english: 77:62 And he shut up his people under the sword: * and he despised his inheritance.

7b62c470ca1bc5660baa.latin: 77:63 Iúvenes eórum comédit ignis: * et vírgines eórum non sunt lamentátæ.
7b62c470ca1bc5660baa.english: 77:63 Fire consumed their young men: * and their maidens were not lamented.

c9d883f652e4bdc43c78.latin: 77:64 Sacerdótes eórum in gládio cecidérunt: * et víduæ eórum non plorabántur.
c9d883f652e4bdc43c78.english: 77:64 Their priests fell by the sword: * and their widows did not mourn.

10068474423a27eb4f1b.latin: 77:65 Et excitátus est tamquam dórmiens Dóminus: * tamquam potens crapulátus a vino.
10068474423a27eb4f1b.english: 77:65 And the Lord was awaked as one out of sleep, * and like a mighty man that hath been surfeited with wine.

3d525608e855e6686342.latin: 77:66 Et percússit inimícos suos in posterióra: * oppróbrium sempitérnum dedit illis.
3d525608e855e6686342.english: 77:66 And he smote his enemies on the hinder parts: * he put them to an everlasting reproach.

a8cbdba3e50e75c33716.latin: 77:67 Et répulit tabernáculum Ioseph: * et tribum Éphraim non elégit.
a8cbdba3e50e75c33716.english: 77:67 And he rejected the tabernacle of Joseph: * and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

8e6081d9cc1325b90328.latin: 77:68 Sed elégit tribum Iuda, * montem Sion quem diléxit.
8e6081d9cc1325b90328.english: 77:68 But he chose the tribe of Juda, * mount Sion which he loved.

2fb5b334d1f8bdce3cb2.latin: 77:69 Et ædificávit sicut unicórnium sanctifícium suum in terra, * quam fundávit in sǽcula.
2fb5b334d1f8bdce3cb2.english: 77:69 And he built his sanctuary as of unicorns, in the land * which he founded for ever.

c73b07ba0f51bd3df4a7.latin: 77:70 Et elégit David, servum suum, et sústulit eum de grégibus óvium: * de post fœtántes accépit eum,
c73b07ba0f51bd3df4a7.english: 77:70 And he chose his servant David, and took him from the flocks of sheep: * he brought him from following the ewes great with young,

eb7acccc10c8301818af.latin: 77:71 Páscere Iacob, servum suum, * et Israël, hereditátem suam:
eb7acccc10c8301818af.english: 77:71 To feed Jacob his servant, * and Israel his inheritance.

a37412be3a76979f7ccb.latin: 77:72 Et pavit eos in innocéntia cordis sui: * et in intelléctibus mánuum suárum dedúxit eos.
a37412be3a76979f7ccb.english: 77:72 And he fed them in the innocence of his heart: * and conducted them by the skilfulness of his hands.

4641c1056f1aea2d7671.latin: Ant. Inclináte aurem vestram in verba oris mei.
4641c1056f1aea2d7671.english: Ant. Incline your ears to the words of My mouth.

b55ebc974babc8cb4715.latin: Ant. Propítius esto * peccátis nostris, Dómine.
b55ebc974babc8cb4715.english: Ant. Forgive us our sins * O Lord.

c7f396ad6919036e8d31.latin: 78:1 Deus, venérunt gentes in hereditátem tuam, polluérunt templum sanctum tuum: * posuérunt Ierúsalem in pomórum custódiam.
c7f396ad6919036e8d31.english: 78:1 O God, the heathens are come into thy inheritance, they have defiled thy holy temple: * they have made Jerusalem as a place to keep fruit.

2842da4fc51f3601f82b.latin: 78:2 Posuérunt morticína servórum tuórum, escas volatílibus cæli: * carnes sanctórum tuórum béstiis terræ.
2842da4fc51f3601f82b.english: 78:2 They have given the dead bodies of thy servants to be meat for the fowls of the air: * the flesh of thy saints for the beasts of the earth.

7f9934c94b984fdb178e.latin: 78:3 Effudérunt sánguinem eórum tamquam aquam in circúitu Ierúsalem: * et non erat qui sepelíret.
7f9934c94b984fdb178e.english: 78:3 They have poured out their blood as water, round about Jerusalem, * and there was none to bury them.

1b0e0f411f363101d152.latin: 78:4 Facti sumus oppróbrium vicínis nostris: * subsannátio et illúsio his, qui in circúitu nostro sunt.
1b0e0f411f363101d152.english: 78:4 We are become a reproach to our neighbours: * a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

b7f25bed1762acd4a8de.latin: 78:5 Úsquequo, Dómine, irascéris in finem: * accendétur velut ignis zelus tuus?
b7f25bed1762acd4a8de.english: 78:5 How long, O Lord, wilt thou be angry for ever: * shall thy zeal be kindled like a fire?

c3803b0ae1042ef191dc.latin: 78:6 Effúnde iram tuam in gentes, quæ te non novérunt: * et in regna quæ nomen tuum non invocavérunt:
c3803b0ae1042ef191dc.english: 78:6 Pour out thy wrath upon the nations that have not known thee: * and upon the kingdoms that have not called upon thy name.

b1429faf9fc47352ce0e.latin: 78:7 Quia comedérunt Iacob: * et locum eius desolavérunt.
b1429faf9fc47352ce0e.english: 78:7 Because they have devoured Jacob; * and have laid waste his place.

7eac15c4a5ebf8168f36.latin: 78:8 Ne memíneris iniquitátum nostrárum antiquárum, cito antícipent nos misericórdiæ tuæ: * quia páuperes facti sumus nimis.
7eac15c4a5ebf8168f36.english: 78:8 Remember not our former iniquities: let thy mercies speedily prevent us, * for we are become exceeding poor.

76e5bbb239fa8689737f.latin: 78:9 Ádiuva nos, Deus, salutáris noster: et propter glóriam nóminis tui, Dómine, líbera nos: * et propítius esto peccátis nostris, propter nomen tuum:
76e5bbb239fa8689737f.english: 78:9 Help us, O God, our saviour: and for the glory of thy name, O Lord, deliver us: * and forgive us our sins for thy name’s sake:

0f2724a35839b4f8e7e5.latin: 78:10 Ne forte dicant in géntibus: Ubi est Deus eórum? * et innotéscat in natiónibus coram óculis nostris.
0f2724a35839b4f8e7e5.english: 78:10 Lest they should say among the Gentiles: Where is their God? * And let him be made known among the nations before our eyes,

98f413f88e9626c0d737.latin: 78:10 Últio sánguinis servórum tuórum, qui effúsus est: * intróeat in conspéctu tuo gémitus compeditórum.
98f413f88e9626c0d737.english: 78:10 By the revenging the blood of thy servants, which hath been shed: * let the sighing of the prisoners come in before thee.

0bbabcdbc537a63ba5fe.latin: 78:11 Secúndum magnitúdinem brácchii tui, * pósside fílios mortificatórum.
0bbabcdbc537a63ba5fe.english: 78:11 According to the greatness of thy arm, * take possession of the children of them that have been put to death.

8c43950ea8f850820672.latin: 78:12 Et redde vicínis nostris séptuplum in sinu eórum: * impropérium ipsórum, quod exprobravérunt tibi, Dómine.
8c43950ea8f850820672.english: 78:12 And render to our neighbours sevenfold in their bosom: * the reproach wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

abe98ec16d6b9f010fc0.latin: 78:13 Nos autem pópulus tuus, et oves páscuæ tuæ, * confitébimur tibi in sǽculum.
abe98ec16d6b9f010fc0.english: 78:13 But we thy people, and the sheep of thy pasture, * will give thanks to thee for ever.

36e8a24362dd1bbf6f54.latin: 78:13 In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábimus laudem tuam.
36e8a24362dd1bbf6f54.english: 78:13 We will shew forth thy praise, * unto generation and generation.

c2494dba11704ca6cfc7.latin: Ant. Propítius esto peccátis nostris, Dómine.
c2494dba11704ca6cfc7.english: Ant. Forgive us our sins O Lord.

5ee4203c05516f5a1ae0.english: ℣. Thy way, O God, is in the holy place.

8d1240e49e75d1c9daee.latin: ℟. Quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster.
8d1240e49e75d1c9daee.english: ℟. Who is the great God like our God?

1b7d8836d4db75a40ab5.latin:
℣. Iube, domne, benedícere.
Benedictio. In unitáte Sancti Spíritus, benedícat nos Pater et Fílius.
℟. Amen.
Lectio brevis
Sap 3:9
Qui confídunt in illo intélligent veritátem, et fidéles in dilectióne acquiéscent illi: quóniam donum et pax est eléctis eius.
℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
℟. Deo grátias.
℟.br. Exsultáte Deo, * Adiutóri nostro.
℟. Exsultáte Deo, * Adiutóri nostro.
℣. Iubiláte Deo Iacob.
℟. Adiutóri nostro.
℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Exsultáte Deo, * Adiutóri nostro.
1b7d8836d4db75a40ab5.english:
℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.
Benediction. In the unity of the Holy Ghost, may the Father and the Son bless us.
℟. Amen.
Short reading
Sap 3:9
They that trust in him, shall understand the truth: and they that are faithful in love shall rest in him: for grace and peace is to his elect.
℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.
℟. Thanks be to God.
℟.br. Sing aloud * unto God our strength.
℟. Sing aloud * unto God our strength.
℣. Sing aloud to the God of Jacob.
℟. Our strength
℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Sing aloud * unto God our strength

ea28342c5536f1500ce3.latin: 79:2 Qui regis Israël, inténde: * qui dedúcis velut ovem Ioseph.
ea28342c5536f1500ce3.english: 79:2 Give ear, O thou that rulest Israel: * thou that leadest Joseph like a sheep.

6174159d29f17ca01c76.latin: 79:2 Qui sedes super Chérubim, * manifestáre coram Éphraim, Béniamin, et Manásse.
6174159d29f17ca01c76.english: 79:2 Thou that sittest upon the cherubims, * shine forth before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasses.

7bfd0f1c2b1fff1aa392.latin: 79:3 Éxcita poténtiam tuam, et veni, * ut salvos fácias nos.
7bfd0f1c2b1fff1aa392.english: 79:3 Stir up thy might, and come * to save us.

d7e96e64a394ebbb2803.latin: 79:4 Deus, convérte nos: * et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.
d7e96e64a394ebbb2803.english: 79:4 Convert us, O God: * and shew us thy face, and we shall be saved.

82c9994f21c5617dae74.latin: 79:5 Dómine, Deus virtútum, * quoúsque irascéris super oratiónem servi tui?
82c9994f21c5617dae74.english: 79:5 O Lord God of hosts, * how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy servant?

8337ed295fdce99b358f.latin: 79:6 Cibábis nos pane lacrimárum: * et potum dabis nobis in lácrimis in mensúra?
8337ed295fdce99b358f.english: 79:6 How long wilt thou feed us with the bread of tears: * and give us for our drink tears in measure?

b3dcc184964a14fd91cb.latin: 79:7 Posuísti nos in contradictiónem vicínis nostris: * et inimíci nostri subsannavérunt nos.
b3dcc184964a14fd91cb.english: 79:7 Thou hast made us to be a contradiction to our neighbours: * and our enemies have scoffed at us.

330986eb97bc8e60bb7c.latin: 79:8 Deus virtútum, convérte nos: * et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.
330986eb97bc8e60bb7c.english: 79:8 O God of hosts, convert us: * and shew thy face, and we shall be saved.

6883c95fc6b6de58007b.latin: 79:9 Víneam de Ægýpto transtulísti: * eiecísti gentes, et plantásti eam.
6883c95fc6b6de58007b.english: 79:9 Thou hast brought a vineyard out of Egypt: * thou hast cast out the Gentiles and planted it.

54237d58946d59e63a89.latin: 79:10 Dux itíneris fuísti in conspéctu eius: * plantásti radíces eius, et implévit terram.
54237d58946d59e63a89.english: 79:10 Thou wast the guide of its journey in its sight: * thou plantedst the roots thereof, and it filled the land.

91f7073f3e2e866d8be0.latin: 79:11 Opéruit montes umbra eius: * et arbústa eius cedros Dei.
91f7073f3e2e866d8be0.english: 79:11 The shadow of it covered the hills: * and the branches thereof the cedars of God.

d088a41d22103ae1a63c.latin: 79:12 Exténdit pálmites suos usque ad mare: * et usque ad flumen propágines eius.
d088a41d22103ae1a63c.english: 79:12 It stretched forth its branches unto the sea, * and its boughs unto the river.

da3c007407dd6b410cd2.latin: 79:13 Ut quid destruxísti macériam eius: * et vindémiant eam omnes, qui prætergrediúntur viam?
da3c007407dd6b410cd2.english: 79:13 Why hast thou broken down the hedge thereof, * so that all they who pass by the way do pluck it?

128b7baf74cbdff7f7e7.latin: 79:14 Exterminávit eam aper de silva: * et singuláris ferus depástus est eam.
128b7baf74cbdff7f7e7.english: 79:14 The boar out of the wood hath laid it waste: * and a singular wild beast hath devoured it.

de0c55fd1b4346631825.latin: 79:15 Deus virtútum, convértere: * réspice de cælo, et vide, et vísita víneam istam.
de0c55fd1b4346631825.english: 79:15 Turn again, O God of hosts, * look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vineyard:

072dea6fb0dc541d8b44.latin: 79:16 Et pérfice eam, quam plantávit déxtera tua: * et super fílium hóminis, quem confirmásti tibi.
072dea6fb0dc541d8b44.english: 79:16 And perfect the same which thy right hand hath planted: * and upon the son of man whom thou hast confirmed for thyself.

9faf685d5c632a215812.latin: 79:17 Incénsa igni, et suffóssa * ab increpatióne vultus tui períbunt.
9faf685d5c632a215812.english: 79:17 Things set on fire and dug down * shall perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

4bbf7d4478131575d456.latin: 79:18 Fiat manus tua super virum déxteræ tuæ: * et super fílium hóminis, quem confirmásti tibi.
4bbf7d4478131575d456.english: 79:18 Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand: * and upon the son of man whom thou hast confirmed for thyself.

8ec314c458957ec343e8.latin: 79:19 Et non discédimus a te, vivificábis nos: * et nomen tuum invocábimus.
8ec314c458957ec343e8.english: 79:19 And we depart not from thee, thou shalt quicken us: * and we will call upon thy name.

08260c2518f395d46b61.latin: 79:20 Dómine, Deus virtútum, convérte nos: * et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.
08260c2518f395d46b61.english: 79:20 O Lord God of hosts, convert us: * and shew thy face, and we shall be saved.

0e8b6a6204c2007f988f.latin: 80:2 Exsultáte Deo, adiutóri nostro: * iubiláte Deo Iacob.
0e8b6a6204c2007f988f.english: 80:2 Rejoice to God, our helper: * sing aloud to the God of Jacob.

6b0099e87ebc9f8e62e3.latin: 80:3 Súmite psalmum, et date týmpanum: * psaltérium iucúndum cum cíthara.
6b0099e87ebc9f8e62e3.english: 80:3 Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel: * the pleasant psaltery with the harp.

b5413c1068b347c01065.latin: 80:4 Buccináte in Neoménia tuba, * in insígni die solemnitátis vestræ.
b5413c1068b347c01065.english: 80:4 Blow up the trumpet on the new moon, * on the noted day of your solemnity.

da671662b52983d46be5.latin: 80:5 Quia præcéptum in Israël est: * et iudícium Deo Iacob.
da671662b52983d46be5.english: 80:5 For it is a commandment in Israel, * and a judgment to the God of Jacob.

d38a4ee91aaa92eb2b75.latin: 80:6 Testimónium in Ioseph pósuit illud, cum exíret de terra Ægýpti: * linguam, quam non nóverat, audívit.
d38a4ee91aaa92eb2b75.english: 80:6 He ordained it for a testimony in Joseph, when he came out of the land of Egypt: * he heard a tongue which he knew not.

551b36c19941ae2faf42.latin: 80:7 Divértit ab onéribus dorsum eius: * manus eius in cóphino serviérunt.
551b36c19941ae2faf42.english: 80:7 He removed his back from the burdens: * his hands had served in baskets.

87a1421dd3994eb7cc04.latin: 80:8 In tribulatióne invocásti me, et liberávi te: * exaudívi te in abscóndito tempestátis: probávi te apud aquam contradictiónis.
87a1421dd3994eb7cc04.english: 80:8 Thou calledst upon me in affliction, and I delivered thee: * I heard thee in the secret place of tempest: I proved thee at the waters of contradiction.

464ca0762fa1eedb3b65.latin: 80:9 Audi, pópulus meus, et contestábor te: * Israël, si audíeris me, non erit in te deus recens, neque adorábis deum aliénum.
464ca0762fa1eedb3b65.english: 80:9 Hear, O my people, and I will testify to thee: * O Israel, if thou wilt hearken to me; there shall be no new god in thee: neither shalt thou adore a strange god.

f732d414212ecf875905.latin: 80:11 Ego enim sum Dóminus Deus tuus, qui edúxi te de terra Ægýpti: * diláta os tuum, et implébo illud.
f732d414212ecf875905.english: 80:11 For I am the Lord thy God, who brought thee out of the land of Egypt: * open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

1caeb8e17ee0d3100ce8.latin: 80:12 Et non audívit pópulus meus vocem meam: * et Israël non inténdit mihi.
1caeb8e17ee0d3100ce8.english: 80:12 But my people heard not my voice: * and Israel hearkened not to me.

b3a450b9805a8ecdf5c2.latin: 80:13 Et dimísi eos secúndum desidéria cordis eórum: * ibunt in adinventiónibus suis.
b3a450b9805a8ecdf5c2.english: 80:13 So I let them go according to the desires of their heart: * they shall walk in their own inventions.

3e001606bdfca0b63be4.latin: 80:14 Si pópulus meus audísset me: * Israël si in viis meis ambulásset:
3e001606bdfca0b63be4.english: 80:14 If my people had heard me: * if Israel had walked in my ways:

847fa30f7a67bbe9de43.latin: 80:15 Pro níhilo fórsitan inimícos eórum humiliássem: * et super tribulántes eos misíssem manum meam.
847fa30f7a67bbe9de43.english: 80:15 I should soon have humbled their enemies, * and laid my hand on them that troubled them.

1b16a8f222497dd06eff.latin: 80:16 Inimíci Dómini mentíti sunt ei: * et erit tempus eórum in sǽcula.
1b16a8f222497dd06eff.english: 80:16 The enemies of the Lord have lied to him: * and their time shall be for ever.

38364ae4342727cf2af3.latin: 80:17 Et cibávit eos ex ádipe fruménti: * et de petra, melle saturávit eos.
38364ae4342727cf2af3.english: 80:17 And he fed them with the fat of wheat, * and filled them with honey out of the rock.

717e5bc4971da48bfeb0.latin: 81:1 Deus stetit in synagóga deórum: * in médio autem deos diiúdicat.
717e5bc4971da48bfeb0.english: 81:1 God hath stood in the congregation of gods: * and being in the midst of them he judgeth gods.

8e280b06c9e27f80219f.latin: 81:2 Úsquequo iudicátis iniquitátem: * et fácies peccatórum súmitis?
8e280b06c9e27f80219f.english: 81:2 How long will you judge unjustly: * and accept the persons of the wicked?

5c6f19ce5c64e0fd1ea6.latin: 81:3 Iudicáte egéno, et pupíllo: * húmilem, et páuperem iustificáte.
5c6f19ce5c64e0fd1ea6.english: 81:3 Judge for the needy and fatherless: * do justice to the humble and the poor.

b4a4ec6ea84bebc3b745.latin: 81:4 Erípite páuperem: * et egénum de manu peccatóris liberáte.
b4a4ec6ea84bebc3b745.english: 81:4 Rescue the poor; * and deliver the needy out of the hand of the sinner.

7d65e1f3361dcdb398cf.latin: 81:5 Nesciérunt, neque intellexérunt, in ténebris ámbulant: * movebúntur ómnia fundaménta terræ.
7d65e1f3361dcdb398cf.english: 81:5 They have not known nor understood: they walk on in darkness: * all the foundations of the earth shall be moved.

2459d879f5ec423b3a9a.latin: 81:6 Ego dixi: Dii estis, * et fílii Excélsi omnes.
2459d879f5ec423b3a9a.english: 81:6 I have said: You are gods * and all of you the sons of the most High.

a7dafe21b47cbc67727b.latin: 81:7 Vos autem sicut hómines moriémini: * et sicut unus de princípibus cadétis.
a7dafe21b47cbc67727b.english: 81:7 But you like men shall die: * and shall fall like one of the princes.

e9c9767ff50d08343ee0.latin: 81:8 Surge, Deus, iúdica terram: * quóniam tu hereditábis in ómnibus géntibus.
e9c9767ff50d08343ee0.english: 81:8 Arise, O God, judge thou the earth: * for thou shalt inherit among all the nations.

84c8e0537bca95182157.latin: 82:2 Deus, quis símilis erit tibi? * Ne táceas, neque compescáris, Deus.
84c8e0537bca95182157.english: 82:2 O God, who shall be like to thee? * Hold not thy peace, neither be O God, thou still,

3bca41bdfc3075e4ab61.latin: 82:3 Quóniam ecce inimíci tui sonuérunt: * et qui odérunt te extulérunt caput.
3bca41bdfc3075e4ab61.english: 82:3 For lo, thy enemies have made a noise: * and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.

584ba267f80015f71ced.latin: 82:4 Super pópulum tuum malignavérunt consílium: * et cogitavérunt advérsus sanctos tuos.
584ba267f80015f71ced.english: 82:4 They have taken a malicious counsel against thy people, * and have consulted against thy saints.

f3b1240ef9aef60acc90.latin: 82:5 Dixérunt: Veníte, et disperdámus eos de gente: * et non memorétur nomen Israël ultra.
f3b1240ef9aef60acc90.english: 82:5 They have said: Come and let us destroy them, * so that they be not a nation: and let the name of Israel be remembered no more.

4369a91d60eeff1324b0.latin: 82:6 Quóniam cogitavérunt unanímiter: * simul advérsum te testaméntum disposuérunt, tabernácula Idumæórum et Ismahelítæ:
4369a91d60eeff1324b0.english: 82:6 For they have contrived with one consent: * they have made a covenant together against thee; the tabernacles of the Edomites, and the Ismahelites:

0bdabf010b5d565b531b.latin: 82:8 Moab, et Agaréni, Gebal, et Ammon, et Ámalec: * alienígenæ cum habitántibus Tyrum.
0bdabf010b5d565b531b.english: 82:8 Moab, and the Agarens, Gebal, and Ammon and Amalec: * the Philistines, with the inhabitants of Tyre.

552ae1b95b1fb375e2fe.latin: 82:9 Étenim Assur venit cum illis: * facti sunt in adiutórium fíliis Lot.
552ae1b95b1fb375e2fe.english: 82:9 Yea, and the Assyrian also is joined with them: * they are come to the aid of the sons of Lot.

66172b43067ad1be01aa.latin: 82:10 Fac illis sicut Mádian, et Sísaræ: * sicut Iabin in torrénte Cisson.
66172b43067ad1be01aa.english: 82:10 Do to them as thou didst to Madian and to Sisara: * as to Jabin at the brook of Cisson.

d7415acc0a3626c00907.latin: 82:11 Disperiérunt in Endor: * facti sunt ut stercus terræ.
d7415acc0a3626c00907.english: 82:11 Who perished at Endor: * and became as dung for the earth.

b5a25538551f046a86e8.latin: 82:12 Pone príncipes eórum sicut Oreb, et Zeb, * et Zébee, et Sálmana:
b5a25538551f046a86e8.english: 82:12 Make their princes like Oreb, and Zeb, * and Zebee, and Salmana.

0e8a8f359c8414a605a0.latin: 82:13 Omnes príncipes eórum: * qui dixérunt: Hereditáte possideámus Sanctuárium Dei.
0e8a8f359c8414a605a0.english: 82:13 All their princes, * who have said: Let us possess the sanctuary of God for an inheritance.

dd2f51897bc05bf2e0e1.latin: 82:14 Deus meus, pone illos ut rotam: * et sicut stípulam ante fáciem venti.
dd2f51897bc05bf2e0e1.english: 82:14 O my God, make them like a wheel; * and as stubble before the wind.

d8a604502cade0587a1e.latin: 82:15 Sicut ignis, qui combúrit silvam: * et sicut flamma combúrens montes:
d8a604502cade0587a1e.english: 82:15 As fire which burneth the wood: * and as a flame burning mountains:

74845a06125c26e2c4c4.latin: 82:16 Ita persequéris illos in tempestáte tua: * et in ira tua turbábis eos.
74845a06125c26e2c4c4.english: 82:16 So shalt thou pursue them with thy tempest: * and shalt trouble them in thy wrath.

3e48141b250a0a186e4a.latin: 82:17 Imple fácies eórum ignomínia: * et quærent nomen tuum, Dómine.
3e48141b250a0a186e4a.english: 82:17 Fill their faces with shame; * and they shall seek thy name, O Lord.

4c130bd38b3cb1bcda94.latin: 82:18 Erubéscant, et conturbéntur in sǽculum sǽculi: * et confundántur, et péreant.
4c130bd38b3cb1bcda94.english: 82:18 Let them be ashamed and troubled for ever and ever: * and let them be confounded and perish.

76d667f82bbc18149e03.latin: 82:19 Et cognóscant quia nomen tibi Dóminus: * tu solus Altíssimus in omni terra.
76d667f82bbc18149e03.english: 82:19 And let them know that the Lord is thy name: * thou alone art the most High over all the earth.

fe3c80166106c7486890.latin: 83:2 Quam dilécta tabernácula tua, Dómine virtútum: * concupíscit, et déficit ánima mea in átria Dómini.
fe3c80166106c7486890.english: 83:2 How lovely are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts! * my soul longeth and fainteth for the courts of the Lord.

d25941d4937fe126bf62.latin: 83:3 Cor meum, et caro mea * exsultavérunt in Deum vivum.
d25941d4937fe126bf62.english: 83:3 My heart and my flesh * have rejoiced in the living God.

e91be7f901983583bb2c.latin: 83:4 Étenim passer invénit sibi domum: * et turtur nidum sibi, ubi ponat pullos suos.
e91be7f901983583bb2c.english: 83:4 For the sparrow hath found herself a house, * and the turtledove a nest for herself where she may lay her young ones:

518ea86d92696045464b.latin: 83:4 Altária tua, Dómine virtútum: * Rex meus, et Deus meus.
518ea86d92696045464b.english: 83:4 Thy altars, O Lord of hosts, * my king and my God.

48f42749adb6a03afac7.latin: 83:5 Beáti, qui hábitant in domo tua, Dómine: * in sǽcula sæculórum laudábunt te.
48f42749adb6a03afac7.english: 83:5 Blessed are they that dwell in thy house, O Lord: * they shall praise thee for ever and ever.

8a76e2608c2a4d0d4235.latin: 83:6 Beátus vir, cuius est auxílium abs te: * ascensiónes in corde suo dispósuit, in valle lacrimárum in loco, quem pósuit.
8a76e2608c2a4d0d4235.english: 83:6 Blessed is the man whose help is from thee: * in his heart he hath disposed to ascend by steps, in the vale of tears, in the place which he hath set.

45323f09772c273994e6.latin: 83:8 Étenim benedictiónem dabit legislátor, ibunt de virtúte in virtútem: * vidébitur Deus deórum in Sion.
45323f09772c273994e6.english: 83:8 For the lawgiver shall give a blessing, they shall go from virtue to virtue: * the God of gods shall be seen in Sion.

6b9cc494107b0bbf95c4.latin: 83:9 Dómine, Deus virtútum, exáudi oratiónem meam: * áuribus pércipe, Deus Iacob.
6b9cc494107b0bbf95c4.english: 83:9 O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: * give ear, O God of Jacob.

2b86b84b8e3cb93ac27c.latin: 83:10 Protéctor noster, áspice, Deus: * et réspice in fáciem Christi tui:
2b86b84b8e3cb93ac27c.english: 83:10 Behold, O God our protector: * and look on the face of thy Christ.

d63b50c868ab8f7a1c85.latin: 83:11 Quia mélior est dies una in átriis tuis, * super míllia.
d63b50c868ab8f7a1c85.english: 83:11 For better is one day in thy courts * above thousands.

8a93c27c4fb98071a0c2.latin: 83:11 Elégi abiéctus esse in domo Dei mei: * magis quam habitáre in tabernáculis peccatórum.
8a93c27c4fb98071a0c2.english: 83:11 I have chosen to be an abject in the house of my God, * rather than to dwell in the tabernacles of sinners.

5442c53ea86519b2288b.latin: 83:12 Quia misericórdiam, et veritátem díligit Deus: * grátiam et glóriam dabit Dóminus.
5442c53ea86519b2288b.english: 83:12 For God loveth mercy and truth: * the Lord will give grace and glory.

318429addafbe4f7656f.latin: 83:13 Non privábit bonis eos, qui ámbulant in innocéntia: * Dómine virtútum, beátus homo, qui sperat in te.
318429addafbe4f7656f.english: 83:13 He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: * O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

1d1e9e33955bed820bc8.latin: 84:2 Benedixísti, Dómine, terram tuam: * avertísti captivitátem Iacob.
1d1e9e33955bed820bc8.english: 84:2 Lord, thou hast blessed thy land: * thou hast turned away the captivity of Jacob.

040d0c84c1b409d2b71c.latin: 84:3 Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.
040d0c84c1b409d2b71c.english: 84:3 Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people: * thou hast covered all their sins.

9815830baa29a101414b.latin: 84:4 Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.
9815830baa29a101414b.english: 84:4 Thou hast mitigated all thy anger: * thou hast turned away from the wrath of thy indignation.

fb7a90c03d8773af116d.latin: 84:5 Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
fb7a90c03d8773af116d.english: 84:5 Convert us, O God our saviour: * and turn off thy anger from us.

1948df4652a8a1b7cef4.latin: 84:6 Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?
1948df4652a8a1b7cef4.english: 84:6 Wilt thou be angry with us for ever: * or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation to generation?

e54bf8223784c6f0eb2c.latin: 84:7 Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
e54bf8223784c6f0eb2c.english: 84:7 Thou wilt turn, O God, and bring us to life: * and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

6a6ce3dc9d75f4b9f297.latin: 84:8 Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.
6a6ce3dc9d75f4b9f297.english: 84:8 Shew us, O Lord, thy mercy; * and grant us thy salvation.

3143a04b8f0816489821.latin: 84:9 Áudiam quid loquátur in me Dóminus Deus: * quóniam loquétur pacem in plebem suam.
3143a04b8f0816489821.english: 84:9 I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: * for he will speak peace.

64091f9a199431f24bcb.latin: 84:9 Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.
64091f9a199431f24bcb.english: 84:9 And unto his saints: * and unto them that are converted to the heart.

b288a5394fc757553c2d.latin: 84:10 Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.
b288a5394fc757553c2d.english: 84:10 Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: * that glory may dwell in our land.

6a35e72c49521fa7bbfd.latin: 84:11 Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * iustítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.
6a35e72c49521fa7bbfd.english: 84:11 Mercy and truth have met each other: * justice and peace have kissed.

1b4e34965cdf170c344a.latin: 84:12 Véritas de terra orta est: * et iustítia de cælo prospéxit.
1b4e34965cdf170c344a.english: 84:12 Truth is sprung out of the earth: * and justice hath looked down from heaven.

7b9ed02ac501d44e143d.latin: 84:13 Étenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
7b9ed02ac501d44e143d.english: 84:13 For the Lord will give goodness: * and our earth shall yield her fruit.

69212384ddf668b8d8c8.latin: 84:14 Iustítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.
69212384ddf668b8d8c8.english: 84:14 Justice shall walk before him: * and shall set his steps in the way.

c1a1ee3f53c1a3d9be39.latin: Ant. Tibi soli * peccávi, Dómine, miserére mei.
c1a1ee3f53c1a3d9be39.english: Ant. Before thee only have I sinned, * O Lord, have mercy on me.

8473bb4bb3fb04a0dcda.latin: Ant. Tibi soli peccávi, Dómine, miserére mei.
8473bb4bb3fb04a0dcda.english: Ant. Before thee only have I sinned, O Lord, have mercy on me.

5bb09df875eec93c2764.latin: Ant. Intret * orátio mea, in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
5bb09df875eec93c2764.english: Ant. Let my prayer * come in before thee.

8006638cf6bab68694b5.latin: 87:2 Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.
8006638cf6bab68694b5.english: 87:2 Lord, the God of my salvation: * I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.

d3d9e756829ffe764ed7.latin: 87:3 Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:
d3d9e756829ffe764ed7.english: 87:3 Let my prayer come in before thee: * incline thy ear to my petition.

a124bd8ef23c88fabe50.latin: 87:4 Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.
a124bd8ef23c88fabe50.english: 87:4 For my soul is filled with evils: * and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.

efb035c3968fbbfaadc3.latin: 87:5 Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adiutório, inter mórtuos liber.
efb035c3968fbbfaadc3.english: 87:5 I am counted among them that go down to the pit: * I am become as a man without help, free among the dead.

5823395baaa397d85707.latin: 87:6 Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.
5823395baaa397d85707.english: 87:6 Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: * and they are cast off from thy hand.

50547e799d5d36f8441b.latin: 87:7 Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.
50547e799d5d36f8441b.english: 87:7 They have laid me in the lower pit: * in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.

38ad4e3993a6a8e9ec2c.latin: 87:8 Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.
38ad4e3993a6a8e9ec2c.english: 87:8 Thy wrath is strong over me: * and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.

ecd5369d741d807ea99e.latin: 87:9 Longe fecísti notos meos a me: * posuérunt me abominatiónem sibi.
ecd5369d741d807ea99e.english: 87:9 Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me: * they have set me an abomination to themselves.

3f4cc07047b45af9c852.latin: 87:9 Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.
3f4cc07047b45af9c852.english: 87:9 I was delivered up, and came not forth: * my eyes languished through poverty.

de87e4d29803f1f869b6.latin: 87:10 Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.
de87e4d29803f1f869b6.english: 87:10 All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: * I stretched out my hands to thee.

56917edf77e0b7b9b072.latin: 87:11 Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?
56917edf77e0b7b9b072.english: 87:11 Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? * or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?

8cef1e0a53bd0f24795f.latin: 87:12 Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?
8cef1e0a53bd0f24795f.english: 87:12 Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: * and thy truth in destruction?

2ebb3793bb4a4913b272.latin: 87:13 Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et iustítia tua in terra obliviónis?
2ebb3793bb4a4913b272.english: 87:13 Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; * and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?

6684108b3357ea69df66.latin: 87:14 Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.
6684108b3357ea69df66.english: 87:14 But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: * and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

694766983fb68e5a324a.latin: 87:15 Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?
694766983fb68e5a324a.english: 87:15 Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: * why turnest thou away thy face from me?

41f5b71544e92417b6c4.latin: 87:16 Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a iuventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.
41f5b71544e92417b6c4.english: 87:16 I am poor, and in labours from my youth: * and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.

2479b252c41e84c483e7.latin: 87:17 In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.
2479b252c41e84c483e7.english: 87:17 Thy wrath hath come upon me: * and thy terrors have troubled me.

9dbf7bbb4b1b789c2cc7.latin: 87:18 Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.
9dbf7bbb4b1b789c2cc7.english: 87:18 They have come round about me like water all the day: * they have compassed me about together.

e5f3c9ce6cc94bf407d1.latin: 87:19 Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.
e5f3c9ce6cc94bf407d1.english: 87:19 Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: * and my acquaintance, because of misery.

f42ecaa16ad07eaecbd7.latin: Ant. Intret orátio mea, in conspéctu tuo, Dómine.
f42ecaa16ad07eaecbd7.english: Ant. Let my prayer come in before thee.

8eed1515398919b2fcec.latin: Ant. Dómine, * refúgium factus es nobis. ‡
8eed1515398919b2fcec.english: Ant. Lord, * thou hast been our refuge. ‡

42bb7fbec0ff2ecfe299.latin: 89:1 Dómine, refúgium factus es nobis: * ‡ a generatióne in generatiónem.
42bb7fbec0ff2ecfe299.english: 89:1 Lord, thou hast been our refuge * ‡ from generation to generation.

1e3e00a5fb58b9215c9e.latin: 89:2 Priúsquam montes fíerent, aut formarétur terra et orbis: * a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum tu es, Deus.
1e3e00a5fb58b9215c9e.english: 89:2 Before the mountains were made, or the earth and the world was formed; * from eternity and to eternity thou art God.

c05709ad72ccefd18f08.latin: 89:3 Ne avértas hóminem in humilitátem: * et dixísti: Convertímini, fílii hóminum.
c05709ad72ccefd18f08.english: 89:3 Turn not man away to be brought low: * and thou hast said: Be converted, O ye sons of men.

84489c34b867ab763c3e.latin: 89:4 Quóniam mille anni ante óculos tuos, * tamquam dies hestérna, quæ prætériit,
84489c34b867ab763c3e.english: 89:4 For a thousand years in thy sight * are as yesterday, which is past.

58ccf9ce4118b8dfb58d.latin: 89:5 Et custódia in nocte, * quæ pro níhilo habéntur, eórum anni erunt.
58ccf9ce4118b8dfb58d.english: 89:5 And as a watch in the night, * things that are counted nothing, shall their years be.

45b73ab247b157edbd56.latin: 89:6 Mane sicut herba tránseat, mane flóreat, et tránseat: * véspere décidat, indúret et aréscat.
45b73ab247b157edbd56.english: 89:6 In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: * in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.

106faf1258fe5a53174d.latin: 89:7 Quia defécimus in ira tua, * et in furóre tuo turbáti sumus.
106faf1258fe5a53174d.english: 89:7 For in thy wrath we have fainted away: * and are troubled in thy indignation.

861f1a3236fd1d66b561.latin: 89:8 Posuísti iniquitátes nostras in conspéctu tuo: * sǽculum nostrum in illuminatióne vultus tui.
861f1a3236fd1d66b561.english: 89:8 Thou hast set our iniquities before thy eyes: * our life in the light of thy countenance.

6e0dd5cf14f6fbf7e8ea.latin: 89:9 Quóniam omnes dies nostri defecérunt: * et in ira tua defécimus.
6e0dd5cf14f6fbf7e8ea.english: 89:9 For all our days are spent; * and in thy wrath we have fainted away.

2362522f54a5c7fd8dee.latin: 89:9 Anni nostri sicut aránea meditabúntur: * dies annórum nostrórum in ipsis, septuagínta anni.
2362522f54a5c7fd8dee.english: 89:9 Our years shall be considered as a spider: * the days of our years in them are threescore and ten years.

48efc486ba3e608a482b.latin: 89:10 Si autem in potentátibus, octogínta anni: * et ámplius eórum, labor et dolor.
48efc486ba3e608a482b.english: 89:10 But if in the strong they be fourscore years: * and what is more of them is labour and sorrow.

6be130476468e01a237d.english: 89:10 For mildness is come upon us: * and we shall be corrected.

b4d83f5f4969bd37eb96.latin: 89:11 Quis novit potestátem iræ tuæ: * et præ timóre tuo iram tuam dinumeráre?
b4d83f5f4969bd37eb96.english: 89:11 Who knoweth the power of thy anger, * and for thy fear can number thy wrath?

bc65c675f576ea3e9975.latin: 89:12 Déxteram tuam sic notam fac: * et erudítos corde in sapiéntia.
bc65c675f576ea3e9975.english: 89:12 So make thy right hand known: * and men learned in heart, in wisdom.

05f6176977943070f0aa.latin: 89:13 Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo? * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
05f6176977943070f0aa.english: 89:13 Return, O Lord, how long? * and be entreated in favour of thy servants.

59f21db651e0d599a112.latin: 89:14 Repléti sumus mane misericórdia tua: * et exsultávimus, et delectáti sumus ómnibus diébus nostris.
59f21db651e0d599a112.english: 89:14 We are filled in the morning with thy mercy: * and we have rejoiced, and are delighted all our days.

eaf35bd4284ebed9a25b.latin: 89:15 Lætáti sumus pro diébus, quibus nos humiliásti: * annis, quibus vídimus mala.
eaf35bd4284ebed9a25b.english: 89:15 We have rejoiced for the days in which thou hast humbled us: * for the years in which we have seen evils.

19ffa7b5f45ac23a91d1.latin: 89:16 Réspice in servos tuos, et in ópera tua: * et dírige fílios eórum.
19ffa7b5f45ac23a91d1.english: 89:16 Look upon thy servants and upon their works: * and direct their children.

8f70fde052a92be23502.latin: 89:17 Et sit splendor Dómini, Dei nostri, super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos: * et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.
8f70fde052a92be23502.english: 89:17 And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct thou the works of our hands over us; * yea, the work of our hands do thou direct.

d0737b05a795dbaa26f5.latin: Ant. Dómine, refúgium factus es nobis.
d0737b05a795dbaa26f5.english: Ant. Lord, thou hast been our refuge.

b6e0e9cdc542f16fab19.latin: 31:10 Audíte verbum Dómini, gentes, * et annuntiáte in ínsulis, quæ procul sunt,
b6e0e9cdc542f16fab19.english: 31:10 Hear the word of the Lord, O ye nations, * and declare it in the islands that are afar off,

227af266cb4d4c54c5ef.latin: 31:11 Et dícite: Qui dispérsit Israël, congregábit eum: * et custódiet eum sicut pastor gregem suum.
227af266cb4d4c54c5ef.english: 31:11 And say: He that scattered Israel will gather him: * and he will keep him as the shepherd doth his flock.

7ad8d772b1b0f654c066.latin: 31:12 Redémit enim Dóminus Iacob, * et liberávit eum de manu potentióris.
7ad8d772b1b0f654c066.english: 31:12 For the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, * and delivered him out of the hand of one that was mightier than he.

8a8df0e4a8d455157b19.latin: 31:13 Et vénient, et laudábunt in monte Sion: * et cónfluent ad bona Dómini,
8a8df0e4a8d455157b19.english: 31:13 And they shall come, and shall give praise in mount Sion: * and they shall flow together to the good things of the Lord,

4ab983c680dc3936cf4a.latin: 31:14 Super fruménto, et vino, et óleo, * et fœtu pécorum et armentórum:
4ab983c680dc3936cf4a.english: 31:14 For the corn, and wine, and oil, * and the increase of cattle and herds,

846917d6153164ae192f.latin: 31:15 Erítque ánima eórum quasi hortus irríguus, * et ultra non esúrient.
846917d6153164ae192f.english: 31:15 And their soul shall be as a watered garden, * and they shall be hungry no more.

9d433e8180ce359b98d2.latin: 31:16 Tunc lætábitur virgo in choro, * iúvenes et senes simul:
9d433e8180ce359b98d2.english: 31:16 Then shall the virgin rejoice in the dance, * the young men and old men together:

f48dc68384d8a35049cf.latin: 31:17 Et convértam luctum eórum in gáudium, * et consolábor eos, et lætificábo a dolóre suo.
f48dc68384d8a35049cf.english: 31:17 And I will turn their mourning into joy, * and will comfort them, and make them joyful after their sorrow.

0a0784fd8108257643b5.latin: 31:18 Et inebriábo ánimam sacerdótum pinguédine: * et pópulus meus bonis meis adimplébitur.
0a0784fd8108257643b5.english: 31:18 And I will fill the soul of the priests with fatness: * and my people shall be filled with my good things.

849aa93a0d37e2d143e0.english: Ant. My people said the Lord, shall be filled with good things.

7d12267fe29d790a0b42.english: Ant. Praise ye the Lord * in his holy places.
