1351d0bdea4dcf19a86d.latin: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor, animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum: ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur:
1351d0bdea4dcf19a86d.english: O God, who art thyself at once the Maker and the Redeemer of all thy faithful ones, grant unto the souls of thy servants and handmaids remission of all their sins, making of our entreaties unto our great Father a mean whereby they may have that forgiveness which they have ever hoped for.

cc5796511d7161abe534.english: Ant. The bones which thou hast broken * may rejoice.

1c27c7a3169edc3d945b.english: Ant. The bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

01d0c8a1549c1afab4bf.latin: Ant. Exáudi, Dómine, * oratiónem meam: ad te omnis caro véniet.
01d0c8a1549c1afab4bf.english: Ant. Lord, hear * my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.

3234b300be8897cf90f0.latin: 64:2 Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion: * et tibi reddétur votum in Ierúsalem.
3234b300be8897cf90f0.english: 64:2 A hymn, O God, becometh thee in Sion: * and a vow shall be paid to thee in Jerusalem.

f9c6246a07e91ef4189b.latin: Ant. Exáudi, Dómine, oratiónem meam: ad te omnis caro véniet.
f9c6246a07e91ef4189b.english: Ant. Lord, hear my prayer; unto thee shall all flesh come.

3eaefcab00f71b90fc2b.latin: Ant. Me suscépit * déxtera tua, Dómine.
3eaefcab00f71b90fc2b.english: Ant. Thy right hand * upholdeth me.

ef9f80498016ee9a3a25.latin: Ant. Me suscépit déxtera tua, Dómine.
ef9f80498016ee9a3a25.english: Ant. Thy right hand upholdeth me.

a33c102b7d387abb501b.latin: Ant. A porta ínferi * érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
a33c102b7d387abb501b.english: Ant. From the gates of hell * deliver my soul, O Lord.

0b104c7abcf22dbffcc8.latin: 38:10 Ego dixi: In dimídio diérum meórum * vadam ad portas ínferi.
0b104c7abcf22dbffcc8.english: 38:10 I said: In the midst of my days * I shall go to the gates of hell:

dfed83d2686414bd0ae6.latin: 38:11 Quæsívi resíduum annórum meórum. * Dixi: Non vidébo Dóminum Deum in terra vivéntium.
dfed83d2686414bd0ae6.english: 38:11 I sought for the residue of my years. * I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living.

48fd1d19c3c9803f5a50.latin: 38:12 Non aspíciam hóminem ultra, * et habitatórem quiétis.
48fd1d19c3c9803f5a50.english: 38:12 I shall behold man no more, * nor the inhabitant of rest.

26a3b8c33a9c782e770a.latin: 38:13 Generátio mea abláta est, et convolúta est a me, * quasi tabernáculum pastórum.
26a3b8c33a9c782e770a.english: 38:13 My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, * as a shepherd’s tent.

50cd65e1b29788580e9f.latin: 38:14 Præcísa est velut a texénte, vita mea: dum adhuc ordírer, succídit me: * de mane usque ad vésperam fínies me.
50cd65e1b29788580e9f.english: 38:14 My life is cut off, as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, he cut me off: * from morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me.

b49ee8fc37690e200ade.latin: 38:15 Sperábam usque ad mane, * quasi leo sic contrívit ómnia ossa mea:
b49ee8fc37690e200ade.english: 38:15 I hoped till morning, * as a lion so hath he broken all my bones:

9e1b2f6a71cf96556a2e.latin: 38:16 De mane usque ad vésperam fínies me: * sicut pullus hirúndinis sic clamábo, meditábor ut colúmba:
9e1b2f6a71cf96556a2e.english: 38:16 From morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me. * I will cry like a young swallow, I will meditate like a dove:

d080c3ce718dd924aab0.latin: 38:17 Attenuáti sunt óculi mei, * suspiciéntes in excélsum.
d080c3ce718dd924aab0.english: 38:17 My eyes are weakened * looking upward:

1ab15a960d930451c5e1.latin: 38:18 Dómine, vim pátior, respónde pro me. * Quid dicam, aut quid respondébit mihi, cum ipse fécerit?
1ab15a960d930451c5e1.english: 38:18 Lord, I suffer violence, answer thou for me. * What shall I say, or what shall he answer for me, whereas he himself hath done it?

2f9a07f4022a4b0d9dfc.latin: 38:19 Recogitábo tibi omnes annos meos * in amaritúdine ánimæ meæ.
2f9a07f4022a4b0d9dfc.english: 38:19 I will recount to thee all my years * in the bitterness of my soul.

9b64f24c7bbc61e4c694.latin: 38:20 Dómine, si sic vívitur, et in tálibus vita spíritus mei, corrípies me, et vivificábis me. * Ecce, in pace amaritúdo mea amaríssima:
9b64f24c7bbc61e4c694.english: 38:20 O Lord, if man’s life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, thou shalt correct me, and make me to live. * Behold in peace is my bitterness most bitter:

098155e81b998f36602b.latin: 38:21 Tu autem eruísti ánimam meam ut non períret: * proiecísti post tergum tuum ómnia peccáta mea.
098155e81b998f36602b.english: 38:21 But thou hast delivered my soul that it should not perish, * thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

22134a5b40ac2ec6ceb2.latin: 38:22 Quia non inférnus confitébitur tibi, neque mors laudábit te: * non exspectábunt qui descéndunt in lacum, veritátem tuam.
22134a5b40ac2ec6ceb2.english: 38:22 For hell shall not confess to thee, neither shall death praise thee: * nor shall they that go down into the pit, look for thy truth.

dbf2f358f760ecbaa0ff.latin: 38:23 Vivens vivens ipse confitébitur tibi, sicut et ego hódie: * pater fíliis notam fáciet veritátem tuam.
dbf2f358f760ecbaa0ff.english: 38:23 The living, the living, he shall give praise to thee, as I do this day: * the father shall make thy truth known to the children.

ce65449c109e75fc3792.latin: 38:24 Dómine, salvum me fac * et psalmos nostros cantábimus cunctis diébus vitæ nostræ in domo Dómini.
ce65449c109e75fc3792.english: 38:24 O Lord, save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life * in the house of the Lord.

7cae5b42b4e3d90d9ab1.latin: Ant. A porta ínferi érue, Dómine, ánimam meam.
7cae5b42b4e3d90d9ab1.english: Ant. From the gates of hell deliver my soul, O Lord.

30a500b99c0f4d1a7135.english: Ant. Let everything that hath breath * praise the Lord.

3f004b3bcc962e59a047.english: Ant. Let everything that hath breath praise the Lord.

a03f2c60e4d1759bfd96.english: Verse (taking the place of the Chapter)

9422f76dbb6c8cf6399e.latin: ℣. Audívi vocem de cælo dicéntem mihi.
9422f76dbb6c8cf6399e.english: ℣. I heard a voice from heaven, saying unto me:

cf420adde2892982ca1e.latin: ℟. Beáti mórtui qui in Dómino moriúntur.
cf420adde2892982ca1e.english: ℟. Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord.

2afe3a4cde1bd63c55d8.latin: Ant. Ego sum * resurréctio et vita: qui credit in me, étiam si mórtuus fúerit, vivet; et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non moriétur in ætérnum.
2afe3a4cde1bd63c55d8.english: Ant. I am the resurrection and the life: * he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die.

da3e67a7b17fe947a2f0.latin: Ant. Ego sum resurréctio et vita: qui credit in me, étiam si mórtuus fúerit, vivet; et omnis qui vivit et credit in me, non moriétur in ætérnum.
da3e67a7b17fe947a2f0.english: Ant. I am the resurrection and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live; and whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die.

85ff6ddd742a37f83b6c.latin: Súpplices, Dómine, pro animábus ómnium famulórum famularúmque tuárum preces effúndimus: ut, quidquid conversatióne contraxérunt humána, clemens indúlgeas, et pœnis eórum finem benígnus impónas.
85ff6ddd742a37f83b6c.english: We suppliants, O Lord, pour forth our prayers for the souls of all thy servants and handmaids, that thou wouldst mercifully pardon whatsoever they have committed through human frailty, and graciously vouchsafe to deliver them from the pains of purgatory.

c183dc93aa640ff68e87.latin: Tértio Nonas Novémbris Luna vicésima tértia. Anno Dómini 2026
c183dc93aa640ff68e87.english: November 3rd 2026, the 23rd day of the Moon,

fe27ffd0f72f38c6a3bf.latin: Hac die Commemorátio ómnium Fidélium Defunctórum; in qua commúnis pia Mater Ecclésia, postquam univérsos fílios suos iam in cælo lætántes cóngruis stúduit celebráre præcóniis, mox et omnes adhuc in Purgatório geméntes válidis apud Dóminum et Sponsum Christum satágit suffrágiis adiuváre, ut quam cítius váleant ad societátem supernórum cívium perveníre.
fe27ffd0f72f38c6a3bf.english: On this day, the Commemoration of all the Faithful Departed, on which day Holy Church, their common Mother, after due diligence to celebrate with fitting praise all her children who now rejoice in heaven, doth strive also to assist by her prayers all them that suffer still in Purgatory, which are of avail before Christ, her Lord and Spouse, in order that as speedily as possible they may join the society of the citizens on high.

a4c72c83b213868fbda0.latin: Medioláni natális sancti Cároli Borromǽi Cardinális, Epíscopi Mediolanénsis et Confessóris, quem, sanctitáte conspícuum et miráculis clarum, Paulus Papa Quintus in sanctórum númerum rétulit. Ipsíus tamen festívitas sequénti die celebrátur.
a4c72c83b213868fbda0.english: On the morrow we keep in England the feast of the holy Virgin and martyr Winefrid.

ead31961b6d9b6c0615e.latin: Eódem die natális quoque sancti Quarti, Apostolórum discípuli.
ead31961b6d9b6c0615e.english: Upon the same 3rd day of November, were also born into the better life:

eaaf9bdc53826a6db4ad.latin: Vitérbii sanctórum Mártyrum Valentíni Presbýteri, et Hilárii Diáconi, qui, in persecutióne Maximiáni, ob Christi fidem, cum saxi póndere in Tíberim præcipitáti et inde ab Angelo divínitus erépti, demum, abscíssis cervícibus, corónam martýrii percepérunt.
eaaf9bdc53826a6db4ad.english: Holy Quartus, the disciple of the Apostles.

209ed80e3f691b1d4a19.latin: Cæsaréæ, in Cappadócia, sanctórum Mártyrum Germáni, Theóphili, Cæsárii et Vitális; qui, in persecutióne Deciána, óptime duxérunt martýrium.
209ed80e3f691b1d4a19.english: At Caesarea, in Cappadocia, the holy martyrs Germanus, Theophilus, Caesarius, and Vitalis, who bore a noble testimony in the persecution under the Emperor Decius.

8948b4e781eb6ac7b026.latin: Cæsaraugústæ, in Hispánia, sanctórum innumerabílium Mártyrum, qui, sub Hispaniárum Prǽside Daciáno, mirabíliter occubuérunt pro Christo.
8948b4e781eb6ac7b026.english: At Saragossa, countless holy martyrs, who wondrously laid down their lives for Christ's sake under Dacian, President of Spain, (in the year 304.)

ac05c77eeb2ae165276c.latin: In Anglia sanctæ Wenefrídæ, Vírginis et Mártyris.
ac05c77eeb2ae165276c.english: At Viterbo, the holy martyrs Valentine the Priest and Hilary the Deacon, who, in the persecution under the Emperor Maximian, were for Christ's faith's sake cast into the Tiber weighted with stones, but by the will of God were thence delivered by an Angel, and received the crown of martyrdom by being beheaded.

b42d7fc470032096a338.latin: In monastério Clarævallénsi, in Gállia, deposítio sancti Malachíæ, Connerthénsis in Hibérnia Epíscopi, qui multis virtútibus suo témpore cláruit; cuius vitam sanctus Bernárdus Abbas conscrípsit.
b42d7fc470032096a338.english: At the monastery of Clairvaux, (in the year 1148,) holy Maleachlan, Archbishop of Armagh, in Ireland, who in his time shone with many graces, and whose life hath been written by the holy Abbot Bernard.

ae2f98753830319d54ed.latin: Eódem die sancti Hubérti, Tungrénsis Epíscopi.
ae2f98753830319d54ed.english: On the same day, (in the year 727,) holy Hubert, Bishop of Tongres.

483f07032b9e7c288244.latin: Viénnæ, in Gállia, sancti Domni, Epíscopi et Confessóris.
483f07032b9e7c288244.english: At Vienne, (in the sixth century,) holy Domnus, Bishop (of that see.)

a15171c79872f72a777b.latin: Item deposítio sancti Pirmíni, Meldénsis Epíscopi.
a15171c79872f72a777b.english: Likewise (in the year 755,) holy Pirmin, Bishop of Meaux.

1bab20afb0fcf518528f.latin: Urgéllæ, in Hispánia Tarraconénsi, sancti Hermengáudii Epíscopi.
1bab20afb0fcf518528f.english: At Urgel, in Spain, holy Hermengaudus, Bishop (of that see.)

718cea4bdb9b1dc6f7a8.latin: Romæ sanctæ Sílviæ, matris sancti Gregórii Papæ.
718cea4bdb9b1dc6f7a8.english: At Rome, holy Sylvia, the mother of holy Pope Gregory.

f2f66cdd580680968f57.english: ℣. The just shall be in everlasting remembrance.

f2ac62e3bbca124802d8.english: ℟. They will not fear from hearing evil.

98f5c530ed90ae9fc529.latin: Deus, véniæ largítor et humánæ salútis amátor: quǽsumus cleméntiam tuam; ut ánimas ómnium fidélium qui ex hoc sǽculo transiérunt, beáta María semper Vírgine intercedénte cum ómnibus Sanctis tuis, ad perpétuæ beatitúdinis consórtium perveníre concédas. Per Christum Dóminum nostrum.
98f5c530ed90ae9fc529.english: O God the giver of pardon, and the lover of human salvation, we beseech thy clemency: that thou grant the brethren of our congregation, kinsfolk, and benefactors, which are departed out of this world, blessed Mary ever Virgin making intercession with all the saints, to come to the fellowship of eternal blessedness. Through Christ our Lord.

603ba6a5ec5f75d36e5f.latin: Ant. Placébo Dómino * in regióne vivórum.
603ba6a5ec5f75d36e5f.english: Ant. I will walk before the Lord * in the land of the living.

492c7bb9ee993cfda73d.latin: Ant. Placébo Dómino in regióne vivórum.
492c7bb9ee993cfda73d.english: Ant. I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

79abf1fb808d5e4cf184.latin: Ant. Heu mihi Dómine, * quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
79abf1fb808d5e4cf184.english: Ant. Woe is me! O Lord, * that my sojourn is long.

a691d304b098f26f81d7.latin: Ant. Heu mihi Dómine, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est.
a691d304b098f26f81d7.english: Ant. Woe is me! O Lord, that my sojourn is long.

cb415f5ad96403daa755.latin: Ant. Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
cb415f5ad96403daa755.english: Ant. The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, * the Lord shall keep thy soul.

cc214400c6bb57f29a26.latin: Ant. Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
cc214400c6bb57f29a26.english: Ant. The Lord shall keep thee from all evil, the Lord shall keep thy soul.

7501b3f2863eda10b23b.latin: Ant. Si iniquitátes * observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
7501b3f2863eda10b23b.english: Ant. If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, * O Lord, who shall stand.

b987240aa5cb08097957.latin: Ant. Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: Dómine, quis sustinébit?
b987240aa5cb08097957.english: Ant. If Thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand.

3528bf018078600ab273.latin: Ant. Opera * mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
3528bf018078600ab273.english: Ant. O Lord, forsake not * the works of thine own hands.

a10b44cb1ce4a8b33131.latin: Ant. Opera mánuum tuárum, Dómine, ne despícias.
a10b44cb1ce4a8b33131.english: Ant. O Lord, forsake not the works of thine own hands.

dab12afc7e9885a26991.latin: Ant. Omne * quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
dab12afc7e9885a26991.english: Ant. All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; * and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

8f64383a1d056747a93f.latin: Ant. Omne quod dat mihi Pater, ad me véniet; et eum qui venit ad me, non eíciam foras.
8f64383a1d056747a93f.english: Ant. All that the Father giveth Me shall come to Me; and him that cometh to Me I will in no wise cast out.

457094fbdfa70574a4c7.latin: 2:29 Nunc dimíttis ✠ servum tuum, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum in pace:
457094fbdfa70574a4c7.english: 2:29 Now ✠ thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, * according to thy word in peace;

d2cc0f1d1fd9d75d5585.latin: 2:30 Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,
d2cc0f1d1fd9d75d5585.english: 2:30 Because my eyes have seen * thy salvation,

2ce6ecf7c323c0944db8.latin: 2:31 Quod parásti * ante fáciem ómnium populórum,
2ce6ecf7c323c0944db8.english: 2:31 Which thou hast prepared * before the face of all peoples:

545199dc6a346e0d9477.latin: 2:32 Lumen ad revelatiónem géntium, * et glóriam plebis tuæ Israël.
545199dc6a346e0d9477.english: 2:32 A light to the revelation of the Gentiles, * and the glory of thy people Israel.

614e81aa2fd2771fdb80.latin: Propitiáre, quǽsumus, Dómine, animábus ómnium famulórum famularúmque tuárum, pro quibus maiestátem tuam supplíciter exorámus: ut, per hæc piæ deprecatiónis offícia, perveníre mereántur ad réquiem sempitérnam.
614e81aa2fd2771fdb80.english: We beseech you, O Lord, to be merciful to the souls of all your servants and handmaids for whom we humbly entreat your majesty, that by these offices of pious supplication they may be found worthy to enter into everlasting rest.
